dpe bskrun gsal bshad/kha ba ri bas yongs su bskor ba'i bod dang bod chen po'i ljongs su nye bar mkho ba'i bod rigs rnams ni rang rgyal gyi lo rgyus yun ring ldan pa'i mi rigs rlabs chen zhig yin la/rlabs chen gyi mes rgyal gsar gtod byed pa'i go rim nang du byas rjes 'od stong 'bar ba bzhag yod cing / lo rgyus 'phel rgyas ring bo'i nang du bod kyi rig gnas kyis gces su 'os pa'i mes rgyal gyi rig gnas bang mdzod chen po'i nang du rtsa 'gengs che ba'i gnas phun sum tshogs ba zhig bzung yod/tang gi —skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa tshogs pa nas bzung tang gi mi rigs srid jus sor chud dang dngos 'bebs yang dag ba byas bar brten/mi rigs slob gso dang mi rigs rig gnas kyi phyogs

gang thad nas dkar phyoges kyi zla ba'i dpal la 'gran pa ltar yar rgyas gong 'phel du 'gro dang 'gro bzhin yod skabs 'di dag tu blo gros kyi stobs rtsal rab tu rgyas shing /rnam dpyod kyi mche sder rab tu rno ba'i bod rigs na gzhon dag gis lo rgyus dang sgrung gtam/gtam brjod/snyan tshig sogs brjod pa gsal ba'i ngag gi rol mo 'gog pa med par 'dzam gling yangs pos khyon kun 'gengs par byas pa dang / deng yang zi khron dkar mdzes khul gyi lha rtse dgon pa'i lha rtse mkhan chen rin po che'i yang sprul dkon mchog bsam gtan rin po che mchog nyid kyis bod kyi rig gnas dar spel dang mi rigs mthun sgril rgyal khab bde 'jags yong ba bcas kyi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i ngang / bstan 'gror sman pa'i snyan rtsom dri za'i phang 'gro'i rgyud las drangs pa sna tshogs snga phyir ljags rtsom mdzad pa re 'ga' phyogs4 bsdus su bkod pa'i deb〈 snyan rtsom lhag bsam dkar bo'i rang mdangs〉zhes bya

ba 'di ni/ dad ldan skyes bu rnams kyi re ba bskong ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rmongs pa'i skye bo rnams kyi blo mun sel ba'i nyin byed gzur gnas mkhas pa rnams kyi rna ba dgyes ba'i bdud rtsi/ na gzhon slob ma rnams kyi zur lta'i tshul du blo gros kyi sgo 'byed du 'gro ba zhig yin pas/ 'dir dpe bskrun byed pa ni kun la sman pa'i don bzang bla na med pa zhig tu snyam mo/ 7zhes2000lo'i spyi'i zla11tshes26nyin bse tshang blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje'i ming can nas 'phral du bris pa'o//

rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus rags bsdus/rtsom pa po mgo log dkon mchog bsam gtan ni spyi lo 1964lor mgo log gcig sgril rdzong lung dkar sde bar 'khrungs/ chung dus nas yi ge 'bri klog dang sdeb sbyor/ cho ga sogs la byang bar gyur/de rjes mdo smad bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du 'ong nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen mo rje 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho dang /rje mgo log tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ rje blo bzang rgya mtsho sogs kyi zhal snga nas tshad ma dang phar phyin/ dbu ma dang mdzod dang lam rim sogs kyi khrid rgyun legs par gsan/ khyad par du mkhas pa'i dbang bo dmu dge bsam gtan rgya mtsho dang / rje 'jam dbyangs nyi ma/ rje blo bzang rgya mtsho sogs kyi mdun nas dbyangs can sgra ṭīka tshar gnyis dang /sgra ka la pā dang /sdeb sbyor gyi skor sna tshogs/ rtsis dkar nag sogs dang / sa dpyad rig pa/gzhan yang /snyan ngag yang gsal snang mdzod/dbyangs can dgyes glu/ bod mkhas snyan ngag daṇ+ḍi'i dgongs

rgyan dang / tshangs sras bzhad pa'i sgra dbyangs sogs dang / pra ti dang si tu'i sum rtags/ gser tog sum rtags dang blo gsal 'jug ngogs dang dga' ston sogs kyi khrid rgyun zhib mor gsan bzhes mdzad/de nas zi khron dkar mdzes sa khul gyi gser lha rtse dgon chen gyi skyabs mgon rin po che lha rtse sangs rgyas dpal ldan gyi dgon de'i mkhan chen bsod nams dbang phyug gi skye sprul du ngos 'dzin mdzad/deng sang kun su'u zhing chen bod kyi shes rig lhan tshogs su phyag las gnang bzhin rgya dbyin 'jar gsum gyi yig rigs sogs la sbyangs pa gnang bzhin bzhugs/ thengs mang bor 〈 bod ljongs zhib 'jug〉dang 〈 bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉kan lho'i 〈 zla zer〉dang 〈 spang rgyan me tog〉sogs kyi steng du rtsom rigs bzhi cu lhag spel gnang mdzad do/7zhes mgo log lha ris pa dge slong shes rab rgya statshos2000lo'i zla11tshes26bzang po la bris/

ched du zhu ba'i mchid/gangs can bod kyi rig gnas la mi dman pa'i blo gros ldan zhing lhag bsam dkar pa'i dam pa gang gi drung du/zhu bar bya ba'i snying bo ni/ 'di ltar/ de yang phran gyis brtsams pa'i 〈 snyan rtsom lhag bsam dkar bo'i rang mdangs 〉zhes pa'i dpe deb phyogs bsgrigs kyi brjod bya'i nang don rob tsam zhu na/thog mar deb 'di 'bri dgos pa'i dmigs yul lam dgos pa ni bod kyi rig gzhung spyi dang khyad par du snyan ngag rig gnas la blo kha mngon du phyogs pa'i deng rabs blo gsal gzhon nu rnams kyi chu tshad dang mthun zhing bod gangs can gyi gna' bo'i srol rgyun snyan ngag gi khyad chos dang ldan zhing brjod bya deng rabs spyi tshogs dang tshan rig sogs dang kun nas mtshungs par byas pa yin la/ rjod byed tshig gi ngo gdong thad nas gsal zhing go sla la snyan zhing brjod bde ba sogs kyi khyad chos du ma 'bur du thon zhing gson nyams ldan par

byas yod/gtso bo nang don gyi skor la/ dper na/ sum rtags sogs rig gnas kyi dka' ba'i gnad la 〈 gangs can bod kyi sgra rig nyer mkho blo gsal dgyes pa'i mgul rgyan 〉lta bu dang /snyan ngag gi skor la 〈don rgyan so lnga'i dper brjod thog ma'i blo sgo 'byed pa'i lde mig〉 sogs dang / mgur glu'i skor la 〈gangs ri'i gnas bstod〉 dang 〈lha gcig kong jo bod du phebs pa 〉〈 rang byung sems las brdol ba'i chu mig〉sogs dang /lo rgyus dang sbyar ba'i snyan ngag gi skor la〈 rgyal bo rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod khrod kyi btsun mo sī ta'i mdzes sdug la bsngags pa〉 dang 〈 nan te ri bo gru 'dzin gyi thugs rje chen po la gsol ba 'debs pa nyam chung bung ba rtsen pa'i gshog glu〉 sogs dang /bla ma'i gdung 'bod sogs kyi skor la 〈 paṇa chen dran pa'i gdung dbyangs〉 dang 〈 gangs ljongs bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan gung thang rin po che'i gdung dbyangs gsol 'debs nyam chung bung ba skyo bas gshog glu〉sogs dang / khyad chos

'bur du thon pa'i yul ljongs nyams 'bri sogs kyi skor la 〈 dpal gyi chos 'khor lha sa〉dang 〈 mtsho sngon por lta skor tu phyin pa'i mthong thos〉〈 bod〉dang 〈 nga yi pha yul gnyis pa bla brang 〉dang 〈myu thang bu mo'i glu sgra〉sogs dang /chos gzhung gi skor la 〈 lha mo dbyangs can ma la zung ldan gyi sgo nas rgya cher bstod pa 〉dang 〈 dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po gang nyid dran pa'i gsol 'debs〉sogs kyi mtshon pas khyon bsdoms tshan pa bdun bcu lhag dang / tsheg khyim yi ge khri bco lnga tsam yod la/ tshig sbyor snyan zhing brjod bya spyi tshogs kyi 'bab dang bstun te bris pa lags pas khyed mkhyen dpyod yangs pas gzigs phebs gnang rogs zhu/7mjug mthar bkra shis bde legs yong bas smon 'dun dang bcas sprul ming ba mgo log dkon mchog bsam gtan gyis nyis stong lo'i zla tshes dge bar bris pa'o/

thog ma'i gleng bslangs ba/stong chen 'gyur med 'od gsal chos kyi dbyings//thugs rje ma 'gag nyi zla'i 'od snang 'dzum//rig pa'i khyung chen lding pa'i gshog 'gyur las//legs bshad dbyangs snyan 'byin pa'i mgon de rgyal//kai la sha ri'i phreng ba'i zlum por bskor//sa la'i sman ljongs me tog dud pa'i tshal//srong btsan mi rje'i 'phrin las 'od stong gis //bod yul mun pa'i smag chen drungs nas 'byin//rnam dpyod g.yu yi ral klong mkha' la bsigs//mdo sngags mkhyen pa'i lus kyi zung stobs rgyas//gangs can sgra rig stong gi gad rgyangs bsgrags//thon mi gdong lnga'i dbang po phyag gi yul//shong dpang yab sras bde 'byung ral ba'i tshal//

legs 'ong snyan ngag gang gā lha yi chab//nga cag bod mi'i bsod nams bgo skal du//thob pas gzhung 'di cung zad spel na snyam//bdag yid gces 'dzin thig le'i gur khyim du//sgra don nyams brgya'i sgeg pa'i smin legs ma//snyan tshig mdzes pa'i 'dzum dkar ngom bzhin du//blo gsal gzhon nu dgyes pa'i grogs su rtsen//gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba mkhas pa'i tshogs//cung zad ngal gso'i rkang stegs 'di na mchis//lnga rig lang tsho'i dregs pa'i smin 'khyogs ma//cung zad mdzes pa'i zur mig 'di na ngom//blo gsal dga' ba'i 'jug ngogs yin gyi gting dpog dka' ba'i chu gter min//rang blo 'phel ba'i sbrang char yin gyi dregs pa'i thog zhags 'khyugs pa min//sgra don nyams brgya'i zlos gar yin gyi 'gran 'dod g.yo sgyu'i sgeg 'gros min//lha ga bsam dkar bo'i rang mdangs yin gyi grags

'dod dbyar gyi rnga gsang min//rnam dpyod mnyen lcugs gshog pas gar rtse zhing //snyan ngag mgrin pa'i rdza rnga 'khrol ba'i tshogs//'di na bdag blo pad ma'i khrus rdzing du//smin legs 'dab stong mdzes pa'i grogs su longs//7zhes gzhung 'di'i rtsom pa po dkon mchog bsam gtan du 'bod pas nyis stong lo'i gnam lo gsar ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba dang bo'i nyin rang shag dga' ba'i skyed tshal du bris so//

dkar chagatshan pa dang po/ dad pa'i lha dar dkar po/slob dpon mchog gi mdzad rjes bskal brgyar dran/ (3)tshangs sras dga' ma la 'dod don gsol ba bung ba gzhon nu'i gshog sgra (7)yi ge'i byed po slob dpon a nu'i bka' drin rjes su dran pa lus dkar mgrin pa'i dril chung / (10)nan he ri bo gru 'dzin gyi thugs rje chen mo la gsol ba 'debs pa nyam chung bung ba rtsen pa'i gshog glu (13)lha mo dbyangs can ma la zung ldan gyi sgo nas rgya cher bstod pa/ (20)rig pa dang grol ba'i yon tan gyi mdzod 'dzin 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde la snyan ngag gi gzugs rgyan nyi shu'i sgo nas bstod pa/ (25)rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i ngo bo dbyangs can ma la 'dod don gsol ba/ ( rte3)

dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po gang nyid dran pa'i gsol 'debs zhu 'phrin bung ba rtsen pa'i gshog sgra (37)tshan pa gnyis pa/ skyo gdung mchi ma'i do shal/paṇa chen dran pa'i gdung dbyangs/ (45)gangs ljongs bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan gung thang khri rin po che'i gdung dbyangs gsol 'debs nyam chung bung ba skyo bas gasna ga glu (48)dri med kyi zla ba dkar bo/ (53)bdag gi slob dpon/ (56)dran pa'i mig chu/ (57)gdung 'bod co ku'i mgrin sgra (62)rje 'jam dbyangs bla ma gang gi mdzad pa'i bka' drin rjes su dran pa/ (64)tshan pa gsum pa/ bstod dbyangs dri za'i 'gyur khugadapal gyi chos 'khor lha sa/ (73)me tog skyed tshal gyi glu (77)

bdag gi ma yum slob grwa (81)kun lho'i zla zer dus deb la bstod pa/ (83/dben pa'i gnas ri yid dga' chos 'phe' gling gi khyad chos/ (85)grogs la sbon pa'i mchid lhag bsam dkar bo'i rang mdangs/ (88/bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal dus deb la bstod pa/ (91)rgyal bo rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod khrod kyi btsun mo sī ta'i mdzes sdug la bsngags pa/ (95)lha bzo zhig gi ngo mtshar ba'i lag rtsal la bsngags pa/ (101)dus tshigs rnam bzhi (105)bod kyi yul ljongs la bsngags pa khu byug myos pa'i gdangs glu (108)mgo log sa khul gyi gnyan po g.yu rtse'i snod bcud kyi yon tan cung zad brjod pa/ (110)kun lho sa khul gyi drug pa'i shing slong la bsngags pa'i gtam/ (119)bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi 'du khang chen mo bskyar bzhengs

legs grub byung ba'i dga' ston/ (121)ma hā tsi na'i lho phyogs kyi grong khyer chen mo hrang he'i ngo mtshar ba'i rnam pa gsar ba/ (127)bod yul skyid pa'i mdzes ljongs la bstod pa/ (1 31)nub byang mi rigs slob gling dbu brnyes nas lo 'khor lnga bcu lon pa'i dga' ston rten 'brel du phul ba/ (133)bod kyi ri chu la bsngags pa'i gtam bung ba bzi bas gshog glu (140)rgya yul lho phyogs kyi ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i yul gru su'u dbang rnam gnyis kyi khyad chos mdo tsam brjod pa/ (142)bod kyi lo gsar/ (145)sems las 'phros pa'i gtam/ (147)gangs rgyan chos rig tshags par bklag rjes gyi gtam/ (149)tshan pa bzhi pa/ bya dka'i rgyan tshig gzhig bral rdo rje'i mdud grol/nga yi pha yul gnyis pa bla brang / 4 (153)rtswa thang bu mo'i glu sgra (155)

lha gcig kong jo bod du phebs pa/ (156)rang byung sems las brdol ba'i chu mis (/59)yid/ (160)'khor ba/ (162)tshan pa lnga ba/ mgur dbyangs co ba'i drug 'gyur/mtsho sngon por lta skor tu phyin pa'i mthong thos (165/dngul rwa lha sde'i dpyis me tog thang gi mthong thos (166/skyo glu (168)bod/ (169)rgan rgya'i mkhar nang / (171)gangs ri'i gnas bstod/ (176)bdag chung ngu'i dus su/ (173)mi rtag ngag mgur/ (176)slob mar gdams pa'i bslab bya/ (180)nga yi pha yul/ (182)smug rlangs khrod kyi ri grong / (184)

lhag bsam a ma'i 'dzum mdangs/ (186)mdo dbus mtho sgang / (188)rang gi chos grogs zhig la phul ba'i ka rtsom/ (191)skyes su 'os pa'i pha yul gyi rnam pa gsar ba/ (19 2)dga' skyo 'dres ma'i ngag mgur/ (198)zhu yig ko ki la yi dbyangs snyan/ (201〉mdzes pa'i slob grwa 'di ru/ (203)grogs la blangs pa'i ka mgur/ (201)pha sa pha yul gcig pa'i spun zla tsho/ (206)tshan pa drug pa/ lhug rtsom nor bu'i do shal/kun lho sa khul gyi bsang gi rta rgyugs/ (211)tshan pa bdun pa/ dpyad rtsom rig pa'i rtsed 'jo/dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i bod rigs slob grwa chen mo rnams kyis bod kyi rig gnas dang skad yig skor la 'dzin pa'i lta stangs cung zad brjod pa/ (223)bod gangs can gyi lha ris sgyu rtsal skor cung zad brjod pa

skal bzang gzhon nu dgyes pa'i 'jus ngogs/ 2 rte rte)dus rabs nyi shu'i lam la brtson pa/ra bskul ba rkang ba drug pa'i glu dbyangs/ (216)tshan pa brgyad pa/ snyan gzhung bdung rtsi'i thigs pa/snyan ngag gi gzhung las don rgyan so lnga'i dper brjod thog ma'i blo sgo 'byed pa'i lde mig (251)snyan ngag gi gzhung las zung ldan gyi rnam bzhag bshad pa dbyangs can gzhon nu dgyes pa'i 'dzum zer/ ( 347)gangs can bod kyi sgra rig nyer mkho blo gsal dgyes pa'i maṭa/la rgyan/ (‘rte70)tshan pa dgu pa/ lo rgyus rgyal khams lta ba'i me long /yun nan sa khul gyi gnas ri khyad 'phags can spyi dang khyad par du gnas mchog ri bo bya rkang phugs kyi ngo mtshar ba'i lo rgyus kyi mthong snang cung zad brjod pa tshangs chen mes po'i 6nal tha/nga zhes bya ba/ (379)mjug tu brjod pa'i gtam/ ( /72)
dad pa'i lha dar darka /de — —— — ljon gu dad ngapo /

— ngadapa'i dar rapo / de— —— 3 /deslob dpon mchog gi mdzad rjes bskal brgyar dran/ (mkhas dbang sprul ba'i sku rin po che bse tshang blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rjer phul ba/)nyin byed bye ba'i mdangs kyis legs 'khyud mtshams sprin gsar ba'i rtse dga' 'bum//mdza' bor sdebs pa mtshan dpe'i lang tsho bcu drug gzhon nu'i nyams kyis sgeg /rmongs mun dra ba kun nas gcod byed shes rab ral gri mkha' la rtsen//brtan pa'i 'khor lo ngag gi dbang phyug bdag yid thig ler dgyes par rol//bcu phrag shes bya gangs ri'i zom na rnam dpyod g.yu yi ral klung bsigs//rig lam gsar ba rno ba'i mche sder phas rgol glang bo'i klad 'gems pa//

༅ngang lha tsho4 bsamang྾ zhirangamangangs ——nang gi rim gnyis lam gyi rtogs pa rtsal gsum lus kyi gzi mdangs rdzogs//dpal ldan bla ma gdong lnga'i dbang po dad gsum rab bas mchod la spro/ /gangs can bho ṭa'i rig gzhung phal cher snum zad mar me'i zlar gyur dus//brtse chen 'gyur med thugs rje'i ma bzod bgrang yas legs bshad dga' ba'i char//kun nas 'bebs mdzad skyo ngal dang bral 'gags med gsung gi rnga gsang 'bum//dus gcig ldir bas skal ldan blo gsal mdongs mtha'i bu mo dga' bas myos//mdo sngags rab 'byams dka' ba'i gnad kun thogs med 'chad mkhas ri gzar klung //tshul gsum tshad mas sgro 'dogs kun bcad rtsod na dmar 'od glog gi gar//tshig sbyor yid 'phrog snying bo'i bcud ldan rtsom na dbyangs can phang 'gro'i sgra//

— —— ———nga5༅74 — nga༅— —nga—— —༷ngagro 'chad rtsod rtsom la 'gran pa'i zla bral rig pa'i khyung chen phyag gi yul//nang gi rtogs pa klong bzhin brdol bas mdo sngags shes bya mkhyen pas mkhas//sdom gsum rnam bzhag mig 'bras ltar bsru ngas tshul khrims dri ngad ldang bas btsun//rang gzhan kun phan dpag bsam shing bzhin 'gro kun thugs rjes 'khyud pas bzang //mkhas btsun bzang gsum yon tan kun rdzobs gangs ri'i ljongs kyi rta bdun lags//'gro ba'i bsod nams zhing gi dpal du sras mkhar dgu thog legs par bzhengs//blo gsal slob bu re re'i blo la shes bya'i nor gyis legs par gtams//rig grol 'phags pa'i dge 'dun tshogs rnams smin cing grol ba'i lam la 'god//smra ba'i rgyal bo shes bya kun mkhyen gangs can sā la'i rgyan du brjid//

——༅go ༷༷ sgrarwargyo4sgya44da༄3 4 dwa5sa ——— ca4 4 snga na med pa'i legs bshad mchog gyur tshangs sras bshad pa'i sgra dbyangs ni/ /brjod bya don gyi snying bo zab brling rjod byed tshig gi sdeb legs snyan//go sla'i ngag gis dka' gnad mdud grol skal ldan blo gsal mtshams pa'i bzhung / /khrid rgyun rnam gnyis 'grel ba rab gsal yon tan du ma'i phyug pa lags/ /ri bo dge ldan grub mtha'i rnam bzhag zhwa ser bstan pa'i dpal du 'dzum//'dren mchog shāka seng don gyis rab bsngags khyad par 'phags pa'i bstod 'grel sogs/ /gangs ljongs bstan pa'i nor 'dzin dpyid du legs gsungs chos kyi sbrang char 'bum//kun nas 'jo mdzad rig ba'i khu byug chos srid zung gi bstan pa spel//blo gros dman zhing sbyangs pa chung ba'i 'khos bral gzhon nu'i yid sgo nas/ /

————ཿnga'iḥ4 ༅—— —— —gsol ba rtse gcig 'debs pa'i 'bras bu nyid sku yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal//gangs ljongs 'gro ba'i zhing sa dam par bskal brgyar g.yo med rtag brtan zhing //chos srid zung gi rlabs chen bya ba'i rgyal mtshan mkha' la sgrengs gyur cig/7zhes gan lho rang skyong khul rig rtsal lhan tshogs kyis bod ris pa'i mkhas chen dam pa/bse tshang )sprul ba'i sku rin po che blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi jo rje'i rig gzhung dpyad gleng tshogs 'du bde legs ngang 'grub par bkra shis bde legs zhu ba'i smon tshig dang bcas nyis stong lo'i zla1tshes24nyin bris//tshangs sras dga' ma la 'dod don gsol ba byang ba gzhon nu'i gshog sgra zhes bya ba//'di nas 'bum phrag yul gyi bskal ba'i sar/lho phyogs dri za'i dga' tshal 'o ma'i mtshor/tshangs pa'i sras mo ngang ba'i na chung ma//gdung ba'i yus kyis 'bod pa gsan lags sam//

— — rwa 4nga— rtsom— 4da raḥ444ྈ———phra ldem lus dkar 'jog sgeg nyams brgya'i rtser//dgyes 'dzum zhal ras pad mo dasod pa'i dbus//gnag snum smin 'khyog bung ba'i zur mig gis//yid kyi thig le 'jo mdzad tshangs sras kye//'di na ma rig mun pa'i khung bu ru//blo gros snang ba'i 'dren byed mi ldan zhing //tshogs gnyis zong gis dbul ba'i gus ldan zhig /gyi nar 'khyams pa thugs rjes gzigs min nam//dbyibs legs byu ru'i mchu 'dab grol ba'i dbus//dgyes 'dzum dkar ba'i tshems phreng mthong na dga'//de las 'ong ba'i snyan 'jebs drug cu'i dbyangs//shes ldan snyan dbang 'gugs mdzad zla mdzes ma /'di na ge sar 'dzum pa'i pad dkar phreng //rjes chags bung bas za zis sgra skad ltar//nyin mtshan dus drug yus kyis bos lags na//chags bral shes bya'i blo gros 465 cig kye//sku stod 'jam mnyen yangs pa'i 'o mtsho ru//gsal ba'i ngang mo lang tsho'i nu 'bur zung //

————— 4༄4༅—4nga——————— ༷ — 9— ——rin chen brgyan gyis spud pa'i do ra ru/ /lhod kyis nyal ba'i pi wang dbyangs ldan ma/ /'di na sprin sngon dbyings kyi sgra brgya la//re bas mig 'bur gtod pa'i rma bya bzhin/ /gangs can ljongs na grags pa'i bcu phrag rig /ma lus khong du chud pa'i rnam dpyod stsol/ /gang gi lang tsho gsar ba'i mdzes sdug gis/ /tshangs chen yid kyi thig le 'phrogs byed na//sdeb legs tshig gi sbyor ba stong dag gis/ /sku yi cha tsam dpog min tshangs sras ma//'di na snang brgyas phye min ba ku la/ /mdzes ma'i 'gram pa'i chang gis kha 'byed ltar/ /bdag blo rab rmongs thum pa'i sbubs kyi rgya/ /grol la rnam dpyod gsar ba'i dga' ston stsol//7zhes tshangs sras dga' ma la 'dod don gsol ba'i snyan rtsom 'di ni dad pas sor mo snying khar zum bzhin du dkon mchog bsam gtan nam ming gzhan dbyangs can dgyes pa'i blo gros kyis rang shag pad ma'i dga' tshal du gus pas sbyar ba'o//

—— 10 —glus rtsomaglurwabasamang tshorapo'irangamangangasa'i —rmorgoca jesposlozejarbornorārbethor+sharjorno— rjes su dran pa lus dkar mgrin pa'i dril chung zhes bya ba/ka la ping ma'i mgrin rnga ji bzhin du//ka ma la ltar mdzes pa'i lus dkar ma//ka li dgongs don rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag /ka ye chags bral mkhyen pa'i ngag sbyin mdzod//ka ni ka yi rgyal bo ji bzhin du//ka ma ru ltar rab mdzes gangs ri'i ljongs//ka mad sum cu'i sbyor ba rgya cher mdzad//ka dag gi ge'i byed po a nur dran//ka cog zhang gsum la sogs lo tsā'i khrod//ka ṇi ka yi mdzes byed ji bzhin du//ka ye gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir yod min zhes//ka khol ma yi byed po srong btsan smra//ka kha'i sbyor ba thog mar mdzad pa'i mgon//ka ma la ltar dkar ba'i ljongs 'di na//

cangapa'ilha/ rang rapo 11 —kulaming— ku'imagrin snyanajibazhirnedī—— —nga—4ོbhe——ོka ye thon mi'i bka' drin su yis gzhal//ka min kha min nga rgyal mtho ba 'gas//ka mad sbyor ba a nus ma mdzad zhes//ka kha shes pa'i khul gyis zlordom sems bcas//ka sgrogs skad ltar rna bar 'dzer nas 'ong //ka ye kha ba can gyi mkhas dbang 'bum//ka dag thugs klong dbyings nas mgrin gcig tu//ka li'i byed po sam bho ṭa yi mtshan//ka ba li yi snod na cis mi gsal//ka rdo bod kyi yin par shes bzhin du//ka ba med zhes mu cor smra ba 'di//ka bshad mkhan po ci ltar rlom na yang //ka gnyis pa yi dpe ru mi 'gyur grang //ka kha sum cu'i byed po ma mchis na//ka ye rang re'i yi ge'i bstan bcos 'di//ka min rdo min mgo med mjug rdum du//ka zhes mdzub mo ston yul rnyed re skan//

nga /nga—rwartsom bsamad rapo'i44/—/de ka bzhi gdung brgyad bod kyi grub mtha' kun//ka dag ris su ma chad sam bho ṭa//ka li a li'i byed po yi ge 'phrul//ka nas dag pas sems kyis 'dud la ltos//ka ye kha ba can gyi gzhon nu tsho//ka min kha min phyogs la ma brgyugs par//ka ba gdung lcam bkra ba'i khang mig tu//ka kha'i sbyor ba zhib tu sbyong byas shig / ka ye mkhas pa'i gral tu 'tshangs na yang //ka yig nor gyis dbul na ngo re nongs//ka li yi ge'i byed po a nu'i drin//bskal ba'i bar du brjed par ma 'jug ang //lnga rig shes bya'i mkha' dbyings dag pa'i klong //brtson 'grus dar dkar gshog 'dab rab brkyangs nas//snyan tshig mgrin pa'i gling bu bsgyur bzhin du//e ma blo gsal mtsho yi ngogs su 'phur//7yi ge byed po slob dpon a nu'i bka' drin rjes su dran pa lus dkar

— 5dpa྾44zo —zo༅༷ nga —— mgrin/pa'i dril chung zhes bya ba'i ka rtsom 'di ni tha snya da smra ba dkon mchog bas ma gtan gyis rab byung bcu bdun pa'i sa mo yos kyi zla tshes bzang bor bris /nan he ri bo gru 'dzin gyi thugs rje chen po yi gsoyi ba 'debs pa nyam chung bung ba rtsen pa'i gshog glu zhes bya ba//kun gsal g.yu yi mdangs 'dzin stong ba'i mkha'//sprin dkar rba klong 'khrigs pa gnam gyi mtha'//lho phyogs li khri'i chu gter 'phyur ba'i gnas//nor 'dzin phyug mo nan he po ta la//steng na khri gdugs nyi ma'i 'od snang dro//bar na smug sprin sngon mos rtsed dga' rol//'og na tshang tshang g.yu lo'i ljon shing brjid//yid kyi dwangs ma 'dren pa'i gnas ri lags//gting mtha' mi mngon li khri'i rgya mtsho cher//rlabs phreng dkar bo'i 'dzum zer 'dzad du med//gser mig chu srin la sogs rtse dga' rol//

— — 14 /de rtsom bsam nga ra po'i rang mngangs ——ོdz+nyāje khrung chubyalasogs zlosagarabasgyur /———༅—pad dkar 'dab stong 'dzum pa lha'i khrus rdzing //ngang ba'i bu mo dal gyis rol dang lhan//'gags med mgrin pa'i rdza rnga re re yis//rna ba'i bcud dag dbang med 'phrogs pa yod//dgung sngon dbyings la 'phyo 'dra'i rba klong gar//dkan gzar brag sna 'thab pa'i gdengs ka nas//dbang bo'i gzhu ris yid du 'ong ba yis//yid kyi thig le kun nas 'jo bar mdzad//ljon shing g.yu lo dud pa'i dga' tshal na//gnyis skyes dga' ba'i rab myos mgrin pa'i rnga//bar mtshams med par brdung pa'i ngo mtshar yul//e ma ting 'dzin lha yi phugs 'di rmad//dwangs pa'i mtsho las mdzes pa'i gru bskyod shing //brjid pa'i ri rtser legs pa'i lha khang mang //lhun chags ljon shing dud pa phu'u tho hran(stsakhya'u/6)//'dzam gling go la mdzes pa'i rgyan du brjid//bag phebs ting 'dzin rtogs pa ngang gis 'khrungs//

ngadapa'isgrangaragatsopo — 15 — nga—— 'tshemedazhibasdengan sa—rmerārje d+merde+o//—ཿ— — —————sa la dge bcu'i ri zlo'i rtsibs stong bkra//yid dga' bsam 'phel gling 'di su yi gnas//de ni 'gro kun thugs rjes dam 'khyud shing //ma rung 'jigs brgyad duḥkha'i klong nas 'dren//spyan ras gzigs dbang dar thod 'dzin pa'i lhas//byin gyis brlabs shing zhabs kyis bcags pa'i gnas//shel gyi lcugs phran g.yo ba'i mdzes sdug dpyid//dung gi 'khri shing gzhon nus 'khyud pa ltar//gang gi mtshan dpe'i lang tsho mthong bas mod//ma rig nyis brgya'i 'ching ba lhod min nam//dri med dung gi zla ris 'dzum pa'i zhal//dkar nag ma 'dres snying rje'i spyan zung bkra//rab dmar bag tsam grol ba'i mchu sgros dbus//thag bzang bzhi bcu'i tshems phreng lta na sdug /srab 'jam mdzes pa'i snyan gyi bu ga ru//rin chen sil sil sgra yis ci yang mdzes//dkar 'jam yid 'ong mgul gyi bum pa ru//

——bye nga 3gizo—/de4bsamang rapo'irang༄4 / de nga —yid 'phrog rin chen sna lnga'i mgul rgyan 'phyang //sku stod 'o ma'i chu gter mdzes pa'i klong //nu 'bur ngang mo zung gis ci yang sbeg /lha rdzas gos kyis sgrib g.yogs med par spud//de ni dwangs pa'i mtsho la zla gzugs bzhin//phra ldem lus mdzes na chung nyams kyis sgeg /sku stod rab rgyas sked skabs phra la ldem//dar la 'bab pa'i lang tsho de'i chog gi /rnam mang rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i dgos pa ci//gnag snum ral ba'i rtse na snang mtha'i sku//dri med rab dkar dar thod nyil nyil g.yo// phyag g.yas 'theb srin rtse na mnyen lcug ljon//phyag g.yon 'dod dgu stsol bas bum bzang bsnams//chu 'dzin bsnol mar 'khrigs pa'i lding khang na//g.yu 'brug sngon mo 'khyugs pa'i yid 'phrog zom//thugs rje'i bdag nyid brtse chen snying rje'i lha//khams gsum mig gi dpyid du ci yang brjid//thig le mchog ma la sogs lha yi phul//

dpa' jarang4ba —— 17 — ོ kashimadzesadaga'atsher+sholos 0r+shartse— —khyod drung bran mo tsam yang 'thob min na//srid zhi'i mdzes sdug rtse ru cis mi 'phags//tshangs chen gdong bzhi sprul kyang ngoms pa med/ /dbang bos mig stong gis kyang tshims ma gyur//gos ser can gyis bsngags pa'i mtha' ma rig /lha yi lha mchog snying rje'i mgon la 'dud//mtsho yi zhing khams zhes grags po ta lar//sngon dus che‘thang tā krong ’’gi rgyal rabs skabs//dbus ldan rgya gar chos kyi zhing khams nas//phebs pa'i dge slong sems dpa'i rnam rol der//dkan gzar brag ri'i phang bar brlabs phreng gis//chal chil rtse dga' bgyid pa'i sgrub phug tu//‘‘khro yan dung (tshotso.o)’nas 'phags mas zhal gzigs te//shin tu gsal ba rtsig ngos ris bzhin snang //de'i phyir da lta'i bar du las can rnams//thugs rje chen mos sgrub phug grags pa ste//

—— 18 /de rtsom bsam ra po'i rang mngangs/ /der+yāgyon duje’’nasartsegacigagasolagadab na —dza—sna tshogs zhal gzigs dbang bo'i gzhu bzhin snang //gzhan yang ‘thang shan thong ’’gi rgyal rabs skabs//'jar pan dge slong dpas i zhes grags pas//ri bo dwangs gsal gnas nas 'phags ma'i sku//snang brnyan gdan 'dren rang rgyal phyir phebs dus// ‘khro yan dung mi gi sgrub phugs gnas 'dir nas//shin tu ngo mtshar 'phags ma'i zhal sgo nas//phebs min sna tshogs gsung ni 'byin pa dang //sngon dang mi mtshungs ljid pas gdan ma drongs//rgya nag gnas chen bzhi yi ya gyal te//'phags pa'i gnas ri nan he po ta la//spyan ras gzigs dbang dar thod 'dzin pa des//'gro kun ma rig srid pa'i mtsho las 'dren//sngon dus rgyal bo'i bu mo spun gsum gyi//tsho me'o hran’ (11/cho)zhes bya'i skye ba bzhes pa'i tshe//'jig brgyad duḥkha'i mtsho las skyabs po zhes//dam bca'i me tog spyi bo'i rgyan du blangs//

ngangapa'agringar dkropo —— 19 — —ngh+rusnen phraca rjethagazlo r+ṣa—rger+ṣa tsha dū zlo — — 4 nga'akhos chung bdag rno 'di na shes bya'i nor//cung zad mi mnga' nad gdon bar chad las//thar ba'i gdeng ni ci yang ma mchis pas//myur mgyogs thugs rjes shugs kyis skyobs pa ra 'tshal//sa chu me rlung phyi yi gnod 'tshe dang //nad gdon bar chad nang gi rkyen la sogs//khyod zhabs pad mo dran pas zad byed kyang //yon tan yar ngos zla bzhin 'phel bar mdzod//tshe ring nad med dbang phyug brgyad kyi dpyid//dpal la nyin mtshan kun tu rol ba dang //bkra shis bde legs bsam pas don mtha' dag//bsam ma thag nas 'grub par byin gyis rlobs//mkha' la nyi zla'i thig le 'dzum pa dang //sa la ri yi lhun po brtan brjid bzhin//dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe rtag brtan shing //'gro rnams rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par shog / rgyal kun thugs rje'i tshom bu las 'khrungs pa'i//

— 20 — rtsom bas༄1 po'irangamangangayid/de/de———/dergyen ras gzigs dbang brtse chen snying rje'i lha//skye dang skye bar bdag ni rjes bzung ste/ /sa lam rtogs pa rim gyis 'phel bar mdzod//7ces nan he ri bo gru 'dzin gyi thugs rje chen po la gsol ba 'debs pa nyam chung bung ba rtsen pa'i gshog glu zhes bya ba ni ma hā tsi na'i yul gru chen po 'dir byang chub sems dpas gnas chen bzhi'i ya gyal/ thugs rje chen mo sgro la dkar yid bzhin nor bu bsam bzhin mi yi rnam rol tu 'khrungs pa'i gnas nan he‘ phu'u tho hran po ta lar grags pa'i gnas chen 'di ru phran chung bdag kyang thengs gnyis la slebs pa'i skal ba ldan zhing / khyad par du rje btsun sgro la ma dar thod 'dzin pa'i lha la mi phyed pas dad pa skyes pas rkyen byas te/ rab byung bcu bdun pa'i lcags pho 'brug gi lo dbo zla ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba dang po'i nyin sbyar ba'o//lha mo dbyangs can ma la zung ldan gyi sgo nas rgya cher bstod pa blo gsal mgrin pa'i rdza rnga/mdzes mdzes rin chen skyed mos tshal gyi ngogs//shig shig rlabs phreng dkar bo mgul byed pa//'dzum 'dzum mu tig gsar ba'i wu ba'i phreng //

—— — — ja 4zhi 1ཿ4——༅———/ —༷༷ 4chil chil g.yo ba mdzes pa'i mtsho 'gram du/ dwangs dwangs shel gyi lcug phran gzhon nu'i tshogs/ /lhag lhag rab dgas phan tshun 'khyud pa/ 'dra/ /ldem ldem gser gyi pad mo dgod pa'i bzhin/ /zir zir bung bas glu len 'phur zhing lding / /gas la gsal rang gzugs 'phos pa'i mtsho gling du/ /ling ling dga' bas gshog zung gar bsgyur ba'i/ /snyan snyan ngang ba'i rgyal bo'i mgrin pa'i rnga /yang yang brdungs 'di snying gi dpal du 'jebs/ /'khyil 'khyil rlabs phreng shig shig 'gul ba'i dbus//dkar dkar spu sdug gshog pa'i rtse mo yis/ /sim sim chu yi sil ma 'grem byed pa'i/ /bzhad dkar mgrin ring rtse dgas gar la rol//'grig 'grig tshar du dngar ba'i dga' tshal na//dung dung mgrin pa'i gling bu bsgyur mkhas pa/ /zhim zhim dri bsung 'thul ba'i khor yug tu/ /ling ling khu byug snyan pa'i sgra yis myos//'khyil 'khyil 'dab yangs pusnyo ri ka dang //

— 22 — 4 bsamang༄44dngas — —— — —rmedzesamadzesa'adzum pa'i ut+pal ku mud sogs//sim sem snyoms por 'bab pa'i sbrang ma'i char//sems sems char sprin sngon mo'i dbyings la blta//'bol 'bol rtswa sngon g.yu yi gzhong pa na//ldem ldem g.yo ba nags kyi bye'u tshogs//gyur kyur dga' bas mgrin sgra 'khrol ba dang //yang yang mdzes pa'i 'phur lding ci yang rtsen//ldir ldir 'brug sgra snyan mor rjes chags pas//mdzes mdzes 'khyil ba thig le'i sgro ldan ma//zlum zlum skor ba'i sgro gur phub dang lhan//yang yang re bas mig 'bur dbyings la gtod//bsil bsil khrus la 'jug 'dod ngang ngur tshogs//mdzes mdzes spu ris bkra ba'i gar rtsen zhing //snyan snyan mgrin pa'i gling bu bsgyur ba sogs//yang yang dga' ba'i bltad mo ci yang ngom//zhim zhim rtsi tog sna tshogs bcud rol bas//lha ga lhag stobs kyi phung bo rab rgyas pa'i//mtshar mtshar spu sdug ri dwags gzhon nu'i tshogs//

——— — ——————da ngarwa 4 zodar sa 4——༅— — 2 ni — —— ——— mdzes mdzes yid dga'i tshal na rgyug cing mchongs//ljang ljang mad gad lo ma'i 'dab phreng yangs/ /ldem ldem g.yo ba pad ma'i khrus rdzing du//dkar dkar gangs ri g.yo 'dra'i glang chen tshogs //'khrul 'khrul dri ma spangs pa'i tshal na rgyu//'thul 'thul dri zhim phyogs kun ldang ba yi//bsil bsil tsan dan snum po'i grib bsil dang //yang yang 'jug na bde ba'i li shi'i gur//mdzes mdzes lding khang gsar ba'i dga' tshal na//'dzum 'dzum pad mas 'dzum dkar grol ba'i dbus//dung dung dad pa'i yid ngor shar pa'i lha//kye kye ngag gi dpal 465 zla mdzes ma//lhag lhag snying gi thig le'i dpyid du mdzod//mang mang lnga rig shes bya'i dga' tshal du//yang yang rtse zhing rgyu bar bdag 'dod kyang //'thoms 'thoms blo 'di ma rig rkun pos 'khyer//gsal gsal snang ba'i blo gros 465 cig kye//dkar dkar shel gyi lcug phran g.yo 'dra'i rtser//

ོ———/de—— dpa'i ra rang— —— 17 /dertsen pa'i legs bshad gang gā 'di rmad byung //ngang ba'i bu mo dal gyis rgyu ba bzhin//lnga rig shes bya'i pad+mo'i lding khang du//'dzum dkar rlabs kyi rtsed 'jo 'o ma'i mtshor//gar du rtsen pa'i rig grol bsngags bya'i yul//rnam dpyod pad ma'i 'dzum dkar grol pa'i gdong //bslab gsum dri bsung dpyid kyi yid 'phrog pa//mos ldan rkang drug gzhon nu dga' bskyed pa'i//dge 'dun chu skyes tshal 'di bsngags la spro//yid 'phrog sku yi dpag bsam ljon bzang la//ngur smig gos kyi mtshams sprin gsar bas 'khyud//snyan 'jebs gsung gi rnga gsang rgod pa can//rnam grol dge ba'i ljon pa 'di ko rmad//khyod zhal zla gzhon gsar ba'i 'dzum rlabs kyis//bdag yid ku mud khongs nas dgod par byed//rnam dpyod gsar ba'i 'brug sgra snyan mo yis//dad ldan mos pa'i rma bya myos par byed//gang thugs kun gsal sgeg mo'i mdzes zhal ngos//

— 28 —— —3 ཿ 4ngh+rurapo'irangangang4—/de ——lnga rig mkhyen pa'ichu 'dzin mang 'khrigs shing //snyan 'jebs gsung gi rnga gsang rgod dang lhan//chabs cig legs bshad gru char ci yang 'jo//tshems phreng mu tig 'dzum pa'i khongs gseng nas//ljags dmar glog gi phreng ba 'khyugs dang lhan//dgag sgrub rig pa'i thog zhags 'bebs mkhas pa//khyod zhal mthong la bdag ni ci yang brel//phul byung 'jo sgeg nyams brgya'i gzugs sku la//zhi dul dpal gyis lhod pa'i thugs mnga' zhing //bgrang yas legs bshad 'chad la 'gran bral ba//rig grol 'phags pa'i ljon bzang de la gus//yid 'ong gzugs kyi lang tsho lta na sdug /'jam snyan gsung gi pi wang rna bar 'jebs//zab yang thugs kyi mkhyen pa dpag par dka'//mgon khyod thar 'dod bye ba'i gtan gyi grogs//khyod zhal yid 'phrog phun ḍa rī ga'i tshal//gnag snum 'dren byed bung ba zhi dul can//tshems phreng ge sar ro yis yid tshims nas//

— pa'i ngar da ra po — 29 ——sgroṅge dmarasirnor+sharad+kude+ongage/de—nga—nga—ོ——rnam dpyod gsar ba'i dmar 'od zhags pa'i rgyun//e ma thugs kyi chu gter klong na 'khyugs//snying rje'i lha lam yangs pa'i do ra ru//brtse ba'i 'dzum dkar pad mo dgod la ltos//zhi dul spyod lam rnam bzhi'i dpal gyis sgeg /dbu zlum gnag snum bung ba yid du 'jebs//ngur smig rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i dpal yon can//rig grol yongs 'du'i ljon 'di bsod nams zhing //lung rtogs mdzod 'dzin rig grol 'phags pa'i sde'i//zhabs sen yid bzhin dbang gi nor bu'i phreng //blo gsal ngang mos gtsug gi rgyan gyi dpyid//'dzin pas ma rig nyon mongs dri ma 'khrud//kun gsal sgeg mo'i 'gram par mi rgyu zhing //ku mud gzhon nu'i 'dab stong mi grol bar//khyed kyi mkhyen rab chu shel dbang bo'i rgyun//mthong bas bdag blo'i chu gter ci yang 'phel//'gro kun rmongs mun sel ba'i 'od dkar can//

— 30 — rtsom bsamang rapo'irangam4gdo//de nga'agyar med mdza' ba brtan phyir gser gyi lhun//pharno bde'i legs bshad stsol ba'i rta bdun dbang //yid la re ba kun skong yid bzhin nor//kwa ye grogs mchog khyod sku yongs 'du'i shing //skal ldan gzhon nus longs su spyod pa'i yul//rnyog bral yid 'phrog re ba'i 'bras bu kun//ci dgar stsol la 'gran pa'i zla dang bral//khams gsum 'gro la brtse ba'i rjes chags pa'i//snying rje'i zla gzhon 'dzum pa gang gi thugs//dwangs gsal dri ma med pa'i khrus rdzing du//'dzum zhing ldem pa'i pad dkar mdangs dang mtshungs//ri rgyal lhun po kun bzod lto bar 'phags//gang sku gser ri 'gro ba'i dpal du brjid//sa 'dzin lhun po gdos bcas bem gzugs nyid//khyod sku snang stong sgyu ma'i lang tsho 'bar//bcu phrag rig gzhung dga' char sil ma'i 'bras//'bebs mkhas khyod thugs sprin sngon zhags pa'i rgyun//skal bzang mdongs mtha'i snying la chags bral ba'i//

za ngangapa'i rwa4༅———nga༅ zo—bathar ba'i dpal ster phyir na chu 'dzin min//gang gi mkhyen rab dmar 'od thog zhags kyis//rgol ngan log smra'i tshang tshing ma lus bsregs//de ni gang gi nus pa phun tshogs par//ma zad log lta'i gnas la goms pas skyon//gang sku zla gzhon ut+pal 'dzum phreng las//legs 'ong ga bur sbrang char gsar ba'i rgyun//thob pas bdag yid rlabs phreng me tog dbus//legs bshad bdud rtsi'i ze'u 'bru phang phung gtams/ 'di ni khyod thugs ma yin 'o ma'i mtsho//khyod gsung min te mkha' 'gro dkar bo'i glu//khyod sku ma lags shel gyi ljon bzang ngo //phal ba ma yin rgyal sras gzhon nu'i sku//'dir smras pa/mkhyen rab dmar 'od glog gi rjes 'gro zhing //brtse chen thugs rje'i sprin dkar 'dzum pa'i sde//skyabs dang re sa khyed las ma mchis pas//

— 32 —— na 4 ཿ ༅ ༅4ཿngu༅44—44 —4— rmyo phyi karnorte 'i.omedarjes 'dzin mdzod//brtse bral sprin phung nag po 'phyur ba'i klong //nges med mi rtag glog gi gar rtse bas//nyam chung 'dab yangs grol ba'i pad ma bdag /glo bur ser bas 'joms par ma 'jug ang //mdza' gcugs mi 'gyur btso ma'i rjes 'gro ba'i//dmar ser li khri'i mdangs 'dzin rig grol sde//rma bya'i snying la g.yu 'brug sgra dbyangs bzhin//rtag tu brtse ba'i zhags pas bdag ma lhod//gangs ri'i khrod 'dir gangs can nyin byed bzhin//kun la brtse chen thugs rjes nyer bskyangs pa'i//gtan gyi skyabs gcig dpal ldan bla ma yi//zhabs pad srid mtha'i khyon dang mnyam gnas shog /nges med srid pa'i klong 'dir zo chun bzhin//rtag tu 'khor ba'i ma gyur 'gro ba'i tshogs//deng nas bzung ste thar ba'i lam bzang du//'jug la gegs byed med par bgrod nus shog /zhes ris pa dang grol ba'i yon tan gyi mdzod 'dzin 'phags pa'i dge

— — ngangapa'i darang྾ ོ— — —nga—nigro—— 'dun gyi sde la snyan ngag gi gzugs rgyan nyi shu'i sgo nas bstod pa changs chen mes po'i mgrin glu zhes bya ba 'di ni phran chung bdag gis bla brang bkra this 'khyil ba'i gling nas snyan ngag sogs ris sanas la sbyangs pa byed bzhin pa'i ska bas su bris pa lags shing / bya ba mang ba'i rkyen gyis 'phro lhag pa'i rjes so ra la na gru grong khyer rang shag dga' ba'i skyed tshal du legs par mjug yo ngas su rdzogs par bris pas dase 'dun gyi sde thugs mthun khrims gtsang 'chad nyan gyi bya ba rnams yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba'i rgyur gyur cig/rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i ngo bo dbyangs can ma la 'dod don gsol ba mdongs mtha' dga' bas sgro gur zhes bya ba/ka ma la dang bsil zer bdag po'i mdzes sdug snying khu bsdus pa bzhin//kha dog gangs ri pad rtsa li dang kun ta'i 'khri shing gzhon nu'i mdangs//ga bur zhun thig la sogs kyis bkrus srid zhi'i khongs na macesas sdug sgeg /nga sogs 'gro ba'i snying gi dpyid gyur dbyangs can dga' ma thig ler mdzod//

—34— rtsom bsamang ra po'irangamangadwas —/deca ris ji bzhin 'khums pa'i blo dang snyan ngag smra byed lkugs pa'i lce//cha rkyen lnga rig sbyangs pa'i grogs dang lung rtogs gnyis 'dzom dge ba'i bshes//ja zas gyis mtshon chos kyi mthun rkyen 'tsho ba'i dbul ba'i gzhon nu bdag/nya rgyas bzhin can tshangs pa'i sras mo dbyangs can dpal mos rjes bzung mdzod//ta thā ga ta'i bstan la dad kyang thos bsam nor gyis dbul ba bdag/tha na shes bya'i rnam grangs gcig kyang mthar phyin dka' bas yid gdung nas//da lta dbyangs can snang stong sgyu 'phrul sgo gsum gus pas gtsug bsten na //na tshod gzhon pa'i dus nas shes bya ma lus mkhyen pas dga' ston mdzod//pa ba sangs sogs lta bu'i lus dkar snying gi dpyid gyur rgyan gcig ma//

——— — ba'i dard rapo /de༅gri nga ༷— pha rol lho phyogs 'o ma'i mtsho 'gram dga' ba'i tshal na tsog pus bzhugs//ba mos zil ba nyin mo'i 'od bzhin mi shes rmongs mun gtan bcom nas//ma lus shes bya mkhyen pa'i 'od snang sgron me sbor cig zla mdzes ma /tsa ri ltar bsil gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir gnas lnga rig pa'i dpal gyis phyug /tsha grang khyad bsad mkhas pa'i dbang phyug nam mkha'i skar ma'i grangs la 'phya//dza lang gtum spyod bod kyi yul 'dir da lta de las go ldog ste/ /wa wol ngang du mi tshe 'dzad pas gnyis med nyam thag rjes brtse mdzod//zha lu lo tsā la sogs mkhas pa'i gsung gi man ngag dza hu'i rgyun//za ma tog sogs dag yig snyan ngag rig gzhung mdzod la 'jug 'dod kyang //

—— 36 —snga rtsom tshi bsamangakar po'i rang mngangs— —ོ—4 — ————ye ——ble—ོrmo———rmo——'a 'ur ngang du dus tshod 'da' nga — bas ga zung gsal bas//༵mtshan mkhyen pa'i ye shes stsol cig rgyal kun gsung gi thig ༷ ༵/ ga/ ngas dang nags kyis bskor ba'i sgang drug chu bzhi'i ljongs 'di na//la lung 'khyams pas mu to ba bzhin bdag ni snyom las ngang lus pas//sha khrag gdos bcas lus 'di ma gzhig de srid shes bya la brtson na//sa lam rtogs pa rim gyis bgrod nas kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang mdzod//ha cang snyan pa sdeb sbyor gyis dbul brjod bya don gyi bcud bral yang //a ma dran pas bu chung ngag bzhin gang la yid kyis gsol 'debs na//shes bya ma lus mkhyen pa'i blo dang gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i ljags//

— 38 — glurwa rtsom 'ichi samang rapo'irangamarang —:rāngathojuder+sha rmod+nghar rū—// —— ———————phul byang spobs pa'i gru char gyis brlan pa'i//mkhyerno yangs tā ma la yi klong dbus su/ /zla med legs bshad sgra brgya rgod bzhin du//skal bzang ma yur bskyangs te bzhugs lags grang //gang khyod mdzad bzang mad gad zhun ma'i tshal//dran rig yid 'phrog me tog 'dzum zhing rgod//gzhan phan spyod pa'i dri bsung 'thul ba can//nged cag bung ba'i thos 'dzin dpal du snyan//khyod zhal las 'khrungs legs bshad 'gram chang gis//bdag rmongs blo yi ba ku la yi kha//legs 'byed snyan tshig rtse dga'i 'dab phreng dpal//bzhad pas mkhas mchog sgeg mo khyod drin gsal//ngag gi dbang phyugs smra ba'i seng ge yis//'od tshogs 'bar ba rtse dgas khyod la 'khyud//khyod yon srid zhi'i khams kun rnyed min zhes//grags pa'i mu khyud 'khor lo'i shes des smra//rtsod ngag chu 'dzin g.yo ba'i gdengs khang nas//

ngangapa'i 44/ lta—༷— lung rig rjes chags glog phreng rtse dga'i gar//dgag sgrub gnam lcags 'bebs mkhas dpal yo na can//khyod ni rig pa'i g.yu 'brug yin no lags//shes bya kun gsal sgeg mo'i 'gram pa la//ljags yangs gos dmar gshog 'dab brkyangs pa las//snyan 'jebs legs bshad rdza rnga brdung ba can//khyod ni 'chad mkhas ngang mo yin no lags//bcu phrag rig pa'i rkang 'thung ldem pa'i tshal//'dod 'jo'i sdeb legs me tog 'thor bzhin du//snyan 'jebs tshig gi phreng bas yid 'phrog pa//khyod ni rtsom mkhas khu byug yin no lags//bsil ljongs mkhas dbang spyi bo'i me tog gis//khyod zhabs dri med nor bu'i phreng bsten na//ches rmongs blo gros dman pa bdag lta'i ni//khyed nyid gtan gyi skyabs su cis mi 'dzin//mkhas mchog khyed kyi mdzad bzang chu gter che//gangs ljongs dbyig 'dzin sgeg mo'i phang ba ru//rnam kun bri gang med par 'khyil ba'i dpyid//
