— 46 — nga mchi ma'i la dbang med sems kyi chu klong //skyo bas rba rlabs 'phyur byung //dbus ldan chos kyi zhing nas//rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i ngo bo//paṇa chen snang ba mtha' yas /mjal 'dod sems pa skyes kyang //gzugs sku dbyings la gshegs pas//mjal ba'i go skabs ma mchis//chos srid gnyis kyi ka ba//nam mkha'i mthongs la btsugs byung //bstan 'gro gnyis kyi bya ba//mkha' la nyi ma shar 'dra//khyod kyi mdzad phrin dran rjes//skyo bas mchi ma bsnyil byung //gangs ri sman gyi ljongs 'dir//mdzes pa'i skar chen mang yang //bstan 'gro phan pa'i 'od dkar//khyod kyi do zla ma yin//

/de rtsom bsam rapo'ira' khodas —— 47/de/snang mtha'i sgyu 'phrul zla gzhon//'gog med yid mtshor shar byung / /sku brjid lhun po ji bzhin//gsung dbyangs 'gag med 'brug sgra//thugs klong rdo rje'i gur khang / /paṇa chen snang ba mtha' yas/ /khyed nyid dran pa'i gdung dbyangs//sems kyi gting nas blangs song //gsang gsum ye shes sgyu 'phrul//paṇa chen snang ba mtha' yas /bdag cag mgon med rnams kyi//gtan gyi skyabs gcig lags pas//yang sprul nyi ma gzhon nu//myur bar 'khrungs pa'i smon lam//7zhes pa 'di ni snang ba mtha' yas chos kyi mgon po'i gsang gsum ye shes kyi sgyu 'phrul nges don chos kyi 'khor bsgyur chen po gangs can 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs gcig pu paṇa chen rin po che dgongs pa chos dbyings su gtad pa'i tshul mdzad par bzod glags med par gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'debs pa'i dran mgur gdung dbyangs 'di blangs so//

— 48 cha ngamachima'i la /de /degangs ljongs bstan ba'i mjes rgyan gung thang khri rin po che'i gdung dbyangs gsol 'debs nyam chung bung ba skyo bas gshog glu/rgyal ba kun gyi yab tu gyur kyang rgyal sras gzhon nu'i tshul gyis ni// :'gro kun ma rig tshang tshing kun bsregs shes rab ral gri mkha' la 'bar//gur gum gsal ba'i rtse dga' la chags bcu drug lang cho1re nyams kyis sgeg/dmar ser gzhon nu ngag gi dbang phyug byang chub bar du spyi bos mchod//rab 'byams rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse nus gsum gcig tu rdzogs pa'i ye shes sku//'jam dpal dbyangs dngos mi yi rnam rol bdag gi 'dren par shar ba'i lha//zla bral bshes gnyen gtsug gi nor bu mtshan dpe'i me tog bzhad pa'i mgon//

/de rtsom bsam rapo'irangam ngas — yod/—de ring bdag yid chu gter dbus su byin rlabs gzugs brnyan 'bum 'char mdzod//ngo mtshar snang stong sgyu ma'i rang sazugs gdod nas rdo rje'i sku brnyes shing //dbang phyug yon tan brgyad kyis dpal mnga' 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin thob//brtse chen thugs rje'i 'gro 'ong kun bral gdul bya rgya mtsho'i mgon du shar//glo bur chos kyi zhing du gshegs 'di kye ma bdag cag ci ltar bzod//mdo sngags rab 'byams ma lus kun mkhyen g.yu yi ral bas gnya' khebs shing // rnam dpyod stong gi mche sder rab rno log smras glang bo 'joms la dpa'//nang gi rim gnyis rtogs pa'i klong brdol rtsal gsum lus kyi gzi mdangs brtas//dpal ldan bla ma 'phrog byed dbang po gang nyid dran pas bzod re skan//

/de 50 /de ngamachi ma'i la— gangasacanazhing gi bstanapa'inyidabyedachulha'i༄ngabar zim la nye//thugs kyis ma bzod brtse chen dbyings nas mdzad bzang 'od snang 'bum spros te//bstan pa'i pad tshal slar yang grol mdzad thugs stobs 'gran pa'i zla bral ba//dpal ldan bla ma nam mkha'i nor bu gang nyid mdzad rjes dran pas gzir//brtse chen snying rje'i chu 'dzin 'bum dkrigs gdul bya'i nor 'dzin rab yangs khyon//dbang lung man ngag bye ba phrag brgya chos kyi sbrang char sil ma'i rgyun//snyan 'jebs gsung gi rnga gsang ldir bzhin legs par 'bebs mkhas bdag gi mgon//dpal ldan bla ma chu 'dzin dkar po bdag yid mkha' ru rgyu bar 'tshal /'chad na ri gzar chu klung 'phyo bzhin mdo sngags shes bya'i dka' gnad sel//

—— 4rtsom spyagom—54po'irangamangangaso51—rtsod na bde thung glog gi gar bzhin tshul gsum tshad mas sgro 'dogs bcad//rtsom na snyan 'jebs dri za'i rgyud mangs tshig sbyor snying bo'i bcud chags pa//'chad rtsod rtsom la 'gran pa'i zla bral g.yu 'brug stong gi ngar skad bzhin//mkhas dbang 'bum phrag chu mthongs klong na dbyar skyes sngon mo ji bzhin mdzes//mdo sngags shes bya ma lus kun mkhyen mkhas pa'i snyan pa ring du mched//sdom gsum rnam bzhag mig 'bras ltar bsrungs btsun pas dri bsung khor yug khyab//rang gzhan kun phan mdzad spyod bzang po dpag bsam shing gi zla bor snyems// mkhas btsun bzang gsum yon tan lhun rdzogs dpal ldan bla ma snying nas dran//gang sku dri med shel dkar lhun po bdag gi 'dren byed ma gyur skyo//

— 52 /de nga mchi ma'i la—she rkyeng dbyangasarāgagasamed nāda'i sgra dbyangs thos — 'dzin dpyid du dben pas skyo//gting mtha' mi dpog zab brling mkhyen rab skal dman bdag dang bral bas skyo //sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba zab mos bdag gi sgo gsu ma brlan par mdzod//bstan 'gro gnyis kyi bya ba'i khur chen 'jigs med thugs rje'i phrag tu bzhes//chos srid gnyis kyi bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mi ngal srid zhi'i mthongs na bsgrengs//dbang phyug bye ba'i yon tan mdzod 'dzin yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal bo gang //byang chub bar du brtse bas rjes bzung gsung gi sanang ba 'doms par shog/bstan pa spyi dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid skyabs mchog khyed la rag las phyir//yang dar bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng mkhas gdul bya'i re ltos 'cha' ba'i mgon//

rtsom bsam ra po'i rang ma ngas /de 53 /deyang sprul nyi gzhon gsar ba'i 'od snang myur tu 'char— bas smon lam ni//bcos min sems kyi klong nas 'debs na smon pa bzhin du 'grub gyur cig /7ces rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi ngo bo 'jam dpal dpa' bo mi'i rnam rol tu shar ba dpal ldan bla ma dam pa mchog re zhig zhi ba'i dbyings su gshegs par gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis gsol ba 'debs pa nyam chung bung ba skyo bas gshog glu zhes bya ba ni/ bka' drin gsum ldan gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma mtshan brjod par dka' ba don gyi slad du mtshan nas smras na7rje gung thang yid bzhin nor bu 'jigs med bstan pa'i dbang phyug dpal bzang bo mchog dgongs pa chos dbyings su gtad par ma bzod par gdung shugs drag pos sgo nas gsol ba 'debs shing rjes su dran pa'i tshul du rab byung bcu bdun pa'i lcags pho 'brug gi lo dbo zla ba'i dkar phyogs rdzogs pa gsum pa'i nyin mngon par dang bas sbyar ba'o// dri med kyi zla ba dkar po/a sngon nam mkha'i dbyings na/ /kun gsal zla ba shar byung //kun gsal zla ba mthong bas /sems kyi mun pa sangs song /

/de54 — ngamachi ma'i gal mkha' dbyings mdzes pa'i klong 'dir//'od ldan rgyu skar mang yang //dri med zla ba dkar po//'gran pa'i go skabs ma mchis /mdo smad bkra shis 'khyil gling //mkhas pa'i dbang bo mang yang //gang gi mkhyen pa'i rba rlabs//'gran pas zla bo ma mchis//'chi med dbyings na 'dzum pa'i//nyin byed gzhon nu'i rjes 'gro//brtse chen snying rje'i rang gzugs//dran pas mig chu 'thor song //mgon khyod sems kyi zla bar//chags pa'i legs bshad ga bur//dus drug brtse bas 'doms pas//gang nyid dran pas gdung song //mgon khyod dri med zla ba//chos dbyings klong du gshegs pas//

rtsom bsam ra po'i rang mdangs —— 55 /dedrin gyis bskyangs pa'i bu chung //dran pas bzod thabs mi 'dug /'chad na ri gzar 'bab chu//rtsod na dus mtha'i me dpung //rtsom na gangs rgyan pad+ma//mgon khyod dran pas gsol 'debs//brtse chen nyin mo'i dbang phyug /gang gi thugs klong rdo rjer//nyam chung slob bu'i tha shal//skad cig 'dor bar ma mdzad//sprin sngon nam mkha'i dbyings kyi//'dren mchog zla ba dkar po//byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i zegs ma//rtag tu 'jo bas smon lam//dri med kyi zla ba dkar bo zhes pa'i gdung dbyangs gsol 'debs ni mdo smad bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po don gyis slad du mtshan nas smos na 7rje tshul khrims rgya mtsho mchog dgongs pa chos dbyings su gtad nas lo 'khor gsum lon par rjes dran gyi tshul du 'khos bra' dkon mchog bsam gtan gyis dang bas sbyar ba'o//

/de 56 /de nga mchi ma'i labadag gi slob dpon/dgung sngon nam mkha'i mthongs na//'od stong rta bdun bdag pos//brtse ldan dro 'jam zer gyis//pad mo'i 'dab stong grol byung //gangs ri shel gyi spo na//gangs seng g.yu ral can pos//brjid chags 'gying stabs re res//gangs ljongs mdzes par byas song //tshang tshing g.yu lo tshal du//bya de khu byug sngon mos//snyan 'jebs mgrin glu re res//sbrang char mgron la 'gugs byung //mkhyen rab kun gsal la 'gran//brtse ba nyi zla'i rjes 'gro//khyod gsung bslab bya re res//

rtsom bsam da ra po'irangam ngas — 57 /de——bdag yid rmongs pa sel byung //'gro ba'i re 'dod skong bar//khyod ni dpag bsam ljon pa//rig pa'i nor bzang spel bar//khyod ni zla ba'i ma ma//mkhyen pa nam mkha' la khyab//brtse chen nyin mo'i dbang phyug /nus pas khams gsum zil gnon//slob dpon khyed nyid dran byung //7slob dpon dran pas ngag mgur 'di ni/ rje bsam gtan rgya mtsho mi 'jigs dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros su 'bod pa mchog dgongs pa chos dbyings su gtad nas lo 'khor lnga lon par dran rten du gus pa'i phul ba'o//dran pas mig chu/kun gsal stong pa'i dbyings na//'dzum pa'i zla shel dbang po//na ning chos kyi bdud rtsi//ku mud tshal du stsol byung //

/de 58 /de nga mtshi ma'i lad lo mig gi dpal du//ma mthong skyo bas gzir song //khyed ni rgyal kun gsang gsum//thig le'i gar du zlos pa//'jam dpal ye shes gzhon nu//bsam bzhin bdag cag 'dren par//sku yi 'od zer 'bum 'byed//gsung gi rnga gsang ldir bzhin//khyed la re ltos 'cha' ba'i//ris med gdul bya bzhag nas//glo bur chos kyi dbyings su//thugs dgongs gtad pa 'di ci//'dren mchog khyed dang bral bas//bskal brgyar bzod thabs 'dug gam//dge ldan bstan pa'i srog shing //dad ldan 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig/re zhig sku yi bkod pa//chos kyi dbyings su bsdus pa'i//

rtsom bsam nga rapo'irangam ngas — 59—/de—kye ma shin tu skyo bas//dbang med mig chu 'thor song //chos dbyings nam mkha'i mthongs kyi//kun gsal zla ba gzhon nu//'di na nor 'dzin phang bar//gang nyid dran pas bu chung //sems nas bzod glags med par//skyo gdung drag pos gzir song //gang sku dri med zla gzhon//'dren byed yul du ma gyur//gsung dbyangs snyan pa'i 'brug sgra//deng 'dir thos pa'i bskal bas/ /dbang med sems kyi chu gter//skyo bas rba rlabs 'phyur byung //gang gi mkhyen rab nam mkha'//gting mtha' sus kyang gzhal min//brtse chen thugs rje'i pad mo//'gro ba'i dpal du ldem pa//

— 60 — nga mchi ma'i do la— gung thangayid bzhin nor bu//gdung sims drag pos gsol 'debs//bstan pa'i ba dan dkar po//chos dbyings mthongs su bsgrengs pa//dbang phyug brgyad kyi yon tan//mchen dpi'i sku la rdzogs pa//glo bur chos kyi dbyings su//gshegs par snying nas mi bzod//chos srid gser gyi ka ba//thugs kyi khur du bzhes shing //phyin drug bsdu bzhi'i dpal gyis// 'gro kun bde la sbyor ba//de ring chos kyi zhing du//phebs pas bzod thabs mi 'dug /bstan 'gro gnyis kyi bya bar//dgung la nyi ma shar 'dra//nyin byed bye ba'i 'od skyes//rdzogs ldan dpal la 'god song //

rtsom bsam karapo'irangamangangs da 61 —— gang nyid dran pas modal /————ོskyo bas mig chu 'thor song //sku brjid gser gyi lhun po//gsung dbyangs dbyar skyes rnga gsang //thugs klong mtha' bral nam mkha'//gang gi yang sprul zla gzhon//myur du shar bas smon lam//bcos min snying nas thol byung //7ces 'jam dpal dpa' bo mi'i rnam rol du phebs pa dpal ldan bla ma dam pa mchog la gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis gsol ba rtse gcig tu 'debs pa dran pas mig chu zhes bya ba ni bka' drin gsum ldan gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma mtshan brdzod par dka' ba don gyi slad du mtshan nas smras na7rje gung thang rin po che 'jigs med bstan pa'i dbang phyug dpal bzangapha mchog dgongs pa chos dbyings su gtad par gdung shugs drag pos sgo nas gsol 'debs rjes dran gyi tshul du rab byung bcu bdun pa'i lcags pho 'brug gi lo cho 'phrul zla ba'i dmar phyogs rdzogs pa gsum pa'i nyin zhal slob kyi gral mthar 'dzin pa 7mgo log dkon mchog bsam gtan gyis sbyar ba'o//

—— 62 — ngamachi ma'i do la —gdung 'bod co ba'i mgrin sgra'akhril ldem sku yi lcug phran yid 'ong gi rtse dgar//mdzes sdug zhal ras pad+mo'i 'dzum dkar gyi gdong nas//ngag dbang dbyangs kyi dpal yon 'bad med du stsol ba'i//tshangs sras dbyangs ldan bu mo snying dbus su zhugs shig/mkhyen rab dmar 'od glog gi lcug phran gyi gar stabs//mkhas dbang 'bum phrag yid kyi lha lam na rtsen pa//grags snyan chu khur glal ba'i ngar skad la 'phya ba'i// bshes gnyen rmongs pa'i mun sel bla ma de dran byung //lnga rig sin dhu wa ra me tog gi 'gram par//rnam dpyod bur chang zegs mas dus gcig tu grol ba//bshes gnyen smra ba'i zla ba gdung sel gyi bdud rtsi//yang yang snying dbus thig ler brjed med du dran byung //mkhyen rab g.yu yi ral khur gnya' ba ru khebs shing //rtsod ngag glal ba'i nga ro 'brug stong bzhin bsgrags pas//

rtsomatshogabasamadakropo'irangamangang —— 63 — log smra wa skyes klad rgya cig car du'agems—rmedzad —/de— bshes gnyen smra ba'i seng chen bla ma de dran byung //'bum phrag slob bu ngang mo'i khyu tshogs kyi 'dod mos / /gang la gang 'dod rig gnas sbrang char gyi zegs ma//'dzad med nyal 'gro'i rgyun gyi zla bo ru 'phags pa'i//bshes gnyen chu 'dzin lhun po khyed nyid rang dran byung //'chad na rlabs kyi gar 'dzin ri gzar gyi 'bab chu//rtsod na dmar ba'i 'od 'char glog phreng gi lcug ma//rtsom na snyan 'jebs sgra ldan 'bum phrag gi gling bu//'gran bral dpal ldan bla ma snying dbus su 'char byung //gang gi gsang gsum zab pa chu gter gyi rgya ra/tsho//thos chung ngang mo'i gshog pa'i gzhal bya rang ma yin//'on tang gang nyid dran pa'i gdung dbyangs kyi mgrin sgra//dbang med mgrin pa'i phugs nas 'gog med du thon byung //7ces gdung 'bod co ma'i mgrin sgra zhes bya ba 'di ni rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad 'phrin ni nam mkha' ltar mtha' gru yangs shing / bsta na 'gro gnyis kyi bya ba ni nyi zla'i 'od snang 'phro ba ltar gsal ba bka' drin mtshungs zla ma mchis pa dpal ldan bla ma dam pa don gyi slad du mtshan nas smras pa 7rje btsun bsam gtan rgya

— 64 — — /la4 mchima'idoyid 4 ——ོ—— ———/de— ——r+ha——nga—— mtsho dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros dpal bzang bo re zhig sku yi bkod pa chos dbyings su gtad par shugs drag gdung bas gzir bzhin bla brang bkra shis 'gyil gyi rang shag shes bya'i lding khang nas gang gi zhal slob kyi gral ma/thar 'dzin pa/ maso los dkon mchog bsam gtan gyis sbyar ba'o//rje 'jam dbyangs bla ma gang gi mdzad pa'i bka' drin rjes su drar pa sems las 'phos pa'i rol mo zhes bya ba/rgyal kun ye shes lang cho1re tshom bu gcig tu blum pa'i mtshar sdug sku/nāmar ser li khri'i thig le la chags 'jam dpal gzhon nu mi ba ༵༵ /ba/zhin bdag cag 'dren par legs shar gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i mgon//chos dbyings mthongs las skad cig 'bral med bdag la brtse ba'i spyan gyis 'khyud//'jigs med lung rig gad rgyangs gcig gis sa gsum dbang med 'dar byed pa//rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i khri gdugs 'od snang gser 'od stong gi

da grortsomasagabasam rapo'irangamangangasang— 6 5 ——rmodangasar+shazhinabyarā — ——————4༅dbang phyug brgyad kyi go 'phang rab rdzogs 'gro kun dpyid kyi dpal bzang bo//phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde chen dpal ldan bla ma/ spyi bos mchod// gat+tas ri'i ljongs kyi bstan pa'i nyin byed kye ma chu lha'i phag byā~X la// rgol ba'i chos min dpung gis bstan la shin tu gzan |༷ d+ngha~X/ phu/ la byung thugs stobs mthu yis gangs can grub brgyad shing rta'i srol//chos srid zung gi rgyal mtshan dkar bo mkha' dbyings klong na mthon por bsgrengs//dad ldan 'gro ba'i re ba kun skong bde skyid nyi gzhon slar yang 'char /bcu phrag rig gzhung srog rtsa rab spel dbang lung man ngag bdud rtsi yis//'gro kun yid kyi dri ma rab sel smin cing grol ba'i dpal la

— 66 /de nga mchi ma'i la'agod /degangs ri'i nyin byed khyed kyi mdzad phrin bskal ba'i bar du brjed re skan//mdo dang sngags kyi de nyid rab mkhyen rtsal gsum lus kyi gzi mdangs brtas//rnam dpyod lung rig mche sder rab rno log smras glang bo 'joms la dpa'//nang gi rim gnyis g.yu ral rab rgyas gangs ri'i ljongs kyi gangs seng zhig/glo bur chos kyi dbyings su gzhol 'dis bdag cag skyo bas bzod thabs bral//gang sku nyin byed bye ba'i mdangs kyang zil gyis gnon nus mtshan dpe'i sku//gang gsung 'gag med tshangs pa'i gdangs kyang 'gran nus yan lag drug cu'i gsung //gang thugs zab yangs kun gsal khyon ltar mkhyen brtse'i dpal mnga' 'gran bral thugs//sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan kun rdzogs rdo rje 'dzin pa'i

rtsom bsam — ra po'irangamangangs —— 67 —/demagon de dran//chol gsum ri bzhi chu lnga sgang drug khyed kyi mdzad phrin thugs rje'i ris//nyi gzhon gsar ba'i 'od kyis ma khyab gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir yod min pa'i//chos srid zung gis bstan pa spel mkhas dbang phyug brgyad ldan 'gro ba'i mgon//bsam bzhin dmu rgod gdul dka'i 'gro rnams 'dul slad 'byon khyod snying nas dran//ngo mtshar snang stong sgyu ma'i rang gzugs gdod nas rdo rje'i sku brnyes shing //rtag 'dzin 'ching ba kun nas lhod phyir chos dbyings zhi ba'i mkha' la gshegs//byams brtse'i ma ma gang nyid dran pas nu zho'i lto can bdag cag ni//skad cig mi bzod skyo gdung drag po'i mig nas mchi ma dbang med 'byin// 'chad na mdo sngags dka' ba'i gnad kun thogs med ri

4 —༄ ngamachima'i la — ——gzar chu klung 'bum//rtsod na bde 'thung glog gi gar bzhin tshul gsum rig lam gnam lcags thog /rtsom na sdeb legs tshig gi sbyor ba e ma lha yi pi wang sgra/'chad rtsod rtsom la 'gran pa'i zla bral dpal ldan bla ma lhag par dran//mdo sngags rab 'byams rig pa'i gnas kun kun mkhyen mkhas pa'i grags snyan ldir//sdom gsum phyag len mig 'bras ltar bsrungs btsun pa'i dri ngad khor yug ldang //'gro kun rang gi bu bzhin rab brtse nye ring mi mnga' spyod pa'i bzang //mkhas btsun bzang gsum dpal gyis rgyud dul bdag gi 'dren mchog snying nas dran//sangs rgyas bstan pa ring du gnas min 'gro pa'i rgyud kyi dad pa ste//de yang bslu med bden pa'i legs bshad yin zhes tshad ma'i skyes pas gsung //

rtsomaḥ༅5—rapo'i4༄4 —zhu4de gnyis spel la mchog tu dpa' ba gangs can zhing gi nyin byed khyod//de ring mig gi yu la du ma gyur kye ma mi bzod gdung bas/ mnar//bdag gi sems kyi kha btags dkar po kye ma su yi phyosas su 'bul//gangs can rgyal bstan gdugs da7ra yu ba kye hud su yis 'dzin par byed//gangs ljongs 'gro ba'i dad pa'i sgron me deng nas su yis sgron par byed//bsam bzhin bsam na skyo ba'i smre sngags mi 'byin shes ldan su zhig mchis// bstan 'gro gnyis kyi bya ba'i khur chen 'jigs med thugs rje'i phrag rtser bzhes// chos srid gnyis kyi bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mi ngal srid zhi'i mthongs na bsgrengs// dbang phyug bye ba'i yon tan mdzod 'dzin phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde//

—— 70 — nga mji ma'i do labyang chu( bar ku spyi bos mchod do sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub 465//bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid nyi gzhon skyabs mchog khyed la rag las phyir//yang dar bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs mkhas gdul bya'i re ltos 'cha' ba'i mgon//yang sprul nyi ma gzhon nu'i 'dzum zer myar du 'char bas smon lam ni// ༄bcos min sems kyi mthil nas 'debs na smon pa bzhin du 'grub gyur cig /7ces rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi ngo bo 'jam dpal gzhon nu ngur smig 'dzin pa mi yi rnam rol du phebs pa dpal ldan bla ma dam pa mchog re zhig zhi ba'i dbyings su gshegs par ma bzod par gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis gsol ba 'debs pa rjes dran sems las 'phos pa'i rol mo zhes bya ba 'di ni yul lan kros grong khyer du gang gi zhal slob gyi gral mtha' 'dzin pa7dkon mchog bsam gtan gyis skyo ba'i dbyangs bcas bris pa'o//
྾ཿ —r+ṣa r+ṣa྾nya4r+ṣa4 hūṃ / bstod dbyangs dri za'i 'gyur khug dzha tshan pa gsum pa/ ṣ+ṭṛ ྾྾ 44྾ 444 ྾ rmo

—4 rtsom 4ཿ ca' do༄ཿ———nga༅— —dpal gyi chos 'khor lha sa/e ma mkha' dbugs gtsang ma'i dbyings na sprin dkar gzhon nus rtse dga' 'dzin//dwangs gsal wu bas gar stabs bsgyur ba'i yar klung gtsang bo'i 'gram gyi ngogs//gser 'od lam lam rgya phibs stong gi 'od snang mkha' la mdzes bar lham// dpal gyi chos 'khor lha sa mthong bas bdag yid dga' bde'i ci yang myos//se ra 'bras spungs dga' ldan la sogs chos kyi sde chen du ma yis//dad ldan 'gro ba'i yid kyi bung ba dbang med 'gugs par som nyi'i dben//'dzam gling go la blum po'i khyon 'dir snyan pa'i grags pa 'bum ldir ba//pho brang chen mo po ta la zhes sum rtsen grong gi zla bor

— 74 /de ba byangs za'i 'a ra 'phags —/de/de ni dmar po ri yi rtse na brjid chags krong nger 'gyings ba yis//rtse mo gser tog rgya phibs 'od snang mkha' dbyings gdong na lam lam 'phro//sil sil dra ba dra phyed sgra dang chos dung snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs sogs//dag pa'i zhing khams dngos su slebs 'dra'i snang ba co yang sbyin par byed//mtshan mor 'bum phrag glog sgron 'od kyis yid 'ong brjid chags po ta lar//kun nas gsal zhing mdzes bar byed pa'i snang brnyan chu yi ngogs na lham//dad ldan 'gro ba'i snying gi thig le ra sa 'phrul ba'i gtsug lag khang //gser tog rgya phibs sprin sngon dbyings na lham mer gsal ba'i 'od 'tsher ba//tshong zong sna tshogs phyur bur gtams pa'i bar skor khrom

rtsom bsam ra po'i rang ma ngas — 75 —rar grags pa der//ci la ci 'dod sna 'dzoms tshong rdzas rmugs 'dzin mdzod la ci yang 'dri//bcu phrag rig gzhung dbyar gyi mtsho mo rgyas ltar bod ljongs slob grwa cher//sman rtsis khang dang gso rig slob grwa la sogs srid na snyan pa ldir//dbu phar mdzod 'dul tshad ma'i gzhung sogs bka' pod lnga la thogs med pa'i//rnam dpyod rab yangs dge ba'i bshes sogs grangs med zhabs kyis bcags pa'i gnas// dbus 'gyur lha ldan jo shāka rnam gnyis byin rlabs gzi 'od 'bar ba'i zhing //mthong thos dran pas dad pa'i snyim pa e ma yid kyi chu mtshor zum//deng 'dir tshan rig lag rtsal la sogs nyin bzhin 'phel zhing rab rgyas pa'i//phyi yi 'dzugs skrun nang gi longs spyod kun la bltas na

— 76 — ba ngabyangs za'i 'a ra yid 'phrog pa//glu gar la sogs rig gnas sna 'dzoms dpal gyi chos 'khor lha sa ni//su yis mthong kyang re ba'i mig zhags dga' bas 'od snang mi spro gang //mkha' dbyings mthon po'i klong na ldir ba'i snyan 'jebs g.yu 'brug gzhon nu'i rnga // rjes chags dga' ba'i gar gyis brel ba sgro ldan rma bya'i bu mo bzhin//dag pa'i zhing dang gnyis su med pa dbus ldan chos 'khor lha sa yi//mdzes pa'i yid drangs gzhon nu gang de'i mgrin pa'i lam nas dngags 'di thal/ /dpal gyi chos 'khor lha sa zhes pa'i snyan rtsom ni phran spyi lo 1997lor lha sar chos mjal du song dus kyi mthong snang gzhi byas te sbyar ba'o//

rtsom bsam ra po'i rang mngangs 77 ——me tog skyed mos tshal gyi glu/ /ma 'gag rten 'byung sgyu mas yo lang gis//legs bris brtan g.yo 'bum phrag sgyu 'phrul las//dbang bos tshon sna mi gcig dus bzhi'i mdangs/ /mthong byed mig gis 'phrul 'di blo las 'gongs//pha rol snang byed mig gi sgyu ma dang //tshur rol mdzes byed yul gyi re khā gnyis//gcig las gcig lhag mdzes sdug ngom pa'i tshe /spro gseng byed pa'i gzhon nu had de lus//kun gsal mdzes ma'i rab dkar 'o 'dzin las//legs 'ongs sbrang char sil mas lan stong du//bkrus pa'i pad ma 'dzum pa'i rgya grol las//rkang ba drug pa 'khyog pa'i gar gyis rtsen//gser ldan dga' ma'i chang gis rab myos pa'i//rkang 'thung g.yu lo 'bar ba'i ljon shing yang //

— 78 —— ba byangs za'i 'a ra — drildanahalo'i mdzes sdug ma bzod nas//cung zad ngo tsha'i nyams kyis 'dar ba 'dra//sprin dkar yon ma 'dzum pa'i tshems bar nas//g.yu 'brug gzhon nus dbyar rnga brdung bas tshe//ma bzod sa la sgeg 'gros rma bya yang //chags pas sgro gur thig le blum por bskor//dbang bos tshon gyis bris pa'i ting 'dzin phugs//'thor ba'i chu thigs mu tig gsar ba'i 'dzum//dal gyis rgyu ba'i dri 'khyer dga' ma yang //dri ldan me tog gzhon nu 'khyud la rangs//bai ḍūr zhun ma dwangs ma'i mtsho 'gram du//rba rlabs zegs ma'i klong na rtsed 'jo can//lto dkar gser mig 'khyil ba'i nya mo yang //rab dgas rkyal rtsal ci yang sbyong bar byed//dar dkar gshog zung bskyod pa'i khrung khrung dang //mgrin pa'i rdza rnga 'khrol ba'i ngang mo dkar//shig shig 'gul ba'i rlabs kyi khrus rdzing du//mdzes pa'i zlos gar ci yang ngom par byed//

rtsom bsam rapo'irangamangangs /de79 —'byung bzhi'i lang tsho'i rab dregs 'dab stong gi//sbrang rtsi chang gis rab myos bung ba yang //gang gi mdzes sdug dpyid la snying nye nas//dga' bas mchu 'dab yang yang sbyor bar byed//mtshan mo mkha' la rgyu ba'i 'od dkar can//gang gi mdzes sdug dpal la rjes chags nas//e ma dwangs gsal chu yi rdzing bu ru//'bum phrag gzugs kyi snang brnyan ci yang gsal//skyed tshal mdzes pa'i mkha' dbugs la chags te//skra lo dung ltar dkar ba'i rgan po yang /rang nus lus kyi rtsal dag sbyong pa dang //dga' bas spro gseng dus kyis ci yang brel//shes rig yon tan kho lag rab rdzogs pa'i//dwangs gsal shel mig mnabs pa'i mkhas pa'i tshogs//rang 'os shes bya'i bdud rtsi 'thung bzhin du//mdzes pa'i skyed tshal 'di na gcig tu gnas//'o 'dzin lang tsho'i dud pa'i gzhon nu ma//'dod pa'i chang gis rab myos mdza' bo dang //

—— 1gi ba ngangabyangs ཿ'a rakhya ——/de—— —lha na du brtse dung bgro ba gleng bzhin mchis//de ni zla gzhon dbus kyi gzugs brnyan ltar//stong ba'i dbyings na bris pa'i sgyu ma'i gzugs//sgyu 'phrul skyed mos tshal gyi mdzes sdug gis//drang bor srong ba'i sems kyang bslu byed na//bcos ma'i yid kyis bzod thabs ga la 'dug/drang srong dka' thub can rnams de la chags//stobs 'byor mnga' thang can tsho de la spro//'dod pa'i lang tsho can rnams de la dga'//brtan g.yos mdzes sdug de yis 'phrog min nam//dus tshigs rnam bzhi'i kha dog mi 'dra ba'i//dbang bo'i gzhu ris lta bu'i skyed tshal 'dis//deng rabs gzhon nu'i shin tu gsal ba'i yid//bslu bas rnam grangs grangs gyis ga la gzhal//phar la blta ba'i mig gi dbang bo yang //tshur la snang ba'i skyed tshal des bslus nas//dbang med sems kyi chu 'dzin g.yo ba las//snyan tshig sprin gyi me tog 'di ko thal//

rtsom bsamang rapo'isga ma55 sa /spra bdag gi ma yum slob grwa/ka kha la sogs thog mar sbyang ba'i yul//kha ba lhab lhab 'bab ba'i sa cha ste//ga sa gang du nor lug gis khyab pa'i//nga yi ma yum slob grwa rjes su dran//ca co 'ur zing phyogs la mi spro zhing //cha rkyen bzang ngan gang la mi ltos par//ja zas rnal ma'i 'tsho ba la rol te//nya mo chu la rtsen bzhin shes byar dga'//ta la'i 'dab ltar rnam dpyod ches yangs par//tha snyad shes bya'i rnam grangs kyis phyug pa'i//da lta mkhas pa'i grwar du tshud pa rnams//na tshod chung ngu'i dus su 'di nas sbyangs//pa sangs ltar dkar sems ldan dge rgan tshos//pha mas bu la byams skyong ji bzhin du//

/ 83 — ba dbyangs za'i' ra /deb mo'i zil ba la 'khu gsar ba'i blo//ma lus shes bya'i nor gyis phyug par byas//tsa ri ltar bsil 'gu log sa cha ste//tsha grang snyoms pa'i ma yum slob grwa ru//dzā ti'i me tog dpal bzhin khor yug gtsang //wa wol bung bas 'phur lding rol sa red//zha sgyug lag tu thog pa'i slob ma tshos//za 'thung la sogs dus tshod bed spyad de//'a 'ur ma yin blo rig bsgrims pa'i ngang //ya rabs mkhas pa'i go 'phang brtson kyin mchis//ra ba khor yug mdzes pa'i slob grwa ru//la la rab dgas rtsed mo g.yengs pa dang //sha thang 'bad pa 'ga' zhig slob sbyong ched//sa gzhir yi be'i ri mo 'bri bzhin gda'//ha cang yid 'ong ma yum slob grwa 'dir//a pra'i 'bras bu lta bu'i slob gso ldan//ha ri ṇa yi gar mkhan ma bzhin du//a ho yid dbang mi 'phrog dpyod ldan su//

—/de— rtsom bsamad rapo'irangamadangs — 83/de/de7bdag gi ma yum slob grwa ni mgo 'o sa khul gcig sgril rdzong dpal yul dar thang chos sde chen po'i nye 'dabs su gnas la/ bdag chung dus su rig gnas kyi rmang gzhi 'di nas chags la/ der slob gso dang sgrig lam/ kun spyod/ khor yu ga sogs phyogs kun nas gzhan yid 'phrog par gdon mi za ba zhig tu ma/chis pas phran gyis nam yang yid nas brjed thabs bral bar ma zad yang yang bsngalas brjod dbang med du thal bas ka rtsom 'di bris ba yin no//gan lho'i zla zer dus deb la bstod pa dbyar skyes sngon mo'i sgra dbyangs/ / rab dkar 'o ma'i chu gter las 'khrungs pa'i//mdzes sdug shel dkar mdangs la co 'dri ba//dkar gsal zla bzhin ut+pal mig yangs mas /bdag mgrin pad+ma'i 'dab brgya 'byed par mdzod//kun lho gser ldan bu mo'i phang ba ru//snyan rtsom 'dab phreng rtse dga' rgod pa yi//dpal gyur dri med 'dod 'jo zla zer zhes//blo gsal kun da'i gnyen du shar la bsngags//deng rabs blo ldan rig pa'i rtsed 'jo las//

— 84 — ba dbyangs za'i 'a ra khya— 'khrungasapasnyan 'jebs rtsom gyi ut+pal phreng //gcig las gcig lhag 'dren byed dbang bo'i dpyid//zla zer zhes grags dus deb 'di ko rmad//phun tshogs rig gzhung chu 'dzin dra ba las//tshig sbyor mdzes sdug bde 'thung dang 'grogs pa'i//legs bshad dbyar las skyes pa'i rnga gsang sgra/snyan tshig dus deb 'di yi dpal du rdzogs//mkhas dgu'i mkhyen dpyod rta bdun dbang bo 'bum//rtsom 'dod phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i khyon yangs por//shar ba'i 'od kyi snyan rtsom chu skyes 'dab//grol ba dus deb 'di yi dpal du smin//ci 'dod re skong yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal//snyan 'jebs tshig gi phreng 'di rgyad mangs 'dra//blo gsal don gnyer can gyi mazlo' na mo//legs bshad char 'bebs zla zer 'di ko rmad//blo rig 'dab stong dgod pas nyin byed dbang //blang dor phra zhib 'byed pas dkyus ring spyan//deng rabs na chung dga' bas gnyen gcig pu//

ཿtshongartsom bsamang ra po'i rang mngangs//de 85 — 4ོrmede'aphrogazlazirabarmosal cilothe——— —— — sgo ——————4legs legs blo gsal yid kyi rtse dga'ade nas//gsal gsal legs/ bshad zla zer me tog phreng //mdzes mdzes mig gi bdud rtsir smin ma thag /myur myur bstod pa'i glu dbyangs 'di blangs so//7ces man lho'i 〈 zla zer dus deb 〉la bstod pa dbyar skyes sngo na mo'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba ni phran rang lo nyer gsum spyi 'o 1967kho/'i zla 9 pa'i tshes 21 la bris shing rjes sor lo de'i gan lho'i 〈 zla zer〉dus deb nang 'khod pa las bshus so// dben gnas yid dga' chos 'phel gling gi khyad chos/ /kun gsal mdzes ma baiḍūr chos kyi dbyings//chu 'dzin gzhon nu dgyes pa'i tshems phreng las/ /dbyar skyes rnga gsang dal gyis brdung ba na//sbrang char sngon mo 'bebs pas sta gon byed//nor 'dzin phyug mo g.yu yi gzhong ba na//sna lnga'i dri ldan me tog mgo lcog ldem//

—— 86 — ba byangs za'i 'a ra khya ༅ bungababyelebasgegapa'igarartsezhing /de—gnyis skyes mgrin snyan dga' bas glu dbyangs len//tshang tshang g.yu lo dud pa dga' ba'i tshal//dri 'khyer dga' mas reg tshe ldem ldem g.yo//na bun smug pos 'khyud pa'i rdza brag rnams//e ma ting 'dzin la gnas drang srong bzhin//mad rgad zhun ma'i mdangs 'dzin spang gzhong mthil//dri ldan ha lo'i ljon shing rgyas pa'i rtser//gzhan gsos bu yis dung dung 'then pa'i glus//yid kyi 'ching ba kun nas lhod par byed//bar snang dbyings su bya rgyal rgod po lding //'dzin ma'i thig ler shwa rkyang dgo ba rtse//dwangs gsal mtsho mo khrung khrung chu bya'i tshogs//rab dgas gshog 'gyur rlabs phreng rtse na bsgyur//gdug pa'i mtshan ma'i ming yang mi grags shing //dga' ba'i dge mtshan 'dzad pa med pa'i gnas//ting 'dzin zab mo'i rtogs pa ngang gis skye//yid dga' chos 'phel gling 'di su yis gnas//

rtsom bsam da ra po'i rang mdangs /de 87 — —deningagaladabang 'byorachosakyirje /de/de'agro kun gtan bde dga' ba'i zhing khams te//rin chen gsum gyi dpal la 'god mdzad pa//bshes gnyen bzang po gang de'i sgrub phugs lags//phyi ru shes bya kun mkhyen blo gros rgyas//nang du rim gnyis gnad kyi rtsal kun rdzogs//gsang ba las bzhi'i dpyid la dbang 'byor ba'i//gtan gyi skyabs gcig khyod la snying nas dad//srid gsum 'gro ba'i zhing sa gshin ngo la//dge legs kun phan sbrang char 'jo dang lhan//bka' gsung 'gyur med zim bu'i sgra brgya yis//skal bzang ma yur bskyangs te phyag 'gyid do//pas rgol klad 'gems rig pa'i mche sder rno//log smra zil gnon g.yu yi ral klong brjid//'gro kun rjes 'dzin dge ba'i lus stobs rdzogs//gangs ri'i 'phrog byed khyod 'dra srid 'dir dkon//nyi zla'i rna cha sgron pa'i ri rgyal bzhin//ting 'dzin mi g.yo dga' bde'i klong yangs nas//

—— 88 — ba nga byangs za'i 'a ra — 'grokunamayisabulabartseb ltar ——/de—thugs rje'i 'ching zhags nam yang lhod pa med//'di na gang gi thugs rje'i 'tsho ba bdag /ngang ba'i bu mo pad ma'i mtsho la bzhin//rtag tu khyod la yid kyis gsol 'debs na//thugs klong rdo rje'i dbyings nas 'da' med shog /7dben pa'i gnas ri yid dga' chos 'phel gling gi khyad chos zhes pa'i snyan tshig gsol 'debs 'di ni/ chos rje rnyi phuḥrin po che ngag dbang kun dga' ṭ+wāṃt+na byes hāpal bzang bo la gsol ba rtse gcig tu 'debs pa'i smon tshig gsol grogs la sbon pa'i mchid lhag bsam dkar bo'i rang mdangs/ /dgun gsum kha ba dkar bos rab g.yogs shing //dbyar gsum khu byug sngon mos glu len pa'i//ston gsum su ru'i me tog bzhad pa'i yul//rgan gya zhes grags nor 'dzin thig le ru//don med 'du 'dzi phyogs la mi dga' zhing //

rtsom bsam nga ra po'i rang mngangs — 89 —— bag phebs shes bya'iganasalagacig tubartson——4— /degazhung drang grogs la phyi thag ring ba yi//snying gi thig le gang khyod mchid 'di sbon//dus kyi 'gyur ldog rta phos bang bzhin skyen//mi yi bsam blo bal po'i ras khra 'dra//na chung phal cher rang 'dun lam gyis dben//su la yid rton dka' ba'i dus tshod 'dir//ser bo gser gyi rang bzhin ji bzhin du//rang rgyud bzang bo'i rang bzhin ma 'dor na//rkyen ngan dus dang mi yi 'gyur ldog gis//dbang du 'gro ba med do yid kyi grogs//sa pan gyis/dam pa srog la babs na yang //rang bzhin bzang po ga la 'dor//sa ler sbram ni bsregs bcad kyang //de yi kha dog nyams mi 'gyur//zhes gsungs so//deng sang skye bo phal cher gsar 'grogs che//'phrad ma thag nas snying gtam 'byin byed kyang //lo gcig ma 'gor dgra yi dwangs mar rlom//

— — 90 — ba da ngabyangs za'i 'a ra khukye ma rang gzhan 'phung bas phyag ma bzhin// —nor dang lus kyi stobs shugs zhan na yang //rang bzhin brtan cing shes la rab grims na//'gyur med bde ba'i chu shel dbang bo ni//sems kyi phugs nas 'char ro mig yangs kye//rang gis 'bad pa'i go cha ma bgos na//sems kyi tsher ma gang gis mi 'don la//yon tan kha ru sus kyang mi ldug pas//blo sems nang du khug la 'bad par rigs//gangs ri'i ljongs na grags pa'i bcu phrag rig/seng chen mkha' la mchongs 'dra'i mkhas pa'i gsung //chu klung dwangs pa'i dbus kyi zla gzugs bzhin//ma lus sems kyi thig ler 'ub chud mdzod//kwa ye yid kyi zhu 'phrin ko ki la//'di nas le dbar nyis brgya'i chod pa'i sar//nga yi snying gi grogs po gang de'i drung //zhu 'phrin mgrin pas glu dbyangs longs shig ang //kun gsal dbyings su rgod pa'i sgra brgya ba//

rtsom bsam ra po'i rang ma ngas /de 91 /derjes chags sgro ldan rma bya'i bu mo bzhin//gang khyod yid kyi thig le nas 'ongs pa'i//gsung 'phrin gang gā'i rgyun gyi zla bor zhu//7gang gi yid kyi grogs po dkon mchog bsam gtan gyis zla 4pa'i tshes 1la bris pa dge/bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal dus deb la bstod pa bkra shis rtags mtshan rdzogs pa'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba/ /rnyog bral 'o ma'i chu mtshor lan stong du//nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bkrus pa ltar//pad ma'i bzhin la ut+pal mig ldan ma//tshangs sras bu mo'i zhabs skyes gtsug gis mchod//dri med lhag bsam zla ba'i bsil zer gyis//dpag med skye dgu'i yid dbang mngon 'phrog pa//

— 92 — ba byangs za'i 'a ra mtshungs med mkhas pa'i zhabs sen nor bu'i phreng //grangs med 'gro ba'i gtsug na mdzes gyur cig/rnam mang shes bya'i rig gzhung pad ma'i mtshor//rnam dpyod blo gros rtsal gyis 'phur lding can//snyan tshig mgrin glu 'khrol ba ngang mo'i khyu//deng rabs dga' bde'i tshal na rtsen par rigs//tshig gi sbyor ba mi dman mgrin mgul las//snyan pa'i sdeb sbyor g.yas 'khyil dung gi sgra//phyogs kyi bu mo'i 'gram stegs la 'god pas//bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal a ho rmad//phun tshogs rgyal mtshan ma lus lhun rdzogs pa'i//mdzes sdug rtsom rig ka sha'i mdud rgya can//sgyu rtsal dpal be'u dra mig gzhig bral ba'i//rnam mang rig gzhung bsu ba'i legs skyes bsngags//mi mthun rgud pa'i smag rum stug po las//rnam rgyal kun phan gser gyi yu ba can//zla med rtsom rig mdzes pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog/grags snyan srid zhi'i khongs na brjid khyod bsngags//

/de/de rtsom bsam ra po'i rang mngangs 93 —log spyod tsha ba'i gdung ba gtan bcom shing //phun tshogs sde bzhi'i sham bu mdzes grol ba//bod kyi rtsom rig bla med gdugs dkar bo//srid gsum 'gro ba'i rgyan gyur de la bsngags//skye dgu'i phan bde'i legs tshogs mdzes pa'i phreng //dpyid du rdzogs pa'i dge mtshan rtsibs stong can//rtsom rig mu khyud blum pos nyer mdzes pa'i//mtshungs med rig gzhung 'khor lo bsngags la spro//yid 'phrog shes rig 'o ma'i chu gter du//deng rabs snyan rtsom nyams ldan rlabs kyi phreng //dga' mgur rtsen pa'i blo ldan gser mig khyu//mkhas dbang kun yid 'gugs mkhas mdza' bor bsngags//nang na don bzang bcud kyis yongs su gtams//phyi ru snyan tshig gser gyi gzi mdangs 'bar//mi zad rig gzhung gter gyi bum pa bzang //blo gsal dga' ba'i gnyen du thob la bsngags//zab yangs snyan rtsom bdud rtsi'i zil mngar bcud//yongs smin mdzes pa'i 'dab phreng g.yur du za//

— 91 — ba byangs za'i 'a ra mdzes sdug dus deb pad ma'i 'dzum dkar gyis//blo gsal yid dbang rtse dga'i ngos su 'god//khyed cag blo gros pad ma'i rtsi bcud las//'khrungs pa'i snyan rtsom mngar bo'i bdud rtsi'i bcud//bdag cag rkang drug gzhon nu'i rtsed 'jo'i dpal//thob pa'i dga' mgur ro yis ci yang myos//bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal smin legs gzugs//blo gsal bdag gi 'dren byed dpyid dpal du//thob pa'i dga' ba yid kyi rtsigs ngos su//gsal ba'i snyan rtsom rtse dga' 'di ko thal//7zhes bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal dus deb 'di nyid dpar 'don thengs grangs lnga bcu zin par bkra shis bde legs zhu ba'i tshul du tha snyad smra ba7mgo ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃspyanā ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃg bsam gtan gyis spyi lor 1998lo'i zla 6pa'i tshes 13gyi

/de/ rtsom bsam rapo'irangamangangs— 95 rwa—rgyal bo rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod khrod kyi btsun mo sī ta'i mjes sdug la bsngags pa legs bris me na ka yi zlos gar zhes bya ba/ /sngo bsangs dwangs ma'i mkha' dbyings mthon po'i klong //lang long sprin dkar rtse dgas 'dzum phreng ngom//mdongs mtha'i bu mo'i re ba skong slad du//dbyar skyes rnga gsing dal gyis brdungs par byed//de las 'ong ba'i dga' char sil ma'i 'bras// nor 'dzin sgeg mo'i bzhin ras brlan par byas//de la blta 'dod pad+ma ut+pal sogs//mdzes pa'i bzhin gyi mgo lcog ci yang ldem//dri bsung zhim pos gcus pa rkang drug dang //thig le'i 'dab yangs phye ma leb rtse sogs//rna ba'i bcud len dir dir dbyangs lam nas//'phur lding gar gyi rtse 'jo ci yang rol//phyogs kyi 'khor lo mdzes ma'i 'gram pa'i gzhir//

— 96 — ba byangs za'i 'a ra mtshams sprin gzhon nus rtse dgas dmar 'od 'dzin//lo ma 'bras bu g.yur za ting 'dzin phugs//mdzes pa'i phul gson sī ta'i snyan pa 'phur//de ni stobs kyi 'khor lo rgyal srid sogs//chags med mchil ma'i thal bzhin phun tshogs kun//yal bar 'dor nus snying stobs rmad po che//rā ma ṇa yi dga' grogs sī ta lags//shel gyi lcugs phran ldem 'dra'i mdzes pa'i gzugs//dung gi zla ba la 'gran 'dzum pa'i bzhin//bong ba ltar nag mdzes pa'i lan bu sogs//gcig las gcig lhags mdzes sdug 'gran pa bzhin//gang gi mtshar sdug dpal la ma bzod nas//ri bong 'dzin pa nam mkha'i dbyings la bros//bung ba'i bu mo pad ma'i tshal la yibs//nag po brtsegs pa bde 'byung mgrin par 'khyil//khyod kyi gdong gi dri bsung la sred de//tsan dan a ka ru sogs bzang bo'i dri//'khyer bas rdzu bag la brten lho phyogs kyi//

rtsom bsam ra po'i rang ma ngas — — 97 /de/de—malalarlungaskegapa'igaragyis rtsenaganag snum smin 'khyog dkyus ring 'dren byed zung //e ma/ ut+pal mthing ga'i 'dab mar 'khrul//rab dmar bag tsam grol ba'i mchu sgros las//yang dag mthong ba tshems phreng lta na sdug/'jam mnyen sku stod yangs pa'i do ra ru//mkhrang zhing blum pa'i nu 'bur zung gis sgeg/de ni shin tu dwangs pa'i chu klong dbus//ngang ba'i bu mo dal gyis rgyu ba bzhin//gnam sngon mdangs kyi khu bas sbags pa ltar//srab 'jam lha rdzas gos kyi stod g.yogs las//cung zad sgrib min snang ba'i sku gzugs ni//e ma/ cha/kha' dbyings chu 'dzin drwa ba las//'od dkar can gyi 'dzum zer spros bzhin mdzes//dkar mdzes dbyibs legs gang gi mgul ba la//rin chen sna lnga'i phra tshom dbu rgyan ni//sngo bsangs stong ba'i dbyings kyi nam mkha' la//sgyu skar phreng tshogs lam lam 'tsher ba bzhin//

/de༅— ba dbyangs ཿ'a rakhra ——/de—dkar zhing phra ba mdzes pa'i skad skabs ni//rin chen sil sil sgra 'dzin rgyan gyis sgrib//de ni ku mud gsar 'khrungs mdzes pa'i bzhin//snying nye bung bas gshog pas 'gebs pa 'dra//lcugs phran 'khri shing gsar ba ldem pa'i lus//pad ma'i zhal dkyil g.yo ldan ut+pal mig/mdze4 ma khyod kyi dmal la blta bas slad//brgya byin mig stong sprul ba cis ma lags//chil chil rlabs kyis bkrus pa'i chu bya bzhin//khrid kyi mnyen lcugs lag pa'i yal ga la//rin chen mdzes pa'i sor gdub sgra 'byin pas//bsam bzhin chags ldan gnyid las slong ba 'dra//rol las rnyed shing zhing pa'i 'dren byed zung //'gul min snang brnyan gzugs su khyod kyis 'god//khengs ldan dpal gyis myos pa'i rā ma ṇa//khyod kyi bran bzhin nags kyi rtul zhugs 'dzin//srid gsum mdzes pa'i lang tsho ldan bzhin tu//da dung rgyan gyis spud 'di ngal ba'i rgyu//

ba rtsom bsam rapo'irang ngangs ——390/desum rtsen gnas na grags pa'i dga' ra/ rnams//khyod kyi bran tsam thob par dka' bas nongs//gdong bzhi gdong gi pad tshal gyis bltas kyang //khyod kyi mtshar sdug ngoms pa'i mtha' mi rig /yid 'phrog mdzes pa'i lang tsho srung slad du//khyab 'jug mi'u thung zol gyis btegs min nam//dal bu'i rlung gis 'dzum pa'i rba rlabs dang //ge sar tshems phreng ngom pa'i dpal gos sogs//khyod kyi 'dzum zer phra mo'i cha rer yang //med phyir rang nyid dper bstan lus phra ma /gya gyur 'khyog par 'bab ldan dza hu'i rgyun//ha ri gar mkhan dri 'khyer bu mo yang //gang gi mdzes sdug dpal la ma bzod nas//'khyog pa'i tshul gyis rgyu zhes tshangs chen smra//mdzes mas 'gram chang gis 'byed ba ku la//tshogs can rkang bas sor gdub gyis reg tshe//'dzum pa'i mya ngan med shing dpal gos bzhin// gang gi lang tsho gsar bas su ma bcom//

/de 100 — ba byangs 6 za'i 'a ra 'phags yul chos kyi zhing na snyan pa'i rnga//ring du ldir ba rā ma ya ṇa'i gtam//chos dbang grags pa'i thugs kyi 'o mtsho las//gangs ljongs bsil ba'i tshal la 'dren pa'i rgyun//don ldan lo rgyus phreng 'di yal bor nas//don med snyan tshig gzhan dag blangs ba ni//ri bong 'dzin pa mkha' nas shar ba la//blta phyir rnyog pa'i khron par re ba bzhin//tshig gi lo mas sgrib g.yogs mi ldan zhing //snyan pa'i ro 'don mdzes ma'i lang tsho bzhin//gang na gson nyams ldan zhing yid 'gul ba//de ni snyan ngag sdeb sbyor byang ba'i rtags//de ltar snyan ngag la byang ngag rtsal gyis//brjod bya'i dngos po gang yin bstod pa'am//sgro btags la sogs nyams kyis klog mkhan gyi//yid kyi thig le kun nas 'jo bar mdzad//brjod bya don gyi chu gter gting mtha' bral//rjod byed ngag gi phreng ba'i rba rlabs can//

rtsom bsam ra po'i rang ma ngas/de 101 /delo rgyus snyan dngagasaphrenga'adibaklagapa'imod —/de+obastod pa'i glu dbyangs dbang med mgrin las thal /7zhes brjod bya rjod byed gang gi cha nas yid 'phrogs pa'i rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod bklag pas 'char snang 'di ni dkon mchog bsam gtan nam ming sazhan dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros gyis 1999'o 'i zla10tshes1la bris/lha bzo zhig gi ngo mtshar ba'i lag rtsal la bsngags pa bkra shis rtsibs stong rdzogs pa'i 'khor lo zhes bya bzhugs so//gangs ri shel gyi sman ljongs sā la'i tshal//yid 'phrog g.yu yi mtsho mo 'khyil ba'i sa//ngo mtshar dge bcu'i thig le zlum por bkra//de las 'ongs pa'i dpyod ldan gzhon nu zhig/thugs la shes rig 'o mtsho'i rlabs phreng 'gyur//ngag la bgrang yas legs bshad bdud rtsi 'khyil//lag na sgyu rtsal bye ba'i gser mig 'khyugs//bi shwa kurma gnyis pa bsngags la spro//

— 102 — ba byangs ske za'i 'a ra phul byung rig rtsal 'khyugs pa'i rtse dga' dang //yid 'phrog lag sor ldem pas 'du 'god las//ngo mtshar dbang bo'i gzhu ris snang brnyan 'bum//'phos pa srid gsum mdzes pa'i rgyan du che//gang gi rnam dpyod gser 'od 'khyugs pa'i tog /rab mdzes lag rtsal ka shi'i sham bu g.yo//yid 'phrog bzo rig gser gyi yu ba brtan//rmad byung rin chen gdugs dkar dpal la 'khu//ngo mtshar bzo rig 'o ma'i chu gter dbus//brtson 'grus rkyal rtsal gshog zung 'khyugs pa can//ya rabs dam pa'i rang mdangs 'od du 'tsher//srid zhi'i khongs na gser gyi nya mo bzhin//'dzad med shes rig longs spyodi mdzod du 'khyil//gang la gang 'dod re ba lhun gyis grub//mtha' yas dpal 'byor 'gugs pas yid bzhin gter//mdun 'dun rig pa gter chen bum bzang bzhin//rang gzhan kun phan mdzes pa'i rtsa ba brtan//gang 'dod sgyu rtsal lhugs 'jo yal 'dab yangs//

rtsom bsam ra po'i rang mdangs 103 —shes bya'i me tog ge sar 'dzum pa can//bzo rig rgya mtsho pad dkar sdong bu bzhin//mi shigs dad pas 'dun ma gzhom gzhig bral//kun phan rtse dga'i mdangs bzang lham mer bkra//ngo mtshar sgyu rtsal ri mo'i dra mig 'khyil//phul byung lag rtsal mdzes sdug dpal be'u bzhin//bgrang yas rnam dpyod rtse dga'i ba dan g.yo//ngo mtshar lag rtsal sman thang tog gis mdzes//mi mthun rgud pas gdung ba las rgyal ba'i//mngon par mtho ba mchog gi rgyal mtshan bzhin//shes rab mtha' bral ri mo'i lte ba zlum//rgya mtsho lta bu'i sgyu rtsal rtsibs stong bkra//kun spyod dam pa'i mu khyud dra ba can// phul byung gser gyi 'khor lo'i gzi byin bzhin//rnam mang shes bya'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa las//legs 'ong lha ris sgyu rtsal chos kyi char//ngo mtshar skye bos gzigs mor 'thob pa'i mod//rab dga'i bsngags brjod 'brug stong ldir ba bzhin//

— 104 —— ba ngabyangs za'i 'a ra de ltar bzo rig sgyu rtsal la mkhas pa'i//rnam dpyod gsar ba'i rtse dga' ngom pa na//mdzes pa'i 'gram chang mngar bos yid myos pas//kun dga' bskyed 'di ba ku la bzhin no//gna' rabs nyams myong sgyu rtsal bye ba'i steng //deng rabs 'bur gzugs gson nyams dpal ldan zhing //nub lugs snum tshon ri mo la sogs pa//lha ris sgyu rtsal ma lus thugs su chud//nyams myong rgan po'i sems kyang mog por sgyur//khengs ldan gzhon nu'i yid kyang 'phrogs byed pa//sgra tshad bzo gso shes bya'i gnas thams cad//khyod kyi thugs ngor pad nang bung bzhin rol//sprin sngon dbyings na rgod pa'i zim bu'i sgra//rjes chags thig le'i sgro 'dzin rma bya bzhin//gang gi lha ris mdzes pa'i sgyu rtsal gyis//yid drangs bsngags pa'i glu 'di mgrin las lud//7ces bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi rgyan gyis spras pa'i lha bzo zhig gi ngo mtshar ba'i lag rtsal la bsngags pa zhes bya ba 'di ni yul mgo log gi lha ris pa chen po

rtsom bsam ra po'i rang mdangs/de 105 /desgerā rab rgya mtsho'i ngo mtshar zhing phul tu byung ba'i lag rtsal gyisnangabarnyan dang — ṭ+wāṃt+yā ṭ+wāṃ ༈d+ngha / ni rnam dpyod gsar ba'i rtse dgas yid drangs te 'phral du sbyar dus tshigs rnam bzhi/dgun/mkha' dbyings gdong gi skar tshogs 'dar byed kyang //mu med rgya mtsho dar gyi yol ba 'dzin//ri thang med par kha ba'i rdul gyis g.yogs//dgun zhes grags pa'i dpa' bo 'jigs su rung //grang rlung bser bu'i spu gri lag tu thogs//'jam mnyen rtsi bcud me tog ma lus 'joms//dwangs gsal nyal 'gro'i rgyan dag gcod byed pas//khyod ni snying rje med pas rgoshed ma 'dra//dpyid/'khyags pas bsdams pa'i sa gzhi drod kyis bskyangs//grang ba'i reg byas gdung ba'i skye dngos tshogs//

—— 106 /de ba byangs za'i 'a ra gnyid las sad bzhin lus mdangs rgyas byed pas//dpyid kyi dus 'di brtse ldan ma ma 'dra//nyal 'gro'i bu mo chab rom rgya las thar//bung ba phye leb lus kyi gshog zung rgyas//khu byug sngon mo dga' bas mgrin glu len//khyod ni brtse ldan a ma'i 'dzum zhal 'dra//dbyar/kun gsal dbyings na sprin dkar lang long 'phyur//nor 'dzin yangs por g.yu yi mdangs 'dzin zhing //sbrang char sil ma mkha' nas 'jo ba'i dus//dbyar gyi dpyid 'di lha yi mdzes ma 'dra//'brug sgra snyan mo sing sing ldir ba'i mod//mdongs mtha'i bu mos ling ling gar bsgyur zhing //me tog sna tshogs lam lam bzhad pa ste//khyod ni yid du 'phrogs pa'i bu mo bzhin//

rtsom bsam ra po'i rang mngangs/de 107 /de ston/dri bral mkha' dbyings baiḍūr zhun ma'i mdangs//rlabs phreng wu ba'i gar 'dzin dal 'gro ma//e ma dmar ser li khri'i dpal dang ldan//ston gyi dus 'di ma dros klu dbang 'dra//gser mdog snye ma'i skra lo gser ldem ldem//phang phung chags pas rtsi bcud khur gyis dud//rkang bzhi phyugs kyi 'du 'god sprin phung 'dra//khyod kyi dpal yon rnam thos sras bzhin brjid//zhes lan kru'u grong khyer nas/spyi lo1999lo'i zla12tshes30la/

— 108 — ba nga byangs za'i 'a ra bod kyi yul ljongs la bsngags pa khu byug myos pa'i gdangs glu/ke la sha ri'i ljongs na gnas shing //khe tshong la sogs las la brtson pa//ge sar rgyal bo'i lo rgyus ldan sa//nge cag bod mi'i sa cha yin song //ce spyang la sogs ngar skad 'byin zhing //che mtho mkhas pa'i snyan grags ldan sa//je mang je che'i bsod nams bsags sa//nye ring med par kun la byams sa//te bor shes bya'i yon tan brtson zhing //the tshom med par sgro 'dogs chod sa//de ring ma zad mkhas pa'i go 'phang //ne tsos sgro 'dzin ljongs 'dir 'dzoms song //pe cing la sogs rgya yul kun tu//phe tse'i re so ji bzhin mdzes zhes//be'u lug mang bo'i rtsed 'jo rol sa//

rtsom bsam ra po'i rang mjangs— 109 —— me togartsildan bodakyiljongasaram̐d ba/de——tse re sgra 'byin nags kyi bye'u//tshe bsod gzhi ma chos kyi dgon grwa/dze reg phog thug bral ba'i bod mi//wer ma la sogs dgra lha 'khor sa//zhe sa brtsi 'jog 'dzoms pa'i sa cha//ze 'bru phang phung ldem pa'i yul ljongs//'e cag dag pa lha yi ljongs bzhin//re 'dun ma lus lhun gyis grub sa//le lo g.yengs pa gnyid las bslang sa//she mong lta bu'i stobs 'byor rgyas sa//se ba mkhan pa ba lu'i rgyan sa//he he gangs can bod kyi ljongs 'dir//e ma sum rtsen lha yi dpal zhes//he bag med par kun gyis bstod ra//e ma gsung gcig mgrin gcig bsgrags song //7bod kyi yul ljongs la bsngags pa khu byug myos pa'i gdangs glu zhes bya ba 'di nan cin grong khyer du sa mo yos kyi smin drug zla ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba gnyis pa'i nyin bris pa dza yan tu/

— 110 —/debra ngangabyangs za'i' ra —/demargo khrog sa kuyi gyi gnyan po gasku rtse'i snod bcud kyi thon tan cung zad brjod pa dbyangasu can gzhon nu dgyesu pas 'dzum zerna zhesga bya ba/mkha' dbyings dwangs mar 'od gsal nyi zla'i mdzes pa'i thig le rtse dga' rgod//brjid chags lhun stug rdza ri sngon mor kha ba dkar bo'i dar thod 'dzin//rab yangs dbyig 'dzin dga' ma'i lto bar dwangs gsal gaX/ yi ma31 phyorgo 9rdostertoshā/// a sngon dbyings su mdzes par bslangs pa'i g.yu rtse'i gzi byin snyan pa 'phur//rtse na sprin dkar gzhon nus 'du 'god g.yang dkar lug gi khyu tshogs bzhin//bar na smug sprin na bun sngon mo lha yi bla bre bris pa 'dra//'dabs na tshang tshing g.yu yi ljon shing chu gter dga' ma'i

lhunartsomalngagabs mngalar po'ir ngamadang sa/—— 11/ — nga ——4—ོ/de—/de/de /de/༅——nga—— ————nga — ———— ༅—rlabs phreng bzhin//e ma lha yi gnas mchog chen po g.yu rtse'i ngo mtshar srid las 'gongs /gangs ri rdza ri g.ya' ri la sogs gcig las gcig lhag mdzes sdug dpal//bar snang dbyings kyi sprin dkar gseb na rtse mo rno zhing lhun chags pa//gangs chu rdza chu phu chu la sogs lhung lhung 'bab lda na snyan pa'i ṭ+wāṃ~X/sa/ chen dka' thub gnyid las slong shing gdong bzhis bltas kyang ngoms pa med//shar gyi sgo srung lha yon thod dkar mtho zhing brjid chags lta na sdug /lho yi sgo srung dar dkar snang rtse g.yang gzar mkha' la snyesas pa 'dra//nub kyi sgo srung rdza ri gser khrab zur gsu/ma phur nag bslangs/ bzhin brjid//byang gi sgo srung pha bong gru bzhi spang sngon mthil gyi lha g.yag

—— 112 — ba da byangs za'i' rakhu zlodra/———— — — ————srid zhi'i mdzes sdug bdag gir bzhes pa'i brjid chags g.yu rtse'i nang ma'i sgor//g.yas kyi srung ma rgya stag dmar po thur tu mchong 'dra'i 'jigs su rung //g.yon gyi srung ma lha g.yag dkar bo bag phebs lhun brjid zhi ba'i nyams//ngo mtshar mdzes pa'i dpal de chags nas brgya byin mig stong sprul min nam//gangs ri'i ljongs kyi phyag rdor gnyis pa lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje yis//byin rlabs char gyis brlan pas sgrub phugs ngo mtshar ting 'dzin phugs pa mang //mkhas dbang mkhyen brtses zhabs kyi me tog rdo la gsal ba'i ngo mtshar ris /ge sar rgyal po'i cang shes rmig rjes la sogs bltad mo 'di na gda'//grub pa'i khyu mchog rdzogs chen ras pa'i byin rlabs stong

rtsom bsam da ra po'i rang ma ngas/de 113 ————'bar phyag gi rjes//gling gi dpal thul rgya tsha la sogs mang bos dpal rtsal 'gran pa'i brdar//ral gri'i shul dang mda' yi shul sogs bden dpang lo rgyus re khā 'bum//deng gi dus 'dir thun mong skye bo'i mig gi dpyid du snang min nam//dwangs shing gsal ba g.yu yi mtsho mo gnam sngon sa la 'khyil bzhin mdzes// 'o ma'i bdud rtsi mer gyis ltems 'dra'i dkar mdzes dung gi mtsho mo dang //mtshams sprin gsar ba'i rtse dga' la 'gran dmar ser rag ta'i mtsho mo sogs//las bzhi'i mtshon pa'i ngo mtshar mtsho rdzing skye bo'i blo las 'gongs pa yod//skabs 'gar dwangs shing gsal ba'i ngogs su gzugs brnyan 'bum 'char me long bzhin//skabs 'gar rlabs phreng dgung su brtsegs 'dra'i 'jigs

— 114 —— ba byangs za'i 'a ra r+ṣagazibyinabazod par dka'// —skabs 'gar smig sprin na bun gyis 'khyud seng ras g.yogs pa'i lha mo bzhin//ngo mtshar 'bum ldan lha yi mtsho mos skal ldan shing rta'i snyan pa 'gog/dkan gzar brag ri'i rtse nas 'phyo ba'i lhung lhung 'bab pa'i rdza chu'i rgyun//g.yu 'brug stong gi ngar skad la 'gran dzā hu'i bu mos zlos gar bzhin//phyogs bcur 'bab pa'i gangs chu rdza chu sman sna'i chu sogs nyal 'gro'i rgyun//wu ba dkar bo'i 'dzum dkar rgod bzhin nor 'dzin g.yu yi gzhong bar 'bab /de yi khrus la rtsed dgar rol ba'i ngang ngur la sogs chu bya'i tshogs//mdzes pa'i dar gshog zlos gar bskyur bzhin dwangs gsal rlabs kyi rtse na rtsen//mgrin pa'i gling bu phyogs bcur bsgyur bas thos 'dzin thig

rtsom bsam ra po'i rang ma ngas/de 115 ——rlezlojoba'adi /de.e ma dbyangs can phang bar nyal ba'i pi wang sngon mo rgyud stong bzhin//mtshar sdug me tog gzhon nu'i 'dzum phreng mdzes pa'i dpyid la snying nye nas//bung ba'i bu mos 'jam mnyen gshog pas yang yang 'gebs shing srung ba 'dra//phye leb sgeg mo'i thig le'i sgo gshog mkha' la ngom zhing 'khyog pa'i gar//'brug sgras myos pa'i rma bya ji bzhin gang gi tshal na ci yang rtsen//mthong na mngon dga' rdza ri'i mgul nas rang byung lha yi rol mo 'bum//cho 'phrul zla dang dus chen rnams su thun mong skye bo'i snyan lam du//ngo mtshar rdza rnga stong gi sgra bzhin gcig min du mar thos pa 'di//lha dang bcas pas bsngags pa'i gnas su gyur la su zhig nem

— 116 — ba ngabyangs za'i 'a ra nur gyur//rna dang dgo ba bag phebs rgyu zhing shwa rkyang ma bus rtsed 'jor rol /bya rgyal rgod po mkha' la lding zhing khrung khrung dkar mos gshog 'gyur ngom//'brong g.yag dar mas rwa rtsal 'gran zhing 'phar spyang sngon mos ngar skad 'byin//stag gzig dom dred 'jigs rung nyams ldan ngo mtshar che ba'i gnas zhes grags//de yi nye 'dabs dga' ldan yid dga' chos kyi zhing khams gnyis pa zhig/lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa rgyas shing bshad sgrub nyams len mtsho bzhin 'phel//thar ba dam pa'i 'jug sgo yangs shing rig grol 'phags pa'i blo rtsal 'bar//ngo mtshar bye ba'i gling zhes grags 'di mig gi dpyid du ci yang snang //lho yi phyogs su pad ma rdzong zhes 'bru drug snye ma'i lo legs

rtsom༅༅ bsam da ka ra po'i rang mngangs//de /17 — skorngo——/de ———/de/de —4—————nga—nga——rgya stag ngar ma nags la 'gying 'dra'i dpal rtsal ldan zhing las la brtson//nub kyi phyogs su dga' bde rdzong zhes kha ba'i rdul brtsegs lhun po brjid//sa gzhi me long baiḍūr sngon mor shwa rkyang dgo bas bang rtsal 'gran//byang gi phyogs su gcig sgril rdzong zhes nor lug rkang bzhi'i sa gastu/ khurmib// sde bzhi'i mnga' thang lha la 'gran zhing khyad nor mig skya'i mdzod la 'khu//ṭ+wāṃr gyi phyogs su rnga ba rdzong zhes skar tshogs sa la 'dzum 'dra lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi gzhon 'char zhing 'bru drug tshong las longs spyod dar//thun mong lhun brjid rdza ri sngon mo dgongs sngon dbyings su zug 'dra la//na bun dkar pos rtse dgas 'khyud pa'i mdzes sdug stong gi

— 4ྈji ngazo — 4 4sgo4rak+ṣe ——— —————snying po can/ /thun min snod bcud 'khor lo sdom pa bde mchog lha yi gzhal yas khang / /tshad ldan skyes chen du mas 'khrul med lung gis bsngags pa'i gnas mchog shākhugs/ /tshangs chen yid kyi thig les gzhal min dbang bos mig stong blta bas ngal /sred med bu yis lce stong sprul kyang ji bzhin brjod bral gnas mchog gi /snod bcud yon tan cung zad brjod 'dod yid kyi pad mo'i dga' tshal nas/ /snyan tshig dar dir bung ba'i dbyangs 'di dbang med mgrin pa'i phugs las thal/ /7zhes mgo los sa khul gyi gnyan po g.yu rtse'i snod bcud kyi yon tan cung zad brjod pa dbyangs can bzhon nu dgyes pas 'dzum zer zhes bya ba 'di ni7rig gnas spyi dang khyad par du lha ris sgyu rtsal gyi phyogs la rnam dpyod yangs pa maso log lha ris pa shes rab rgya mtshos nan gyis bskul ngor snyom las pa7dkon mchog bsam satan gyis nyis stong 'o 'i sanam lo gsar tshes kyi rgyal pa gnyis pa'i nyin bris pa'o//

rtsom bsamarwa༄za3rangamangago// nga/dezecagan lho sa khul gyi drug pa'i shing slong la bsngags pa'i gtam mtshams sprin gzhon nus rtsed dga' zhes bya ba/(1998lo'i zla6par shing slong dus ston gyi ska bas〉dang por brtse ba'i rba rlabs 'dzum dkar gyis 'khyud pa//bar du shes rig nu zhos dga' mgur gyis legs bskyangs//tha mar chos dbyings gdod ma'i khang bzang du 'khrid mdzad//nga yi gtan gyi dpal mo shes rab gyi lha mchog /kun lho nor 'dzin phyug mo'i lte ba ru legs 'khyil//skar tshogs sa la 'dzum 'dra'i mdzes sdug gi grong khyer//gtsos zhes grags pa'i ljongs kyi ngo mtshar gyi dus ston//bsngags pa'i gtam gyi me tog sil ma de 'thor song //dgun gsum 'khyag gis bsdams pas gdung ba las thar zhing //dpyid gsum drod kyis bskyangs pa'i gser ldan gyi dga' ma//dbyar gsum lang tsho'i dregs pa'i mdzes sdug gi ne'u gsing / /ci dgar shing slong byed pa'i phun tshogs des skyid pa//

— — 120 nga ba byangs za'i 'a ra khulhung lhungasnyanapar sgrogs pa'i chu bo yi 'gram du//ldem ldem dgod pa'i me tog lding khang gi khrod na//glu len gar byed nyams dga'i dus ston la rol ba'i//rgan gzhon skye bo'i rab dgas ngang tshul des mdzes ba//dngul gyi tshom bu sa la 'dzum dkar rang grol 'dra'i//yid 'ong re khras spud pa'i mdzes sdug gi gur khyim//sna tshogs bza' bca'i dpal la ci 'dod ngang spyod pa'i//phun tshogs gsar ba'i dpyid kyi skabs gsum la 'gran song //sngon chad chos sdes shing slong lo rgyus kyi ngag rgyun//deng 'dir srid na mdzes pa'i dus ston gyi rnam pa//khyad par kun lho phyogs kyi dbyar dus kyi spro gseng //e ma sum rtsen gnas kyi zla bo ru 'phur song //bsang chu dal gyis 'bab pa'i nye 'gram na brjid pa'i//mdo smad bla brang bkra shis chos 'khor gyi gling 'dir//ring nas grags pa'i shing slong dus ston gyi bsngags brjod//'di na gzhon nu gang des mgrin dbyangs las thon byung //

rtsom bsam rapo'irangamangangs 12//de—bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i 'du khang chen mo bskyar bzhengs legs grub byung ba'i dga' ston rten 'brel la bstod pa gzhon nu dga' ba bskyed pa'i gtam/yangs yangs kun gsal sgeg mo'i 'gram pa la//dkar dkar sprin gyi phung po 'phyur ba'i gdan//brjid brjid skyil mo krung gis legs bzhugs pa'i//mchog mchog kun mkhyen bla ma spyi bor mchod//dka' dka' 'thob bya mthar thug sangs rgyas lam//myur myur bgrod pa'i dedwa dpon snying rje can//gung thang bla ma gtsug gi nor bu mchog /dung dung gus pas 'dud do rjes su bzung //mdzes mdzes bsang gzhung g.yu yi me long du//brjid brjid g.yas su 'khyil ba chos kyi sde//snyan snyan grags pa srid zhi'i khongs las brgal//zab zab mdo sngags bshad sgrub dar ba'i gnas//

— 122 — ba byangs za'i 'a ra lhag lhag 'gran pa'i zla bral dgon chen 'dir// —mdzes mdzes lta bas mi ngoms gtsug lag khang //legs legs bskyar bzhengs grub pa'i dga' ston la//snyan snyan dbyangs kyis bstod par bdag yid spro//ljang ljang mar gad thags su bkra ba'i ljongs//mang mang skar tshogs sa la babs pa ltar//mtshar mtshar bkod legs grwa shag mtha' klas pas//mdzes mdzes nor 'dzin lto ba dog por byas//ljang ljang g.yu yi zhun thig lhung 'dra ba'i//lhung lhung dal 'bab bsang chab nyal 'gro ma'i//ngogs su me tog gcal du bkram pa'i tshogs//lhug lhug rnam bkra'i bzhin ras g.yo bar rtsom//ldem ldem g.yo ba nags kyi 'khri shing rtser//legs legs g.yu yi lo 'dab kyis phyug par//kyur kyur snyan pa'i glu len 'dab chags tshogs//ling ling 'phur lding gar gyis ci yang myos//mang mang 'dab brgyas spras pa'i dbyig 'dzin gzhir//legs legs lha khang tshar du dngar ba'i dbus//

rtsomasgragabasamangamorapo'irang mngangasang 123 — dul rtser+yādalarmengaḥ—denyor+shasdurnosne———4 ———ba 'dzum 'dzum sa la gur kum gzhon nu bzhin//khyad par gsar du bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang //brjid brjid lha yi rnam rgyal khang bzang ltar//legs legs rten gsum nor bu'i gzi byin ni//lha lam ngos su rgyu skar phreng bzhin mdzes//mdzes mdzes phyogs kun tshon mdangs ri mo bkra//gsal ba/sal mun sel 'od dang glog sgron mdangs//dung dung brtse ba'i tshul gyis 'dres pa ni//mdzes mdzes dbang gzhu bkra ba'i dpal la 'khu//legs legs gzi 'od 'bar ba'i byin rten dang //mtshar mtshar tshon sna bkra ba'i thang ga sogs//gcig las gcig lhag sku gsung thugs kyi rten//mang mang dad ldan yid dbang 'gugs pa yod//'bol 'bol stan la bzhugs pa'i rig grol sde'i//lhod lhod mgrin pa'i dril chung snyan mo nas//lhang lhang legs par gsungs pa'i sgra dbyangs kyis//mang mang dad ldan yid kyi re ba bskangs//

— 124 — ba nga dbyangs za'i 'a ra khu—za/mamigagisaltazhingazhurmezhumarngonge — —/dedud dud gus pa'i rnam 'gyur mos ldan tshogs//brtan brtan mi 'gyur dad pa'i nyams dang bcas//dung dung gus pas gsol ba 'debs par rtsom//'jigs 'jigs gdong lngas btegs pa'i rin chen khrir//mdzes mdzes mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od 'bar ba can//brjid brjid gung thang yid bzhin nor bu'i sku//bzhugs pas srid zhi dge legs snang ba'i khyab//zab zab chos kyi bdud rtsi 'gyed mkhas pa'i//mdzes mdzes li khri'i mdangs 'chang rig grol sde//brjid brjid 'phags pa'i gnas brtan ji bzhin du//legs legs sku yi gzi mdangs yi gar 'ong //dwangs dwangs blo rig rab gsal btsun chung 'gas//zab zab drang 'grel la sogs gzhung gi tshig/shar shar blo nas lhang lhang dbyangs dang bcas//snyan snyan gsung ba sim sim rna ba'i rgyan//grung grung rnam dpyod glog gi gar 'dzin pa'i//myur myur lung rig gnam lcags 'bebs mkhas tshogs//

rtsom bsamad༅khapo'irangamadangs— 125 —— ngar ngararigalamathogamadasasgerlor+sharkebyerje——— —zhib zhib phye mar btang pa'i grags snyan 'bar//lhod lhod 'chad pas rtogs dka'i mdud pa grol//myur myur phra zhib rig pas log rtogs 'joms//snyan snyan sdeb legs rtsom gyis yid dbang 'gugs//'chad rtsod rtsom gsum rab rgyas sde 'di legs//dka' dka' gzhung don ji bzhin 'grel bas mkhas//zab zab sdom gsum mig 'bras ltar srung btsun//legs legs zhi dul spyod pa'i dpal gyis bzang //mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa'i sde 'di legs//brjid brjid lta na sdug pa'i 'du khang che'i//mdzad sgo'i dga' ston rten 'brel 'dzoms pa'i nyin//lhang lhang rab dga'i glu dang ldem ldem ngang //bro gar 'cham sogs lha yi dpal la bsnyegs//snyan snyan pi wang gling bu'i sgra snyan snyan//'grig 'grig rkang bas gom stabs gral 'grig 'grig/legs legs rgyan sos spras pa'i mdangs legs legs//mdzes mdzes gar stabs sgyur ba'i nyams mdzes mdzes /

—— 126 —— ba byangs za'i 'a ra khu 4)la sar+shapa'ime tog 'dzumabazhadapa ——/de—'khyog 'khyog 'khar ba la brten rgan rgon tshogs//rab rib mig mthar mchi mas gsher bzhin du//dung dung dad pas gsol 'debs dbyangs su gyer//skad cig yid la dran pa tsam gyis kyang //thengs cig ma rig gnyid las rab slong ba//e ma rmad byung chos kyi sde chen por//yang yang skye ba'i smon lam snying nas 'debs//bzhad pa'i rdo rjes legs 'debs sprul ba'i zhing //khri chen rnam bzhis rgyun bskyangs bshad sgrub zung //dbyar mtsho rgyas pa'i dpal la rab 'gran zhing //srid mtha'i bar du dar zhing rgyas par shog /7ces bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i 'du khang chen mo bskyar bzhengs legs grub byung ba'i dga' ston rten 'brel la bstod pa gzhon nu dga' ba bskyed pa'i gtam zhis bya ba ni/ gangs can bod kyi chos sde chen po drug gi ya gyal mdo smad bshad sgrub kyi 'byung gnas bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i chos kyi sde chen po de nyid kyi ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i gtsug lag khang ste 'du khang chen mo legs grub byung ba'i dasa' ston rten 'brel zhu yig tu 'khos chung mgo log bsam gtan gyis rab byung bcu bdun pa'i lcags mo lug gi lo chu stod zla ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba gnyis pa'i nyin bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du sbyar ba'o//

༅— rtsomasgrag ༄mad rwagrozhir mo5 sa/ — /ngaX — ༷ ༷— sma hā rtsi na'i sto phyogs kyi grong khyerna chen glo hrang nye'i ngo mtshorna ba'i rnam pa gsarna ba spru bstod pa tshongs chen mes po'i dgyesga pa'i 'dzum zerna zhes bya ba/stong chen mkha' dbyings mdzes ma'i bzhin gyi skar tshogs sa la 'dzum 'dra ste//dpang phu'u gtsang bo'i rgyud du brjid chags mdzes sdug 'bum gyi snying bo can//sum rtsen dpal gyi zla bor mched pa 'dzam gling nor 'dzin thig le 'dir//snyan pa'i grags pa ring du 'phur ba hrang he'i ngo mtshar 'di na snang //sprin sngon ba gam brtsegs pa'i 'og na rdza ri sngon mo'i phreng 31gas bstunon//gnam la bslangs pa'i khang ba khang brtsegs bya rgyal gshog sne 'dar 'chor ba /bgrang yas tshong zang ma tshang med pa dbyar gyi mtsho mo'i rba

—nga༅gro— ba ngabyangs za྾ gyugon ———rlabs bzhin//khyad nor phun tshogs phyur bur gtams pas rmugs 'dzin dbang po'i mdzod la 'phya//ngo mtshar bzo bkod 'gran pa'i zla bral shar phyogs mu tig 'tsher ba zhes//'dzam gling glog 'phrul dra mig lta bu gzugs mthong 'phrul gyi mchod rten te//e ma kun gsal yangs pa'i mthongs na gser gyi ka ba bslangs bzhin brjid//de yi grags snyan srid pa'i khong na dbyar skyes 'brug gi sgra bzhin ldir//kun gsal dga' ma'i rab yangs lto bar gar du 'khyugs pa'i g.yu 'brug ltar//yang phu'u nan phu'u zam chen rnam gnyis 'dzam gling khyon 'dir snyan pa ldir//khang brtsegs rab mtho brgyad cu'i grangs brgal man shel rno lcags las grub pa'i//skabs gsum grong gi gzhal med khang bzang dman pa'i go

rtsomalhagabasamangarapo'irangamangangagashe 9 r+shar+shardod+menanam//—————————————gna' bo'i bzo rtsal phul du byung ba mig sman mdangs 'dzin rgya phibs can//srid na rab mdzes khrun dpang me'o zhes tshong zong rnam par rgyas pa der//rnam mang skye bo khri phrag las brgal 'gro 'ong 'dzad med sa gzhir ngal//dper na kun gsal dga' ma'i ltor gyi sprin dkar gzhon nu'i 'du 'god bzhin// deng rabs shes bya'i ne'u gsing tshal na tshan rig cang shes bang ba'i rtsal//myar mgyogs shugs ldan glog gi gar rtse e ma 'dzam gling go rlo 'dir//ring du mched pa'i snyan pa re res dbyar skyes sngon mo'i skad la za/'gran pa'i zla bral tshan 'phrul rig gzhung grong khyer 'di yi dpal du lham//rnam mang shes rig rgyu skar grangs ldan brtson 'grus dar

—— 130 — ba da byangs za'i 'a rakhya — /de/degashog legs brkyangs te//ming gi snyan pa phyogs kyi mtha' khyab rig gzhung slob pa'i grwar gyi nang //ci 'dod shes bya 'dod rgur rol ba'i na chung gzhon nu 'di dag ni//dus drug ngal ba'i skabs kyi dben zhes sum rtsen sked phras snyan par zlos//de ltar ji bzhin ngo mtshar re rer tshangs dbang lce brgya'i brjod bral na///ga gi sgo mo ngal ba las med re zhig mdor bsdus tshig gis krung hwa mes po'i khang khyim yangs por snod bcud dpal gyis mngon mtho ba//lho phyogs grong khyer hrang he'i rnam pa tha snyad smra ba'i mgrin las lud//

— rtsom 14ཿ 44nga / 131 —༷—4bod yul skyid pa'i mdzes ljongs la bstod pa thun mtshams gsar ba'i rtse dga'/ /(bla brang nas)a re skyid kyi longs spyod kun 'dzoms pa'i /ha las sna lnga'i me tog bzhad pa'i mdangs//sa gzhir tshon rtsis ri mo bris 'dra'i ljongs//sha shed spu rgyas rkang bzhi phyugs kyis khyab//la lung ri thang med par mad rgad mdangs//ra ris dri mas ma bgos me tog 'bum//ya mtshan mdzes pa'i mgo lcog ldem bzhin du//'a 'ur dri bzhon bu mo'i phang bar rgyu//za zi'i gshog pa'i dbyangs ldan rkang drug tshogs//zha lu'i ljang myug ltar rgyas pad ma'i tshal /wa wol 'khor zhing rtsen pa'i gar dang bcas//dza ti'i dri ltar zhim pa'i rtse la rol//tsha zer drod kyis bskyed pa'i pad dkar mdangs//tsa ri la sogs gangs ri'i yongs bskor zhing //

— 132/de ba byangs)za'i' rakhya /de——ma pham g.yu mtsho la sogs dwangs gsal mtsho//ba gam gser 'od 'tsher pa'i po ta la//pha yul gangs can ljongs kyi sa cha 'di//pa tra'i re khā ji bzhin lta na sdug/na bun smug po rgyu ba'i thang chen du//da lta 'byor phyug legs pa'i dpal dang ldan//tha dad snang ba bsgyur 'dra'i rta nor lug/ta la'i 'dab ltar yangs pa'i sa gzhir khyab//nya rnams dwangs gsal chu bo'i rgyun dag la//ja chang zas la sred bzhin ci dgar rtsen//cha byad bag yod rgyan mdzes bod mi dag/ca co 'ur zing phyogs la mi spro zhing //nga khyod phyogs res med par mdzes pa'i yul//ga ler rang 'os bya bar brtson kyin mchis//kha ba'i ljongs zhes srid na snyan pa'i dbyangs//ka ye skyid kyi gshong bu 'u cag yul//kha tsam ma yin don gyis mdzes pa'i ljongs//ka kha shes min kun gyis gcig tu gleng //

— rtsom2khagamad rapo'iragongar+yā/ 3grozo — dgun gsum lwa ba dkar bos rab mdzes shing //dbyar gsum mad rgad zhun ma'i mdangs 'dzin pa//ston gsum su ru'i me tog bzhad pa'i ljongs//nga cag bod mi'i yul 'di mdzes re ltos//7 zhes bod yul skyid pa'i mdzes ljongs la bstod pa thun mtshams gsar ba'i rtse dga' ces bya ba 'di ni bya dka' ba'i rgyan te ka mad sum cu lugs ldog gi tshul du spel ba 'dis kyang blo gsal gzhon nu rnams kyi snyan ngag gi blo sgo 'byed pa'i rgyu la dmigs te bris pa'o//nub byang mi rigs slob gling dbu brnyes nas lo 'khor lnga bcu lon pa'i dga' ston rten 'brel du phul ba'i shis tshig blo gsal gathon nu'i mgrin sgra/dwangs shing gsal ba gnam gyi kha dog baiḍūr sngon mo'i mdangs la lta//gangs ri dkar po shel gyi zom na sprin dkar gzhon nu'i 'dzum zer ngom /mtsho mo sngon mo g.yu yi rlabs rtser ngang ngur mgrin pa'i rol

/de 134 —— ba byangs za'i'u rakhya — ————mo 'khrol//gangs can bho ṭa'i yul ljongs 'di ni e ma lha yi dpal ltar skyi da//stod na dbus gtsang chos kyi chol kha chos bsod mnga' thang dar ba'i ljongs// bar na khams zhes mi yi chol kha dpa' rtsal snying stobs gzi byin rdzogs//smad na mdo smad rta yi chol kha gyi ling rta pho'i 'tsher skad snyan/ /chol gsum ri bzhi chu lnga sgang drug gangs can sa yi thig le der//a chen gangs rgyab mdo la zhes grags ming gis bsdus pa'i sa cha ste// yan lag brgyad ldan rma klung phyug mo dal gyis 'bab pa'i nye 'gram du//gnam gyi skar tshogs sa la 'phos 'dra'i lan kru zhes bya'i grong khyer ni//bzo rig sgyu rtsal drug cu'i dpal mnga' sde bzhi'i phun tshogs

— rtsom bsamad rwagro'irangamangangs— — 35 /deklung bzhin brdol//lha yi bdud rtsi sa la 'khyil 'dra'i chu mig lnga ldan(rwa blo/yi)lhun po ni//gangs seng dkar mo sa la nyal ba'i brtul zhugs rab 'dzin gnas kyi 'dabs//khang ba khang brtsegs gnam la bslang bzhin yid 'ong gzhal med khang chen du//bgrang yas shes bya 'o ma'i chu gter rnam dpyod ngang mo ci yang rtsen// gzhung lugs rab 'byams thugs kyi dpal ber ji snyed shes bya'i thig le 'khyil//bcu phrag gnas la sngon medwa rnam dpyod gangs ri'i ljongs kyi seng chen bzhin//tshe tan zhabs drung rig pa'i 'dod 'jo mkhas dbang yid kyi lha lam na//nyin byed gsar ba'i dkyil 'khor ji bzhin bskal ba'i bar tu brjed re skan// gangs can ljongs 'dir yi ge'i byed po slob dpon a nu

— 136 — ba dadabyangs za'i' rakhu r+shadhermepa bzhin /desngon na med pa'i legs bshad gtam gyis kun yid dbang med ci yang 'phrog/bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i drung yig ming 'dzin bstan pa rgya mtsho'i mtshan snyan rnga //e ma sum rtsen lha yi gnas 'dir 'chi med nu rgyas tshogs kyis brdungs//snyigs ma'i dus 'dir sā la'i ljongs su shes rig sgron me sbar mdzad pa//skyes chen dam pa'i mdzad spyod lhur len nges don ma hā paṇa ṭi ta//'gran bral rtsis gzhung man ngag bye bas gangs can rig gzhung phyug por bsgyur//mkhas pa'i dbang po bsam 'grub rgya mtsho dad gsum ral ba'i rgyan gyis mchod//skad gnyis smra ba shong ston rdo rje slar yang ljongs 'dir phebs pa bzhin//rgya bod zung gi skad la thogs med rnam dpyod gsar ba'i

rtsom bsamang rapo'irangamadang sa — 137 —gathogazang sis — /de ———drodzu r+shano sheshā bya'i 'o ma'i chu gter skad cig tsam gyis bgrod nus pa//deng rabs mkhas dbang snyems pa'i blo ldan e ma gling 'di'i rgyan du brjid//gzhon nu nyid nas chu bo'i rgyan bzhin lhod med brtson pa'i go bgos te// ༄gangs can sgra rig brda sprod la sogs rnam dpyod rtsal gyis thugs su chud//rang gzhan kun phan lhag bsam dag pa'i bod kyi rig gzhung rgyas par mdzad//dpa' ris yul gyi bud dha'i ming can skyes bu de yang bsngags bya'i yul//mkhas dbang yid kyi ma la ya yi nags klung mdzes pa'i dga' 65'a/ nas//legs 'ong bcu phrag shes bya'i dri ngad 'bum phrag 'thul bas nyer 'gugs te//rnam dpyod 'phur lding rlung la sdeb pa'i skal bzang gzhon nu

rtsom44 rapo'irangakrogo/—3gi mtshon par nus//brjod bya don gyi lang tsho rab mdzes bzhin gyi pad+mo dgod pa mo//rjod byed tshig gi rgyan gyis legs spud sgeg pa'i 'gros ldan smin legs ma//bdag yid skyes 'dzin 'o mtsho bsrubs las legs 'khrungs dga' ba'i skyes kyi mchog/nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i dus ston gsar ba'i grogs su phul// 7zhes nub byang mi rigs slob gling dbu brnyes nas lo 'khor lnga bcu lon pa'i dga' ston rten 'brel du phul ba'i shis tshig blo sasal gzhon nu'i mgrin sgra ces bya ba 'di ni rab byung bcu bdun pa'i lcags pho 'brug gi lo'i rnam gnon zhes pa'i khrums stod zla bar dkar phyogs rgyal ba dang po'i nyin sbyar ba'o/

— 140 — ba ngabyangs za'i' rakhu /debod kyi ri chu la bsngags pa'i gtam bung ba bzi bas gshog gludapyid gsum me tog phang phung mgul bar rgyan//dbyar gsum mad gad lang tsho'i gos kyis mdzes//dgun gsum lwa ba dkar pos g.yogs 'dra bo//nor 'dzin ri yi lhun po lta na sdug/la la dkan gzar brag ri dpa' bo'i nyams//'ga' zhig g.yu yi mdangs 'dzin mdzes ma'i dpal//gzhan dag lhun zhing stug pa'i rgyal po bzhin// e ma lhun po 'di dag mthong na dga'//khyod ni ne'u gsing dpal mo 'chel ba'i gzhi//rtsi shing 'bras bu phang phung chags pa'i gnas//g.yang dkar lug khyu 'tsho ba'i gzhi dang rten//kun gsal zla nyi bgrod pa'i dbang phyogs lags//gsham na dal zhing rgyu ba'i nyal 'gro ma//wu ba dkar bos phyag rgya bsgyur bzhin du//

rtsom bsam ra po'i rang mngangs—— 141 ——lhung lhung snyan pa'isgrabargya'abyinadangalhan /de—/degang gi lto bar dar skud sngon mo bzhin//'jam mnyen rtswa yi bzhin ras brlan bzhin du//rnam mang 'gro ba'i skom pa sel bzhin du//chil chil rlabs kyi phreng ba rtsen bzhin du//e ma dbyig 'dzin sgeg mo'i dpal du rgyu//gser mig rab dgas 'khyug rtsal rol ba'i gzhi//ngang ngur khrung khrung snyan pa'i rdza rnga dang //lhod lhod gshog pas gar stabs bsgyur ba'i gnas//dal 'bab lang tsho ma de bsngags par 'os//nor 'dzin phyugs mo mdzes pa'i ska rags dang //shes ldan skom pa'i gdung sel lha'i bdud rtsi//kun gsal dbyings kyi 'od dkar gzhon nu'i grogs//gser mig 'khyil ba rol bas ma ma lags//baiḍūr zhun ma'i mdangs 'dzin nyal 'gro ma//skabs 'gar dmar ser li khri'i dpal la 'khu//mtshams rer dar dkar 'then bzhin yid du 'ong //'dzad med mngon dga'i ltad mo ci yang sbyin//

—/de 142 —— ba byangs za'i 'a ra —gong na ri yi phreng ba tshar du dngar//gsham na snyan sgrogs chu bo lhung lhung 'bab//'og na nor 'dzin dpal mo mtha' gru yangs//lhun gyis grub pa'i yul 'di mdzes re ltos//dwangs bsil zhim dang 'jam pa dri med sogs//yan lag brgyad ldan bdud rtsi lta bu'i chu//khang sa zhing sa la sogs sa yi dge/sa yi dge bcu tshang ba'i yul ljongs red//rgya yul lho phyogs kyi ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i yul gru su'u dpang rnam gnyis kyi khyad chos mdo tsam brjod pa gar mkhan bu mos 'jo sgeg ces bya ba/mtshar sdug lang tsho'i me tog 'dzum pa'i sku//pi wang sngon po'i khu byug myos pa'i glu//blo gsal ri skyes rna ba'i bcud len mkhan//dbyangs can dga' ma bdag blo'i khab tu rtsen//

rtsom bsam rapo'irangamangangs 143 /de'adzamagling sridapa'irgya olhasartserne—mar————/denor 'dzin bu mo'i thig le ltar chags pa'i//krung hwa mes po rab dga'i bzhin gyi mdangs//su'u dpang rnam gnyis dge mtshan 'di na spro//srid zhi'i mdzes sdug nying bcud yod do cog /tshangs chen blo yis gcig tu bsdus 'dra ba//steng na sum rtsen lha yi zhing khams skyid//'og na su'u dpang rnam gnyis gling 'dir brjid//dri bzhon spos kyi dud pa baiḍūr gyis//phyogs kyi bu mo'i khyon kun rab 'gengs pa//cang nan zhes bya sa yi thig le 'dir//su'u gros dpang kros zhes bya'i snyan pa 'phur//g.yu lo snum zhing ldem pa'i ljon shing gseb//na bun sngo bsangs sgeg mo'i bzhin ngom pa//sbrang char sil mas yid la dpal ster ba//de ni su'u dbang rnam gnyis khyad chos lags//the hos zhes hos zhes bya lhas rdzing bur//ngang ngur khrung khrung dga' bas gshog rtsal bsgyur//

/de— 144 — ba ngabyangs za'i 'a ra khumathing ril 'jol mo snyan pa'i mgrin rnga 'khrol//rlabs kyi 'phreng ba shig shig 'gul bar byed//bkod legs lha yi pho brang smra 'bebs pa'i//bsil byed khang mig bzo rtsal zla bral ba//de ni 'bri chu'i lho rgyud su'u dpang gi/khyad chos kho nar gyur la som nyi'i dben//lang tsho gang bu'i me tog rab 'dzum pa'i//'dod pa'i dpal gyis myos pa'i chang mig mas//phang bar nyal ba'i pi wang sngon mo'i sgras//yid kyi brtan pa cig car 'phrog min nam//phyi yi skyed tshal lha yi zhing khams 'dra//nang gi phun tshogs rmugs 'dzin bang ba'i mdzod//srid zhi'i khams na 'gran pa'i zla bral ba//de ni su'u dpang yul las gzhan du ci//zhib phra'i yon tan dbang bo'i lce yis min/ /mdor bsdus tsam gyi su'u dbang yul gyi khyad//tha snyad smra ba gang de'i mgrin mtsho las//snyan tshig rlabs phreng dkar bo'i gar 'di bsgyur//

rtsom bsam rapo'irangamangadas/ 1—sde——/debod kyi lo gsar/ka ma la yi 'dab stong 'dzum pa'i dbus//kha dog chu shel zla ba'i rjes 'gro can//ga bur mdangs 'dzin ngag gi dbang phyug ma//nga cag yid mtshor pad nang bung bzhin rol//ca lag khor yug mdzes pa'i khang mig du//cha lugs yid du 'ong pa'i gos brgyan spud//ja chang zas sna kun 'dzoms gnam lo gsar//nya gang zol gyis bsngags brjod byed la rangs//ta la'i 'dab bzhin rab yangs dbyig 'dzin ltor//tha dag rtse dga'i gnam lo gsar du bzhad//da lta dga' ston gsar ba'i pad tshal khrod//na chung rkang drug rab dgas gar la rol//pa sangs ltar dkar sna mang 'gro ba'i blo//pha gu'i ra bar 'phyo ba'i rlabs phreng bzhin//ba spu g.yo 'dra'i dga' ba'i 'dzum dkar ngang //

— /de6 de ba zangs ཿ'a ra ——————ma nyams bza' bca'i dpal la ci dgar rol //tsa tur sde bzhi'i dpyid la longs spyod pa'i//tsha zer 'od kyi kha 'byed pad+ma bzhin//dza yan tu sogs rab dga'i shis brjod dbyangs//wa ler bsgrags la shin tu brel ba bzhin//zha lu gsar skyes lta bu'i gzhon nu tsho//za 'og 'bol stan gdan la legs 'khod nas//'a 'ur dga' mgur zas chang rol dang lhan//ya mtshan mdzes pa'i gar la ci yang rol//ra yig gnyis pa me tog tshal la bzhin//la 'ur gnam lo gsar ba'i dga' ston nyin//sha tsha gnyen gshis mgon la 'gro 'ong gis//sa gzhi'i gdong la mig mangs ri mo bris//ha ha gnam lo gsar ba'i dga' ston dus//a ho ngo mtshar bltad mo ci yang mchis//ha cang snyan pa'i tshig gis bstod min kyang //a mtshar gnam lo'i legs skyes bsam nas bris//gnam lo gsar ba'i dga' ston 'o ma'i mtshor//

rtsom gabasamadatshorapo'irangamangangs— 147 ——————'gararolab ṅkasnede na ngar+shar+shazlo——————brjod bya don gyi snying bos dben na yang /rjod byed tshig gi srad bur brgyus te phul//7bod kyi lo gsar zhes pa'i snyan rtsom 'di ni la rne kru'u grong khyer rang ༅0 dga' ba'i skyed tshal du bris pa'o//sems las 'phros pa'i gtam/ka ye ltos dang deng sang mi phal cher//kha bshad don la gnas pa shin tu dkon//nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal ri las mtho//ga ler bsam na snying bo cang ma mchis /ca cos 'chal gtam smra tshe mgo 'phang mtho /cha med mi la brnyas thabs sna tshogs byed//ja zas longs spyod 'dzoms kyang ser sna'i bcings//nya nyog de rigs nyin bzhin je mang red//ta len phrag par 'khur ba'i nyom chung la//tha na snying rje tsam yang med pa'i khar//da lta brnyas mod byed pa de mthong rjes//

— 148 — ba byangs za'i 'a ra ————da werne rangamathong canatshokhorechad — ——— ———ྈpa sangs ji bzhin snying rje'i sems med kyang //pha ma'i bu tsha lta bu'i brtse gdung gal//ba lang 'du shes gsum pa'i dper song na//ma yi bu khyod zer ba ming gis ci//tsa ri'i gnas bskor byed pa ji bzhin du//tsha grang dka' spyad ches cher ma nus kyang //dza lang spyod ltar mi tshe chud zos na//wa ler gzhan gyis 'phya smod byed par nges zhwa gos lham sogs su mdzes lta ba dang //za ma'i myong ba gang zhim gleng ba sogs//'a 'ur don med dus tshod 'da' thabs des//ya so ldan pa'i ba lang ci yang 'gran//ra ma rta lug sogs kyang rang gi don//la lung kun tu myul ba chos nyid de//sha tsha nges par rang la yod pa'i na//sa cha gang du bsdad kyang yon tan gal//ha cang mang bo smras na thal che yang //

rtsom bsamarwalngarapo'arangamangangs—/ /1 9 — samasasnying gtar+sha.o'adisapos rlo—4— ———ha go don la zhib tu dpyod shes na//a ho rang la sman no gzhon nu tsho//gangs rgyan chos rig tshags par bklag rjes kyi gtam/mtshan dpe'i lang tsho'i me tog 'dzum grol ba//pi wang sngon mo'i khu byug glu len mkhan//rgyal kun gsung gi dbang phyug smin legs ma//bdag yid pad ma'i khrus rdzing 'di na rol//blo gsal blo yi 'o mtsho bsrubs pa las//legs 'khrungs rig gzhung 'od dkar zla ba'i 'dzum/ /'di na mig gi dpyid dpal smin ma thag//rab dgas bsngags brjod mi byed rang dbang ci//gangs ri'i zlum por bskor ba sā la'i ljongs//rgyan gyi mchog gyur bshes gnyen dam pa'i gsung //chos kyi bdud rtsi 'thung ba'i blo gsal 'gas//

——— 150 — ba nga byangs za'i 'a ra khu4 rigartsalatshags paraspelabs bdag yidaspro /de/dedapyad rtsom rig pa'i me long 'di na snang //snyan rtsom co ma'i mgrin glu 'di na snyan//rjes dran dad pa'i me tog 'di na 'dzum//gab tshig khye'u rol rtsal 'di na ngom//nga cag kha ba'i ljongs kyi shes rig rgyun//snum zad mar me'i zla bor slebs pa'i dus//thugs kyis ma bzod brtson pa'i go bgos pa//blo gsal ngang pa'i khyu tshogs bsngags la spro//gangs can rig pa'i rmang gzhi brda sprod dang //don gyi 'khrul ba sel byed tshad ma sogs//legs par thugs kyi dpal ber 'ub chud nas//gangs ljongs shes rig spel la brtson gyur cig//zhes gangs rgyan chos rig tshags par bklag rjes kyi gtam ces bya ba 'di ni phran gyi chos grogs rnam dpyod rab tu yangs pa kho tshe tshul khrims 'jam dpal ngagyes pa'i blo gros kyis thulas khur 'og tu legs par spel ba'i rig gzhung tshags pa ra rmad du byung ba zhig lags pas rjes su yi rang byed pa'i slad du snyan rtsom 'di ṭ+wāṃ~X ṭ+wāṃ ༷ ༵hā/ /kru grong khyer nas snyoms las pa maso log dkon mchog bas ma gtan
