ོ rtsom bsamang rapo'irangamadangasarwa—43/ ༅ — — —nga yi pha yul gnyis pa bla brang/ko ki la yi mgrin glu len pa'i gnas//kho ra yug kun bkra shis re khā'i mdzes//go rig gnyis 'dzoms dge bshes 'khrungs pa'i yul//ngo mtshar srid na 'bar ba'i sa cha red//co ma'i skad snyan grags pa'i dus nas bzung //cho ga dbyangs su gyer ba'i a khu rnams//jo bo la sogs sku gdung rnams kyi mdun//nyo ba'i dngos po 'bul zhing gsol ba 'debs//to re long btsan la sogs bod chos rgyal//tho rangs skar chen lta bu'i mdzad rjes rnams//do zla med pa'i lo rgyus khungs gtug sa//no mon han gyi gdan sa bla brang red//po ti bcu phrag mang po thugs nas 'chad//pho tshod gdengs dang ldan pa'i rnam dpyod yangs//bo dong paṇi chen lta bu'i mkhas pa'i tshogs//mo lha dbyangs can dpal mos rjes bzung 'dra//

154 /bya 'i tshi bral rje'i ma grolྈ— — ru tsal sogasasil togatshodama'irigs ba4tsho khag du mar tshong gnyer tshong ba rnams//dzo dzor ri bzhin spungs pa'i tshong rdzas te//wo brgyal med par btsong ba'i sa cha red//zho phung dpyis kyi dge 'dun chos 'phel dang //zo bzang mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan rdo sher sogs//'o cag shes rig rtsol mkhas dge bshes tshogs//yo byad ci yod btang kyang brin pa'i sa//ro brgya'i zas rigs sna tshogs 'dzoms pa'i yul//lo gsar la sogs dus ston mang ba'i sa//sho rgyan rtsed mo'i rigs kun ma tshang med//so sor mdzes pa'i lang tsho ngom sa red//ho thog thu sogs sprul ba'i sde chen dang //o tan pu ri'i gtsug lag la 'gran pa'i//mdo smad bla brang zhes bya'i grags snyan rnga//deng sang bar du srid pa'i khyon la ldir//7nga yi pha yul gnyis pa bla brang zhes pa'i bya dka' ba'i snyan rtsom 'di ni tha snyad smra ba7margo log dkon mchog bsam gtan gyis rang shag rig pa 'phel ba'i dasa' tshal nas sbyar ba'o//

/de rtsom bsam ra po'irangamangangs——355 0nga—rtswa thang gi bu mo'i glu sgraka ye kha dog skye 'bras mtshar sdug ga bur mdangs 'dzin nga rgyal med// ca co'i sgra min cha tshang dbyangs ldan ja shing las mdzes nya rgyas bzhin/ ta la'i blo yangs tha dad sems min da lta na tshod gzhon pa'i khar// pa sangs ltar dkar pha rol yid 'gugs ba zho ster ba'i ma ma lags//tsa ri ltar bsil tsha grangs mi snyoms dza lang ce spyang wa ler marwadzan// zhwa gos za btung longs spyod kun 'dzoms 'a cag ya mtshan skye ba'i ljong sa// ra ba gangs ra'i yongs bskor la lung sha rkyang dgo ba'i sa gzhor khyab// ha cang mdzes ba'i ljongs kyi a mdo'i bu mos glu skad snyan re 4/sa//7zhes pa 'di ni lan kru'u grong khyer du1999lo'i zla12pa'i tshes3la/

— — 156 (rgya 'i tshi bral rje'im grol /de/lha gcig kong jo bod du phebs pa/ka dag sā la'i sman gyi ljongs na//kha ba bod zhes grags pa'i yul der//ga sa gang na nor lug gis khyab//nga khyod phyogs res med pa'i sa cha//ca dag bkod legs lhun gyis grub shing // cha lugs phal cher lha la 'gran sa//ja shing lo 'bras phang phung chags pa'i//nya rgyas bzhin can kong jo'i pha yul//ta la'i blo mnga' mgar gyi stong btsan//tha dad rig pa'i 'phrul la bsten nas//da lta kong jo bod du phebs pa'i /na tshod lo rgyus 'phreng ba 'di byung //pa sangs ltar dkar gangs ri'i mu khyud//pha gu'i ra bas blum por bskor ba'i//ba mo'i zil ba khrom khrom thogs 'di//

rtsom bsam da ra po'i rang mngangs 157 —ma gcig kong jo phebs pa'i ljongs red//tsa ri ltar bsil rdza chu lhung lhung //tsha grang dus bzhi snyoms pa'i sa cha//dza lang gtum dreg gcan gzan mang bos//wa ma wol la ngar skad 'byin sa//zhwa gos rab mdzes chas kyis spras shing //za ma sna 'dzoms zas sna bshams te//'a 'ur rab dgas glu gar rtsed 'jos//ya mtshan lha gcig kong jo bsus byung //ra ba khor mdzes thang gi rgyal bos//la lung stod khams bod kyi btsan por//sha las chad pa'i 'un shing kong jo//sā la'i ljongs kyi grogs la brdzangs byung //ha cang dar dregs thang gi rgyal rabs//a re bod rgyal spyan ras gzigs dbang //gnam la nyi ma zla ba'i dpe bzhin//sa la btsan po dbon zhang rnam gnyis//g.yu yi mdangs 'dzin pho brang chen por//

/de 158 :rgya 'i tshi bral rje'i ma nga grolargyal rje thang gi the tsung bzhugs byung //gser 'od 'khyugs pa'i pho ta la rir//srong btsan bod kyi lha rje bzhugs byung //gnam la nyi zla zung gcig shar dus//sa la nyal 'gro rnam gnyis 'bab 'dug/rgya bod zung gi mi rigs rnam gnyis//e ma chu dang nya mo'i dpe bzhin//mdza' mthun lo rgyus chu bo dal 'bab//gser ldan dga' ma'i lto bar 'khyil 'dug /ma 'ongs dus rabs nyi shu'i lam chen//lhod pa med par brtson zhes bskul byung //7zhes spyi lo 1996lo'i zla 3par grong khyer chen po zhis an du sbyar ba'o//

༅— com bsam4rapo'irom yon 499 — rang byung sems las brdol ba'i chu migasems kyi phye leb la lung kun tu 'phul//lus kyi gshog zung da dung ma rgyas pas//'dod pa'i yul de cis kyang slebs min pa'i//skyo bas mig chu bsil yang bya thabs bral//lus kyi phung po mdun du bskyod byed kyang //sems kyi bung ba rgyab tu rgyugs byed pa//ma brtags lus sems gcig tu 'brel mod kyang //brtag tshe tha dad yin par rjes su dpog /sgong nga'i sbubs nas skad 'byin mgrin snyan dang //gangs ri'i spo 'gying gdong lnga'i dbang bo ba'in//skyes chen dam pa ci ltar rgud na yang //rnam yang zhum pa med pa chos nyid do//la la bden par smra yang rdzun par go /la la rdzun pa'i gtam yang bden par rlom//kye ma bden rdzun 'byed dka'i 'gro ba 'di//

— — 160 /byang 'i tshi bral rje'imagro dgrol /deṣ+pepa'itshangatshinga'adaman ciyang 'khor /ྈ—gsum bzhi gsum kyi dgra bo 'phel bzhin du//rang nyid deng rabs mkhas par khas 'ches nas//skyes chen dam pa smod pas sna nag ma//a ma glen mas bu la bslab pa bzhin//nges par rang gi rigs la sha tsha na//mtho dman skye bo dregs zhan su yin yang //bsdu bzhi'i dngos po'i ska rags bcings na legs//phyin drug spyod pa'i rta pho chibs na legs//sked/(gang byung du thol ba'i snyan rtsom)sprin dkar mul mul dgod pa'i tshems bar nas//g.yu 'brug sngon mo dal gyis bzhad pa'i tshe//gang la snying nye thig le'i sgro 'dzin ma//dga' ba'i gar gyis brel 'di yid re dga'//tshang tshing g.yu lo rgod pa'i dga' tshal du//

rtsom bsam ra po'i rang mngangs/de 161 /debar bar me tog tshom bu'i lding khang bkra/bung ba phye leb rab dga'i 'phur lding gis//yid kyi brtan pa ci yang 'bigs par byed//'dzum 'dzum rlabs kyi phreng bas nyer bskul ba'i//ngang ngur rtse dgas gshog 'gyur bsgyur ba'i ngogs//wu ba dkar bo'i thig le 'dzin byed pa'i//dwangs gsal mtsho mo yid kyi dpal du 'jebs//dgun gsum kha ba dkar bo yid ngor mdzes /dpyid gsum me tog bzhad tshe yid du 'ong //dbyar gsum sbrang char sil ma yid kyi gsos//ston gsum 'bras bzang smin tshe yid re spro//mdor na bzang ngan snang ba ci shar yang //thams cad yid 'di'i snang ba gcig bu ste//yid ni chom rkun 'dra bar gsungs mod kyang //yid kyis bslus pa grangs kyis ga la chod//

/de/ 162 /dra/ da 'i na bral rje'i ma grol — ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ rdo ṭ+wāṃ bhe/ sdosbyi ༷ — — 'e'otshu sdi༈ rte s+t+waṃ snyebheṭ+wāṃb/—— — — 7 rtoñtshahūṃ rnyi t+t+waṃ hūm̐ ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ 3 —shā ོ tsho — rtosnyidz+rīṣ+ṭṛ / ṭ+wāṃ bhe smo 'jig rten 'khor ba sna tshogs rmi lam dang //chu yi rlabs bzhin skyid sdug nges pa med//bltas na thams cad skyid skyid 'drar snang yang //dpag tshe rang rang sa hā ṭ+wāṃshā bsngal re//ṭ+wāṃsna ṭ+wāṭ+wāṃ~X ༵༵ ṭ+wāṃ ༵ ṅge yirje ༵༷dra brdong ba/ /med//'on kyang 'dus byas lus 'di ma 'jig par//skyid sdug 'dres ma'i gzeb tu gnas dgos phyir//skyo bas mig chu lhung yang bya thabs bral//
rgyu 4 hūm̐ mgur dbyangs co ga'i drug 'gyurahā tshan pa lnga pa/hā ཿ ཿ ཿ ཿ 2 ཿ

༅—— rtsom bsamang rapong4nga sazo༅hūṃ nga— mtsho sngon po lta skor tu phyin pa'i mthong thos/sprin dkar g.yo ba'i lding khang khri gdugs kyi 'og tu//skar tshogs sa la 'dzum 'dra'i zi ling gi grong khyer//skye sngon las kyis bsags pas pha yul de mthong rjes//e ma mngon dga'i tshor ba 'gog med du 'char byung //yid kyi thig ler gyur ba'i grogs dag dang lhan du//gnam sngon sa la 'khyil 'dra'i khri shor gyi rgyal mo//rlabs phreng mul mul rgod pa'i 'dzum dkar de mthong rjes//dbang med rab dga'i pad+mo 'bum phrag tu bzhad byung //mdzes sdug baiḍūr zhun ma'i mdwangs 'dzin gyi mtsho mo//mgrin pa'i rdza rnga 'khrol ba'i snying sdug gi ngang mos//rlabs kyi phreng bar rtsed 'jos gshog zung gi gar stabs//yid kyi dwangs mar bsus pas mgron po ru gyur byung //rtswa sngon skyil bu'i mal gyi mdzes sdug gi me tog /'dzum pa'i tshems phreng rgod pa'i dpyid dpal la chags pas//bung ba phye leb dga' bas skor bro dag bsgyur dus//

— —— —/ de zo ༷ ma radagos4gridrugar+yād1——— /de—༅ khrung khrung snyan pa'i mgrin pas gling bu de 'bus byung //dwangs gsal wu bas gar 'acirdon mtha' yas kyi mtsho mo//rlabs phreng shig shig g.yo zhing 'dzum dkar gyi zegs mas//gang gi lto bar rtsen pa'i gser mig gi tshogs rnams//dbang med rab dga'i dpyid kyi zlos gar la bskul byung //yid 'phrog gangs ri dkar bos skor ba yi ljongs 'dir//mdzes pa'i phul tu son pa khri shor gyi rgyal mo//mthong bas bdag yid rab dgas bsngags brjod dang lhan du//smyug sor chu 'dzin rtse yi snyan tshig de thon byung //zhes spyi lo 1998lo'i zla 7par yid 'ong yid kyi dwangs ma mngon par bsu ba mtsho sngon ngo ra zhes snyan pa'i grags pa sum rtsen dpal du mched pa der yu la ljongs lta skor du byin ska bas thol byung du bris pa'i snyan tshis go//dngul rwa lha sde'i dpyis me tog thang gi mthong thos/steng na gnam sngon dwangs ma sngo dwangs se//bar na na bun smug po smugs shigs se//'os na 'brog bi rtswa thang lhod cig ge//

rtsom bsamangagarapo'i rangamadwangagashe /67 — ——rdogyiyimetog thang zhesargegs 'ar+sād 4ོ——ོser bo gser gyi me tog ser ldem me//dkar bo dung gi mkhan pa dkar lam me//dmar po mchong gi ba lu dmar ldem me//dpyi yi me tog thang 'di mthong na dga'//kun mkhyen 'jam bzhad lnga ba chen po nas//bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma thug gi bar//byin rlabs zhabs kyis bcags pa'i gnas mchog te//dpyi yi me tog thang 'di e ma rmad//der khod 'brog bi khyim gzhi bsod nams ldan//pho rnams dpa' rtsal 'dzoms shing rang bzhin drang //mo rnams lang tsho ldan zhing las la brtson//bde skyid ngang gis 'khyil ba'i sa cha red//stobs bzhi rta mchog gom kha bsgyur sa red//phyugs rdzi dga' bas glu dbyangs len sa red //rgyang gi mgron pos bstod ra 'then sa red//yang yang slebs par 'dod pa'i sa cha red//7dngul rwa lha sde'i dpyis me tog thang gi mthong thos 'es pa ni rang 'o nyer

/de 168 /de ma ra byangs co 'i 'a ragasu ma gyi dus su rma chu rdzong dngul rwa lha sde'i dpyis me tog thang du rta rgyugs 'gran rtsal rgya chen por byas par lta skor du song ba'i mthong thos so//4 tsātsha4tshan ༄bu'iṭ+wāṃ 1ste shā ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃzhiyo/byerdzo —3casnyuskyid la sdug pa 'jig rten pha yul//skye mthar 'chi ba 'khor ba'i chos nyid//bsags kyang 'dzad pa 'dus byas rang bzhin//gang la bltas kyang snying po mi 'dug /mthon po'i mtha' rgud 'dus pa'i mtha' bral//mdzes mthar rgas shing dar mthar slong ba//de ring myong ba'i bde skyid zegs ma//sang nyin dus su rmi lam rang bzhin//de ring snying gi dwangs mar gyur kyang //sang nyin dgra yi gshed ma lta bu//'phrad pa'i grogs dang bsags pa'i nor rdzas//dgos pa'i tshe na phan par mi 'dug/

rtsom bsamangatshopo'arangamangangs—— 169 /de7sems shin tu skyo ba'i nyin zhig la rang shag tu bris/1 — / sna25cad/la / khro/gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs ༵skor bod kyi ljongs//sangs rgyas bstan pa'i nyi gzhon 'char sa med//ma ṇi yig drug glu ru len sa red//'dod chung chog shes 'tsho ba rol sa red//lha sa/dbus 'gyur chos kyi zhing khams lha sa ni//nga cag bod mi'i bsam don 'grub sa red//dkar bo chos kyi sa bon 'debs sa red//legs pa'i dge tshogs sna tshogs byed sa red//gtsang /chos kyi chol kha zhes grags gtsang gi yul//bzo rigs sgyu rtsal sna tshogs byed sa red//

—— 170 —— ma ra byangs co 'i 'a raglu gar rol mo'i phyogs la dga' sa red//dka' spyad 'khur du nus pa'i sa cha red//mnga' ris/'dzam gling srid pa'i rtse mo mnga' ris ni//gangs ri dkar po'i mchod rten mthong sa med//mtsho mo sngon mo'i kha dog mdzes sa red//ngo mtshar che ba'i gnas zhes grags sa red//a mdo/bsod nams mar khu'i rdzing bu a mdo ni//rta nor lug gsum ri lung khyab sa red//sha mar thud gsum ri bzhin spungs sa red//rdzi bo rnams kyis skyid glu len sa red//khams pa/mi yi chol kha zhes grags khams pa ni//gos rigs rgyan cha'i phyogs la dga' sa red//

rtsom bsamadakurapo'irangamangangs/de 171 ——dza—rwangazong sna tshogasabyedalarmechezlo༄rdo—ོ—————gnod sbyin 'dra ba'i phyug po skyes sa red//7bod ces pa'i snyan rtsom 'di ni dkon mchog bsam gtan gyis spyi 'o 1999lo'i ston khar rang shag pad+ma'i dga' tshal du sbyar ba'o//rgan rgya'i mkhar nang /steng sprin dkar long long 'phyur ba'i 'og/bar na na bun bla bre bris pa der//ma mkha' 'gro'i zhing sa brag dkar zhes//mtshan snyan pa can de mthong na dga'//spangs ser po maṇ+ḍal spungs 'dra'i 'og//thang yangs po me long mdzes pa'i gzhir//mkhar g.yung drung ris su bkra ba de//yul de ni rgan gya'i mkhar nang yin//'bras 'bru rigs sna lnga de ru 'dzoms//dman bu mo'i skye gzugs de na legs//khog shes rgya ldan pa de ru yod//

/de 172 /de ma ra byangs rtsa 'i 'a ra— sdedelayidasmon mi 'chor su//chu dwangs gsal wu ba'i 'dzum dkar can//nya gser mig rtsed 'jo rol sa red//'bru snye mas mgo lcogs ldem pa'i khrod//ma bu mos glu dbyangs len sa red//gser lam lam ke che1re me tog rtser//sgra dir dir bung bas 'phur lding rol//thang sngon mo g.yu yi me long mthil//g.yang lug khyu nam mkha'i sprin dkar 'dra//khra lam lam me tog 'bum phrag bzhad//mdog legs pa tshom bu bkod 'dra'i ri//thang bde mo g.yu yi gzhong ba 'dra//gnas de ni rgan gya'i yul ljongs red//sngon dus su 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sogs//mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i mkhas pa slebs//des deng sang tshan rig lag rtsal sogs//dbyar mtsho mo 'dra ba'i 'phel rgyas byung //rang pho lo nyi shur son pa'i dus//

rtsom bsam nga ra po'i rang mngangs 173 ——gnas 'di ru shing slong byed du yong // —yul de ni lha yi dga' tshal dang //sgo kun nas mtshungs zhes smra bar spobs//7rgan gya'i mkhar nang zhes pa'i snyan rtsom ni phran rgan gya'i rtswa thang la shing slong spro gseng du yong ba'i nyin zhig la bris ba'o//gangs ri'i gnas bstod/'dzam gling srid pa'i rtse mo//gangs dkar shel gyi phreng ba//mtsho mo g.yu yi man ḍal/ /gangs ljongs bod kyi sa red/ /steng na nam mkha' dwangs ma/ /'og na ne'u gsing sngon mo/ /bar na mkha' dbugs gtsang ma/ /nga cag bod kyi sa cha/ /stod kyi gangs ri dkar po//rtse mo na bun lang long //'dabs na rdza chu lhung lhung / /mthong bas spro ba lhang lhang / /gangs dkar ti se'i gzi mdangs/ /jo mo glang ri'i lhun brjid//rma chen sbom ri'i dpyid dpal/ /e ma yid la dga' bskyed/ /stod kyi ma pham g.yu mtsho/ /bar gyi yar 'brog g.yu mtsho/ /smad kyi khri shor rgyal mo//gnam sngon sa la 'khyil 'dra//lhun zhing sdug pa'i ri brgyad/ /dwangs shing gsal ba'i mtsho brgyad/ /'phags mchog snying rje'i

—— /5 mgar byangasaco44lto0 — ————mgon gyis/ /lung gis zin pa'i sa cha/ /dbus ldan chos kyi zhing na//dmar po ri yi rtse na//pho brang po ta la zhes/ /gru 'dzin gnyis pa dran byung / /ra sa sprul ba'i gtsug lag /jo bo yid bzhin nor bu/ /gser 'od byin rlabs rang 'bar mjal ba'i skal ba ldan song / /se ra 'bras spungs la sogs/ /gdan sa gsum gyis 'chad nyan/ /rgya gar na len dra dang / /khyad par ci yang ma mchis/ /lha sa'i bar skor khrom ra/ /mi rigs sna tshogs tshong zong //phun tshogs klu la 'khu zhing //bde skyid lha la 'gran song / /rma lung phyug mo'i lte bar/ /dal gyis 'bab pa'i rma chu/ /ba yan ha ra'i lho phyogs/ /drag tu 'bab ba'i 'bri chu/ /gangs can bod kyi zung chu/ /rma chu 'bri chu rnam gnyis/ /chu 'go bod nas gyes shing / /chu rnga rgya mtsho 'bab 'dug /tsong la ring mo'i rgyud du/ /chags pa'i byams pa 'bum gling / /mjal bas yid kyi me long / /thar ba'i sa bon bskrun byung / /bsang gzhung sngon mo'i 'gram du/ /bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gling / /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i dbyar rnga / /srid pa'i khyon du brdung song / /stod kyi mnga' ri'i skor gsum/ /gangs ri'i phreng bas mdzes sa/ /g.yu yi mtsho mos rgyan sa/ /steng gi mkha' dbugs gtsang sa/ /

rtsom bsam ra po'i rang ma ngas—— 175 ———r+sharegyidabusagatsang rubazhi chosakyizhing khamasargenyisapa rmye bod tshong zong rgyas sa/ /skyid pa'i 'tsho ba rol sa/ /smad kyi mdo khams sgang drug /ri lung thang gsum med par/ /rkang bzhi phyugs kyis bkang sa/ /mar chur 'o ma'i gter mdzod/ /gangs lha me tog la sogs/ /dkon pa'i sman sna 'khrungs sa/ /g.yu byur gzi mchong la sogs/ /dkon pa'i rin chen sna 'dzom/ /'bri g.yag mdzo mo la sogs/ /rmig bzhi'i sa gzhi khyab sa/ /rgan gzhon pho mo med par/ /ya rabs ngang gis ldan sa/ /bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas la//rnam dpyod yangs pa'i mkhas pa e ma lha lam khrod kyi/ /rgyu skar las kyang mang ba/ /mdor na gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir/ /sde bzhi'i mnga' thang dar zhing / /dbang phyag yon tan brgyad kyis/ /rtag tu 'tsho ba'i smon lam//༄ 7ces gangs ri'i gnas bstod zhes pa'i snyan rtsom 'di ni rgya'i grong khyer chen mo zhwa min nas bris pa'o//

— 176 — ma ra byangasaco 'i 'a ra /de/bdag chung dus su/ka ra bu ram za ba chung ngu'i dus//kha nas ci bshad gtam sogs rang dbang ldan//ga sa gang du rtsed mo sna tshogs rtse'i//nga las skyid pa'i mi zhig med par snyam//ca lag rgyu rdzas mang po med na yang //cha rkyen 'dzom po snyam pa'i snang ba 'char//ja sogs zas kyi btung ba sna tshogs rol//nya re nyor re'i ngang du lang tsho brtas//ta las 'dab ltar blo rig rgyas pa'i tshe//tha snyad shes byar 'jug pa'i go skabs rnyed//da lta ma las lhag pa'i a ce yis//na gzhon rnams dang 'dra bar slob grwar 'jug /pa sangs ltar dkar sems ldan a ce yi sa//pha rol gzhan las lhag pa'i skyed bsrings byas//

—— /li— bsamang 44dwangang 177 ——ཿga ba las 'o bzhin mthun rkyen legs sbyar te//ma 'u sa thes byar khong du chud par mdzad /tsa ri gnas bskor lta bu'i sdug ma myong //tsha grang dka' spyad ci yang mi dgos par//dzā ti'i sdong bzhin shes rig rmang chags nas//wa ler slob chung de las slob ma/thar phyin//zha lu'i ljang myug ji bzhin na chung dus//za zi 'du 'dzi'i dbang du ma btang zhing //'a 'ur shes bya'i grwar tu 'jug mkhan te//ya rabs brtse ldan a ce khyod las su //ra ba khor yug mdzes pa'i slob 'bring nas/ la 'ur shes bya'i gnas la legs sbyangs te//sha tsha snying nye a ce khyod kyi drin//sa cha gang du bsdad kyang brjed mi srid//ha ha ku re'i rtsed mo ma yin par//a mdo rgan gya'i yul gyi gzhon nu des//

/de 178 —— ma ra byangs co 'i 'a ra ོ———ta cangabadagalabaculdana.acel /de————a ho dga' ba'i dbyangs kyis smras pa'o//mchog ṭ+wāṃ ༷༷ ༵ ṭ+wāṃ dā ṭ+wāṃ ba dkon mchog bsam gtan gyis sangs rgyas dkon mi rtag ngag mgur/mi yi tshe srog chu yi wu ba 'dra//da ltar snang yang da lta mi snang ngo //'jig rten 'dun ma ston gyi gnam ngo 'dra//skabs 'gar dro zhing skabs 'gar ci yang grang //bya byed phal cher sos ma'i ba/nam ngo 'dra//yud tsam dkar la yud tsam nag po red//phan tshun ngo srung thang ga'i ri mo bzhin//snga so legs cing phyi so mi legs pa'i//tshe 'di'i bde skyid dbyar gyi 'ja' mtshon 'dra//yud tsam mdzes kyang yud tsam mi snang gi//des na bya spyod 'di yis mi bsrun pas//

—— rtsom 3su4du rapo'id ༄khus 179 ——skye bo 'ga' yang srid 'dir yod min pa'i//nog chung bya bar mgo bo mi 'khor bar//rang gi phugs 'dun rang gis bskyangs na legs//sems kha chos la phyogs pa mang na yang //bya spyod chos su song ba shin tu dkon//bltas na chos dang 'jig rten so so red//dpyad tshe phan tshun 'gal ba cang ma mchis//chos pas 'jig rten smad par mi 'tshal zhing //'jig rten pa rnams chos la sdang mi rigs//grwa chas gyon tshad rnam dag ma lags shing //grong chas gyon tshad khyim pa ga la rigs//des na bzang ngan bya spyod yon tan sogs//sa le sbram gyi gser bzhin brtag par 'tshal//

— 180/de— mabadangabyag co༄ 'a ra slob mar gdams pa'i bslab bya/ka ba lang bzang mdzes pa 'i slob grwa ru//kha ya ma zla'i slob grosas rnams dang mnyam //ga ler rang gzhan mthun pa'i grwar nang du//nga khyod phyogs res med par slob sbyong rem///ca co 'ur zing ngang du ma btang zhing //cha lugs gang bzang phyogs la ma brtson pa ra//ja zas rnal ma'i 'tsho ba'i chog shes te//nya mo chu la rtsen bzhin shes byar brtson//ta la'i 'dab ltar blo rig bzang ba'i dus//tha snya da shes bya'i rnam grangs mang bsosas te//da lta gzhan las 'phags pa'i yon tan nor//na tshod gzhon pa'i dus nas yod par rigs //pa sangs lta bur khyod la sems dkar ba'i//pha ma la sogs dge rgan rnams pa'i gsung //ba drus 'o bzhin snying gi mthil snoms te//

rtsom bsam ra po'i rang mdangs/de 181 /dem lus shes bya khongs du chud par byos//tsa ri'i gnas skor lta bu'i dka' spyad 'bum//tsha grang ngal ba ci yod khyad bsad nas//dza hu'i bu mo'i rgyun bzhin lhod med ngang //wa ler shes bya'i gnas la 'jug shig ang //zhwa gos lham sogs gang mdzes lta ba dang //za ma'i bro ba gang zhim gleng ba sogs//'a 'ur don med nyi ma ma gtong bar//ya mtshan mkhas pa'i go 'phang brtson par rigs//ra ba khor yug mdzes pa'i slob grwa ru//la lung sa phyogs mi gcig yul kun nas//sha rus gcig pa nga cag bod mi'i gdung //sa phyogs 'di ru 'ong don slob sbyong ched//ha ha blo mdzangs rnam dpyod yangs pa'i bu//a ho bcu phrag rig pa'i gangs kyi spor//sha ra bha bzhin 'gyings par 'dod pa'i na//a re deng nas shes byar brtson shig kye//7zhes ba 'di ni kun lho sa khul gyi gtsos grong khyer du bris pa'o//

/de 182 /de ma ra byangs co 'i 'a rang yi sa yul/gangs ri dkar po shel gyi mchod rten//mtsho mo sngon mo g.yu yi mar+bhal//me tog ser chen gser gyi spang ljongs//nga cag bod mi'i yul ljongs yin song //rta nor lug gi sha shed rgyas sa//sha rkyang ma bus rtsed 'jo rol sa//na chung rdzi bos glu dbyangs len sa//nga yi pha yul skyid kyi gshong bu//ne'u gsing g.yu yi me long mthil du//dkar dmar mdog legs me tog gzhon nus//'dzum 'dzum rab dgas mgo lcog ldem sa//nga yi pha yul yid la 'khor song //dwangs shing gsal ba mtsho yi ngogs su//gangs ri shel gyi gzugs brnyan 'phos pa//ngang ngur khrung khrung rtsed 'jo rol sa//skye sngon las kyi pha yul dran song //

rtsom gabasamad rapo'i rang ma ngas— 183 —tshangatshinganagasaklongasturgopo'ikhrodadu —/de———stag gzig dom dred ngar skad 'byin zhing //sha ba rog pos rwa rtsal ngom sa /ngo mtshar ldan pa'i pha yul dran song //spang thang sngon mo g.yu yi gzhong bar//sbra nag gru bzhi skyid pa'i khyim du//dga' skyid glu gzhas dgod sgra lhang lhang //chung nas 'dris pa'i pha yul dran song //rdza ri smug po'i rtse mo rno zhing //spang ljongs sngon mo'i mtha' gru yangs por//g.yang dkar lug khyus zhogs sgra thos pas//nga yi pha yul yid la 'khor song //mi yi gshis rgyud mda' ltar drang zhing //thag ring mgron po 'dzum gyis bsu ba//yid gzhung khrel yod ldan pa'i sa char//nga yi pha yul mgo log yin song //bcu phrag shes yon ldan pa der yod//gnod sbyin 'dra ba'i phyug po der yod//

/de 184 /de ma ra byangs co 'i 'a ra— ltaba'imingoms mdzes ma der yod//yod dgu 'dzom pa'i pha yul dran song //ma thon rgyang nas ming grags che sa//thon na don gyi 'byor phyug legs sa//dga' skyid 'dres ma'i glu dbyangs len sa//me tog bung bas lding 'khor rgyag sa//khu byug sngon mos dung dung mgrin glu//sgra 'dzin lam du rtag tu thos sa//skye sngon las kyi grub pa'i pha yul//dran pas glu dbyangs 'gog med thon byung //smug rlangs khrod kyi ri grong /gangs dkar shel gyi rtse mo rno zhing //rdza ri sngon mo smug pas g.yogs dus//lhing 'jags na bun bla bre'i khrod nas//dud sprin 'dres pa'i rang khyim rnyed song //ri lung phal cher smug pas btum pa'i//

rtsom bsam nga ra po'i rang mngangs — 185 ——gyi ling rtaphosa'atsheraskadaskyonganas ——rdzi bo gzhon nu'i dbyangs rta snyan zhing //g.yang dkar lug khyus zhogs sgra thos song //sbra nag gru bzhi g.yang khyim gud du//gsal la mi gsal sgron me'i ngogs su//skyid sdug 'dres ma'i gdong gi gnyer ma//thod du bsdus pa'i a pha rgad pos//dus bzhi'i bya ba'i 'phrang gog 'greng bzhin//ma 'ongs 'dun lam re ba bcol te//ngam stug thod gnyer brtsegs pa'i gseb nas//zhum med sems kyi chu thigs 'dzum 'dug /ma 'bri mdzo mos dur skad khrod nas//las la brtson pa'i a ma rgan mos//shag shag 'o ma'i sgra dang bcas te//thag ring rdzi bo'i glu skad nyan bzhin//dka' sdug 'phreng ba'i la thur mi 'jigs//ma 'ongs phugs 'dun re ba bcol bzhin//mig zung mchi ma 'khor ba'i sdings nas/ /

— 186 — ma ra ngabyangs co 'i 'a racho —— semasakyi'odazhagasaphyinamangona'adugashe—/de——7ces smug rlangs khrod kyi ri grong zhes pa'i snyan rtsom 'di nyid bod kyi 'tsho ba dngos la sbyar nas bris pa'o//lhag bsam a ma'i 'dzum mdangs/rdza ri sngon mo smug pas bzung zhing / /rdza chu snyan mo lhung lhung 'bab dus//ma 'bri'i 'o ma shag shag bzho ba'i//a ma'i 'dzum zhal yid la 'char byung //a ma'i 'dzum mdangs yid la 'char bas//dbang med mig chu sa la bsnyil byung //ri lung med par g.yu yi mdangs 'dzin//kun gsal dbyings nas 'brug sgra ldir zhing //sbrang char sil ma mkha' nas 'bab dus//brtse ldan a ma'i 'dzum zhal dran byung //brtse ldan a ma'i 'dzum zhal dran pas//dbang med mig nas mchi ma 'thor byung //

rtsom bsam rapo'irangamangangasa'i /87 —me togasadamosanasa'adzumazhing — /de/debung ba mang bos 'phur lding rtsen te//khu byug sngon mos gsung skad 'byin dus//thag ring rgyang gi a ma dran byung //thag ring rgyang gi a ma dran pas//dbang med sems nas bzod thabs mi 'dug/sdong rtse'i 'dab ma sa la bsnyil zhing //sa gzhi'i gdong ba 'khyags pas bsdams te//chu bo chab rom dar gur phibs dus//lhag bsam can gyi a ma dran byung //lhag bsam can gyi a ma dran nas//sems kyi bung ba gdung bas gzir song //sprin sngon nam mkha'i mtha' la gnas shing //le bar mang bo'i sa yis bskal yang //ma khyod sems pa bde bar bzhugs dang //bu ngas slob grwa chen mo 'di nas//shes bya rig pa'i rtsal lag rgyas mthar//ma ngo bu ngo lhan 'dzoms byung yong //

—— 188 /de ma ra byangasaco 'i 'a ra — ces lhag bsam a ma'i 'dzum mdangs zhes bya ba 'di ni rab byung bcu bdun pa'i spyi lo 1999lo'i smin drug zla ba'i dmar phyogs rdzogs pa sasum pa'i nyin lan kru'u grong khyer gser gling me tog ldum ra'i tshal rang shag skyid pa'i gshong bu nas bris pa'o//mdo dbus mtho sgang / gzhung lam dar skud sngon mo 'then pa 'dra//g.yas g.yon ne'u gsing mdzes pa'i kha dog ni//e ma gnam sngon sa la 'khyil ba 'dra//yid kyi brtan pa kun nas 'phrogs par byed//myur mgyogs rlangs 'khor bya bzhin lam du bskyod//kha ba'i rdul brtsegs gangs ri'i phreng ba dang //baiḍūr g.yu yi mtsho mo 'gyur ba sogs//lam lam mig gi bdud rtsir 'thob pas spro//rma bya'i mgrin 'dra rtswa thang mdzes pa'i gzhir//g.yang dkar lug khyu sprin dkar gtibs pa'i khrod//rdzi bos snyan 'jebs glu yi 'gyur khug gis//

rtsom bsamang rapo'irangamangangs/ 189 ——— — bdegayid tsista dga'aba'icharngo+ormyes —— /de/gnam sngon gtsang ma rdul gyis go skabs dben//gangs kyi mchod rten nyi mas gdung ba med//gtsang chab sngon mo snyog pas dri bral zhing //bar snang yangs po du bas brdzi ba med//ma bgos baiḍūr zhun ma'i ne'u gsing gzhir//ma btab dri ldan sna lnga'i me tog 'dzum//ma bkrus dwangs gsal nyal 'gro dal gyis rgyu//ma bos rkang drug gzhon nu 'phur zhing lding //bzhengs mkhan med kyang gangs ri lhun gyis grub/ 'debs pa min yang rtsi 'bras phang phung chags//bos mkhan med kyang ri dwags dgo ba'i khyu//rdzi bos 'tshos min bag phebs bde bar rol//mad gad thags su btags 'dra'i nor 'dzin gzhir//shwa rkyang ma bus rab dga'i rtsed 'jo dang //khrung khrung dkar mos mdzes pa'i gshog 'gyur gyis//mdo dbus mtho sgang lha yi tshal ltar bsgyur//gnas mchog jo mo glang ri'i gzi byin dang //

—— 190 —— ma ra byangs co ra'i 'a ra —/ kurngogatsang bo'izarwalarlubasakyi/de ——khri shor rgyal mo'i rab mdzes kha dog gis//dbang med brgya byin lag gi mtshon cha bsnyil//dgun gsum kha bas g.yogs pa'i lus dkar ma//dpyid gsum rtswa sngon g.yu yi mdangs 'dzin zhing //dbyar gsum me tog bzhad pas sgeg 'chang ma//ston gsum 'bras bu smin tshe yid du 'ong //mdor na gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs bskor ba'i//skyid pa'i sa 'dzin mdo dbus mtho sgang gi//mdzes pa'i dpyid dpal la chags bstod pa'i glu//rgya bod kun gyis mgrin las dbang med len//'di na snyan ngag smra la rab dga' ba'i//gang de'i ra/dzub rtse'i shel dkar sgo nga'i sbubs//bstod tshig ka la ping ga'i dbyangs snyan gyis//blo gsal thos 'dzin spud pa'i rgyur gyur cig /7snyan rtsom 'di ni blo gsal gzhon nu zhig gis gangs ri'i yul ljongs spyi dang khyad par tu sha rus gcig pa'i spun zla rnams dran pa'i mgur gyi tshul du1997lo'i 6pa'i tshes 21la rgya yul gyi grong khyer hrang he nas bris/

nga —————— rtsom bsang4༅nga lhosgo/ rje༅snga3 ༅ —rang gi chos grogs zhig la phul ba'i ka rtsom lhag bsam bla ba'i 'od snang /ka ye snying grogs rnam dpyod rtse dga'i klong //kha zhe gnyis med sems las 'phos pa'i gtam//ga bur yid kyi thig ler yol go ru//nga khyod phyogs res med par snoms shig ang //ca co smra ba'i ngag tshig ma yin par//cha shas yongs gang ṅgems kyi zla ba las//ja chu mnyam 'dres dpe bzhin yid kyi grogs//nya rgyas zla bzhin khyod la gtam 'di thal//ta la'i 'dab ltar blo rig rgyas pa'i dus//tha shal spyod pa'i gnas las ring 'das te//da nas mdo sngags rig gzhung nyal 'gro'i rgyun//na tshod yol yang 'bad pa byed par 'tshal//pa sangs ltar dkar rgyal ba byang sems kyis//pha rol phyin gzhung gsung gi man ngag rgyan//ba mo nyi zer 'char ba ji bzhin du// ༄

/de 192 —— mgar byangs co 'i 'a ra ——rālusarnamadapyodaltobarachubaparamadzod /de—tsa tur sde bzhi'i dpal ldan dgon chen der//tsha grang dka' spyad khul du 'khyer nus shing //dza lang spyod pa ma lus drungs 'byin te//wa ler mkhas pa'i go 'phang brtson shig ang //zhwa ser bstan pa'i chos kyi dga' tshal der//za zi'i bag chags bzang bo'i 'phro mthud de//'a 'ur ma yin dge bcu'i bya ba la//ya rabs lugs bzhin 'bad pa don yod mdzod//ra yig gnyis pa pad ma'i tshal bzhin du//la 'ur rang la mkho ba'i shes bya'i tshogs//sha tshugs lus 'di bam po ma gyur bar//sa cha 'di ru 'bad pa byed par 'tshal//ha cang snyan pa'i sdeb sbyor gyis dbul zhing //a ma gcig gi spun ltar khyod la ni//a ho smras pa'i gtam la mi khrel bar//ha cang dga' ba'i bzhin bcas len par 'tshal//

/de rtsom bsam rapo'irangamangadas—— 19shi—/de/deskyes su 'os pa'i pha yul gyi rnam pa gsar ba/(1998lo'i zla 7par pha yul gyi rnam pa gsar ba'i 'gyur ldog mthong rjes/)mdzes sdug sku yi 'o mtsho gsar ba'i dbus//yid 'phrog nu 'bur ngang mo zung gis 'khyud//gnag snum skra lo sil grol sku stod khebs//tshangs sras dga' ma bdag yid khab tu rol//gangs ri shel gyi mchod rten bzhengs 'dra bo//chol kha gsum gyi nang tshan mdo khams smad//rma klong dal gyis 'bab pa'i khugs pa ste//mgo log zhes grags a skyong lcags mo'i rgyud//dbus su ri yi phreng tshogs lhun zhing stug/rtse mo gangs ri dkar bo dgung la reg /'dabs na g.yu yi mtsho mo sngo ltems se//sa yi dge mtshan ngang gis grub pa'i ljongs//ltos dang 'dod lha'i me long lhung 'dra'i thang //yid 'phrog spangs gzhong g.yu yi dga' tshal na//

/de 194 —— ma ra byangs co 'i 'a ra/demadogalergesametogatshon gyisarabadz+reṅka pa'i/de——dga' ba'i 'dzum dkar khongs nas dgod min nam//ha ri gar mkhan sgeg mo'i gdong gi dri//rings du 'khyer 'dra'i me tog dri bsung 'bum//rjes chags bung bas rtse dga'i zlos gar dpyid//'chi med mig yangs ma dag yid smon 'chor//dwangs gsal rlabs kyi phreng ba mkha' la 'thor//sngo ljang baiḍūr zhun ma 'khyil 'dra bo//mtsho yi rlabs phreng shig shig 'gul ba'i dbus//ngang ngur mgrin pa'i rol mo ci yang 'khrol//de yi ngogs na khrung khrung dkar mo sogs//gnyis skyes spu sdug mdzes pa'i gshog bsgyur dang //snyan pa'i mgrin sgra phyogs kyi 'gram par khyab//de ni sum rtsen gnas kyi zla bor 'khu//nyin byed 'od kyi mdangs kyang mog mog por//sgyur byed tshang tshing g.yu yi dga' tshal du//shwa rkyang ma bu dga' bas rtse 'jo dang //chabs cig mdzes pa'i mchong lding dpal la rol /

rtsom bsam da ra po'i rang mngangs—/ — 19 5 /dekya ——stoljangagayuyilomasor+ṣaṅgār+sha———/de+orab mdzes smin legs myos bum sil tog gi //lang tsho gsar ba'i mdzes sdug la chags nas//'dab yangs spu sdug dga' bas mchu 'dab sbyor//dbu ba dkar bo'i thig le thod du bcing //rlabs kyi lag pas me tog 'thu bzhin du//lhung lhung sgra 'byin dwangs gsal nyal 'gro ma//spangs gzhong yangs por dar skud sngon mo bzhin//gser mdog 'bru drug snye ma'i mgo lcog ni//mtshams sprin gsar ba'i rtse dga' la chags shing //ldem ldem g.yo ba'i phun tshogs chu gter mas//rlabs kyi phreng bar kun nas 'phya bzhin mdzes//dbyibs ni rus sbal gzugs la nyer 'khu ba'i//rab mang sdom rgya'i chon thag dra ba can//mdzes sdug sbra nag dga' ba'i gur khyim du//skyid pa'i gtam gleng e ma 'dzad re skan//rngam brjid lus kyi gzi mdangs rab brtas pa'i//rgya stag dmar yag la 'gran sgo srung khyis//

——— 196 — ma ra byangasaco 'i 'a ra /de/bzod dka'i mche ba glal bzhin zug pa'i sgras//gnam sa bla 'og dgas kyis dogs pa bzhin//rab yangs spang ljongs khyon 'dir bal ldan khyus//yongs su 'gengs 'di kun gsal bu mo'i 'gram//rgyu skar phreng bas spud bzhin yid du 'ong //de ni 'jig rten byed pos bskrun pa 'dra//gzugs dpyad blta bas chog mi shes pa yi//phul byung mgyogs 'gro stobs bzhi cang shes rtas//rmig bzhi blum po'i 'khor lo skyen pa'i tshad//brgya byin mig stong sprul kyang gzhal re skan//in dra nī la'i mdangs 'dzin rwa rtse ni//gnam la bsgrengs pas mkha' lding dbang bo yang //snying rtsa lkog mar 'byin pa'i 'jigs ster ba//zhol g.yag stobs rtsal 'gran pas nus ldan su//yid 'ong snying du sdug pa'i be'u'i tshogs//mdzes sdug me tog bzhad pa'i ne'u gsing ngogs//rtse dga'i bang rtsal 'gran pas mchong lding gis//dri za'i bu mo'i tshogs kyang bzhad gad bslang //

—— rtsom bsamangakar po'irangamadangs — 1 7/de—de ltar rnam mang bgrang yas rkang bzhi'i khyu//kha grangs bgrang bar ma nus khyab 'jug ni//'dren byed sa la lhung ba'i brtul zhugs kyis//mi smra skyengs pas sprin dkar phag tu 'chel//mar chur bal sogs 'dzad med longs spyod kyis//lcid kyis ma theg khengs ldan nor 'dzin ma//rgya mtshor 'phyang dogs tshul la ma bzod nas//mi'u thung rus sbal zol gyis 'degs min nam//de ltar srid gsum longs spyod khyad nor kun//snying bo ma lus gcig tu bsdus 'dra 'di//'jig rten byed po'i kun rtog pir rtse las//ma bris ri mo gsar ba cis ma yin//gna' rabs lo rgyus 'od stong 'bar ba'i ljongs//deng rabs tshan rig la sogs sde bzhi'i dpyid//dbyar gyi mtsho mo'i rjes 'gro pha yul gyi//rnam pa gsar bar bsngags brjod byed la spro//sdeb legs tshig sbyor sems kyi ri mo yin//sems ni dga' sdug gnyis kyi sgo mo yin//

—— 198 — ma ra byangasaco 'i ga' ra—/dezlon semasalas 'ongs pas bstod tshig gi//me tog chun po dga' bas sbyin par bya//dga' skyo 'dres ma'i ngag mgur/(lan kunazag med bde stong rdzogs pa 'khril ldem gyi sku gzugs//zhal ras zla ba rgyas pa'i 'dzum dkar gyis 'phya ba/ /srid zhi'i khengs pa kun 'phrog lang tsho yis sgeg pa'i//ngag dbang dbyangs ldan stsol mkhas dga' ma de dran byung //sprin sngon ba gam mthon por brtsegs pa yi gdengs nas//dregs rtsal gshog pas gar bsgyur mkha' lding bzhin rtsen pa'i//rnam gsal lnga rig shes bya'i me tog gi thang du//blo gros rig rtsal 'gran pas snang tshul des dga' ba//nga cag bod mi'i bsod nams bgo skal du 'thob pa'i//'gran bral bcu phrag rig gzhung gter mdzod de bor nas//nges med nu zho'i lto can byis pa bzhin 'khyams pas//

rtsom ༅mngakarapo'irangamadangs / 9ri /dedeng dus skye bo 'ga' yi spyod tshul des skyo ba//gnam sngon sprin dkar g.yo ba'i khri gdugs kyi 'og tu//mu mtha' yas pa'i rtswa thang rta nor gyis 'gengs pa//ri bo'i gtos dang mnyam pa'i mar chur gyi longs spyod// ji dgar nyams su myong bas 'tsho ba des skyid pa//bsags tshad 'dzad du gtong bas khrel med kyi ga'on nus//cha lugs sna tshogs bsgyur zhing dud chang la rngam pa//shes bya'i gnas las g.yel zhing pha ma la sdang bas//spyod tshul de la mi skyo dpyod ldan rang su yod//chol gsum chu bzhi sgang drug so sor na gnas zhing //bro dang glu gar dga' zhing mchog gsu ma la dad pa'i//nga cag sha rus gcig pa'i spun zla tsho'i rigs la /skye sngon las kyis 'brel bas dga' ba rang skyes byung //bde ba'i mal gyi skyid pa'i 'tsho ba de dor nas//don med rtswa dang chu yi rtsod pa la bsnyad de//ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ hā / ༷ ṭ+wāṃ ༵ ṭ+wāṃsdi ṭ+wāṃ ༵༵ /ṭ+wāṃ ༵ ṭ+wāṃ~Xṭ+wāṃ ltas//'phrad ma thag tu dga' 'dzum lhug lhug tu ston zhing //

— 200 — mgar ngabyangs co 'i 'a ranang gtam gsong bor smra bas blo thub kyi grogs po//bde ba kho nar rlom pa'i deng rabs kyi gzhon nu//phyi yi spyod tshul mthong bas dga' ba rang 'dug kyang //cung zad dar tshe dga' bas zim zim gyis blta zhing //cung zad rgud tshe rgyang nas sdang mig gis blta ba//drin byas drin du mi go khrel med kyi rigs la//bsam zhing snang ba skyo ba'i nyams snang zhig shar byung //chu 'dzin ba gam rtse yi sgra brgya de chags nas//re bas mig 'bur gtod pas rma bya yi dpe bzhin//sha rus gcig pa'i rigs la brtse gdung rang che ba'i /gzhon nu gang de'i mdzub rtses gdengs ka nas 'thon byang //dga' skyo 'dres ma'i ngag mgur 'di ni deng bod yul kun tu sa rtsod chutī da kyis phu nu nang phan tshun nang dme chen po byas 'dug pas cung zad sel na snyam pa'i kun slong gi gzhi byas te bris pa'i snyan tshig zhig go/

— rtsom bsamang ra po'i rangamadangs/de 201 /de——zhu yig ko ki la yi gdangs snyan/ka ye snying dbus thig le ltar gyur ba'i//kha ton dge la gzhol ba'i chos grogs lags//ga ler sems kyi rgyad las 'phos pa'i gtam//nga yis smra 'o gang rked rna ba blogs//ca 'byid dug gsum rim nad ma 'dor na//cha lugs mdzes byed ngur smig bklubs pas ci//ja zas bag med spyod pa ma spangs na//nya rgyas zla ltar phyi spyod mdzes pas ci//ta la'i 'dab bzhin blo gros kyis dbul na//tha shal khrel med spyod pa rgod pas ci//da res lus rten don yod ma byas na//na tshod mthon por smin kyang dgos pa ci//pa sangs bzhin du dkar ba'i sems med na//pha ma lta bu'i chos grogs yin kyang ci// ba lang 'du shes lta bu'i chog shes na//ma yi bu khyod zer ba'i ming gis ci//

—— 202 — ma ra byangs co 'i 'a ratsa ma ra ltar blang dor mi shes na//tsha grang don 'gal shes 'chal rig pas ci//dza ya'i bstan la cung zad mi phan na//wa ler chos grwar 'grim kyang snying bo ci//zha 'theng nyam thag rigs la mi byams na//za 'og khri la 'gying yang dgos pa ci//'a cag slob tshogs drin gyis mi skyong na//ya mtshan mkhas pa'i go 'phang thob kyang ci//ra ris nyes tshogs cung zad ma spangs par//la lung ri khrod 'grim kyang ngal ba'i rgyu//sha chang sred pa'i 'dod pa ma spangs par//sa steng dam pa'i mtshan snyan ci ltar 'thob//ha be ho be rgyu nor la sred bzhin//a la ha sad snying rje des ci phan//ha ha snying gi grogs por gyur ba khyod//a re dga' skyo 'dres ma'i gtam 'di thal//ches rmongs bdag blo rkang 'thung 'khri shing rtser//snyan pa'i legs bshad me tog rgod min yang //

rtsom bsam da ra po'i rang mngangs— 203 —grogs khyod nye bar bskul ba'i gru char gyis//reg tshe 'dab phreng grol 'di chos nyid do//grogs kyi dwangs ma gang gis bskul ngor grong khyer chen mo zhes an nas dang bas sbyar ba'o//mdzes pa'i slob grwa 'di ru/gangs dkar shel gyi zom na/ /gangs seng dkar mo 'gyings byung / /gangs seng g.yu ral ngom pas/ /log smra zil gyis gnon byung / /mdzes pa'i mkha' dbyings 'di na/ /dung gi zla ba 'dzum byung / /dung zla gsar ba'i 'od kyis/ /gling bzhi'i mun pa sel byung / /dwangs pa'i mtsho nang 'di na/ /gser gyi nya mo 'khyugs byung / /brtson 'grus gshog 'dab phra mos/ /chu yi zegs ma 'thor byung / /tshang tshing g.yu lo ldem par/ /khu byug gsung snyan 'byin byung //khu byug gsang skad snyan mos//phyogs bzhi'i mgron char 'gugs byung //mdzes pa'i slob grwa 'di ru//rnam dpyod yangs pa'i tshogs kyis//ci 'dod shes bya'i sbrang rtsi//ngoms pa med par spyod song / /mthun pa'i gral nang 'di na/ /

— 204 — ma ra byangs co 'i 'a ra —dga' ba'i grogs po mang yang rang sems song ba'i mi de/ /nam yang brjed thabs mi 'dug/grogs la blangs pa'i ka mgur/ka ma la ltar 'dzum pa'i bzhin can//kha zhe gnyis med sems kyi 'tsher ya//ga ler snying gtam bdud rtsi 'thung nas//nga khyod med par brtse bas 'chings shig/ca ris bzhin du 'khums pa'i sems te//cha rkyen yod pa kho nas 'byed min//ja zas 'tsho ba mnyam du rol bas//nya rgyas bzhin can mthong bas grol song //ta la'i 'dab ltar blo rig rab rgyas//tha mal las lhag snying rje'i zla gzhon//da lta sems kyi mkha' nas 'char ba'i//na gzhon gang gis 'gran pa'i yul min//

rtsom bsam ra po'i rang mngangs— 205 —pa ra mi ta'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel//pha rgod bla ma'i man ngag zhal chems//ba drus 'o bzhin blo ngor gsal ba//ma lus mkhas pa'i rnam dpyod can khyod//tsa ri ltar bsil dgun gyi grang reg /tsha gdung 'bar ba dbyar gyi ngal dub//dza lang gtum spyod deng gi goms gshis//wa ler ma lus khyod kyis spangs song /zhwa gos don gnyer mdo med 'chor sgeg/za 'thung bde bas nyi ma gtong thabs//'a 'ur grags skam snyan pas rjes 'brang //ya rabs khyod kyis rings du spangs song //ra ba khang mig gru bzhi'i nang du//la lung 'du 'dzi g.yeng pa 'dor nas//sha rus rdo thug dpe bzhin shes byar//sa cha 'di nas khyod kyis sbyangs song //ha ha semaso las 'phos pa'i snying gtam//a re dga' bas grogs la bsring ngo //

/de 206 /de ma ra byangs co 'i 'a ra— ahokamadametogaphrenga'adi /de /deྈha cang dga' ba'i grogs la phul lo//pha sa pha yul gcig pa'i spun zla tsho/(pe cin nas)ka kha la sogs thog mar sbyangs pa'i yul//kha ba bu yug rgod pa'i sa cha ste//ga sa gang du nor lug gis khyab pa'i//nga yi pha yul mgo log zhes bya'i ljongs//ca co 'du 'dzis yongs dben sa gzhi yangs//cha rkyen sha mar thud kyis bang mdzod de//ja chang zas kyi dpal la ci dgar du//nya mo chu yi dpe bzhin 'jug pa'i yul//tā la'i 'dab ltar blo mig gsal ba'i tshogs//tha snyad shes bya'i gnas kun yod do cog/da nas sbyangs pa ches cher ma byas na//

rtsom bsam nga ra po'i rang mdangs— 207 —na tshod yol dus 'gyod kyang des ci phan//pa sangs ltar dkar blo sems rab mthun pa'i//pha sa pha yul gcig pa'i spun zla tsho//ba lu 'khan pa bzhad pa'i sa cha 'dir//ma lus shes bya'i gnas la brtson shig ang //tsa ri ltar bsil grang ngar gdong gis bsus//tsha zer nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lus kyis blangs//dza drag dka' ngal gang la ma 'jigs par//wa ler rang gzhan phan pa'i gnas te brtson//zhwa gos rgyan char dga' ba deng gi dus//za 'thung lto rgyab kho na tsam men par//'a 'ur 'du 'dzi'i srad la ma rgyugs par//ya mtshan mkhas pa'i gral du 'jug par rigs//ra ba khor yug gtsang pa'i gral nang du//la lung mi gcig las kyis 'dir bsdus pa'i//sha rus gcig pa'i spun zla gzhon nu rnams//sa 'dir 'ong don slob sbyong yin pas rem /ha cang snyan pa'i legs bshad ma yin yang //
a mra'i 'bras ltar blo ldan gzhon nu rnam/sa//ha lam phan pa cung re yod snyam nas//a ho dga' ba'i 'dzum bcas shar mar spel//

/deb rtsom bsamang rapo'irangamadangs— 2/ 1 0 gan lho sa khul gyi bsang gi rta rgyug /kun lho'i nor 'dzin thig le'i rgyan gcig ngu///snyan pa'i rgyal rnga ring nas mched pa'i yul//bsang gzhung sngon mo'i lo rgyus mgul ba'i phreng //rta rgyugs gtam gyi ut+pal 'di na 'dzum//de yang zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin ni bsang gi rta rgyug gi nyi ma yin la/ de nyin nga rang grogs po rnams dang mnyam du bsang khog dang bla brang bar gyi skyel 'dren rlangs 'khor la bsdad nas bsang gi rta rgyug 'gran par blta ru lam du chas so/ /gzhung lam dar skud sngon mo 'then 'dra'i thog tu rab myur 'phur ba dang mtshungs pa'i nged cag gi rlangs 'khor rgyugs thengs re rer dkan gzar gyi ri tshogs dang bde snyoms kyi ne'u gsing sogs skad cig gi yun tshad la nga tsho'i mthong byed kyi lam du mngon par 'char byung / /nyin byed gzhon nu'i 'dzum mdangs shar ri'i phrag rtse nas drod 'jam gser mdog gi 'od snang 'phro bzhin dal bur nor 'dzin

rtsom bsam nga ra po'i rang mngangs — 213 /der+shaṅgā'isgralogs thosa'adzina.ut+paladapalamor+sharūrnortsesmin — pas nyams dga' la/ mad rgad thags su 'thag pa'i rtswa thang yangs po'i lto bar dkar dmar ser gsum gyi me tog bar mtshams med par bzhad pa'i do ra na bung ba dang phye leb sgeg mo sogs kyis ro mchog sbrang rtsi'i thig ler rol ba'i yid 'phrog pa/ dar skud sngon mo ring du 'then 'dra'i nyal 'gro'i rgyun bzang gis wu ba dkar bo'i 'dzum dkar rgod bzhin sgeg pa'i 'gros gyis dal bar rgyu ba sogs lha yi skyed tshal mi yul du 'phos pa lta bu de yi ming khyed kyis e shes thal/ de ni kun lho nor 'dzin phyug mo'i phang bar snyan grags dbyar skyes sngon mo'i skad la za ba'i bsang gzhung g.yu yi dga' tshal gyi paṇa chen rta rgyug thang zhes grags pa de yin la/ bsang gi rta rgyugs 'gran rtsal byed sa'ang de yin no/ 'dir paṇa chen rta rgyugs thang zhes ming du grags don ni/ rgan rabs rnams kyi lo rgyus kyis ngag sgros ltar na/sngon paṇa chen sku phreng drug pa blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes mchog sa 'dir phebs nas dus 'khor dbang chen bskur ba dang dus mtshungs/ byang phyogs rig ldan sham bha lar myur du skye ba'i bden rtags kyi smon

ོ— 214 — rtsom raba'i do la —— ——lam gyi rten 'brel la dgongs nas/ 'o bco lnga yas mas kyi na chung gzhon nu lang tsho ldan pa 'ga' mgo la dar thod dkar po dang lus la dar tshon sna lnga'i dbang bo'i gzhu bzhin bkra ba legs par bgos te rta rgyug 'gran rtsal byas pa de nas bzung da bar du srol rgyun bzang bo 'di ma nyams par phun sum tshogs pa dar ba yin zhes thos shing sa 'di yang paṇa chen rta rgyug thang zhes byin rlabs can du grags pa lags/ /de lta bu'i mtha' gru yangs shing mu med pa'i sa gzhir chen po ni gnam sngon sa la 'khyil bzhin yid 'phrog shing nyams dga' ba'i ljongs 'dir pad ma'i tshal du bung ba 'khor bzhin skye bo khri phrag mang bo 'gro 'ong gi rgyu 'grul sprin sngon gyi 'du 'god ltar zam mi chad pas sa gzhir ri mo 'bri ba/ lus la yid 'phrog sna tshogs gos kyis spud cing / ngo la dga' bas mdzum gyis khengs pa'i gzhon nu ma rnams kyis ci 'dod snyan pa'i glu len zhing / byis pa rnams kyis gang 'dod kyi sgyu rtsal rtsed mo'i g.yeng ba/ stag shar gzhon nu rnams kyis ki ki swo slos bsang ma/chod dang rlung rta 'grem bzhin lha rgyal lo sogs kyi skad sang 'brug stong ltar sgrog bzhin pa'i skabs der/ e ma rta rgyug gi

ma rtsom bsam dkar po'i rang mngangs— 215 ——zlogobartsamasabyung ltosadang mig gi dbangabostor+ṣar du 'phrog pa'i rta mchog cang shes la 'gran bzod pa rnams gcig las gcig mgyogs kyi tshul du sngon la bkar yong /rmig bzhi zlum po'i 'khor lo glog ltar myur ba/ thag thag gi rmis pas 'dzin ma'i rnga bo rdung ba'i bar gseng nas gyen du bslangs pa'i sa rdul na bun ji bzhin nam mkhar mched pa//ltad mo ba rnams kyis khyod rgyal dang nga rgyal gyi skad sgra lhang lhang dang dga' ba'i tshang kha shig shig sngon la phyogs pa/bdag cag rnams kyang gdong la 'dzum gyis khengs shing mig gis ltad mor g.yeng bzhin mchis pa'i skabs der/ rig pa'i gnas kun la mi dman pa'i blo gros kyi mig dkyus mchog tu yangs pa bdag gi grogs mjog 'jam dbyangs lags kyis bdag la/ de ring ni bsang gi rta rgyug 'di 'dra'i lo rgyus ldan zhing sgyu rtsal gyi rnam pa'ang mtshon nus pa'i ngo mtshar 'bum/ ldan gyi ltad mo 'di lta bu lags pas/ khyed nas kyang de la bsngags brjod kyi me tog sil ma re 'grem na mi mdzes sam zhes brjod cing bskul ba la/ bdag gis kyang ngo ma ldog tsam du dga' ba'i nyams dang bcas te/

—nga 216 —— com raba'ido la /de— —rab mdzes 'dod lha'i me long lhung 'dra ba'i//yid 'phrog spangs gzhong g.yu yi dga' tshal na/mdog legs tshon sna 'bar ba'i me tog 'bum//'chi med nu rgyas ma dag yid smon 'chor//chu skyes 'dzum phreng grol ba'i gur khyim du//ro mchog sbrang rtsi'i thig ler rjes chags pa'i//rkang drug gzhon nu 'phur lding 'khyog po'i gar//yid kyi mdza' mo 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu lags //sngo bsangs mdzes ma'i me long bzhin gyi snod//rgyu skar phreng ba'i do shal stor 'dra ba'i//mdzes sdug mar rgad zhun ma'i do ra ru//rnam mang ras gur dngul gyi tshom bu'i zla//dbu ba dkar bo'i me tog phyag rgya'i mdud//thod du 'dzin pa dwangs gsal nyal 'gro'i rgyun//lhung lhung rab dgas sgra sgrogs sgeg 'gros kyis//rgyu 'di g.yu 'brug sngon mo 'khyugs bzhin mdzes//gzugs dpyad cang shes la 'gran rta mchog tshogs//

—— com bsamagarapozhirangamar+sā nga/de—— nyams brgya'i 'gros dang rtsal brgya'i bang rtsal sogs//mgyogs 'gro 'phrul gyi zhags pa'i rtse dga' bzhin//rnam mang mig gi bung ba 'gugs min nam//rmig bzhi zlum po'i 'khor lo skyen pa'i tshad//sprin dkar lcug ma'i do shal g.yo ba bzhin//bang bar mched pa'i sa rdul 'phyur ba yang //'bras ldan dus kyi na bun gtibs pa bzhin//rnam mang skye bo'i yid kyi ma ku ra//dga' ba 'bum kyi gzugs brnyan ci yang bkra//dgyes 'dzum sgeg pa'i bzhin gyi chu gter las//spro dga'i sgra dbyangs rlabs kyi zegs ma 'phyo//de ltar srid zhi'i mdzes sdug khyad nor 'bum//snying bo'i thig ler chags pa'i bcud bsdus pa//'jig rten byed po'i kun rtogs pir rtse nas//ma bris ngo mtshar ri mo 'di na gda'//zhes brjod bzhin pa'i mtshams der/ rta rgyug nas thon thal zhes ltad mo ba rnams 'ur 'ur long long gi ngang yar

—— 218 —— rtsom ra ba'i la'agreng ste 'tshang kha brgyab bzhin brel ba dang bcas pa'i ཿ/ rgyal lo zhes brjod pa la/ ngo ma thag thag gi rmig sgra dang bcas rgyugs nas thon byung / rta sngo sngo khu byug 'dra ba zhig mda' tshad gang do tsam gyi mngon la dkar ba ni bya ltar myur zhing glog ltar 'khyug pas e ma ge sar rgyal bo'i sgrung gtam nang du brjod pa'i cang shes rta mchog zhig dang khyad par med snyam pa'i snang ba shar byung /de ni bsang tsho bdun gyi nang gses sde ba gser khri'i lha sde dkar mo yi sde ba tsho chen gyi rta zhig yin la/ rta de ni gzugs dpyad sogs gang cha nas ming grags ldan zhing /'ga' zhig gis de ni gyi ling gi rgyud pa yin zhes gleng 'dugade rjes mi mang gis ki bswo sgra dang mnyam du rta rjes ma rnams kyang rim kyis thon byung / sde ba so sos de ring khyod rgyal lo dang nga rgyal lo sogs kyi sgra skad lhang lhang gis bsang khrir bskor ba re byas mthar rang rang so so'i phyogs su bya 'phur ba bzhin bzhud do/ nged cag rnams kyang nyin gang gi ltad mos ngal bzhin sngar gyi rlangs 'khor la bsdad rjes rang phyogs su chas so/ skabs der nyin byed gzhon nu'ang ltad mo

rtsom bsam rapo'irangamadangs 223—dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i bod rigs slob grwa chen mo ba rnams kyis bod kyi rig gnas dang skad yig skor la 'dzin pa'i lta stangs cung zad brjod pa/de yang / ji skad du/ gangs dkar bo shel gyi mchod rten yod//mtsho sngon mo g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal yod//zhes gsungs pa ltar/rang re'i kha ba bod kyi yul ljongs 'di ni 'dzam gling go la blum po'i khyon yangs por ches mdzes shing yid du 'ong la/ mdo dbus mtho sgang gis mtshon pas sa gshis mtho zhing mkha' dbugs gtsang ba/ phyogs mtshams kun tu gangs ri dkar bo shel gyi mchod rten lta bus bar mtshams med par bskor ba la ming grags can gyi ri chen po brgyad dang dwangs shing bsil ba'i mtsho chen po brgyad kyis mdzes par lham pa/chu bo yan lag brgyad ldan gyi nyal 'gro'i rgyun dag lhung lhung du 'bab pa la ngarnga ngur khrung khrung sogs gshog 'gyur bsgyur zhing snyan pa'i rdza rnga 'khrol ba/ shwa rkyang dgo bas rtsed 'jo rol

— 224 — dpya rtsom ri pa'i rtse 'joba'i gnas mchog 'dir rang re'i bod kyi mes po rnams kyi lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring mo ya mtha' gtugs pa med pa nas ma mtha' yang rang cag la thug gi bar 'dzad mtha' med pa'i lo rgyus kyi ring bzhin ldan te/ dper na spre'u byang chub sems dpa' dang brag srin mo las mi rgyud mched pa de la dpag na mi lo 'bum phrag du ma'i lo rgyus kyi gnas tshul zhig yin par deng sang lo rgyus smra ba rnams kyis gsungs pa ltar lags la/nga tsho bod mi rigs 'di yang dpa' ngar ldan zhing las la brtson pa zhig yin par rgyal khab phyi nang gi gzur gnas rtogs ldan skyes bu kun gyis mgrin gcig tu gleng bar 'dug go/ de la'ang gzi 'od 'bar ba'i bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas la sogs pa 'dzam gling na ngom chog par 'dug pa'i rig gnas mang la/ gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu'i mkhas pa'i dbang bo rnams kyis rlabs che ba'i mdzad rjes sogs bskal ba'i bar du nub pa med par ma zad slar yang phyi nang mkhas pa'i khrod du nam mkha'i sgron me bzhin gzi 'od lhang nger lham mer 'bar bzhin pa ni ngo mtshar che zhing dga' 'os pa'i gnas zhig tu 'khums so//

—/de —4304nga rabo'irang mngangs — 22 da —khyad par du krung hwa mes po'i rgyal khab kyi khyim gzhi chen po 'di'i nang du grangs nyung mi rigs mang po'i khrod na 'o rgyus dang / ris gzhung / srol rgyun gyi sgyu rtsal/ rtsom rig sogs cha kun nas 'bur du thon zhing brjod bya'i snying po dang ldan pa sogs ngom chog chog tu 'dug go/ treng sang dus rabs nyer gcig gi dpyid dpal 'char la nye ba'i skabs 'dir/'dzam gling phyi nang gi shes ldan pa mi mang bos tshan rig 'phru'/ chas can gyi sngon thon gyi sde khag du tshud par dngos po'i dpal yon dang bsam pa'i dpal yo na gnyis char gyis 'bad pa shugs chen du byed par mig mthong lag zin tu ma4 ཿ so / de mtshungs rang cag bod rigs slob grwa ba mang po ste rig pa'i ma tshod kyi gang bla gsar du kha phye ba dag gis rang rang si rig pa'i rtsal yod dgu sprugs te/ gangs can rig gzhung spyi dang khyad par du mi rigs la byas rjes bla lhag tu 'jog bzhin pa ni smros ci dgos/'on kyang / bod rigs slob grwa ba 'ga' res dngos po'i 'dzin tshad dang bsaca/ pa'i 'khyer so la lta tshul 'di ltar mchis te/ gna' nas da bar du bod spyi tshogs kyi dpal

nga ngarji26 —— dpyangartsomari pa'irtseng4———— 'byor dang tshan rig sogs gong 'phel dar rgyas su 'gro ma thub par ma zad/ deng sang nged cag slob mthar phyin rjes spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba mngar skyur la gsum gyi bya ba dngos la zhugs tshe bod yig 'di bkol sa chung zhing bed spyod dka' bas sbyangs pa byas na mkho mi che snyam pa'i lta tshul 'dra min sna tshogs 'char ba la bdag gis cung zad dpyad na 'di ltar/dang po/ mi rigs rang gi skad yig dang rig gnas kyi dgos mkho bstan pa/a lags dor zhi gdong drug snyems blos/ mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'i gnas stangs dang re 'dun mtshon pa'i sgyu rtsal rtsom rigs ni mi la la'i lta tshul ltar yod kyang rung med kyang rung ba'i bya ba gal chung zhig min la/ spyi tshogs gong 'phel du 'gro ba dang mi mang gi blo rig dang bsam pa'i dpal yon yar rgyasasu 'gro ba'i thabs gal chen zhig dang / mi rigs kyi blo rigs sgyu rtsal gyi chu tshad mtshon pa'i rtags mtshan mngon gsal zhig kyang yin pas mig rgyang yod pa'i mi sna dang spyi tshogs yongs rdzogs kyis mthong chen bya bar 'os so zhes gsungs pa'i mtshon la/

—— 4 ——༅44 5r+yā༅1phyozhi—da4ju༅shā34 2 di|— ༷——ngaspyir mi gang dang gang yin pa dang mi su dang su yin rung rang rang gi skad yig dang lo rgyus/ rig gnas sogs rmang gzhi med tshe rang nyid kyang ngo gnong dgos par ma zad gzhan gyis kyang bzhad gad kyi gnas su 'dzin la/ des ga'an gyi yig rigs sogs mkhas pa la ltos pa med de/ji skad du/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal snga nas/ mi rigs rang gi rig gnas ma shes na/ mi rigs gzhan gyi rig gnas mkhas kyang de la bdag gis shes yon can zhes mi zer gsungs pa ltar gtso bo rang gis sbyangs pa ma song ba'i skyon kho nar zad de/dper na/ nyi ma'i 'od ci ltar bzang zhing snang na yang nyin mo long ba ste 'ug pa'i ni mi mthong pa'i dpe ltar/ gtso bo rang nyid kyi sbyangs pa cher bskyed skyus rig gnas kyi byings spyi dang khyad pa ra du rtsom rig gi phyogs la bdar sha chod pa zhig byas yod tshe ngo ma mi 'dra 'dra'i nang nas mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos mngon du yod la/ de min bod gangs can gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas gangs seng dkar mo'i 'o ma lta bu'i mngar khyad la ma myangs par 'ol tshod kyis gtam sna tshogs smra ba ni snying bo ci yang ma mchis te/ rje thams cad mkhyen pas/ gzhung

——༷——328 — byangartsomari lortsenga'ajo — —'u gas che la lo mang sbyangs pa yi/ /grogs dag rang gi nor bu rim po che//dor nas gzhan gyi 'ching bu ma len par/ /rang la rin chen yod par mkhyen paramadzod/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/rang re'i bod kyi rig gnas bang mdzod 'di ni gna' nas da bar du phyi nang rgyal khab kun gyis rin chen nor bu ltar shin tu gtsigs chen por 'dzin par ma zad phyi nang gi shes yon mi sna mang bos dka' ba khyad du bsad/ ngal ba gdong gis bsus te dus tshod skar cha gang yang chud zos su mi gtong bar rang re'i rig gzhung nor bu len par brtson pa shugs chen byed par nyin re las nyin re je mang yin pa 'dis kyang rtogs sla'o/ nga tsho'i da rung rang gi rin chen lta bu'i shes bya'i nor te yal bar dor nas gzhan gyi 'ching bu'i kha dog la chags nas 'gram chu ldang bar dgos pa ci zhig mchis zhes blo kha nang du phyogs na shes so/ des rgyu mtshan gyis bod kyi rig gzhung 'di yang rje thams cad mkhyen pas sa steng gi rin chen gsum gyi grangs su 'dzin zhing ming gis bsngags pa 'di ltar/rig lam rnam par phyed pa'i rnam dpyod dang / /gzhung lugs gdams par shar pa'i nyams len dang / /tshig sbyor tshul la

/ rtsom bsamang rapo'irangamangangs phrigi /demakhas pa'i ngag gi dpal/ /sa steng 'di na rin chen rnam gsum snang //zhes gsungs pa ltar lags so/gnyis pa/rig gnas gang la sbyangs dgos par bstan pa/gtso bo bod kyi rig gnas gang la sbyangs par bya snyam na/ de yang / ji skad du/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la brtson par ma byas na/ 'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid mi 'gyur te/ de lta bas na gzhan dag tshar bcad rjes bzung dang / bdag nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson byed/ zhes gsungs pa ltar rig pa'i gnas chen lnga dang des yan lag gi tshul du spros pa rig pa'i gnas chung lnga ste bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas 'di rnams ni sbyang bya gtso bo yin la/mkhas dang rmongs pa'i khyad par yang rig gnas de dag shes mi shes kyis 'byed de/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas/mkhas dang rmongs pa'i khyad 'byed gtan tshigs dang / /sgra rig 'khor bcas yin no khyad par du/ /mkhas pa'i zhal mdzes snyan ngag kho na yin//zhes gsungs pa ltar lags so nga tsho gangs can bod kyi rig gzhung 'di ni legs par rtogs na

— 230 de pya rtsom ri pa'i rtse 'jogacig shes kunagrolagyigadamasapa'angadapagasate slob dporno a nus/ bslab pa'i rim pa 'di yis ni/ /gang zhig 'bad pa chung ngus kyang / /shes rab myur du grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gtso bo rang nyid sa phyogs gang du song ba'am bya ba sogs ci ltar byas kyang rung rin po che lta bu'i yon tan gyi gan mdzod 'di dang kha ma bral zhing rgyun tu sems dbus su 'chang na gser sa 'og tu bcug pa na 'od nam mkha' la 'phro zhes pa'i dpe ltar nges par du gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos 'bur tu thon pa mngon du yod la gtso bo rang gis sbyangs pa legs po byed mi byed la rag las so/bod kyi rig gzhung gi rin thang ni ngo ma med pa la yod pa dang yod pa la med pa lta bu'i sgro btags pa ga la yin te/rje thams cad mkhyen pas/ 'di ni shin tu dkon zhing 'dod pa 'jo//rmad du byuje ba'i dga' ba rgyas byed pas//rin po che zhes mkhas pa rnams la grags/ /mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog rin chen gzhan yod min/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nga tsho'i dang bor bod kyi brda sprod rig pa sogs la sha phigs rus zin gyi tshul du sbyangs pa legs par byed dgos te/ slob dpon tsan dra go

rtsom bsam ra po'irangamadangs/de 23 1 ——— mis/ dang po sgralamakhasapa yis tshigadonarnermes pazadargyadz+nyā bstan/ /de nas don la mkhas pa yis/ /lhag chad 'khrul ba med par bshad/ /zhes dang / mgon po klu sgrub zhabs kyis/ tha snyad la ni ma brten par/ /dam pa'i don ni rtogs mi 'gyur/ /dam pa'i don ni ma rtogs par/ /mya ngan 'das pa thob mi 'gyur//zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs don ltar rig gnas spyi bye brag la sbyangs pa zhun thar gcod pa lta bu byas mthar rmang gzhi brtan por tshugs dgos/de nas gal bo che la nan tan dang dam pa'i chos la brgya char gyi dpe ltar deng sang 'dzam gling yangs pa'i tha gru 'dir g.yu 'brug stong gi ngar skad ldir ba bzhin snyan grags kyi rdza rnga ring du 'bar pa'i bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i nang rig pa la sbyangs pa rab na dpyis phyin pa dang ma mtha' yang sgra spyi tsam gyi go ba gsha' ma zhig byed dgos te/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas/ bod rig pa zhib 'jug byed skabs sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi zhib 'jug gzhi rtsar ma bzung na/ bod rig gnas kyi gzhi rtsa dor ba yin pas bod kyi rig pa zer ba yang ming stong ba zhig tu 'gyur ba las 'os med ces gsungs

— 232 — pya rtsom ri pa'i rtseng 'jongayod pas tshan drag dang rig garnyosgyu co' la sogs—skye snye rngo po'am rtsa ba lta bu ni bod kyi rig gzhung 'di nyid yin pas deng sang rgyal khab phyi nang gi shes yon can dang tshan rig smra ba/ lo rgyus smra ba kun gyis ma bskul dang blangs kyis bod kyi rig gzhung la zhib 'jug dang sbyangs pa byed par ma zad shin tu ngo mtshar zhing zab cing brling ba'i 'dzam gling yongs kyi rig gnas kyi snying nor ram bang mdzod lta bur ngos bzung bzhin yod do/ /rang gi mi rigs dang rig gnas la snying thag pa nas sha tsha na thog mar shes bya rig pa'i gnas kyi sgo nas mi rigs dang rig gnas la zhabs 'dregs zhu dgos/des na dang bo rang nyid shes yon can du 'gyur bar brtson dgos par gor ma chag go /de la paṇa chen rin po ches/ bod bsam na bod kyi skad dang yi ge sogs sbyong dgos/ de'i phyogs la the tshom spu tsam yang byed mi rung gsungs pa nang bzhin lags pa'i phran gyis deng rabs blo gsal gzhon nu rnams kyis brtson 'grus kyi dar gshog dkar po legs par brkyangs te lnga rig shes bya'i lha lam yangs po'i 'jug ngogs su rnam dpyod kyi gshog 'gyur sna tshogs bsgyur te mkhas dbang sum

rtsom bsamang rapo'irangamangang5— 233 ——d+ngha d+me nā 1yikho rab dbang man da 'arkyegs parā — bsngags brjod byed par 'jug par rigs so/ /zhes smras pa lags so//de lta bu'i bya ba la gcig tu 'bad par 'tshal//bod gangs can gyi lha ris sgyu rtsal skor cung zad brjod pa skal bzang gzhon nu dgyes pa'i 'jug ngogs ces bya ba/de yang 'dzam gling go la yangs bo'i khyon 'dir rigs dang shes rig gis gzengs su mtho ba kha ba ri ba'i ljongs zhes grags pa'i yul 'dir thun mong ma yin pa'i rin thang gzhal du med pa bcu phrag rig pa'i gzhung bzang skal ldan shing rta'i nyal 'gro'i rgyun 'di nyid sngon nas da bar du rgyal khab phyi nang kun gyi mkhas pa'i dbang po dang tshan rig smra ba/zhib dpyod pa sogs kyis kyang gcigs che bar 'dzin par ma zad kyi sbyang brtson byed pa'ang nyin re las nyin rer je mang du 'gro bzhin pa ni smras ma dgos par kun gyis mig mthong lag zin tu mchis/ gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir yongs su grags

———3/1༷ —4———༅5zon+d+ra31྾r+yā— ————ོ— —ོ pa bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas 'di dag las/ rig gnas chung ba lnga ni sgra rig pa'i khongs su gtogs par bshad pa ltar na rig gnas che ba lnga la ma 'dus pa'i rig gnas ni med par bsta na to/ /de yang tshul bsdus na gsum la 'dus ste/ rgyal tshab ma pham pas/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la brtson par ma byas na/ 'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid 'thob mi 'gyur/ de bas gzhan dag tshar bcad rjes su bzung phyir dang / bdag nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson bya zhes gsungs pa ltar rig gnas che ba lnga yang tshar bcad/rjes 'dzin/ kun mkhyen gyi rig gnas te gsum du 'du/ de yang sgra dang tshad mas tshig don gnyis char gyi 'khrul ba tshar gcod nus/ bzo dang gso bas gdul bya spyi dang bye brag rjes su/ 'dzin nus/ nang don rig pas rang nyid kun mkhyen gyi lam 'thob par nus so//rig gnas che ba lnga yi ya gyal du grags pa bzo yi rig pa ni/ rig nas kun gyi rkang dang gzhi lta bu'o/ de la ma 'dus pa'i shes bya med par bstan te/kong sprul yon tan rgya mtshos/don gnyer rjes 'dzin bzo rig mtha' yas kyang / /sgo gsum

rtsom4bsamang/0'arang ma ngangasang — 23dwa r+shangar+ṣabyer+sha rkyocor+shaser+ṣa— ṅger+ṣazlo tho lter rlo r+shar+sha zlo/—/—'dir yongs su grags pa'i bzo rig ni sgo gsu/ma bzo yi nang gses kyi lus bzo yin te/ de la'ang gtso phal gnyis su 'byed pa'i gtso bo lus bzo mchog ni rgyal ba byang sems kyi sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa'i rig pa de la 'o/ /sku rten rgyal ba byang sems kyi sku brnyan bris 'bur ci rigs sogs dang gsung rten 'phags bod kyi yig rigs sna tshogs 'bri ba la byang cha che ba dang / thugs rten mchod rten dang phyag mtshan sogs bzhengs pa la mkhas pa de la'o/ /de lta bu'i bla na med pa bzo yi rig pa'i gnas la ni so so skye bo ma zad kyi rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang bslab par bya ste/mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel bshad las/ bzo'i gnas kyi rig pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis 'tshol bar byed do/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshegs chung ngus sha thang ba med par longs spyod bsgrub par bya ba dang / longs spyod dang ldan zhing bzo'i gnas la mkhas pas 'jig rten pa rnams kyis bkur bar bya ba dang / longs spyod kyi sgo nas 'jig rten pa rnams la phan par bya ba'i phyir tshol bar byed do/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / lha

——— 236 — dpyadartsomari pa'irtsenga'ajong za—skyodhertsalalashinatumakhasapazhigayinatshestobarmedangྈ ྈ mnga' thang dang rigs kyi mtho dman la ltos pa med par lha dang bcas pas bsngags shing bkur bar sam bu ṭi sogs rgyud gzhung mang bo las gsungs te/bsod nams kyi stobs kyi rtogs pa brjod pa las/ de bas na bzo 'ba' zhig mi rnams kyis nyams su sman pa yin te/ bzo bo ni rigs dman par skyes su zin yang / rgyal bo rnams dang / blon po rnams dang /bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams kyis gdon mi za bar bkur to zhes dang / gzhan yang de las sna tshogs las can lha rnams dang / mi rnams kyis kyang legs par bkur/ de bzhin ma rabs bzo yi phyir/ /mi dang lha rnams kyis kyang bkur zhes sogs gsungs so/ /spyir bod 'dir lha ris kyi sgyu rtsal la'ang du ma zhig mchis te/ ldebs ris kyi sgyu rtsal dang thang ga sna tshogs/ thags drub dang gtsags drub 'jim bzo'i sku brnyan dang gser zangs las grub pa'i sku brnyan/ brkos 'bur gyi sgyu rtsal dang shing brkos ri mo sogs sna tshogs dang thang ga gcig pu'i cha nas bshad na'ang shin tu mang ste/ tshon thang dang skya thang /gser thang dang mtshal thang /gos thang dang nag

//lha rtsom bsamad ra po'i rang mngangs— 237 ——yodaṅkasamatha'ayasaso gorngodudror+shapa ltaralta bsgro— mtshan nyid dang ldan pas tshul bzhin bzhengs pa'i bris sla sogs kyi phan yon ni/ ༄dgyes rdor rgyud kyi brtag pa phyi ma le'u drug pa las/'dir ni bri mkhan dam tshig can/ /sgrub po'ang dam tshig can gyis ni/ /bris sku 'jigs pa bri ba nyid/ /skyes pa'i thod gnas kha dog lnga//ro yi skra yi pir nyid kyis//bris sku bla ma bri ba nyid//gang gang skud pa 'khal ba dang //gang gang ras yug 'thag pa dang / /de yang dam tshig can nges pas/ /dam tshig byin rlabs rnal 'byor pas zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskur dngos su 'thob pa dang dge tshul slong gi dam tshig dang ldan pa'am ma mtha' yang bsnyen gnas sdom ldan gyi lha bzos bzhengs pas ras bris sogs kyi phan yon nam byin rlabs kyi tshan kha ni shin tu che bas lha bsgrubs mkhan kyis kyang ras bris kyi thang ga thugs dam gyi brtenadu 'chang na 'grub sla bar rgyud gzhung mang bo las gsungs so/ /'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ ras bris che chung gi cho ga shin tu rgyas pa phan yon tshad med pa dang bcas legs par bshad pa

—d+ngha3༅ de—— dpyangartsom—ni༅r+sārje 3ngh+ru —4———4lta ra bsgrub par bya ste zhes dang / sdom 'byung las/ sngags pa/ las ni dang ngo las/ /gzugs brnyan la sogs bya ba ste/ /bris sku bsgrub na myur bar ni//dngos grub rgya chen thob par 'gyur//zhes sogs/ gsungs pa ltar la gas so/ /de lta bu'i ras bris kyi zhal thang 'bri skabs nges par du lo dang zla ba/ tshes grangs sogs dus chen dang 'phrod sbyor legs par lha re re bzhengs tshul mi 'dra ba'i brtsi tshul la bshad tshul sna tshogs/ kyi rten 'brel mchis pa rnams ma nor par byas nas/ thog mar lha ba'engs byed kyi thig skud sogs kyang gsang sngags kyi rgyud nas gsung ba gnang bzhin skud pa 'khel mkhan dang thig 'debs grogs la skyes pa pho mo lo tshod sogs dang / lag tu blangs ba'i rim pa dang tshon sogs byin gyis rlabs pa'i skor dang / sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi rjes kyi chos phyogs rnams kyi bya ba la'ang sla chos khral chos su ma song ba shin tu gal che'o/ /de nas tshangs thig sogs thig dang sa bcad blangs par bya la sa bcad blangs pa ltar 'bri bya'i lha rang rang gi zhal tshad dang sor tshad rkang ba nas sogs gzhal byed kyi tshad rtags rnams kyis gzhal bya lha zhi khro la thal mo bcu ba dang dgu ba

— nga—— ༅— — 5sproḥ 4༅ 4rwan+d+rardzurwa1 sngagro dusu/rngo1—rjishaṃlta—— — so gas sna tshogs su ma/chis pa rnams kyi rus gzugs kyi nyams dag dang sha gzugs kyi nyams phun su ma/ tshogs nga/'i gzhir gos 'khyud dar dpyang sogs dang snyan rgyan 'gu'/ rgyan dpung rgyan sogs rgyan gtso bo'i rigs dang zhabs gdub sor gdub se mo do sogs rgyan bye brag gi rigs sogs kyi skya thigs legs par 'debs dgos/de nas tshon mdangs rnam par bkra ba'i legs par brgyan pa dang 'jam bcad dang rtsub bcad sogs bcad kyis je gsal dang je zhib su btang ba/ de nas nyin byed 'od kyi mdangs 'dzin gser ris kyi re khā'i mdzes pa/ra byas pa/ dang sku yi spyan 'byed pa dang mtha' thig gis kun nas mdzes par byas pa yin no/ /rjes sor rab gnas dang shis brjod/'grub ston sogs gya nom pa zhig byas pas phan yon ni/dpal sdom pa 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ mtshan nyid thar/sa cang yongs rdzogs shing / /gzugs mdzes pa ni bzhengs pa ra bya//zhi la zhi ba'i tshul gyi sku /khro la drag cing 'jigs pa'i zha' / /dpa' la dpa' zhing nga rgyal sku//sgeg pa la ni bzhad pa'i zhal//mtshan nyid 'di lta mtshon nas ni/ /sngags pa rnams kyis/ bris

— 240 — dpyadartsomari pa'irtsenga'ajo /desku :nye/ /sngags pa las ni dang bo bas/ /gzugasabarnyan la — sogs byas pa de/ /bris sku bsgrubs na myur du ni/ /dngos grub rgya chen thob par 'gyur//zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar lags so/rgyas par spro na khams kyi mkhas pa 'ju mi pham rnam rgyal rgya mtsho dang sman thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ klong rdol bla ma rin po che/ kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho sogs kyis gsungs pa'i lha ris thig rtsa rnams las legs par shes par bya'o//deng sang bod 'dir 'u cag yab mes nas brgyud pa'i lnga rig shes bya'i gter mdzod 'di srol rgyun rig gnas zhes don du gnyer mkhan nyin re bzhin je nyung du 'gro bzhin pa dang khyad par du bzo yi rig pa nyams dma' zhing nyag phra ba'i skabs 'dir dka' ba khyad du bsad/ ngal ba gdong gis bsus te bzo rig rgya mtsho 'phel rgyas kyi slad du brtse gzigs zol med/ brtson pa lhod med kyis nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel gyi tshul du spel ba la thugs stobs mi dman pa rnam dpyod mchog tu yangs pa lha ris pa mgo log shes rab rgya mtsho ni rab byung bcu drug pa dge byed zhes pa chu pho stag gi lor shar stod gnyan po g.yu rtse'i nye

—— nan+t+ra—sgru bsamang ra྾4 4 sa —— 'dabs su gcig sgril rdzong gi longs btogs lang rgan sde bar 'khrungs/ byis pa gzhan dang ཿ kha dra bar chung dus nas ri mo sna tshosas dang yig gzugs 'bri ba la shin tu dga'/ 'o na chung ngu'i dus nas rnga yul pa tra rgyud kyi lha ris pa ming grags can dhi phu dgon gyi dge slong dbyig gnyen gyi drung du bzo yi rig pa ma lus pa bum pa gang 'phyos kyi tshu' du bslab/de nas nges don bzo yi slob dpon a mdo byams pa so/gas bzo rig gi seng chen bcu phrag kha shas bshes gnyen du brten te sbyang brtson rdo rus thug par mdzad/ de nas mdo smad bla brang bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i gling du 'ong nas dase ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rje 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho mchog dang rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ rje blo bzang rgya mtsho sogs kyi zhal snga nas bsdus gzhung dang rnam 'grel/ phar phyin dbu ma/ mngon pa mdzod sogs bka' pod kyi gzhung rnams dang / mdo smad kyi ma hā paṇa ṭi ta rje dmu dge bsam gtan rgya mtsho dang rje 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho/ a khu dkon mchog sogs kyi mdun nas yig dkar nag dang lañtsha dang wa rtu sogs kyi yig gzugs kyi skor dang sum rtags dag gsum dang snyan ngag

— — ram̐ /2—— ༷ —༷ ——ོ — —du sgra ༅rwasduḥsgruza44/———— — nga4 — —ཿ rtsis sogs mkhas par bslab/ gzhan yang rgya'i grong khyer chen mo/ pe cin dang hrang he nan cin/ sus gros/ dpang kros dang g.yang kros sogs nas rgyal lab phyi nang si bzo rig sgyu rtsal gyi nyams myong mang bo bslab brtson byas/ gna' bo'i gangs ljongs kyi lha ris sgyu rtsal dang deng rabs nub lusas kyi sgyu rtsal zung 'brel gyis sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma gson nyams ldan pa zhig bzhengs pas yul khams mang bor snyan pa'i grags pa khyab/ de rjes gung thang sprul ba'i sku rin po ches zhal gsung ltar rje khong nyid kyi yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes gnyen dmu dge thub bstan rin po che dang rigs kun khyab bdag bla kho rdo rje 'chang 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho sogs kyi sku gzugs gson nyams ldan pa 'dra dpar dang khyad 'byed dka' ba de sogs legs par bzhengs/ de nas mkhas pa'i dbang bo dmu dge bsam gtan rgya mtsho mchog bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs nas dpe khrid sogs gnang skabs khong gi sku gzugs yid du 'ong ba zhig bzhengs par khong rang gis kyang bdag dang khyad par med zhes bsngags brjod dang bcas rab gnas kyi me tog 'thor/ rjes sor rnga

snyang rtsom lhag bsam ngakar po'i rang mngangs — 2 13 4 ཿ mi— — —— 4 — —4 — ——— ———— nga— nga /de——— ——— —— — —— —— — ru la sgo ma/nga dbon gyi spru la ba'i sku rin po che har ba 'jam dbyangs blo gros mchog sis/ legs par bzhings pa 'i byang chub mchod rten chen mo mthong ba don ldan gyi brten du dmigs te sa der gdan zhus skabs gnam sngon baiḍūr zhun ma/'i dbyings nas dbang bo'i gzhu ris rnam/ par bkra ba'i gur khyim phubs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang ldan pa'o/ /gzhan yang reb rkang gnyan thog dgon par bzhugs pa'i skabs su sa der zla ba gcig tsam gyi yun la than pa chen ngo byas par lha ris pa khong gis sgron dkar yid bzhin 'alor lo'i rnam sprul nan he po ta la yi sgrol ra/ dar thod 'jin pa(shā1/cor+sā༅)bzhengs nas bum pa las bdud rtsi 'bebs pa'i mtshams la slebs skabs nyin zhag gnyis kyi yun thad la dh+ri der char chen po 'bab pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang khyad par du bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir mdzad rjes mi dman pa brtson 'grus rab rgyas kyis ched du gtso 'gan bzhes nas bzhengs pa bod du ches ring ba'i thang ga ste〈 krung go bod kyi rig gnas sgyu rtsal kun 'dus zhal thang chen mo〉

—133/34—dwa4snga34ngatsho—————— ———'es pa'i gtso sku kun gzisas paca chen mchog gi 'dra sku sama' rabs kyi sgyu rtsal dang deng rabs kyi sgyu rtsa' zung 'brel gyi slo mas legs par bzhingaca5 pa la rgyal khab phyi nang kun tu snyan pa'i grabs pa 'bar/ bzhan yang bod sangs can gyi sku rje 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal bo'i sku gzugs yid du 'ong ba 'ig bzhengs te dpar du 'alod bzhin mchis so /deng sang khong gis bod kyi bzo rig sgo kun nas phyogs kun tu spel bzhin bde bar bzhugs yod do/7'dir smras pa/gangs can lnga ris chu 'dzin gla' ba'i sgras//gling bzhi'i mgrin sngon yid kyi thig le 'jo// de la 'jug 'dod skal bzang gzhon nu rnams //e ma nyin byed kyis 'khyud pad dkar bzhin//skye sngo na bzo rig rgya mtsho goms pa'i 'bras//tshe 'dir dbang phyug brgyad kyi dpa la dang ldan//rgyal kun sku gzugs bzhengs pa'i phan yon ni/ /tshangs chen gdong bzhi sprul kyang brjod nus min//rnam dpyod sked phra'i chang gis rab myos pa'i//

rtsom bsam da ra po'i rang mngangs/de 245 ——— gangs can lha rjes sgyu rtsal ba kul —————'di las lhag pa'i zong mchog med do zhes//'chi med mi na kā dag brjod pas brel//7zhes bod gangs can kyi lha ris kyi sgyu rtsal skor cung zad brjod pa ska 'a bzang gzhon nu dgyes pa'i 'jug ngogs ces bya ba 'di ni tha snyad smra ba mgo log dkon mchog bsam gtan gyis ston pa sangs rgyas kyi 'das lo25'ji3spyi lo 2000lo'i bod rab byung bcu bdun pa rnam gnon zhes pa lcags pho 'brug gi lo smin drug zla ba'i dmar phyogs rdzogs pa gsum pa'i nyin sbyar ba'o//

———nga3༅5rje — —dpyangartso rig cirwa—zhardo— ———— ——— —— dus rabs nyi shu'i lam la brtson par bskul ba rkang ba drug pa'i glu dbyangs/dus kyi 'gyur ldog gnam sa 'khor lo ste//tshan rig lag rtsal rta pho'i bang bzhin skyen//gcig las gcig mgyogs brtson pa'i dus skabs 'dir//snyoms las ngang du bsdad pa'i gnas ma yin//gangs can ljongs 'dir bcu phrag rig gzhung sogs//ma lus tshang zhes chog shes mi rigs te//dus rabs nyi shu'i tshan rig lam chen du//gom pas 'degs 'jog cung zad bsgyur na legs//nang gi shes rig nang gi sgron me ste//phyi yi dpal 'byor tshan rig rag las so//tshan rig med pa'i mi rigs gang yin yang //kye ma rjes su/ lus par gor ma chas /'dzam gling phal cher tshan rig can du 'gyur//phyi nang 'tsho ba mthun rkyen zad du med//

༅nartsomalhagabasamangal ra po'i rangam rangs — 2/7 — bhedochothodza 'a(rme la zlo rārngor+shaje rmong dror+sharne —rje —— — mi—da rdong rjes su r+shas 'di dgod re spro// ༄nang na spang rtogs rnam gnyis klong rdol ba'i//de la phyi yi 'byor rgud ltos pa med//'on kyang deng rabs gsar ba'i lam chen du//'jug pa'i mi la tshan rig shin tu gal//lnga rig shes bya'i mig gcig gsal na yang //deng rabs shes bya'i mig zung mi ldan na//'dzam gling hril bo mthong ba'i thabs med pas///deng nas tshan rig phyogs la 'bad par 'tshal //rig lam mche sder rno ba'i gangs seng la//lung rtog g.yu yi ral bas gnya' lebs shing //deng rabs shes bya'i lus zung brtas pa can//de ni gangs ri'i 'phrog byed cis ma yin//rang gzhan shes bya'i gshog zung rab brkyangs pa'i//tshan rig shes bya rno ba'i mchu sder 'bar//rmad byung brtson 'grus 'dab gshog lhod pa med//de ni gangs ri'i khyung chen cis ma yin//
