—ngh+ru shisngar+shangasgra ngang༅44ngh+ru———— nga —༅ ——— ——dam/ pa'i tshogs la gdod nas yod min pas//des phyir dri ma med pa'i rnam thar ni//bskal ba'i mtha' yang nub pa med la ltos/ /(11)rgyu dngos med kyis 'bras bu dngos med skyed pa'i rgyu ri/lang tsho ldan dus mkhas mang 'dus pa'i gyur/ /lnga zung rig gnas ma sbyangs ba min na//deng nyid mkhas mang tshogs pa'i mdun sa ru//'chad rtsod rtsom la thogs pa yod re skan//(12)ring 'bras kyi rgyu ni/'phrog byed ral pas btegs pa'i gser gyi khrir//legs 'gying srong btsan chos kyi sgam po yis /chab 'bangs chos khrims dkar bos legs bskyangs tshe//dregs ldan phyogs gzhan rgyal khab dbang med btul//(1 /)rgyu 'bras lhan gcig pa ni/mthon mthing mdangs 'dzin 'chi med stong ba'i dbyings//nyi gzhon 'dzum phreng 'od snang spros dang lhan//mdzes ldan yid 'ong pad ma gzhon nu yis//

—nga————྾ ga —zi sngarta r+yā྾ posu jo — —nga gi di/ —rwa rab dkar 'dab ma'i tshogs rnams cig car grol/ /(14)'bras bu snga ba'i rgyu ni/snyim pa'i pad mo snying khar zum pa dang / /bcos min dad pa'i chu gter 'phel ba na/ /yid 'ong mdzes sdug tshangs sras khyod zhal zla//'od gsal dbyings nas 'dzum 'di mthong bas spro/ /(15)'os min nam rigs min gyi rgyu ni/dor zhi gdong drug snyems pa'i blo gros las/ /legs 'ong shes rig nyin byed 'bar ba na/ /thos bral blo chung yid kyi pad mo'i kha/ /dbang med zum 'di kye ma 'os sam ci/ /(16)rigs pa'i rgyu/dbyangs can khyod thugs zla shel 'dzum pa las//'jo ba'i shes bya ga bur 'bum phrag rgyun//bdag yid kun ta'i tshal du 'thims pa'i mod// blo gros gsar ba'i 'dzum phreng dgod par gyur//

——— 322 — ngabangangartsi'izi gsapakhu ———dror+ṣasne—je—thre rmod+kurnorgordo—the+orme — —4— —4 (1)zur gyi phra mo ni/lang tsho'i me tog 'dzum bzhad gzhon nu la//rjes chags mdzes mas rnam bkra'i mig zur dang //lhan cig dmar pa'i mchu sgros rnam 'gyur sogs//sgeg pa'i 'dzum phreng yang yang ngom par byed//(2)rnam pa'i phra mo ni/blo gsal mkhas mang 'dus pa'i drung na mor//blo gros rtsal gyi lung rig 'gran pa'i tshe//gzu bor mi gnas blo mig ldongs pa 'asa'//zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dmar ba'i mdangs shig 'char//bco lnga ba/cha'i rgyan bshad pa la/(1)'os pa'i cha'i rgyan babad pa la/zhi dul spyod pa'i rab mdzes gung thang tshang //mdzes pa'i 'dzum zhal mthong ba tsam nyid las//dad pas mchi ma 'khrigs 'di sa rdul tshogs//

skya1rtsomasgragabasamad rapo 'irangam ngangatsho— 323 — ༄—zlod nga nezlornortsorlojir+sharjezengarnyerno— ༅——༅ — —mi 'os pa'i cha'i rgyan ni/snying gi mdza' ba rab btang smin 'khyog ma//'phrad tshe yid la bsil bas rab gdung ba//grang rlung lhags pas lus sems btab pa'i mod//'dar ba'i tshor snang skye zhes rdzu la brten// ( ༈)zal gyi smad pa'i cha'i rgyan ni/sbyangs tsam nyid nas shes bya thams cad mkhyen//mkho dga'i 'byor ba 'phel ba'i thabs la sgrims//snyan grags gtam gyi rjes 'gro blo gsal khyod //thar 'dod dag gis grogs su cis mi bsten//༵༵ kā/ ni glog gi gar bzhin kun la 'khyugs//phyi nang med par snying gtam lhug par 'byin//kun gyi sems mthun mdza' ba'i sked med ma//gtan gyi grogs su kho bos cis mi 'dod//(4)zol gyis bstod pa'i cha ni/

—— 324 —— ngabardungartsi'ithigasapabarār+shar+sha rle rngormo —r+shaca— r+shah+phor+ṣarmortsom — ——zang zing nor gyi phun tshogs yal bar dor//'jig rten 'dod pa'i bde ba ris su bor//bshes gnyen khyod drung bsdad la dgos pa ci//bcu drug pa/ rim pa can gyi rgyan bshad pa la/bslab brtson bdag gi 'dren par dge ba'i bshes//sku yi gzi byin gsungs dbyangs thugs rje'i mtha'//sa 'dzin dkar po rab snyan ko ki'i dbyangs//chu mthongs yangs pa'i mtha' sogs brkus par snyam//bcu bdun pa/ dga' pa'i rgyan bshad pa la/(1)dngos thob kyi dga' ba ni/mtshan tsam thos pas dpag med dga' bskyed cing //yid la dran pas srid zhi'i gdung ba gzhil//bla ma gung thang yid bzhin nor bu'i sku//mngon sum mjal bas dga' ba sus kyang min//

bya'irwa rtsom 1ba sam da gar po'i rang marangs/— 325 —dor+sha/rnozlor+shas ngarnyarārū—rjergezlotsāzengarnodzadza—44————————— —— — 4 —ngazhi dul spyod lam mdzes pas yid 'phrog cing //mkhas btsun bzang gsum rgyan gyis dga' bskyed pa //bstan pa'i dbang phyug sku brnyan mjal ba'i mod//dga' ba gzugs can bzhin du 'phel bar 'gyur//bco brgyad pa/ nyams ldan gyi rgyan bshad pa la/(1)dga' ba'i 'gyur ba 'phel ba'i sgeg pa'i nyams ni/mi sdug kha bas rab g.yogs dgun gyi dus//mthar byed dpyid kyi dpal yon 'dzum bzhad pa/'i//rkang 'thung sayu lo'i mgo lcog ldem pa'i khrod//khu byug sngon mos rab dgas mgrin rnga 'khrol//(2)khro ba 'phel ba drag shulu gyi nyams ni/stobs rtsal sna dgu'i dpal ldan rā ma ṇa//shin tu khros pas spyan rtsa glog ltar 'khyug /dam bca' gsum ldan nyag phran 'bar ba'i lces//lang ga'i rgyal bo'i mgo bo bcad kyis grags//

— — — 4 ༅/༷— r+sha — 4ཿ༅dud rjizho— briguspra zi/ — ———— — — nga ( /)spro ba 'phel ba dpa' ba'i nyams ni/(tshe tan 'bas drung)rab mang dbyig gis mchog sbyin ma bstabs shing / /btsan stobs dpung gis pha rol 'gugs min par/ /mkhas dbang 'bum sde'i dbus su khyod kyis ni/ /snyan pa'i grags pa ci yang 'thob par gyur/ /(4)mya ngan 'phel ba snying rje'i nyams ni/rab mdzes yid 'phrog 'od 'bar gzhal yas khang / /snyan 'jebs rol mo gling bu'i sgra dang bcas/ /ci dgar rnam g.yeng rtsed 'jo'i gar mkhan ma/ /glo bur 'chi zhags gyis zin snying re rje/ /(5)skyubs bro ba 'phel ba'i mi sdug gi nyams ni/bshang gci'i dri ma'i yongs gang mi gtsang khrod/ /chu 'dam gcig tu khol ba'i mal nang du/ /rul sungs mi tsi nya so gas ldan ljin zas/ /chem chem za bas khyi phag zhe re mel/ /(6)'gong bro ba 'phel byed kyi bzhad bad nyams ni/rnam mang skye bo tshogs pa'i gar stegs dbus/ /

rtsomalhag bsam bkarapo'irangamang ngas1— 327 ngarmozlorjerne lajer+yādz+nyāzlorāblet+narūzlo rmo—nga———— ——— nga ——rang nyid mdzes phyir rting mtho'i lham yu yis//ma tshugs sa la 'gyel 'di dgod re bro//(7)ngo mtshar 'phel ba rmad byung gi nyams ni/rgya nag gnas mchog glang chen 'gyings pa'i ri//tshang tshing g.yu lo rab ldem me tog 'dzum//gnyis skyes mgrin snyan rna ba'i bcud len zhing //rang byung rdza chu ting 'dzin phugs pa'i ma/dzes /(8)'jigs pa 'phel ba'i 'jigs rung bi nyams ni /'jigs rung dus mtha'i me klong 'bar ba'i sku//lho sprin phyug mo 'phyur 'dra'i ral klong dbus//rta mchog khros pa'i 'tsher skad sgra lhang lhang //mthong pa lta ci thos pas snying kha sdigs//bcu dgu ba/ gzi brjid kyi rgyan bshad pa/shing rta bcu pa'i sras mchog rā ma ṇas//'gran gyi zla bral srin gling brlags so zhes//

— 328 — ngabadrangartsi'izi sapa ———1ṅgezhepyorke'ertemasa'akhesosamin te—/ de ngartem chung skye bo gzhom bya ga la yin//7bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa ni/snyan ngag smra ba rnams kyi blo'i pad mor//nyin byed bye ba'i mdangs ltar nyams ldan dang //gzi brjid can gyi rgyan gnyis grags pas na//blo gsal don gnyer can tshos 'bad par rigs//rang gi rigs la srid zhu bsgrubs snyam pa'i//lhag bsam gshis su 'dzum pa'i mdangs lags kyi//g.yo skyu bcos ma'i ston gyi me tog gi//gzugs brnyan bri la ngal ba byed pa'i ci//dus rabs nyi shu'i zla gzhon 'di shar tshe//skyon yon sna tshogs ra ris gzugs kyis ni//gangs can rig gzhung sgrib la nye ba'i tshe//mkhas dbang ngal ba'i mnal thabs chags mi 'tshal /nyi shu ba/ rnam grangs brjod pa'i rgyan bshad pa/

rwartsom1 bsama'atshongapo'irangamangangag— 3 29 khyodaganyis cir+shadodagang dga'igasung ḍā—zlordo ————bag phebs ngang du cung zad bzhugs shig dang //bdag ni bya bas ched du gzhung las khang //'gro'o 'gyangs min ci 'tshal rtogs ma gyur//nyer gcig pa/kun phan gyi rgyan bshad pa la/blo gsal don gnyer chos la rab dga' des//bcu phrag shes bya'i gnas kun brtson pa'i tshe//rang dang rig mthun snying gi grogs po zhig /slebs nas gang gi dka' gnad sel bar byed//nyer gnyis pa/ rgya che ba'i rgyan bshad pa la/(1)bsam pa rgya che ba ni/stobs 'byor rdzu 'phrul la sogs blo las 'gongs//bod rgyal srong btsan chos kyi sgam po des//gya gyu'i sems ldan mi bsrun skye bo'i tshogs//gzhom par nus kyang thabs kyis chos bzhin bskyangs//(2)'byor ba rgya che ba ni/

— 330 — nga bgrongartsi'ithi gsapa ——h+pherje zergor+sār+sharwalorje—rler+sha—d+kungarboblo ————ོ—brjid chags rab ༵dzes pho brang po tal//rin chen du ma'i legs bskrun byin brten 'bum//e ma nyin byed bye ba'i 'od bzhin snang //nyer gsum pa/ bsnyon dor gyi rgyan bshad pa la/(1)chos la bsnyon dor ba ni/bshes gnyen khyod kyi mkhyen dpyod phul byung ba//gcig nyid yin na chos kun ji ltar gzhal//shes byar grangs mtha' med la gzigs pa'i blo//bye ba phrag brgya'i tshad la slebs par nges//(2)yul la bsnyon pa ni/chu 'thongs dbyings na 'dzum pa'i zla gzhon dang //chu gter klong du rtsen pa'i lus dkar ma//snying gi grogs dang bral ba'i snang ngo la//mdzes min bdag cag mig gi dpyid du 'jebs//(3)rang bzhin la bsnyon dor pa ni/

———— rtsom ྾ 40344 s+ho/ ——tram̐༅ ngo nam mkha'i nor bus drin gyis legs bskyangs pas//yid 'ong 'dab stong grol ba'i ka ma la//rang byung gshis kyis mdzes pa ma lags te//nyal 'gro'i bu mos yang yang bkrus pas so//nyer bzhi pa/sbyar ba'i rgyan bshad pa la/(1)tshig gi gcod mtshams tha dad min pa'i sbyar ba ni/mdzes sdug yid kun 'jo ba'i dkar mdangs can//mnyen lcug ldem pa'i 'khril bag dang ldan zhing //dri bsung 'thul bas mdongs ldan re ba skong //dpal 'di srid pa gsum na rgyan du che//(2)tha dad tshig 'dra'i sbyar ba ni/kun gyis thun mong spyad byar gyur ba'i yul//gya gyu'i 'khyog dang ldan zhing thur du 'gro//skye bo thams cad dga' ba'i 'jug ngogs 'di//blo ldan dam pa'i bsten bya ma yin no//(3)bya ba tha dad min pa'i sbyar ba ni/

— 332 ba ngab rtsi'ithi sapa——— ——— ———chags ldan mig sngar mdzes pa'i dpal ster zhing //ji ltar bltas kyang ngoms pa'i skabs dang bral//yid 'ong smin legs ma yi mchu sgros dang //dkar mdzes so yi phreng ba lta na sdug/(4)bya ba 'gal ba min pa'i sprur ba ni/phrag dog dug gis myos pa'i 'khyog 'gro dang //zhe sdang me yis 'tshig pa'i gdug sems can//brang 'gro nag po'i dug ni spangs bya ste//khro gtum dpa' bo'i dug ni zhi bya lags//(5)'gal ba'i las can gyi sbyar ba ni/yid 'phrog sngo bsangs bu mo'i gdong la rtsen//lus can kun dga' ster ba'i dpal yon can//chu shel dbang bo'i dkyil 'khor shar ba na//pad ma'i gnyen gyi mdzes pa zum par byed//(6)nges pa can gyi sbyar ba ni/mtshar sdug lang tsho yongs su rdzogs pa 'di//mdzes sdug bu mo nyid yin pad ma min//

— — 4——dka 4 /dejo ོ3 ༅ngang yid 'ong gnag snum g.yo ba'i rang bzhin can//dkyus ring 'dren byed nyid yin bung ba min//(7)nges pa 'gog pa'i sbyar ba ni/rab mdzes lang tsho'i dpal gyis sgeg pa mo//mthong bas 'dod ldan chags pas rab tu myos//'on kyang ma nges 'dzum ldan ba ku la//khyod kyi 'gram chang thob pa'i myos pa mthong / (8)'gal med kyi sbyar ba ni/ zla ba'i cod pan gtsug na mngon par mdzes//mdzes sdug zhal ras 'dzum pas gdung sel ba//dri za'i na chung snyan pa'i glu len ma//snyan ngag smra ba'i lha khyod snying nas dad//(9)'gal ba can gyi sbyar ba ni/mdzes pa'i ut+pal bsnams kyang gar mkhan min//'jo sgeg lang tsho ngom yang smad 'tshong min//dga' ba'i 'dzum dkar spro yang chags pa spangs//ngo mtshar mdzes sdug rdzogs kyang bem gzugs bral//

— 334 —— tsho mkhab grortsi'i4sangh+ru ——ོ—nga/de — ———————ོོ ————— —nganyer lnga ba/khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan bshad pa/(1)yon tan ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa ni/'chad rtsod rtsom la zla bral bu ston rje//'byor ldan ma lags mdzes sdug ldan pa'i bzhin//mnga' min srid pa gsum gyi lus can rnams//khyod zhal mthong bas yid ni drangs bar gyur//(2)rigs ma tshang ba'i khrad par brjod pa ni/(khro ru tshe rnam)yul dbus rgya gar yul du ma 'khrungs shing //'phrul mdzangs lo tsā'i rgyud du ma gyur zhing //rgya gar skad rigs smra la thogs med pas//khyod ni srid gsum 'gro ba'i sgron me lags//(3)bya ba ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa ni/mdzes pa'i zur mig rtse dgas ma 'khyud shing / /(bla brang a khu ṭ+wāṃ rdoza zloṭ+wāṃ sgeg pa 'i nu 'bur ngom min zhing //bslu brid so yi gos can 'dzum min par//

bhe————rjong5—2susda 5༅nga4zos da da su/ zo ni hūṃXng3 — bdag yid 'phrog mkhas blo bzang mtshan can rgyal/ /(4)rdzas ma tshang ba'i khyang par brjod pa ni/rab mang nor rdzas longs spyod mi ldan zhing //shugs dregs dpa' ba'i dpung ni cang med la/ /rno mtshon go cha'i rigs kyang mi ldan yang / /nag po'i rtsa lag gzhom mkhas zhabs dkar ba//(5)rgyu'i khyad par brjod pa ri/(zla ba)gzhan yid 'gugs pa'i zur mig mi ldan zhing / /mdza' zhing yid gcugs sems dang bral na yang / /'dod pa'i mig can ma dag khyod mthong bas/ /chags pas sems kyang kunā nas myos par gyur/ /nyer drug pa/ mtshungs sbyor gyi rgyan bshad pa/(1)bstod pa'i mtshungs sbyor ni/snyan ngag smra ba'i rgyal bo dge dbang dang //bsil ljongs rig smra tshe tan zhabs drung gnyis/ /sgra tshad bzo gso rig gnas mtha' dag dang / /

—— 336 — ༅nagazhungang dartsi'ithi sapa r+ṣar+sharngo ojergornyerārmer+sā lam gtsurko༅ca— —ོ—— (2)smad pa'i mtshungs smyor ni/la nga long mkha' la rgyu ba'i na bun dang //'khyugs 'khyugs mi brtan glog gi rtsed 'jo dang //lhung lhung thur du 'bab ldan nyal 'gro ma//mi rtag rang mtshang ston la brel ba bzhin//nyer bdun pa/ 'gal ba'i rgyan bshad pa/(1)khyad gzhi tha dad pa'i bya ba 'gal ba ni//sprin sngon lang long g.yo ba'i gdengs ka nas//dbyar skyes rnga gsang dal gyis brdung pa'i tshe//mdza' bo dang bral smin 'khyog chang mig ma//mi bzod chags pas gdung ba lhag par brtas//(2)gzhi gcig gi yon tan 'gal ba ni/stong chen kun gsal mdzes ma'i 'gram pa la//rgyu ba'i sprin sngon 'dzum pa'i rgya grol tshe//thig le'i sgro ldan rab dgas mig 'bur gtod//

rtsom bsam rwa4rwa ཿdudu suzo—ni ni7 0 chags ldan dga' ma'i yid ni gdung bar byed//(3)gzhi gcig gi rdzas 'gal ba ni/mgo skyes bung ba ltar nag bzhin ras dkar//thag bzang so phreng rab dkar mchu sgros dmar//'os min spyod pa kun spangs yon tan len//blo gsal gzhon nu'i lang tshos su ma bcom//(4)gzhi gcig gi rdzas dang las 'gal ba ni/shel dkar sku la mig sman lan bu g.yo//ku mud zhal dkyil bung ba'i 'dren byed ldan//bim pa'i mchu sgros mu tig tshems dkar rgod//pi wang dbyangs ldan lha mo khyod la dad//(5)gzhi gcig sga bya ba 'gal ba ni/mtshar sdug lang tsho'i me tog rab 'dzum pa'i//mdzes mas 'khyud min dad ldan las can 'ga'//lus kyi ba spu ldang zhing g.yo ba dang //'dren byed zung las mchi ma'i char rgyun 'jo//(6)sbyar ba'i 'gal ba ni/

— 338 —— skya5gzhungab ngartsi'ithi sapa —/chirwar+ṣa—olojarmedakar————— — ོmdzes sdug 'khril ldem mig sngar mdzes na yang //gang nyid gzhan gyis longs su spyod pa'i tshe//ngaga' ba bskyed pa'i blo ldan su zhig mchis//nyer brgyad pa/ skabs min bstod pa'i rgyan bshad pa/yod na 'dzad kyis dogs pas ser sna dang //med na ltogs kyis dogs pa'i gsog 'jog sogs//mi dgos bar snang dbyings su lding 'khor mkhan//bya rgyal rgod po'i tshogs kyi skyid pa la//nyer dgu ba/zol bstod kyi rgyan bshad pa la/(1)mthu phun tshobs kyi zol bstod ni/lha dbang gtsug gis 'dud par mi nus shing //tshangs chen yid kyis brjod bral zla mdzes ma//de nyid kho nas ngo mtshar ma lags kyi//snyan pa'i grags pa srid zhir shong min mtshar//

snunartsom bsamangarwarapo'irangam ngang sa/ 23 9 ——/rnyinga'abaphunatshogasarkyezolar+yārdosgo— ——— — ————— — — — — spyan ras gzigs dbang srong btsan sgam po khyod//bag phebs ting 'dzin yur la mi bzhugs par /mthu dpung rnam par btsan pas gangs ri'i ljongs//gcig pus bdag tu bzung ba rigs sam ci//( ༈)stobs phun tshogs kyi zol bstod ni/bde 'byung gtsug gi zla tshes brkus pa dang //tshangs chen tshems las 'khrungs pa'i rdzu bag gis//ci'i phyir srid zhi'i rgyan du 'phags so zhis//smra ba'i spobs pa cung zad yod min no//7bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa ni/mkhas dang rmongs pa'i khyad 'byed snyan ngag la //zla ba nyi ma 'dra zhes bsngags ci dgos//zol bstod rgyan 'di gcig pu'i khyad chos la//dbang bos mig stong sprul kyang rnyed re skan//dwangs gtsang yan lag brgyad ldan lha yi chab//dor nas rnyog ldan ba tshu'i chu 'tshol bzhin//

— 340 —— ༅211nga༅dartsi'ithi sapa — d+me therlo snyarne rngorgergerkyerngorācho—yaḥr+sharte ——/de4—shed dung mkhas par rlom 'di kye ma 'khrul//ngo ma bsod nams dkar bo'i srog ldan na//rgyal bo dge dbang nag mo khol bzhin du//snyan ngag gzhung 'di sbyangs pa tsam gyis ni//bskal ba'i bar du snyan grags rgyas par 'gyur//sum cu ba/nges bstan gyi rgyan bshad pa/(1)mchog gi nges bstan ni/lha yi rdzing ring khrod kyi 'od dkar can//'asog med dwangs gsal mtsho la legs 'char bas /'gro la brtse chen thugs rjes dam 'khyud pa'i//spyan ras gzigs kyi dri med thugs rab ston//(2)mchog min nges bstan ni/dkar gsal zhal ras zla ba rgyas pa'i ngos//smin 'khyog ra yig gnyis pa gar du rtsen//de la rjes chags sred ldan skye bo'i tshogs//

3rartsom bsam ngakyangapo'irangamangangs — 241 —— ོsdod+nghag nyoba'ichos sko—tshathothobalte rdo nga—————— — 4— — so gcig pa/lhan cig brjod pa'i rgyan bshad pa/(1)yon tan lhan cig brjod pa mi 'gro kun rjes brtse dbyangs can 'dzum zhal dang //mtshar sdug 'dab stong kun ta lhan cig grol//gang gi rnam dpyod gsar ba'i blo gros dang //lhan cig dbang bo'i gzhu ris rnam par bkra//(2)bya ba tha dad pa lhan cig brjod pa ni/chu 'dzin dbyar skyes rnga gsang ldir ba dang //lhan cig mdongs mtha'i bu mos sgro gur phubs//mdza' ba'i grogs dang bral ba'i dga' ma rnams//lhan du gdung bas gzir ba'i nyams par byed//(3)bya ba gcig pa'i lhan cig brjod pa ni/'bras ldan dus kyi char sprin sngon mo dang //skyed tshal sa hā kā ra'i yal 'dab phreng //dbyangs can dpal mo'i drin las bdag gi blo//

— nga —33༷ — ཿ5༅zhu༅rwa' ja྾ 4— ༅—— 4 —ོ —lhan cig 'gran pa bzhin du 'phel bar 'gyur/ /so gnyis pa/ yongs brjes kyi rgyan bshad pa/tshe gcig zung 'jug sku brnyes thos pa dgas//grub pa'i khyu mchog rje btsun mar ba la/ /lus ngag yid gsum gyis mtshon mkho dgu dbul/ /phyag chen gdams pa'i man ngag thams cad 'thob/ /so gsum pa/ shis brjod kyi rgyan bshad pa/shel dkar lcugs phran ldem 'dra'i 'jo sgeg sku/ /snyan 'jebs gsung gi dbang phyug zla mdzes ma/ /zab gsal myur ba'i mkhyen rab glog bi gar//de ring bdag gi yid na rgyas par mdzod/ /so bzhi ba/ rab spel gyi rgyan bshad pa la/(1)gcig la gcig brten gyi rab spel ni/'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sku yi ljon bzang ni/ /e ma nyin byed kyis 'khyud gangs ri bzhin/ /

7nartsomalhastubasam nga khar po'i rangamangangs/ 313 — ngang—nga——ྈ————— /de—ca—————ngatsha——/de—/de— — — nga——mkhyen rab glog gi lcugs ma sayo ba'i dpal/ /ma bzod khyab 'jug mi'u thung gzugs su sprul//(2)stobs mtshungs rab spel ni/zla ba'i zhal ras ut+pal dkyus ring mig /bim pa ltar dmar mchu sgros 'dzum pa'i dbus//rab mngon so phreng ge sar bdud rtsi'i rgyun//'thung 'dod gzhon nu'i yid de chu gter bzhin//so lnga ba/ dgongs pa can gyi rgyan bshad pa/tshul 'di sngon byon gsung gi man ngag chab/thugs kyi bum bzang legs 'khyil bdag bi bshes//brtse bas legs 'doms gsung rgyun ji bzhin du//zol med lhag bsam dkar bos 'di brtsams so//༵ 'a~Xṭ+wāṃ nāX ༵/ po'i pha mtha' ji bzhin du//shes bya'i rnam grangs mtha' yas gzhal nus skan//'on kyang gting mtha' mi mngon chu gter las//

—— 34/ — — ༅rwa༅yobaco rtsi'ithi༅ pa/ zlo r+yās mar+sharwab 'dilirmorjen ༷———— — ༅ zlokhas dbang bde 'byung ral ba'i nags klong du//legs 'khyil snyan ngag gang gā lha yi chab//cung zad sbyangs las 'thob pa'i rnam dpyod rdzing //'khrungs pa'i me tog mdzes na rgyan du longs//dus rabs nyer gcig 'dzum zhal ngom pa'i dus//nga rgyal rang snang mtho ba'i skye bo 'ga'//gzhan la smod pa'i dug lce myur na yang //don la snying bo med pa'i chu shing bzhin//lhag bsam sashis su 'dzum pa'i pad dkar las//'khrungs pa'i snyan tshig ge sar 'di las lhag /phyogs lhung la rgya'i rna ba ches ring ba'i//mi sdug mgrin bzang gzugs la ci ltar chags//tshul 'di mkhas pa'i zhal gsung yin gyi rang bzo'i 'khyog brjod snyan tshig min//bdag blo goms pas tshig rgyan yin gyi rtogs dka'i tshig ris gyong bo min//gzur gnas blo gros dpyad gzhi yin gyi nga rgyal rang snang mu

༅༅rtsom bsamang rapo'irangamangang sa 1— 345 — tsharmen — ————— ———ོ— lhag bsam dkar bo'i rang mdangs yin gyi mkhas grags re bas rtsom pa min//me tog snye ma dud pa'i ljon shing rtser//mgrin pa'i rdza rnga 'khrol ba'i khu byug bzhin//de las 'ongs pa'i rnam dkar dga' ba'i char//lus can 'gro ba'i dpyid du smin gyur cig /gangs can bod yul mun pa'i gling 'di ru//rab gsal shes rig sgron me btegs pa'i mgon//thon mi a nus mdzad rjes bskal ba'i bar//mi nub dbyar mtsho bzhin du 'phel bar mdzod//khyad par shong dpang yab sras thugs rje'i phreng //nyin byed 'od kyi kha 'byed snyan ngag gzhung //pad ma'i tshal 'di blo gsal dga' bskyed du//dregs dang gzi mdangs rgyas bzhin bzhad gyur cig /gangs dkar shel gyi mchod rten mdzes pa'i zom//'phrog byed g.yu yi ze ba gnya' khebs pa'i//gdong lnga'i dbang po ji bzhin dge ba'i bshes//

——— ———3hūṃgri —༷——4———༄༄ —ra4phros zi/ —— /de ————zhabs zung saser gyi 'khor lo rtag brtan thog /7zhis ngas snya na si gzhung las don rgyan so lnga'i dper brjod thog ma 'i blo sgo 'byed pa 'i lde mig ces bya ba 'di ni/ rang lo nyer sasum gyi ska bas su bla brang bkra 'is 'khyi'/ gyi7dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab spyi dang khyad par du rje'i lam sngags rnam gnyis thugs thog nas shar shar du gsungs thub pas tshom dpyod 'gran zla dang bral ba7rje blo bzang rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas pra ti'i sum rtags so gas su ma rtags kyi skor dang / gzhan dbyangs can sgra ṭīka dang sdeb sbyor gyi skor sogs dang / khyad par du snyan ngag gzhung gi khrid rgyun legs par mnos so/de rjes gangs ri'i ljongs kyi mkhas pa'i dbang bo slob dpon7dmu dase bsam satan rgya mtsho dbyangs can dga' blos 'al snga nas rig gnas mang bo dang snyan ngag yang gsal snang mdzod kyi khrid rgyun legs par 'thob pas bka' drin la brten nas dpe khrid ska bas su 'jos pa'i dpe brjod rnams cung zad re bcos te rab byung bcu bdun pa'i lcags po 'brug gi 'o nag pa zla ba'i dkar phyogs dasa' ba dang po'i nyin mjug yongs su rjogs par bris pa 'dis kyang gangs can rig gnas spyi dang khyad par du snyan ngag gi gzhung bzang 'di dbyar gyi mtsho mo ji ༵ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ gsal ngang mo'i khyu tshogs kyi dpyid dpal du rgyas zhing mi nub pa'i rgyur ༄ bkra shis bde legs 'phel bar thog /

—— martsom༄ngadakro4༄ nga4nga4༅ rdo —snyan ngag gi gzhung las le'u gsum pa sgra rgyan gyi skor zung ldan gyi rnam bzhag bshad pa dbyangs can gzhon nu dgyes pa'i 'dzum zer zhes bya ba/'dzum 'dzum pad dkar lhag lhag rab bzhad ldem ldem mgo lcog g.yo ba'i rtser//mdzes mdzes 'jo sgeg lang tsho'i dpal 'bar ldem ldem shel dkar lcug phran bzhin//'dzum 'dzum snying rje'i 'dab stong rab grol yang yang 'gro kun rjes chags can// du7 kye kye 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo brtan brtan bdag yid gur khang rtse na//'khyugs 'khyugs dmar ser glog gi lcug bzhin myur myur shes bya'i sgo mo 'bum//zab zab rtog dka'i mdud rgya kun grol ldem ldem shes rab ral gri 'bar//

༅ngagro༅ ngab nga:3thi sapakhu ————4—— gsal gas/la blo gros 'bum phrag stsol mkhas brtan pa'i 'khor lo ngag gi dpal//yang yang mi 'jigs shes bya'i dpal stsol mdzes mdzes 'jam dpal gzhon nu kye//dwangs dwangs lho phyogs 'o ma'i chu gter dkar dkar ngang ba'i bu mo bzhin//'dzum 'dzum bzhin gyi pad mo rab mdzes gsal gsal ma 'dres spyan zung legs//lhang lhang snyan 'jebs pi wang rgyud stong mdzes mdzes nu 'bur ngogs na nyal//dung dung yid nas khyed la 'bod do zab zab shes bya kun mkhyen mdzod//mang mang lnga rig shes bya'i thang chen gyi nar 'joms 'thoms mgo 'khor ba'i//khyog khyog mgrin pa kyogs nas bltas kyang yang yang 'thob dka' dam pa'i nor//wal wal yid kyi smon pa ji bzhin dwangs dwangs gsal ba'i blo gros mchog /

co— rtsom ༄/ yodo྾ ngadwa ga / 3nga nga—ma ma dbyangs can khyed la re na bu bu bdas kyang rjes su zungs/ /dkar dkar ke la sha ri'i ljongs 'dir brjid brjid gangs kyi seng ge bzhin//zab zab mdo sngags chos kyi chu bo dwangs dwangs thugs kyi 'o mtshor 'khyil//mang mang 'gro la brtse bas legs 'doms lhag lhag dge ba'i ljon bzang gang / /yang yang bdag gis mgon du 'dzin no myur myur byin rlabs char rgyun phobs//phyag na pad mo mi yi rnam sprul sprul ba'i chos rgyal srong btsan hu/sa// gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir bstan pa'i sgron me me long mthil gyi gzugs brnyan bzhin//thugs stobs dpung gis yongs su gsal mkhas mkhas dbang khyod la su mi gus/ /slob dpon daṇ+ḍi'i thugs klong dbyings nas legs 'khrungs snyan ngag me long ma//

— 350 — ngab rtsi'ithi sapa ——/de——————sngon med legs bshad gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir 'dren mkhas shong dpang yab sras kyi//bka' drin nyin byed 'bum gyi 'od snang sus kyang gzhal med zla bral mgon//bdag yid dang pa'i me long dbus na sor bcu'i 'dab ma zum bzhin 'dud//ling ling rab dga'i sgro gshog thig le 'bum//yang yang bskor ba rma bya'i bu mo bzhin//snyan snyan snyan ngag dpyid kyi gling bu yis//brtan brtan yid kyi ri dwags cis mi 'gugs//lhang lhang snyan pa'i grags pa srid gsum na//yang yang 'phur ba gangs ri'i snyan gzhung 'di//mtho mtho bde 'byung ral rtse'i 'od dkar bzhin//lhang lhang bsngags brjod mi byed shes ldan su//zab zab mdo sngags rig gnas rtsa 'grel kun//shar shar blo yi glo zhags rtse nas 'khyugs//mang mang mkhyen bzang mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan gang //yang yang mthong na dga' 'o bdag gi bshes//

nartsomalhug ba sam nga ra po'irangamangangs/— 351 ——sorāsolasher+ṣa—karam̐ sgong nga'ir+ṣangang rne+o// ——nga4ྈ—snya na snyan 'gags med nā da'i gling bu'i sgra /lhang lhang snyan par 'byin mkhas rgyal sras mchog /ka la ping ga'i ngang tshul cis ma lags//kye kye blo gsal rig pa'i 'phur lding can//lhag lhag rnam dpyod 'bar ba'i rtsal 'dod na//myur myur legs bshad 'phreng ba 'di longs la//ling ling dga' ba'i gar gyi rtsed 'jo rigs//3 dang po/ bya sla ba'i zung ldan bzhi las/(1)rkang pa dang po la yongapa/'dzum 'dzum zhal gyi me tog rgod pa las//legs 'ongs snyan tshig rna pa'i bcud len mkhan//dbyangs can dpal mo bdag blo'i gur khyim khrod //e ma rab dga'i dpal gyi rtsed 'jo rigs//(2〉rkang pa gnyis pa la yodapa/ngo mtshar 'bum gyi mdzes sdug rdzogs pa yi//

4 352 ngab ngartsi'ithi sapa /de/de ྈldem ldem pad ma'i 'khri shing g.yo ba'i rtser//gnag snum bung ba rab dga'i zlos gar gyis//yid kyi brtan pa cig car 'phrog par nges /(3)rkang pa gsum pa yod pa/gnam sngon sa la 'khyil 'dra yul gyi ljongs//rkang bzhi phyugs kyi na bun gtibs pa bzhin//mdzes mdzes kun lho g.yang gi ra ba ni//e ma sum rtsen dpal dang khyad ci yod//(4)rkang pa bzhi ba layodapa/mtshams sprin gsar ba'i rtse dga' la chags pa'i//ngur smin 'dzin pa chos kyi grogs po gang //lung rigs rab 'byams smra la thogs med shing //mkhas mkhas 'bum phrag ral ba'i rtse na 'gying //gnyis pa/ bar ma chod pa rkang ba gnyis la yod pa'i zung ldan la drug las/

nartsom bsamadakarapojirangamangangasazo 353 ————'o)rkangapadangabodangagasnyeretho sor+sha————————— sngang ljang g.yu yi zhun thigs 'khyil ba'i mtshor//dkar dkar rlabs phreng zegs ma mala' la 'thor//du 'a byung khri shor rgya'/ mo'i snyan pa de//gri/da zhi'i khongs na rgyu zhes lha rnam sa smra//(2)dang po dang gsum pa la yodapa/'dzum 'dzum mu tig gas ra ba wu ba'i phreng //mnyen lcugs gshog 'dab phra mos 'gul byed pa//ling ling dasa' bas gar bsgyur chu bya'i tshogs//snyan pa'i mgrin rnga 'khrol la ci yang brel//(3)dang po dang bzhi ba la yod pa/ dkar dkar gangs ri'i phreng tshogs kyis bskor ba'i//sā la'i sman ljongs yangs pa'i dga' tshal der//mtsho sngon khri shor rgyal mo'i mdzes sdug dpyid// yang yang brjod par dka' 'o shes ldan tshogs//(4)gnyis pa dang gsum pa la yodapa/

/de ——ཿnga4rtsi4su4/ ———— — bla brang bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i mtshor//mang mang bslab ldan gser mig 'dzin pa'i tshogs//snyan snyan mgrin pa'i dril chung 'khrol ba las//mdo sngags rgyud sde'i bka' chos mdzad pa med//5gnyis pa dang bzhi ba yod pa/lta na sdug pa lus kyi 'jo sgeg las//dkar dkar 'o 'dzin myos bum gzengs mtho ba//'dod pa'i lang tsho'i dud pa'i smin legs ma//'dzum 'dzum rab dga'i rtsed 'jo ngom par rigs//6gsum pa dang bzhi ba la yod pa/kun lho g.yang ldan phyug mo'i phang ba ru//sna tshogs rtse dga' bgyid pa'i gar mkhan tshogs//lhang lhang snyan pa'i glu yi myos pa dang //ling ling g.yo ba'i gar gyis ci yang brel//

——༵——ོ4 rtsom ཿ༄ཿn+d+ra'irangam0rgu zothu she gi nga —gsum pa/ bar ma chod pa'i rkang ba gsum la yod pa ba'i las/(1)rkang pa snga ma gsum la yong pa/'dzum 'dzum me tog rab bzhad dga' ba'i tsha' /dir dir bung bas snyan pa'i glu len zhing //dwangs dwangs phu chus mdzes pa'i gar bsgyur ba//de ni dben pa'i gnas kyi khyad chos lags /(2)rkang ba dang po gnyis dang bzhi ba la yong pa/lam lam me tog mang bos kha bsgyur zhing //mdzes mdzes lta na sdug pa'i yul ljongs der//lan gcig slebs kyang snang ba bsgyur byed pa'i//nges nges don gyi gnas mchog bya rkang phug /(3)rkang ba dang po dang phyi ma gnyis la yod pa/ ldem ldem g.yu lo 'dzin pa'i dga' chal der//

—— 356 /de nga ba rtsi'i thi sa pa/mgrin rnga snyan para'akhrolaba'ibyatshogasamang —/debasal gsal 'od snang 'bar ba'i lha khang nang //brjid brjid rten gsum ri mo rnam par bkra//(4)rkang ba phyi ma gsum la yod pa/bya rgod phung bo'i ri dang khyad med pa'i//lhag lhag yun nan sa yi rgyan gyi mchog/mdzes mdzes gnas mchog bya rkang phug zhes pa//ya nga yang slebs par 'dod pa'i sa cha red//bzhi ba/ bar ma chod pa rkang ba bzhi la yod pa'i zung ldan ni/mtshar mtshar ngo mtshar che ba'i zhing khams der//dung dung dad pa'i yid kyis gsol 'debs shing //lhang lhang snyan pa'i bstod bsngags dbyangs gyer na//lhag lhag gnas kyi byin rlabs 'thob par nges//

— 444—ཿ—gongaḥ 4 lngangang— lnga ba/ bar du chod pa rkang ba gnyis la yod pa'i zung ldan la drug las/ /(1)rbang ba dang po gnyis la yong pa/'dzum ldan pad+mo'i mdzes pa zum byed pa'i//'dzum dkar rgod pa'i na chung smin legs ma//phyi yi rnam 'gyur mthong pas yid 'phrog cing //nang sems 'dres par dka' bas sdug la gtad//(2)rkang pa dang po dang gsum pa la yongang nya rgyas zla gzhon 'dzum pa'i zhal gyi dkyil//gnag snum bung ba'i smin ma‘ci yang 'khyog /nya mo chu la 'khyugs bzhin mnyen lcugs phyag/bdag gi phyogs su skyongs shig tā re ma//(3)rkang ba dang po dang bzhi ba la yod pa/ldem bag rdzogs pa'i lus kyi 'khri shing las//pi wang sngon mo khu byug skad 'byin mkhan//

— 358 —— — nga ba nga rtsi'i thi sa pa /—bher+shabyechor+shams smral thogachopo pazo —————༅ldem/ pa'i pad mtshor bung ba zhugs bzhin mdzod//(4)rkeng ba gnyis ngang gsum pa la yodapa/'dzam gling srid pa'i rgyan du gyur ba yi//gangs ri'i bskor ba'i phyag na pad+mo'i zhing //gangs can bod zhes grags pa'i yul ljongs der//nga yi lte 'tshal 'pho ba'i sa cha red//(5)rkang ba gnyis pa dang bzhi ba la yod pa /legs pa'i yon tan ma lus rdzogs byed pa'i//sa yi dge bcu tshang ba cos hwa hran//mthong bas dad pa'i me tog 'dzum pa'i zhing //sa yi snying bo'i gdan sa yin zhes grags//(6)rkang ba phyi ma gnyis la yod pa ni/sngon med zhing mchog ri bo gru 'dzin zhes//spyan ras gzigs dbang dar thod 'dzin pa'i lha//

nartsotshogasama' jupo'irangam ngangs1 — 35 9 — ༄zlormer+shazhin skuyibakode( 'aṣ+pezazloblornonacho —— —bsam ma thag tu dad pa'i spu long g.yo// drug pa/ bar du ma chod pa rkang ba gsum la yod pa'i zung ldan la gsum las/(1)rkang ba dang po gsum la yod pa/yid 'ong sa 'dzin lhun po brjid pa'i dbus//yid 'phrog lta na sdug pa'i dgon sde'i mdzes//yid kyi brtan pa 'phrog byed bos the hran//ri bo rtse lnga zhing 'di'i rgyan tu brjid//(2)rkang ba dang bo ngang phyi ma gnyis la yod pa ni/dkar 'jam lus kyi 'khri shing smin legs rtser//yid 'ong zhal gyi dkyil 'khor snying du sdug/dkar mdzes 'khor lo'i lag ldan 'gran bdo ba'i//dkar ba'i lus can ma khyod bdag gi mgon//

rtsom bsam da ra po'irangamadangs— 381—/de/—gsang ba don dam gzhig bral rdo rje'i dbyings//gnas mchog bya rkang phugs kyi ngo mtshar spro//de yang ji skad du/ rlangs kyi po ti bse ru las/ lar skyes ba'i mis rang gi skye rgyud ma shes na/nags khung gi spre'u 'dra/mi rang gi cho 'brang ma shes na g.yu 'brug zol ba 'dra/ /yab mes kyi cho ge'i yig tshang ma shes na/ mon phrug yul bor ba dang 'dra/ zhes gsungs yod pas deng rabs spyi tshogs gsar ba'i khrod 'dir 'tshar longs byung ba'i mi rigs gang dang gang yin yang gtso bo rang gi yab mes kyi lo rgyus dang de dag gi nyams myong las 'khrungs pa'i 'od stong ldan pa'i shes rig sogs ma shes na shin tu mtshwang che ba gong du drangs pa'i lung gis kyang rtogs sla la des phyir rang gi pha mes yang mes kyi mched khongs kyi lo rgyus dang sgyu rtsal shes rig sogs phun sum tshogs pa zhig shes pa gzhi bzhag gi thog nas rang gi mi rigs dang 'brel ba dam por yod pa'i mi rigs gzhan gyi lo rgyus dang sgyu rtsal/ shes rig dang tshan rig sa rgyus sogs legs par rtogs dgos so/ des phyir phran gyis kyang 'di na

—rjo 3 2/de lo sa la mas ba'imelong ——4 lo rgyus kyi 'od stong 'bar ba'i mi rigs nyer lnga'i khyim gzhi chen po yul gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos kyis kun nas phyug pa/ krung go'i mnga' khongs su ljongs rgyu gnas mjal byed yul ming grags shin tu che ba yun nan sa khul gyi lo rgyus cung zad zhib tu brjod par 'di lta ste/de yang / thog mar lo rgyus kyi khog 'bubs kyi tshul du krung go'i lho nub yul gru spyi yi rang bzhin brjod pa la/ phyi snod lho 'dzam bu gling zhes yongs su grags pa'i go la glum po'i khyon yangs por nang bcud 'gro ba rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir dkar nag dge sdug gi 'bras bu sna tshogs las bskyed pas bde sdug gi tshor ba ci dgar nyams su myong pa'i sa sgang hril bo der/ gzengs su mtho zhing snyan pa'i grags pa ring du ldir ba'i krung hwa mes po'i rgyal khab chen po 'di'i lho phyogs su lha yul gyi zhing khams gnyis pa mi yul du 'phos pa lta bu yin zhes sngon gong ma chan lung sogs kyis yang dang yang du bsngags pa'i yul ljongs cang nan(yi sgo/ )zhes pa 'bri chu'i lho rgyud du gnas pa'i grong khyer te gtso bo/nan cin dang / su'u kros/(mo1〉/) dpang gros/( 7 1//) g.yang

——————3 ༅ ཿ ཿ——5bo'irangangad4nga rjo༅grog(/skya 1//) khrin cang /(yo /1 ) hrang he(༅oṃ) sogs dang /yan he (1ṣ+ṭha༅)ste lho phyogs rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram du gnas pa'i grong khyer te/bkang gros dang /(ḍa 1//) hrin kri(1lkonya//〉 gros he/(ཿ kho) zha min (khu / ka)dang phos kros (༅ 1/)sogs kyi sa char dpal 'byor dang tshan rig rig gnas sogs dar khyab che zhing 'phel rgyas snga ba dang stobs 'byor che zhing 'byor phyug legs pa/ khyad par du 'tsho ba'i gnas stangs dang goms gshis lag len/ bsam pa'i dpal yon dang yul gyi mdzes sdug la sogs kyi cha nas ngo ma lha yul las kyang skyid che zhing klu yul las kyang 'byor phyug legs pa zhig go/gna' bo'i dus nas bzung lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring zhing gna' rdzas shul rgyun gyi bang mdzod lta bu/ 'jam dbyangs gnam gyi gong ma rim byon gyi rgyal sar gyur ba'i sa khul ‘ zhes pe’’(ṣ+ṭha46)ste 'bri chu'i byang rgyud du gnas pa'i grong khyer gtso bo ni/ hu nan gyi grin kros (༅〉//)dang hran zhas zhi an(khri zo)/ kun su'u gyi lan ju (༅1//)dang hran zhi the yan/maṭha)/ nyin zha (ོ )yi yun khron (tsho)//)dang mtsho sngon gyi zi ling (༅ོ)grong khyer sogs ni deng sang ma zad sngon rgyal rabs mang po'i

/de 384 /de lo sa la mas ba'i me long rker+sharāsu' ngalongh+rusadangarigaganas/ tshong las dang dpaya 'byor sogs phyorgos gang thad nas ngo gnongs mi dgos shing gzengs su mtho la/ mi rigs mang zhing chos lugs dar khyab che ba'i sa cha yin par snyon du med la/ mi rnams kyang skyes stobs ldan zhing las la brtson pa/ dpa' ngar 'dzoms shing bzod bsran che ba sogs rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos ldan pa'i yul ljongs zhig tu'ang brtsi chog go /de yi nub phyogs su bod rang skyong ljongs te 'dzam gling hril bo'i khyon 'dir gnam gshis ches dwangs shing mkha' dbugs shin tu legs pa'i tshad du brtsi bzhin yod/ gzhan yang /gangs ri dkar bo shel gyi mchod rten lta bu'i legs par bskor zhing sā la ste spos dkar shing sogs dri sna 'bum phrag gi dri bsung zhim po khor yug tu khyab pa'i dbus su/ rdza ri dang spangs ri/g.ya' ri dang nags ri sogs rgyal bo dang blon po'i tshul du lhun zhing stug la kha dog legs pa mtsho dang mtshe'u dang lteng ka sogs gnam sngon sa la 'khyil 'dra'i mdzes sdug mthong la/de ru khrung khrung dang bzhad gad ngur ba dang mthing ril sogs mgrin pa'i rdza rnga snyan par 'khrol shing mtsho yi nyar ma shig

rtsom bsam nga ra po'i rang mdangs: 385 ——shig tu g.yo ba'i mgul du gshogapasagarastabasabasgyurngob/ dang / rdza chu bsil ma lhung lhung du 'bab pa'i ngogs su 'dzam gling na ches dkon shing rin thang gzhal du med pa'i 'brong dang rkyang / shwa dang dgo ba dang gla sogs kyis rtsed 'jo rol ba'i yul ljongs mchog tu bsngags pa zhig go /de yi grong khyer gtso bo ni dbus ldan chos kyi zhing khams lha sa dang gtsang zhes rig gnas sgyu rtsal gyi lte gnas dang gzhis ka rtse/ bod kyi rigs brgyud dang mkhar grong snga ba/ pho brang dang dgon sde'i 'byung khungs du grags pa lho kha sa khul gyi yar klung dang 'phyong rgyas/ glu gar lha ris sogs kyi sgyu rtsal gyi 'byung gnas su grags pa ste khams kyi chab mdo sogs gtso che ba dang /bod kyi mi rigs kyang dkar bo dge ba'i phyogs la rnam par spro zhing sems rgyud dul ba/ snying rje che zhing gtong phod yangs pa/ dpa' ngar ldan zhing las la brtson pa/ 'grogs yun ring zhing mi gshis bzang ba/ lang tsho ldan zhing shes rig 'dzoms pa sogs kyi yon tan dang ldan pa'o//gna' bo'i rig gnas kyi grong khyer chen po bzhi yi ya gyal/(gna' bo'i grong khyer chen po bzhi ni/ pe cin(shā6sgro)/zhis an(༅zo) nan

nga ༷ 3 6—— — 'o sa la mas ba'i che long cin(khyeblo) lo yang (/sgo7)te bzhi'o) gnam bskos gong ma ta ming rgyal rabs dang man ju gong ma chin rgyal rabs kyi rgyal sa hwa pe ’ste/ཿ4khu)pe cin (46tho)dang hu pe khrin tu(r+sācho)/ then cin (jatsho)dang hri kyā krang (botshal)sogs mtshan snyan rgyal nang kun tu grags che zhing krung hwa mes po'i gna' rabs dang deng rabs kyi rig gnas dang lo rgyus/ ri mo'i sgyu rtsal/glu gar dang rtsed rigs/ tshan rig dang dpal 'byor phyogs gang thad nas bltas kyang 'gran gyi zla dang bral ba zhig go /khyad par du pe cin ni krung go mi dmangs kyi rlabs che ba'i rgyal sa yin par ma zad gna' bo'i mkhar grong chen po bdun gyi ya gyal du grags so/ /mkhar grong chen po bdun ni/ pe cin dang (46cho)/lo yang(/sgo༅)/zhis an(༅za)/dpang kros (ṣ+ṭha〉〉/)/nan cin (sgo/ smo)/khe h+phun (zazo/)/an yang dang bdun no//lho nub phyogs su snyan grags che zhing stobs 'byor ldan pa'i gna' bo'i gros rgyal rabs kyi rgyal sa dang dmag thabs la mchog tu bsngags pa kros ki lang(1tho2cho) dang los pes kyi (ma1tho)'khrungs yul dang dmag thabs dngos su byas myong ba'i sa cha/ rgya'i nang bstan chos lugs kyi gnas ri chen po

rtsom bsam ra po'irangamangangs—— 3 70 bzhi yi ya gyal/(gnas ri chen po bzhi ni/hran zhi'i ri bo rtse lnga( yo yo tsheyi) an hes dpal ri rtse dgu(zo lo༅41/1) kre cang gi ri bo gru 'dzin(1 yosnyi1stsa khyonyuyi) si khron gyi glang chen 'gying ri/(ya1//loṭha(6) dang bzhi'o)gnas ri ste glang chen 'gying ri dang / gzhan yang rgya'i to'o co chos lugs kyi gnas ri chen po bzhi yi nang gses kyi ri bo mdzes zhing sdug pa chin khrin hran (chom༅)sogs kyi gtso byas pa'i ri bo mdzes zhing lhun sdug pa rnams kyis kun nas bskor ba/(to'o co chos lugs kyi gnas ri chen po bzhi ni 'di ltar/hos pe sa khul gyi bos tang hran(༅46ma zoyi)cang zhis kyi hos hran/(/1po༅77) an hes kyi chis yun hran(zo zachowa) si khron gyi chin khrin hran(r+sālo7/)dang bzhi'o)'bri chu dang men cang gtsang bo sogs kyis gtso byas pa'i chu bo mang pos mchod pa'i tshul du brgyan pa dang gzhan yang nags tshal dang mtshe'u sogs du mas yongs su mdzes zhing rmad du byung ba'i zhi'i nan (polo)te si khron gyi khrin cu'i (khrishār+ṣa)gtso byas pa'i grong khyer chen po khrung chen (༅lo)dang bkas kros(zo1//)/ yun nan sa khul gyi khon men(tsho༅)sogs yin no/ grong khyer chen mo khon men ni yun nan zhing chen gyi lte

/de 388 /de lo sa la mas ba'i me long gnas kyi grong khyer yin la/ grangs nyung mi rigs mang bo 'dus sdod byed pa'i sa cha'ang red/ khyon grong khyer yongs la mi rigs mi 'dra ba bzhi cu zhe drug dang grags che ba'i mi rigs nyer drug te gtso bo/rgya rigs dang(45)bod rigs(ma)yas rigs( )/ sa nyes rigs(7ṭha)/ pe rigs(nga )/ me'o rigs(mi)/ grang rigs(4)/ te'u rigs(lho)/ za lar rigs(shā1༈1)/las las rigs(khukhyashātā)/na ce/sa rigs(48༅)/hwa nyes rigs(tshoṭha) sogs mang bo yod/ spyir khon men grong khyer ni mtho sgang grong khyer rnams kyi grangs su 'dren stabs sa gzhi cung zad mtho zhing ri lung mang la spangs ri dang rdza ri/nags ri dang brag ri sogs mthong thub par ma zad/ gnam gshis dro grang gi tshad kyang dbyar bsil zhing dgun dro ba ste dus bzhi'i dro grang la phal cher khyad par cher mi 'dug pas rgyu mtshan gyis sngon nas da bar du ming la ‘dus bzhi'i dpyid dpal’ (༅ shākhucho)zhes pa'i mtshan snyan thob/ gzhan yang /mi rigs so sos dbyar dgun ston dpyid dus rnams kun tu rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i skad kyis glu gar rtsed 'jo sna tshogs su rol bas cha nas 6 glu yi grong khyer gyi rgya mtsho’mi(5

/de 390 /de lo sa la mas ba'i me long chen yan thung zi ste/ de ni khon men gyi lo rgyas ches snga shos dang rgya khyon ches che ba'i dgon sde zhig yin༄/ dgon pa'i ngo mtshar 'bum ldan gyi 'du khang chen mo'i ltag rgyab tu lo rgyus dang ldan pa'i kros co the(ltagumatshe)zhes pa ‘‘sngags nus kyis sbrul 'dul ba ’de yi lo rgyus mdor bsdus ni 'di ltar/ sngon khro yun dong (tsholokho)nang du co lung (4༅)ste lo rgyus rnams kyi nang du 'brug dang cha 'dra ba'i srogs chags zhig yin zhes 'khod 'dug 'dir dug sbrul gdug pa can zhig te rgyun du phyir 'ongs nas mi dmangs la gnod 'tshe byas pas dgon de'i sngags nus 'grub pa'i grub thob pa zhig gis gzungs sngags kyi nus pas 'dul te dgon pa'i sgo 'gram gyi ka bar dam la btags pa'i lo rgyus yod/ rjes sor ka ba sogs 'jig rjes ka rdo'i gzhi la bsil khang phibs te slar yang de la ming de ltar du brjod 'dug grong khyer gyi shar phyogs su to'o co (༅7)chos lugs kyi ming grags ldan pa'i gnas ri ‘men h+phun hran’ (06'ayi)kyi 'dabs su gser gyi lha khang du grags pa'i nang rol du gson nyams ldan pa'i ta'o co'i lha‘ drin bos tas bcun 〉(zozasotsho)sogs kyi zangs sku lo rgyus

/de 392 /de lo sa la mas ba'i me long deng (nga༅za5rtso)te rigs kyis (chuḥ)mchod rten dkar bo (theg pa chung ngu'i lugs su bzhengs pa)yas rigs kyi (༅ṣ+ṭha)thun mong ma yin pa'i rkos 'bur ri mo sna tshogs pa mchis la/ ba rigs kyi (/7ཿ) su gang las (thamo/༅)zhes pa gna' bo'i 'bur bzo'i lag rtsal gling du grags pa dang / cis no rigs(༅ tshoḥ) kyi nyi ma'i sgyu rtsal gyi yig rigs dang cho ga sogs dang /bde chen bod rigs kyis bzhengs pa'i srong btsan lha khang sogs mchis so/ te rigs dang / pe rigs/ yas rigs/ na shes rigs/ ba rigs/ pus leng rigs/ no cis rigs/ la gos rigs/ bod rigs/ hwa nyes rigs/ cin po rigs/ bde nang rigs/(tsho7ཿ)(bod kyi bde nang dang cha 'dra'o)sogs bcu gnyis la rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos dang ldan pa'i grong sde'i 'grem ston khang rgya che ba dngos su blta rgyu yod par ma zad/ gzhan yang mi rigs mthun sgril gyi thang chen dang tshon mdangs sna tshogs su bkra ba'i chu mchod (loblo)ra ba dang / yid dbang ma lus 'gugs pa'i rol rtsed khang sogs yod do/ngo mtshar 'bum ldan gyi grong khyer de yi lho phyogs su spyi le

rtsom bsam nga ra bo'i rang mdangs/de 393 /de66tsam gyi sar rgyal nang kun tu grags snyan shin tu che ba'i ‘‘hri len ’’te (bo.oṃ)dung mdog lta bu'i nags tshal gyi rdza ri zhes pa blta skor byed yul gyi yul ljongs khyad par can de ni tshan rig pa rnams kyis bshad tshul ltar na/ sngon mi lo khri phrag mang po'i snga rol tu sa 'dir rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gengs 'dug la de'i nang du rdo zhun dkar bo rim gyis skyes mthar yun gyis rgya mtsho rnams bri rjes sa 'di'i dge mtshan yongs su mngon pa yin zhes bshad do//sa 'di'i mi rigs gtso bo yas rigs dang sa nyes rigs(maṭhalo)yin la/ de ni mdzes sdug rdzogs shing glu gar la dga' ba/ dpa' ngar 'dzoms shing las la brtson pa zhig tu mchis so/ mi rigs de yi mang tshogs kyi ngag rgyun du a hri ma(ta1poza)zhes bu mo yid du 'ong ba lha yi gtso mo lta bu zhig la bkur ste byas pa'i srol da lta'i bar du dar 'dug lo re'i lug rnying gi zla drug pa'i tshes nyer bzhi'i nyin sa de ma'i mi dmangs rnams kyis rang rang gi mdzes zhing yid du 'ong ba'i rgyan gos sogs kyis legs par brgyan te lag tu rol mo sna tshogs thogs shing 'bud dkrol byas pa dang / rta rgyugs pa

/de 394 /de lo sa la mas ba'i me long dang mda' 'phen pa dang glang dang 'brong 'dul ba sogs pho rtsal sna dgu dang / glu len pa dang gar rtse ba sogs rtsed rigs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas nyin gyi dus su bu mo a hri ma la mchod pa dang mtshan mo'i dus su me mchod rgya che ba'i ngogs su lag tu me tog dang dpa' 'bar sogs thogs nas glu gar la rol ba'i dus ston rgya che ba byed pa'i srol yod do/ de yi ming la me yi dus ston zer/ (ma7lha)sa nyes mi rigs kyi khyad du 'phags pa'i mdzes ma a hri ma yi lo rgyus ni 'di ltar/nyin zhig a hri ma sa de'i rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i gshed ma(capo)zhig gis 'phrogs te rang gnas kyi brag phug su bzung skabs/a hri ma yi phu bo a hes (1rga4)ni snying stobs ldan zhing dpa' ngar 'dzoms pa zhig tu mchis pas/ dpa' chas lus la spras mthar sngon du song te a hri ma yul 'jigs su rung ba'i brag dong nang nas skyabs mthar ming sring gnyis dga' skyid kyi ngang la lam du chas skabs/glo bur du gshed ma ma rung ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gugs thag sogs mtshon cha rnams chu bo chen po kham nag dgung du 'phyo ba zhig tu sprul te bu mo a hri ma skad cig tsam gyis 'khyer ba'i mthar snying du sdug pa'i a hri ma

rtsom bsam rapo'irang marwa nga da 395/de/rkyen gyis dbang du bkrongs ngo / de rjes a hri ma brag ri chen po zhig tu sprul te chu bo'i 'gro lam 'gog par bshad do/ /deng sang brag ri yid du 'ong ba bud med dar la 'bab pa zhig gi dbyibs su gnas pa de yi ming la a hri ma zhes 'bod 'dug la/ chu bo chen po de yang yid du 'ong ba'i rdzing bu zhig tu gyur ba'i mi rnams kyi spro gseng byed yul gtso bo zhig go/hri len sa char blta skor du phyin pa rnams nyin de'i dgong mor khon men grong khyer du thon thub bo/ grong khyer de yi nub byang mtshams kyi spyi le lnga tsam du rgyal khab phyi nang kun tu snyan grags shin tu che ba'i ‘‘'dzam gling skyed tshal rig pa'i 'grem ston gling’’(༅tsho༅cholo lo ༅)du grags pa'i skyed tshal ldum rwa chen po de ni spyi lo 1996lor 3thog mar bzhengs shing spyi lo 1999lo'i zla 5pa'i tshes 1 la legs par rgyal khab phyi nang kun tu sgo 'byed pa'i ches che ba'i 'grem ston gling ste de ru krung go'i zhing chen sum cu rtsa grangs kyis rang rang gi yul gyi khyad par dang dus kyi goms gshis la gzhi byas te mdzes zhing yid du 'ong ba'i 'dzugs bskrun dang /gzhan yang /ya gling gi rgyal khab mi nyung ba'i rang gi rgyab khab dang dgon sde grong

/de 3yo—— tsha sa la mas ba'i me long khyim sogs kyi 'grem ston 'dra gzugs khang mig dang skyed tshal/ me tog ldum ra/ 'grem tshong khang sogs dang / yo rob gling dang o gling sogs kyi 'grem ston tshan rig skor rnams kyang yod/ bsil ldan mtho sgang gi skyed tshal spang ri/rdza ri dang nags ri/ rtswa thang dang lteng ka sogs dang / de bzhin du tsha ba'i sa khul (r+sātsho70)kyi skyed mos tshal dang me tog ldum rwa/rdzing bu dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sdong bu sna tshogs/ sil tog rwa ba sogs mang du mchis/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi zhib 'jug pa dang ljongs rgyu ba dang zlos gar ba sogs 'gro 'ong zam ma chad par gnas so/yun nan sa khul gyi lho phyogs kyi mtha' mtshams spyi le bdun brgya tsam gyi sar ming grags ldan zhing yid du 'ong ba'i sa cha ste‘‘zhis hrang pan na ’(po༅lom)zhes pa'i yul ljongs kyi mdzes sdug mngon thub la/ de ni phyi yi rgyal khab men ten(mkhri)dang lo'o bo'i (tso4/)la thag shin tu nye bar 'dug zhis hrang pan na zhes pa'i nang don ni/sa de ma'i te rigs(ṣ+ṭhalo)mi yi skad cha yin la/ bod skad du bsgyur na zhing sa bcu

rtsom bsamang rapo'irang mngangasa'i 397 —gnyis zhes pa yinal sngon sa'adirazhing rā bzloganyis cor grong tsho chen po bcu gnyis yod par bshad do/ gtso bo'i mi rigs ni/ te rigs (ṣ+ṭhaḥ)kyis brgya cha'i bdun cu zin la/gzhan yang /hwa nyes rigs/ la gos rigs/ pos lang rigs/yo rigs/ cis ro rigs sogs yod do/ te rigs mi dmangs ni spyod lam dang gos rgyan sogs lha la 'gran zhing chos lugs men ten rgyal khab dang lo'o bo'o rgyal khab/ the go rgyal khab sogs kyi shan zhugs pa'i nang bstan theg dman gyi chos lugs so/gnas brtan pa'ir+sha / / rgya'i byis pa rnams slob grwar 'jug pa ji bzhin sa 'dir byis pa rnams lo bdun nam brgyad tsam du slebs pa'i skabs su nges par du lus la ngur smrig gi gos kyis g.yogs nasamachos sgor 'jug te chos sbyangs par byed du bcug de ltar min na mi de brtsis thang chung ngo /de nas rim bzhin nar son nas lo nyi shu la brgal rjes khyim thab 'dzin tu bcug nas srid bskyangs tshe mi de rin thang che zhing bkur sti byed pa'i srol da lta'i bar tu mchis so/sa de ma'i mi rnams khrus byed pa dang chu rtsed rol ba/ chu nang du rkyal ba sogs la shin tu dga' bo 'dug nyin rer

—— 398 /de lo sa nga 4 khams ba'i me long ge sa gsumanas chu ra duchula'ozlod+nghasnatshorgezlormo — pa'i srol mchis/ pho mo'i gnyen sgrig dang mdza' mthun gyi phyogs la nges bzung med pa lta bu snang / rgan rabs dang yon tan pa/ rab byung gi sde la shin tu dad pa dang bkur sti che bar snang ngo /zhis hrang pan na ni 'dzam gling na ming grags shin tu che ba'i rang byung thon khungs ches phun sum tshogs pa'i sa cha ste/dri ldan sman mchog sum brgya lhag gi thun mong ma yin pa'i sdong bo dang rin thang gzhal du med pa'i sdong rigs kyang brgya lhag la nye ba dang /spyir srog chags mi 'dra ba stong phrag gnyis tsam la slebs pa dang rtsa che ba'i srog chags glang bo che dang /ri dwags bse ru/ seng ge dang dom dang mi dred dang gla ba sogs phal cher brgya lhag tsam du mchis par bshad/ sdong bo rnams kyi kha dog dang dbyibs dang yal ga lo ma sogs gzhan phal ba'i sdong bo dang mi 'dra bar yid 'phrog gar mas gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur shes ba lta bu dang / glu ma rnams kyis glu blangs tshe rang byung sdong bos glu rta ltar gar bsgyur shes pa/phan tshun mdza' zhing brtse ba'i lag sbrel byed pa lta bu/ bgres

rtsom bsam ra ra po'i rangamangangs /— 399 —— chor+shar+yā kha yi marwacas bskyod thozlozlozlozlo rdzo— mtshar ba dang / gzhan yang sbrang char sil mas brlan zhing gsher ba'i nags tshal stug po'i bar snang dbyings su gur khang lta bu phibs pa'i rtser spra dang spre'u sogs mchong rtsa' 'gran zhing rma bya dang shang shang te'u sogs mgrin pa'i rdza rnga snyan par 'khrol bas thos 'dzin dbang bo don ldan du byed nga//skad cig nyid la baiḍūr g.yu yi zhun thig 'dzin mar 'khyil 'dra'i mu mtha' med pa'i ne'u gsing gi ngogs su te rigs mi dmangs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i mchod rten dkar ngo/ nyan thos kyi lugs su bzhengs pa brjid cing lhun chabs pa'i ngogs su ngur smig rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i sde dang / yid 'phrog ngang ngur gyi 'gros dang ldan pa'i bu mo lang tsho'i dregs pa rnams dang / dad pa'i me tog snying khar bzhad pa'i mos ldan rgan po'i tshogs kyis phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod pa 'bul ba sogs yan lag bdun pa'i las la gcig tu brtson pa sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos shin tu mang ngo /yun nan sa khul gyi nub phyogs su spyi le bzhi brgya tsam gyi

/de/400 — lo sa la khams ba'i me long —sar mi lo stong phrag gcig dang nyis brgya lhag gi lo rgyus gyi gzi 'od 'bar ba'i shar phyogs kyi ri nas ba (2la4 )gnyis par grags pa'i ta las grong khyer (nga3tsholo)ni gnam gyi skar tshogs sa la 'phos pa ltar yid du 'ong ba'i ar he ( tho r+ṣa)mtsho 'gram du brjid cing lhun chags par gnas so/ de la shar phyogs kyi ri nas ba ru 'bod don ni/ stod na gangs dkar shel gyi thor cog bcings pa'i tshing hran ri bos (ca༅)mdzes sdug lhag ger ngoms shing / bar na g.yu yi zhun thigs sa la 'khyil 'dra'i ar he mtsho mo'i rlabs phreng shig shig tu 'gul ba'i 'gram na mu tig thang mar brdal 'dra'i gna' bo'i ming du grags pa'i ta las mkhar rnying (nga1tshocolo)dang deng rabs gsar du 'dzugs skrun byas pa'i zha bkan (ko༅)grong khyer gyi sde bzhi'i dpal yon dang mdzes sdug yul gyi rnam pa lhag par gsal ba/ khyad par du ta las grong khyer gyi lo gcig gi nyin zhag brgya dang sum cu ni drod grang shin tu ran pas deng sang thun mong du rgyal gces thog lus gso ngal gso'i byed yul gyi sa cha mchog tu gyur ba nub phyogs ri nas ba'i grong khyer dang khyad mi 'dug zhes rgyal phyi nang kun tu

— rtsom ba4r+sāralo4—40ngh+ru— shāgiji —grags so/ ta las grong khyer ni yun nan sa khul khros zhong(༅ ༈lto 〉〉/)gi khongs su gtogs/ de ni mtho sgang sa khul gyi chab srid dang / rig gnas/ dpal 'byor/ tshan rig dang lag rtsal/ lo rgyus sogs kyi lte gnas su gyur 'dug grong khyer 'di ni gna' bo'i shes rig ldan pa'i lo rgyas ring mo mchis te/ lo stong phrag bzhi'i ya sngon du sa 'dinga'i pe rigs(khye tshetsho)(brgya cha'i bdun cu tsam zin)mi dmangs dang yas rigs (oṃshātsho)mi dmangs/ sa nyes rigs(maṭhaḥ)sogs kyis tshing hrin ri bo'i rgyud dang ar he mtsho mo'i 'gram du yun ring bor dka' ngal lo khri stong mang bo'i bar du 'tsho ba rol myong /shis han yan h+phun (༅‘7zazo/)spyi lo sngon gyi 109lor sa 'dir ye bros rdzong zhes( zo)ming du chags/ dung han yong phen (lkoyo7cangar+ṣa)gyi ring la yong khrang zhes pa'i khongs su gtogs par byas/ si khron los pes (sko/1slo)gcig gyur byas pa'i zos dpan (7yo)gyi ring la yun nan gyi mnga' khongs su bcug thang rgyal rabs gyi thang khe yan khri lo nyer drug par(choza༅nga/raca)spyi lo 736lor rgyal yongs lam lugs gcig mthun ‘‘los kros’’(ra/mu)zhes par bsgyur rjes/ sa

༷/de ljo mas ba'imelong —ོ dzi——'dir nan kro rgyal khab kyi mnga' khongs su bcug(smo /ṭa/5)bod kyi lo rgyus rnams su nan kro rgyal khab ni yun nan 'jang sa dum rgyal bo kug la bong gi rgyal sa yin par bshad/ rgyal bo kug la bong dang bod rgyal khri lde gtsug brtan mes ag tshoms kyi yab rje 'dus srong mang bo rlung nam 'phrul gyi rgyal bo dang dus thog gcig yin par ma zad gna' 'brel gyi grogs po mchog tu gyur ba yin par bod kyi lo rgyus mang por snang 'dug/lo tshigs dang dus tshigs rnams su dpag na cung zad mi bde ba lta bu snang / nan kro rgyal khab gcig gyur byas pa'i lo ni 736yin par rgya nag gi lo rgyus rnams su bshad la/ nan kro rgyal khab dang ta las rgyal khab(ོ༅༅)sogs gnas pa'i yu na ni mi lo lnga brgya tsam zhes brjod 'dug kyang /bod kyi rgyal bo 'dus srong mang bo rjes bod dmag 'jang yul du thog mar drangs dus chu yos spyi lo 703yin par lo rgyus rnams su snang la/ de'i phyi lor dmag 'thab kyi skabs su rgyal bo bkrongs par bzhed pa ltar na 'jang gi rgyal bo 'di dang mna' 'brel gyi khom long yod med kyang ma 'tshal pa'i gang ltar bod rgyal dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu'i thog gshegs par bshad pa gang yin

rtsom ༅ma rapo'irangam ngas/ 4lda/de ngayang nan gro rgyal khab ma tshugs gong gi rgyal bo zhig yin na ma gtogs nan kro rgyal khab kyi gong ma de min par nges so /dpyad gzhi can no)'jang ngam myu'i rgyal bo phe lo'o ke zerargya'i lo rgyus la lar thang rgyal rabs kyi nan kro rgyal khab dang sung rgyal rabs kyi ta las rgyal khab zhes so sor bgrang 'dug pa'i skor kyang dpyad dgos/ lo rgyus 'ga' zhig tu de gnyis ming gi rnam grangs tsam ma gtogs gcig tu 'dod do/so sor 'byed pa'i dbang du byas na spyi lo 937kyi dus su ta las rgyal khab (ngaza༅)dbu brnyes shing / spyi lo 1253lor yon rgyal rabs kyi se chen rgyal bos(tso2 zo /)ta las rgyal sa brgyab ste yun nan zhing chen du bsgyur/ de'i dus su ming la ta las los (ོzapo)zhes par btags/ de nas spyi lo 1361lor ta ming rgyal rabs kyi gros yan krang (cho༅lo)gis ta las los zhes pa ta las srid (za4lo)du bsgyur la/ ming la the hu zhan zhes btags 'dug rjes sor go min tang srid gzhung gi skabs su the hu zhan (shā1shāzo)de yang ta las zhan du bsgyur (ma༅6)ro/ /deng sang ta las grong khyer du gyur 'dug go/nga༅cho) ta las yul ljongs gnam 'og na mdzes (nga༅'a༅༅

—/de༅4 — lo sa la mas ba'i me long —ngas)zhes grags 'dug pa gtso bo thun mong ma yin pa'i yul gyi mdzes ljongs brgya dang drug cu lhag yod pa dang / thun mong du gleng 'dug pa'i gnas kyang sum cu lhag tu mchis so/ khyad par du rgya skad la /h+phun dpa' zhe ye’’ste('tshazo7)dbyar dgun ston dpyid dus tshigs rnam bzhi'i mtshon rtags rlung dang me tog gangs dang zla zer gyi dpal yon mdzes sdug rnam bzhi dus gcig la yul gcig tu mthong thub pa ha lam 'dzam gling na dkon par gda' 'o zhes smras chog go de ni 'di ltar te ta las grong khyer gyi zha' bkan (ko༅)na ston gyi rnam par bsil rlung grang mo rim gyis ldang dus/ ar he mtsho mo'i 'gram du gnas pa'i hrang bkan ( ༅)na dpyid kyi rnam par kha dog sna lnga'i me tog 'bum phrag gi bzhin ras rnam par dgod pa la/ tshing hran ri bo'i rtse yi sdings na dgun gyi rnam par gangs dkar shel gyi thog cog bcings pa'i dus su gnam sngon baiḍūr g.yu yi zhun thigs sa la 'khyil ba lta bu'i ar he mtsho mo'i dwangs gsal gyi snod du dbyar gyi rnam par dri ma dang bral ba'i mkha' yi zla gzhon gyi mdzes zhal gsal 'dug pa sogs dus gcig tu rnam pa mi 'dra pa'i yul gyi

rtsom bsam rapo'irang mngangs da405 — mdzesasdugabazhimathong thubapo talasas khurlerūrwang gar+shazlo ldan pa'i yul ljongs re re nas zhib brjod byed par yig tshogs bskyungs phyir ma bris pa yin no/ gtso bo gna' mkhar gyi skor la grags che ba ta las gna' mkhar (za1tsho—/ lo)dang zhis kros gna' mkhar (chomam)sogs yod la/ ta las gna' mkhar gyi lo rgyus ni 'di ltar/ sngon ta ming rgyal bo men hong bos khri lo bco lnga bar (༅༅ma/stu4)bzhengs par bshad la/gna' mkhar ni lhun zhing stug pa'i ri bo mtsho ngos las mus ( ma)4122yod pa'i tshing hran ri bo'i mdun du gnas shing 'gram gyi ngogs su a sngon dwangs ma sa la ltems 'dra'i g.yu yi mtsho mo ar he'i rlabs kyi phreng ba shig shig tu 'gul 'dug pa'i sa yi dge bcu'i mtshan ma yongs su rdzogs pa der lhun zhing brjid chags par mthong thub/ mkhar gyi ring thung la spyi le drug tsam dang / mtho dman la mus brgyad yod par grags la mthug srab la mus bdun zhes bshad 'dug phyogs bzhi na sgo chen bzhi dang nang gi grong khyer la gzhung lam chen po brgyad tsam mchis so/ de ni gna' bo'i lho nub sa khul gyi dar lam tshong las (po lo༅mdzipo)grags can gyi ya gyal du

nga —zo3 —3༅ lo sa la mas ba'i long ——— /debartsi la nang gses kyi mkhar chen grags can gsum ni/ the hu mkhar chen mo(mam17)dang rdo rje gna' mkhar chen mo(chukhru//lo )dang tsi cin gna' mkhar dang gsum mo/ (tsho༅rtsalo)ches snga ba ni lo stong gnyis kyi ya sngon gyi the hu gna' mkhar (ma/shā/dziyishā)yin la/ de ni nan kro rgyal khab kyi skabs su (tho/ / pu༅)bzhengs par grags so/ gna' mkhar de yi nang rol du nan kro rgyal khab kyi skabs nas brgyud pa'i mgron gyi thog ma la sne len gyi tshul du gsol ja rnam gsum(za༅zo〉'dren pa'i srol mchis la/ deng sang bar du be rigs mi dmangs kyis srol de rgyun bsrangs bzhin 'dug pa'i gsol ja rnam gsum ni/ dang bo'i ja ni ro kha ba/ gnyis pa'i ja ni ro mngar ba dang / gsum pa'i ja ni ro 'jam zhing ska ba ste gsum rim bzhin 'dren pa'i srol mchis so/ gna' mkhar deyi nub byang mtshams su 'dzam gling yongs la ming gi snyan pa ring du ldir ba'i ta las mchod rten rnam gsum (nga༅nga1rtso)te rgyab na tshing hran ri bo brjid chags kyang lhun zhing stug pa dang 'gram ngogs su ar he mtsho mo sngo zhing ltems la dri ma dang bral ba/mdun du mchod pa'i phreng ba rang byung du bstar ba lta bu'i dkar dmar me

nga—ོ—༅4 r+sā 4 nga—྾ spu nga4/ tsho —shāhūṃ — tog gi tshom bu cig car du bzhad pa'i 'dab stong dga' ba'i tshal sogs gcig la gcig 'gran gyi tshul du gnas pa'i dbus su mchod rten rnam gsum dbang bo'i bir gyis bris pa ji bzhin brjid chags yid du 'ong bar mchis so ra/chod rten rnam gsum gyi lo rgyus ni 'di ltar/ thang gong ma nan gro h+phun yos(losgo/ /44༈6)ring la bzhengs par grags/ ha lam/ mi lo stong phrag gnyis lhag 'gor yod do/ dbus kyi gtso bo'i mchod rten brjid cing lhun chags pa de yi ming la chan phyon tha zer (r+shasta ’6)mtho chad la nu sa 69 13yod/ thog brtsesas bcu drug tsam mchis la/ dbyibs ni cung zad zlam zhing gru bzhi'e zur can/ bltas pa tsam gyes thang rgyal radres kyi skabs su bzhengs par rtogs thub bo/ spyir rgya yul gyi mchod rten bzhengs tshul la rgyal rabs rnams su mi myo/tshungs te/dper na/thang gi rgyal rabs kyi mchod rten bzhengs tshul gong du bshad pa ltar dbyibs cung zad zlum zhing gru bzhi zur brgyad kyi rnam/ pa can la rtse de ltar mi rno ba ste/ hran zhi zhis an(༅ ༅95zo)gyi mchod rten ming grags can thang zan bla ma'i(ོ༅ṣ+ṭha )/ta)re 'dod ltar gong ma thang go tsung (khyocholko)gis bzhengs pa'i ta

༅nga/ 'o sa la mas ba'imeloja/de /de— yun tha(ma 1rtso)dang zho yun tha (7/ 1 3 ) sogs dang gzhan yang hran zhis rgyus h+phun rdzong (0༅ zlo'〉〉gi dgon pa'i ming grags can sangs rgyas kyi phyag mdzub gyi ring bsrel 'phrul med du bzhugs pa'i h+pha min zi(lhu/ 3r+sha)dgon pa'i po tha (tshi /rtso)ste mchod rten brtsegs bcu gsum can de sogs yin no/su/nga rgyal rabs skabs kyi mchod rten ni dbyibs zlum po kho na rtse na slong bzed kyi rnam pa can te/ dper na/ hu nan krin kros(zo 〉/ /)kyi hro len zi(nga/ o+oṃ) dgon pa'i mchod rten rnams dang hu nan khe h+phun(༈'e/sgo/ lo ze/)kyi lcags kyi mchod rten chen mo(ṣ+ṭha7r+sha)dang / 'bri chu'i lho rgyud kyi su'u kros ( mo 1 / )kyi ming grags can gyi mchod rten (tsho༅1 rtso)hos chos tha sogs dang / gzhan yang bkang kros kyi los rung dgon pa'i(nga nya/ /1do hār+sha)mchod rten lta bu yin/ ta ming rgyal rabs kyi mchod rten gyi dbyibs ni gru bzhi kho na bya 'dabs ring du 'phyang ba rtse mo yang mchod rten chung chung gyi dbyibs can te/ dper na/ 'bri chu'i lho rgyud gyi yang gros ta men zi dgon pa'i (1rmi ) ṣi/ ngawa7)mchod rten dang su'u kros pe zi tha(ོ1〉/ /khu 1jo)mchod rten /su/'u gros han hran zi dgon pa'i (ཿlam )mchod rten lta bu'o/

— rtsom bsam 4gro྾ ༄gro3—༅/ /de—man chin gong ma'i ring la bod brgyud chos lugs dang 'brel ba zab pa'i rkyen gyis mchod rten bzhengs pa rnams kyang bod kyi mchod rten dang khyad par mi 'dug dper na/ pe cin gyi pe he mchod rten (46༈ snyong )stso)dang yas hu yan gyi ltag rgyab kyi mchod rten (ar+shakā༅/skoṣ+ṭhatsho)rnams kyis shes nus so/ dbus kyi mchod rten dkar bo de yi mtho tshad dang dbyibs gzugs mi de ltar yin la/ lho byang gi mchod rten rnam gnyis kyi mtho tshad la mus 43lhag tsam yod la/ thog brtsegs bcu tsam mchis so/ spyi lo 979lor dbus kyi gtso bo'i mchod rten gzhig gso byed skabs thang dang sung gi rgyal rabs skabs kyi rten rnying mang po rnyed zhes mchod rten gyi lo rgyus su gsal ba des kyang lo rgyus ches ring ba rtogs thub bo/ ar he mtsho mo'i stod kyi (༅༅)hrang bkan tu yun nan sa khul kun tu snyan grags shin tu che ba'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar dang ldan pa hos te chan (sgor+sāzlo)te ‘‘phye leb zung gi chu mig rdzing bu’zhes grags pa de yi lo rgyus ni 'di ltar/ sngon chu mig rdzing bu 'di dang thag cung zad nye ba'i sar na tshe sngon las kyi sa bon bzang po'i rkyen gyis lus kyi lang tsho mchog tu brtas pa/ phan tshun

—— 410 /de lo sa la mas ba'i me long r+shazloskorngopha bagle'echingazhar+ṣa—kyikun natsu r+yāde 'otho rigs na gzhon pho mo zung gis dga' skyid rtsed 'arjo'i 'tsho ba rol bzhin pa'i skabs shig la/ sa de'i gshed ma ma rung ba(cacha)zhig gis bu mo a dpas (457)mdzes sdug lang tsho yongs su rdzogs pa la chags te 'phrog par byed pa'i tshe/ a long (khrigo༅)gis mthong te 'thab par ma nus pa'i mthar/ a long dang a dpa' gnyis mnyam du shi bar gros 'chams byung ste/ rdzing bur mchongs pa'i yun ring zhig la ngo mtshar ba'i wu ba sgra dang bcas yang yang 'byin mthar/ wu ba mang bo'i klong nas glo bur du yid du 'ong ba'i phye leb zung gcig thon te mkha' la 'phur song/ de nas bzung sa 'dir phye leb zung gi grangs tsam gyis ga la tshad de mtha' yas shing grangs med do/ sngon nas da bar du phye leb rdzing bu 'di ni pe rigs mi dmangs kyi sems khong dbus kyi brtse gdung gi chu mig zhes brtsis mthong shin tu che'o/ de yis be rigs mi dmangs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i mdza' brtse mtshon thub/ lo re'i lug rnying gi zla bzhi ba'i tshes bco lnga nyin pe rigs mi dmangs na gzhon pho mo rnams kyis gzab 'phyor gos kyis spud de dwangs shing gsal la

—————kro ba — bsam rapo'i rang mngad5zo 4nga—gzugs brnyan 'bum phrag 'phos pa'i chu mig rdzing bu'i nye 'gram du yid 'ong phye leb sgeg mo 'bum phrag mang bos mkha' dbyings dri ma med pa'i klong na 'phur lding gis kun gas la du ri mo 'bri ba/ yid 'phrog g.yu lo sdem pa'i rkang 'thung ljon pa'i rtser dkar dmar mdzes pa'i 'dzum mdangs khongs nas rgod pa'i me tog khri phrag mang po'i dri bsung gi ngad du yid 'ong snyan dgur 'jo ba'i glu len zhing lta na sdug pa'i zlos gar gyi dpal la ci yang rol 'dug /chu mig rdzing bu de yi khar rang byung du grub pa'i rdo ka ma ru mtho tshad mus 6tsam zhig gi ngos su rgya'i snyan ngag pa ming grags can ko mo'o ros (7lotsho)gyis phyag bris gnang ba'i yi ge 'bri sa/sum pa (lha1lkoblo)zhig mig yul du mthong thub/ spyir krung go ni 'dzam gling du phye leb ches mang pa'i rgyal khab tu brtsi la/ rigs mi gcig pa'i phye leb stong phrag gcig dang sum brgya lhag tu slebs 'dug 'dir de'i brgya cha'i bzhi cu lhag tu son pa'i phye leb ches mang ba'i yul ljongs shig tu brtsi la/ deng sang sa 'dir rgya khyon che ba'i phye leb 'grem ston khang yang mchis so ar he mtsho mo ni mtho sgang gi mu tig (choṭha༅lko)zhes ming du grags

nga/de—— ma sa la mas ba྾rwa /de—'dug la/ dbyibs ni mi yi rna ba'i dbyibs su gnas pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis ming la'ang ar he (/po )zhes 'bod do/ mtsho ngos las mus 1972yod la( loyo)lho byang gi ring tshad la spyi le12lhag yod pa dang spyi'i ring tshad la spyi le 150lhag dang spyi'i rgya khyon la spyi le gru bzhi ma 250lhag dang mtsho'i zab tshad la mus 21mchis par bshad do/ mtsho yi steng du yid du 'ong ba'i gling gsum (zayam̐)yod la/ 'dir tshing hran ri bo'i gangs dang ar he mtsho mo'i g.yu mdangs lta bu'i kha dog phul du byung ba la khyad par du nang na yid 'phrog pa'i zla gzugs kyis kun nas mdzes par spud pas/ mi rnams kyis de la yun tshing yus ar (tshocorwa/jo)zhes bsngags brjod byed do/ des nang don ni lha‘dngul ri g.yu mtsho ’ zhes pa yin/ gong du brjod pa'i gling gsum gyi thog ma ni/ ar he mtsho mo'i stod la gnas (༅༅)pa'i gling te zho phos tho(71 stsakhyacu)zhes grags pa de yin la/ gnas 'di dang kre cang nan he phos tho hran (5smo/1sngakhyacuyo)gnyis dbyibs dang kha dog dang byin rlabs sogs gang thad nas khyad par med zhes bshad do/ lo rgyus la dpag na gnas 'di'i lo rgyus snga bar 'dug go/ phos tho hran zhes pa bo rnyi'i

/1 rtsom bsam rapo'irangamangang sa'i— 413 —ṅkas rizhesapa'inangadonamachisal bodhirmorte)byedro— — chub sems dpa' ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i gnas ri mtsho dang ldan pa'i na gru 'dzin zhes par thogs pa'i gnas 'di dag gtso bo 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la rgya'i skad du bkan yun phos sa smo7/ /cho//catsholo)zhes brjod la/ bkan yun phos sa ste spyan ras gzigs yang mo lha kho nar ngos 'dzin mdzad kyang / de ni pho lha yin pa'i nges pa'ang med la mo lha yin pa'i nges pa'ang ma mchis so rgya'i lo rgyus rnams kyi nang du spyan ras gzigs dbang rgyal bo zhig gi bu mo spun gsum gyi chung ba me'o hran (nya7/tsho)zhes pa'i skye ba bzhes pa'i de ltar grags so/ gnas 'dir bkan yun ta hri (7/khathoza )lte spyan ras gzigs dbang slob dpon gyi rnam pa can yun ring du bzhugs pa'i gnas zhes grags 'dug /gnas 'dir mjal ba'i nan he phos tho hran dngos su mjal ba dang khyad par med zhes bshad do/ ar he mtsho mo'i smad du ming grags can gyi gling (lo)bkan yun ki (7smozo/bla)ste 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gi lha khang byin can te brjid chags par gnas so/ gnas 'dir

— 414 —— 4 lo sa la mas ba'i me 'ong rlo r+sha r+shazlothorkyen ras gzigs rgan mo r+sha.o the'i rnarmorā— — dngos su phebs pa'i yul khyad par can te de'i lo rgyus ni 'di ltar/ sngon han rgyal rabs (༈5༅)kyi skabs su/ ta las sa phyogs 'dir dmag chen po'i dpung drangs te pham par rgol ba'i tshe/ spyan ras gzigs rgan mo bgres song gi rnam pa can des sa de'i mi dmangs kyi tshe srog skyobs pa'i slad du sus kyang theg par dka' pa'i rdo pha bong chen po zhig rgyab tu 'khur te dmag gi mdun 'gog par/ dmag mi rnams skyi g.yang zhing ha las te bshad rgyur/ rgan mo bgres song 'di lta bu la de 'dra'i nus stobs dang ldan na/ mi gzhan pa rnams bshad ma dgos so zhes de ma thag tu dmag dpung phyir zlog pa'i lo rgyus mchis so/ rjes sor mi dmangs rnams kyi rjes dran gyi phyir du lha khang dbus su lo bkan yun(tsu7smrapo)te spyan ras gzigs dbang bgres po'i rnam pa can gyi rdo ka ma ru'i sku gzugs de bzhengs so/ deng sang yang yid du 'ong ba'i rdo ka ma ru(nga1sprapo)kho na las grub pa'i ngo mtshar can gyi lha khang dang sku gzugs/ dgra dpung dngos su zlog byed kyi pha bong yang lha khang gi 'gram du mjal rgyu yod do/gling de yi phyi'i

— 422 —— tsha'athaḥ0yims ba'imelong zlor+shabakra yi kya rtagasamatshar+ṣajo+ochar 'o———zots+tsha4 rje tsong kha ba chen mo'i zhal snga nas gnas 'dir 'tsho zhing bzhugs pa'i mi rnams ni 'od srung chen mo dang smon lam gyi 'brel ba zab shing chos bsod che zhes dang / bdag gis 'od srung chen mo'i drung nas gsan pa'i chos rnams ma 'ongs bod yul gyi skal ldan rnams la dngos su 'chad par ma zad/ bod yul dad ldan rnams 'dir 'ong du bcug te 'od srung chen mo sku dngos su bzhugs pa'i gnas mchog 'dir mjal skor byed pa'i dge mtshan brjod do/ gnas 'dir rtse gcig dad pas phyag lan brgya rtsa brgyad bgyid na/ tshe rabs bdun gyi bar du bar ma chad par mi lus 'thob par gsungs so/ /de nas mdun du chas pa na/ cos len zi(16༅ya )dgon par thon thub la de ni rgyang nas bltas tshe yid 'ong me tog pad ma 'dab brgyad kyi kha 'byed pa lta bu'i ri yi zom na brjid chags par gnas so/ tshang tshing g.yu lo rnam par dgod pa'i rkang 'thung gi yal ga dri 'khyer dga' mas reg tshe shig shig gi sgra 'byin pa'i gseb nas ma rig gnyid las slong pa'i rang byung gi sgra dbyangs dang ting 'dzin chos kyi rol mo rgyang ring
