/de dartsom bsamang rapo'irangamangangasang 425 —ngh+rugasayide du'ongangh+ru shernezlozlod gon 'asdebang r+sha༅ mtha' then the tsong (ngachutsho)gi khongs gtogs dpazlo yun tsong(shāca khazlo)zhes brjod pa de yin no/ tshogs chen 'du khang nang du gtso bo'i lha ste (14ṇa rwa zo)kun rig gtso lha rnam gsum bzhugs la/ dbus su rgyu'i skad du 6‘phes los kri na h+pho’ (slokhuḍa 7smokhya/sko/)ste kun rig rnam par snang mdzad dang g.yas su 'jam dpal gzhon nu seng ge sngon mo la chibs pa (4lo+o༅༅zlo1nya0)g.yon tu 'phags pa kun tu bzang po glang chen dkar po la chibs pa ( s+dza ṣ+ṭhazo ༅r+sākhriza)dang gsum gyi sku gzugs yid 'ong brjid chags pa zhig bzhengs yod/ rgya'i kun rig rnam snang la (ngakhushākhulko)yang brjod 'dug dpa' yun tsong ni dpa' yun cun (2zo)chos kyi ming du thogs te dpa' yun cun ni (4nga8chu)mdo phal bo che yin/ de nas mdun du chas pa na cis bkang zi tshorkir+sha )dgon pa ste ming gzhan (cha/dzochor+sha)yang zer ba'i nang don ni sngon zhis han gyi ring la (7maca/ 0/)bzhengs par grags pa'i tshogs zangs chen mo zhig mchis pa'i lo rgyus ni/ rgyun par tshogs zangs chen mo 'di bkol spyod mi byed par ma zad dad ldan rnams

nga ༅nga༄4ཿ4༄ཿ4 / — ——3 nga— — 4r+shardo kyi mjal ba'i rten du bzhugs te mchod pa dang / bskal ba bya yi lo ste gnas mchog 'di yi gnas 'dus kyi skabs su dbon pa 'dir gnas 'dus kyi chos tshogs rgya che ba zhig 'tshogs/ pa'i srol mchis pas de yi dus su tshogs zangs nang du dngos su tshogs thug bskol ba'i srol yod do/ tshogs zangs nang du grwa ba stong phrag lhag la 'dren pa'i tshogs thug shong nus zhes bshad la de lta bu'i tshogs zangs gnyis yod par yang gleng 'dug dgon 'di ni ta ming dpong kri rgyal bo'i sku ring la (wa4shurtashālhoro/po1)la dpa' co'o an (tshim )zhes dgon pa chung ngu zhig mchis la/ rjes sor 'jig pa'i slar yang gong ma ca chin gyi skabs su(tshogri khro zo po )bzhengs par grags/ deng sang yang khor yug sogs shin tu dar la dad ldan mjal ba'ang bar ma chad pa lta bu'o//de nas mdun du chas pa na/ sngon shis than zi (skyam /dgon pa'i shul deng sang yang gnas 'di'i mgron khang chen mo(7gyi༅/khrizayo)dang thag cung zad nye ba'i sar/ming la (tsho7 /spro/zazo)yul te nas rgyang ring du bltas pa na ta las mchod rten rnam gsum yang shin tu gsal bo mthong thub po/ de dang

——— rtsom4 ༅sa༅—nga ra po'i rang mngangs— 427 — —cung zad nye ba namizlorā byed brgyalhagagi ya sngon gyisdongo— rgan chen po khog stong du gnas pa'i ngo mtshar ba zhig mchis la/de'i mtho tshad (cho)mu'u nyi shu dang / nang ngos kyi dong gi mtho tshad la mu'u bzhi tsam yod do/ de ni sgrub phugs mchog tu gyar ba zhig ste sngon rgya'i bkang zhis (ngapo)sa khul gyi dge slorngo zhig sdong bu chen po 'di'i phugs su mi lo bzhi cu lhag la sgom du bzhugs zhes bshad/de nas mdun du cung zad chas pa na/ gnas mchog 'di yi dgon gyi gtso bo hros hrin zi (tshozo /)dgon pa'i yid 'ong gi mdzes sdug mig sngar gnang thub la/ de ni rgya yul na snyan grags shin tu che ba'i slob dpon dam pa(tshozo775)byin yun zhes grags pa de yis bzhengs par bshad la/khong gnas 'dir phebs te hwa thos min (4tho/ ka)nas 'od srung chen mo'i gsung dngos su thos shing chos gsan pa'i tshe gnas 'dir dgon pa zhig bzhengs par dam bca'i ste spyi lo 1904lor dgon 'di thog mar bzhengs pa'o/de nas spyi lo 1953lo dang 1962lo sogs la rgyal khab gyis ma dngul spel te cung zad slar gso byas pa dang / gtso bo spyi lo 1964lor legs par

— 5 3ni—nga4———zho sngazal mas bu/lo /—— ——————bskyar bzhengs bgyis te da lta'i bar gyi rgya khyon 'di tsam zhig tu dar zhing rgyas pa'o/ /dgon 'di'i rten gyi gtso bo ni thub pa gtso 'khor rnam gsum dang de yi phyi rol du nan he phos tho cin zhes (stsa khyatunyihā )'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi ri bo gru 'dzin gyi zhing bkod sogs dang / g.yas g.yon tu dgra bcom pa gnas brtan gyi sde bco brgyad du grags pa(/15lnga༈7) 'od srung(༅/// stoḥ)dang rje btsun byams pa rnam gnyis (smo 7sto+o/)(rgya'i rjes sor bsnan par grags so)sogs rten gsum shin tu mang ngo / de dang thag cung zad nye ba'i sar deng sang rdo ka ma ru'i legs par bzhengs pa'i rgya'i slob dpon byin yun (1khritshe)gyi sku gzugs zhi nyams dang ldan pa zhig bzhengs yod do/de nas cung zad chas pa'i sar na/ rgyal khab phyi nang kun tu snyan pa'i grags pa ring du mched pa'i sgom ga khyad par du phyi yi rgyal khab 'jar pin(khyaḥ)dang the go(r+sā༅)bun le(r+sā lko)o min(4/ ka)zhin ca po(lko1/0lo)sogs su rgya nang gi dgon pa tro len zi (༅/ oṃr+sha)gnyis pa lta bu'i brtsi mthong che ba'i dgon sde hri krung zi (bo7shi )mchis so/ gtso bo dgon

༅——— 44ze45ku4 rangamangangs — —༅— — 'di'i sgom grwa dang drag rtsal/ (ma cho)phyogs la gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos yod do/ dgon 'di ni ta ming gong ma kros yan krang (smo877)gi tsha bu bzhi ba kros tes (lkom)ming gzhan gong ma yung li (75'a6so)yis hro len zi dgon par drag rtsal gzigs zhib gnang rjes de dang cha 'dra bar dgon 'di thog mar bzhengs par lo rgyus rnams su bshad do/dgon 'di deng sang yang rgyal phyi nang kun gyis sgom rtsal dang drag rtsal (maḥ)sbyangs pa'i gnas gtso bo zhig tu gyur to/de nas mdun du yun ring chas pa'i sar/ lo rgyus dang ldan pa'i jo mo'i dgon chen dpas kun an (spya1—/ca)te ‘shes rab sgron me'i dgon’zhes par slebs thub/ dgon 'di ni spyi lo 1605lor bzhengs la/ 1634lor je rgyas su btang bar grags pa dang spyi lo 1692lor cung zad gnod skyon thebs pa zhig gso'i byas pa sogs ta ming rgyal rabs dang man chin rgyal rabs skabs yang yang bzhengs la/ rjes sor 1952lo dang 1963kyi lo sogs la ci/ga gso'i byas pa yin no/lo bcu'i zing 'khrug skabs gnod skyon tshabs chen thebs par spyi lo 1963lor slar gso bskyar bzhengs legs par

— rjerje—༅ — —༷ —sngob—rgyaḥ4༅4————— ——byas so/ spyi'i rgya khyon mu'u gru bzhi ma 93)lhag mchis/dgon 'di'i rten gyi gtso bo gzhan dang mi mthun pa'i khyad chos dang ldan pa ste/ tshogs chen 'du khang (༅4/ rwa༅)gi dbus su 'dren mchog shākya'i dbang bo chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can yid 'phrog pa zhig dang / g.yon du rgya yul na mtshan gyi snyan pa ring du ldir ba'i dge slong grub chen gyi rnam pa can ‘‘ta mo tsos hri (7ṣ+ṭha rnyeskulo/ )ste rgya'i grub mtha' chen mo brgyad kyi nang gses te khran tsung ( lhotshi)gi srol gtod pa po/ grub chen ma tang ki ba yin zhes bshad tshul kyang mchis la gang ltar kyang grub pa'i tshad mthon por slebs pa zhig yin par rgya bod kun gyis mgrin gcig tu khas len no/ ta mo ni rgya gar gyi skad zur chag pa ste dharma zhes pa yin la khran ten te ( 4snyo4)sgom gyi phyogs la shin tu goms par bshad/ lo na gzhon pa'i dus su 'dren mchog shākya seng ge'i thugs sras nyan thos chen mo 'od srung dang gdung brgyud gcig pa rgya nag skad du ming la(1sku6༅7)po ro to lo zer ba'i slob dpon skad grags can te yongs 'dzin du bsten nas theg pa chen po'i chos skor spyi dang khyad par du zhi gnas la shin tu mkhas par gyur te

— rtsom bsam kher po'arangam ngas 431 —— sems can gyi don mdzad par phebs par dgongasanas —blob dpon la zhus pa'i/ slob dpon gyis khyed kyi 'gro don krin tan (ngaza)na yod par gsungs pas rdzu 'phrul gyis zhi bde rgya mtsho chen mo brgal te deng sang gi bkang gros (kha〉6/)grong khyer gyi bkang zho(lkochuco )dgon par phebs/ krin tan zhes pa ni krung go'i gna' ming yin par bshad/ de nas lang bos tes (༅ ma.oṃ)zhes pa'i rgyal bo des cin len sa char (༅tsho)gdan drangs/ cin len ni deng sang gi nan cin ( /hozo)la zer/ 'on kyang sa der rgyal bo dang skad cha mi mthun pa'i rkyen gyis bzhugs ma 'dod par byang phyogs sa khul du phebs par brtsams te 'bri chu'i khar slebs par/ 'bri chu rba rlabs dgung la 'phyo ba lta bu'i chu gzhong shin tu rgyas pa dang / 'gram na gru bo gcig kyang mthong rgyu mi 'dug par bya thabs med pa lta bur gyur ba'i tshe/ rgan mo bgres po zhig gi pang na 'dam rtswa phon po chag gcig ( ོlko)mchis par grub chen ta mos 'dam rtswa phon po ste g.yar bar brjod pa na/ rgan mo ya mtshar nas zhu rgyur/ khyed kyis 'dam rtswa phon po des ci byed/grub chen kyis bdag 'di la bzhugs te chu bo chen po 'dis pha rol tu

ngaX——432 ——— ——zho sa la 4lha sgru྾ —— — —4—brgal bar 'dod do zhes brjod pa na/ rgan mo dgod bzhin bdag chu bo chen po 'dis 'gram du lo mang por 'tsho ba bskyal yang 'dam rtsa'i nyag ma 'di lta bu chibs te chu chen brgal bar mthong ba lta ci thos kyang ma myong zhes zhu bar/ grub chen ta mos sngon krung gor to'o cos (yorma)chos lugs 'ga' zhig gis 'dam gzhong chen por brgal ba na mtha' na rkang rjes tsam yang mi lus par bgrod nus par bshad yod ma yin nam zhes brjod par/ rgan mos de ni yun ring sgrub sbyongs byas pa'i 'bras bu mngon du gyur ba'i grub rtags yin zhes zhu bar/ grub chen ta mos 'o na skyon med bdag kyang rtse gcig tu nyams len byed mkhan zhig yin zhes brjod mthar 'dam rtswa'i phon po chu la 'jog ma thag thog tu bzhugs te gru bzhin chu chen po'i pha rol du bde legs ngang brgal ba'i lo rgyus yod/de nas grub chen ta mo da lta'i hu nan zhing chen ( ༈khri/tsā/ )gyigo hran bro len zi (cho nga/ oṃs)dgon pa'i rgyab ri'i rang byung sgrub phugs (ma 87kho/)zhig tu lo dgu tsam mi g.yo ba'i ting 'dzin la bzhugs/ lo mang brag la sgom gtad pas nyid kyi gzugs brnyan brag ngos su gsal bor dod yod pa de yi ming

—4 rtso4ga 4tho—ra po'i rang mang /de la (otshobo)zer ba'i deng sang yang mjal rgyu yod/ grub chen ta mo dgon pa de'i rgyab rir rtse gcig sgom la bzhugs pa'i lo rgyus dgon pa yongs kyis grwa rigs rnams kyi 'tshol te rjes sor grwa ba yongs rdzogs khong gi slob mar gyur ba ma zad khong yang dgon de'i dgon bdag dang chos kyi slob dpon du gyur zhes bshad/ de dus su khong gis krung go'i khran tsong ( tsāzo )gi grub mtha'i srol gtod pa dang dgon 'dir thun mong ma/ yin pa'i rtsa rlung 'phrul 'khor dgra bcom rtsa rlung zhes (tha 4smor+ṣa )pa sbyangs pa'i srol byas pa nas bzung de la rmang gzhi byas te deng sang bar du hro len zi(༅/ oṃr+sha )zhes skad grags ldan pa'i rtsa rlung ngam lus rtsal la mchog tu gyur ba 'di bzhin no/gzhan yang khong gis srol byas pa'i 'khar gsil lcags kyi a long dgu mig can(༅lokhyu5)de la ta mo'i 'khar gsil zer(ca ) gzhan ta mo'i shes rab ral gri (zaṭha71)sogs mang bo deng sang yang mjal rgyu yod do/de nas grub chen ta mos khong gis dngos su bsnams myong ba'i chos gos dang slong bzed sogs thugs sras dpas khu

——— zo4/shaṃng— ༄4༄hrū4— —————— (phyutho1)la gnang te dgon 'di'i dgon bdag gi khur bzhes su bcug nas khong nyid yun nan sa khul gyi gnas mchog ri bo bya rkang phug 'dir 'ong nas 'od srung chen mo dngos su bzhugs pa'i sgom khang hwa bros min(4tho/ ka)gyi brag rtsar lo dgu'i yun thad mi g.yo ba'i ting 'dzin gyi klong du rol ba'i skabs su dbu skra sogs shin tu rgyas shing sa rdul gyis yun ring g.yogs pas rkyen gyis mjal mi rnams kyis grub chen ta mo'i 'jim sku zhig zhes ngos ma zin pa'i lo rgyas yod/ de dus khong gis hwa bros min gyi nang rol nas 'od༄ srung chen mos chos 'chad pa'i sgra dngos su thos par ma zad rtogs pa'i klong brdol bar bshad/ de nas hu nan lo g.yang (4khri1sgo/ /khyikhu/)gi sa khul ‘‘lung min chan hrin zi (༅/ ku༈zor+sha)dgon par cung zad bzhugs pa dang / mjug mthar hu nan sa cha'i deng sang yasayang rdzong (nya4 gotsho+olaza)gi khongs gtogs ri bo shong ar hran (khyismo༅༅)du sku mya ngan las 'das zhes grags so/dgon des tshogs chen 'du khang gi g.yas phyogs su rgya yul gyi thun mong gi srung ma lta bur bkur sti byed yul bkan tes (cho.oṃ)kyi sku gzugs bzhengs yod/ rgyal rabs gsum gyi

rtsom 45 bsamang ra po'irangamadangs — 435 —— lo rgyus khrod du deyimingalabakan yas(༅༷rtortezer yongs — grags su bkan kong (cho yi)zhes brjod do/ 'di ni rgya'i nor bdag srung ma gsum gyi ya gyal du bshad do/ bkan yas skye yul ni deng gi hran zhis krin shas bkan khrang phen sde ba'o((//jigiyoyo༅ tsho 7)rgyal rabs gsum gyi gtam rgyud (za54zlo༅)nang du khong gi lo rgyus rgyas pa yod/ khong ni dmangs khrod du snyan grags shin tu che ste dper na bod kyi ge sar rgyal bo'i sgrung lta bu zhig ste dmangs khrod du khong la mchod na bar chad zhi ba dang dgra bzlog pa/ ser ba 'gog pa/ 'bru bcud spel zhing longs spyod rgyas pa sogs la shin tu sman par bshad/des stabs kyis lo re'i dbyar zla lnga ba'i tshes bcu gsum nyin khong la mchod pa'i chos thogs sa khul mang bo na spel ba'i srol mchis/de la (༅lkolo༅)zer/ khong ni drag rtsal la 'gran zla ma mchis pa zhig tu gleng la dmangs khrod du khong gi rnam thar sogs 'khrab pa'i srol dar yod/ de la (lkoyi༅)zhes brjod do/ /des stabs kyis khong gi lha khang gi ming la (༅lo)'am (zalo)yang zer gyin mchis/ khong gi sku 'dra dgon pa la lar bzhengs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni rgya'i chos lugs khrod du

/de/de—mnartsosnga ———za༅5kro po'irangaḥ4 137 ༅)nub tu bskyod pa'i sgrung (wamilta /thu) tharje —drorne tsho rgya 'e la chos len tu 'gro ba'i lo rgyus dngos lha sgrung gi tshul du sgro btags te brjod pa'i nub tu bskyod pa'i sgrung ’ lo/tshelhashe6)zhes pa'i nang du gser 'od 'bar ba'i mchod rten(༅lko1rtso)zhig yod par bshad pa ni dgon 'di'i mchod rten gser 'od 'bar ba 'di la dpe blangs nas bris pa yin zhes gdan rabs su gsal/ deng sang shul tsam las ma mchis/ 'du khang chen mo'i nang logs su tsan dan dkar dmar (spo)/khye+o)las grub pa'i 'od srung chen mo'i sku gzugs gser btso mas brgyan pa'i yid du 'ong zhing brjid nyams ldan pa zhig mchis so/ lo re'i cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes gcig nas bco lnga bar tu dgon 'dir 'od srung chen mo (yo༅4sko'od srung chen mo sangs rgyas pa'i mtshan yin zer)mchod pa'i chos tshogs (ma༅zo)zhig 'tshogs pa'i srol mchis pa'i de'i dus su tsan dan gyi dri bsung zhim po 'du khang yongs la 'thul pa'i lo rgyus yod/mtshan mo'i dus su sku gzugs las 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro bar bshad/ deng sang gnas 'dir krung go nang bstan lhan tshogs kyi gtso 'gan bzhes te 'od srung chen mo'i sku gzugs

— ༷4— lde3gi—༷༷— —lo razoḥmusu༅༅go ༅nga—nga ———4thing las grub pa ljid tshad tun gcig tsam dang mtho chad la mus bzhi lhag brgal ba'i yid 'phrog pa zhig gsar du bzhengs yod do/de nas mdun du cung zad bgrod pa'i sar/ zangs sku'i lha khang cung zad chung ba zhig (ma/skom)mchis/ de yi g.yon phyogs su lam chung zhig yod pa'i stod du pha rdo cung che ba zhig mchis pa'i ming la ‘ ca hra hri ri(༅ lko bo)ste chos gos dbyibs can gyi rdo zer/ de ni lo rgyus su sngon 'od srung chen mo hwa bros min la sgom du phebs tshe rdo 'di'i thog tu chos gos bzhag par brjod pas deng sang yang rdo yi thog tu ri mo sngo skya'i chos gos kyi ri mo lta bu shin tu gsal bo dod yod pas nyams ma bzhag na chos gos zhig la 'phrul 'gro ba lta bu'o/ zangs sku'i lha khang zhes pa ni sngon ta ming rgyal bo krin tu'i skabs/wanashu1 //slo༅ / yi)su bzhengs par grags la/ de nas spyi lo 1952lo dang 1963 lo sogs la cung zad re zhig gso'i dang gtso bo spyi lo 1979 lor sa de'i pen khron rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung (lnga1//zatsholo)gis gtso 'gan bzhes te yul de'i dad ldan rnams

— /de —4ca—lhagab༅44rwa4nga4 ༅gro—zo—4 4kyis legs par bzhengs pa'o/ gtso bo'i rten ni sangs rgyas mar me mdzad(15 11/sko)gtso sku rnam gsum gyi sku gzugs mthong pa tsam gyis yid 'phrog pa zhig bzhengs yod do/ rgya'i de la (ngame rwa)zhes brjod mod/ don la 'das pa'i sangs rgyas gtso 'khor rnam gsum zhes pa yin no/de nas cung zad song ba'i sar gnas 'di'i rten gyi gtso bo/ 'od srung chen mo dngos su ting 'dzin la phebs pa'i brag sgo rang byung rgyun tu bdud rtsi'i zil ba khrom khrom du 'bab pa ngo mchar rmad du byung ba'i gnas sgo 'di'i mtho tshad la mus lnga bcu lhag dang / ring tshad la mus nyi shu lhag yod la/dbyibs ni cung zad zlum pa'i dper na 'du khang chen mo zhig gi sgo chen dang cha 'dra la sgo spyi kong ba'i dbyibs su 'dug pa'i dbus su sgo srubs shin tu gsal bo mngon thub pa'i mtho dman ran pa'i mtshams su rang byung rdo yi zwa chen po zhig brgyab 'dug pa dngos su mthong thub bo/ yun nan bde chen bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bod mi dad ldan rnams gnas 'dir mjal tshe thog mar sgo gnyer ba'i lag nas gnas sgo'i lde mig blangs te gnas mdun du phyag gsum 'tshal zhing de

—— 440 —— lo sarwalalamasagrib 'imelong/ rnorlor+yārgor+ṣarkerāskor+yāzlorloḥngar+shasgrurdo— — mjal zhing smon lam 'debs parte/ srol bzang po mchis so/spyir 'od srung chen mo gnas 'dir mi g.yo ba'i ting 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i rnam thar ni nga tsho bod shes yon pa phal cher gyis shes 'dug pas 'dir rgyas par ma spros so/ 'on kyang rgya'i bshad tshul ltar na 'di ltar/ ston pa'i gtad rabs bdun gyi thog ma 'od srung chen mo(sgo/po7khri/—rjestozlo)ni sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i thugs sras kyi gtso bo yin la/ khong gis sngon shākya thub pa'i drung du ma 'ongs sangs rgyas kyi bdun gyi thugs sras mdzad de sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyin mo bzhin du spel pa'i dam bca' mdzad do/ da lta'i shākya thub pa ni dang po dang ma 'ongs rnam 'dren lnga ba byams pa ni khong gis thugs sras mdzad yul gnyis pa'o/ des stabs kyis/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i ring gi chos gos ngo mtshar ba ste bsnams nas ma 'ongs byams pa ma phebs kyi bar du mi lo dung phyur lhag gnas 'dir mi g.yo ba'i ting 'dzin la bzhugs par dam bca'i la/ ma 'ongs rnam 'dren lnga ba byams pa rdzu 'phrul gyis gnas 'dir phebs te thogs ma'i chos 'khor bskor bar

nga ———ཿ rto phu 4༅n+d+raḥ ༅ ཿ ༅ darwa4 /——/—/——༷ brtsams pa na/ 'od srung chen mo'ang ting 'dzin las bzhengs te ngo mtshar ldan pa'i chos gos te rnam 'dren lnga ba byams pa la phul zhing 'khor gyi gtso bo thugs sras mdzad de sangs rgyas bstan pa nyi ma bzhin du spel ba'i grogs mdzad do zhes 'khod 'dug rje btsun byams pa'i mtshan la rgya'i skad du yongs grags la ‘ mes li (smra 7)zhes brjod par ma zad sku gzugs bzhengs tshul kyang sangs rgyas kyi tshul can dang / byang sems kyi rnam pa can rgya'i hwa shang gi rnam can (oṃ41/// 7)sogs du ma mchis mod/ spyir rgya yul du rje btsun byams pa dad pa byed pa'i thog ma zhis chin skabs nas (༅ cholo 1tsho/dar yod par mthong te/ dper na kun su'u pes len zi brag phugs (po /lo zatsa potshi)ngos kyi rje btsun byams pa'i sku gzugs ni zhis chen skabs kyi rgyal rabs lnga zhes pa'i skabs der (༅r+sā//4 4 ༅14shu)bzhengs par yongs su grags pa lta bu'o//bod kyi lo rgyus rnams kyi khrod du snang ba'i rgya nag hwa shang zhes pa ni rgya nag skad zur chag pa ste don la rgya nag gi hu hrang (1khya/ paṃ)te btsun pa zhes pa'i don yin la/ 'dir ‘pos te hu hrang ’’(7༅1shu/ mo)ni rje btsun byams pa mgon po'i rnam

— 4 ——go sa la masaḥ'o rwa 3 —————— —sprul zhig tu ngos 'dzin mdzad do/ khong ni sngon gyi rgyal rabs ‘‘bos te hos lang ’ gi skabs (rwa4྅ṭha༅ 0/༅)su 'khrungs bar grags la/ gtso bo ye len zi (cho.oṃr+sha)dgon par bzhugs par bshad/de ni deng sang gi kre cang zhing chen h+phun dpa' (rnya/yo༈1rtso༈6)sa char yin zhes brjod/ deng 'dir byams pa'i sprul ba pos te hu hrang 〉 gi lha khang ngo mtshar che ba zhig bzhengs yod la de'i ming la(nyo57tsho7)zer/ rgya nag gi gnas chen lnga yi grangs su'ang 'dren 'dug go pos te hu hrang khong gi chos ming la chis siza༅)zhes brjod/ khong ni gtso bo gnas yul nges med du phrag par khug ma zhig bsnams te bsod snyoms la phebs par dga' ba dang / mthong ba tsam gyis yid 'phrog pa'i sku yi mdangs bzang zhing sku sha rgyas pa/ snyan shal phrag rtser slebs thub zhing rgyun tu thugs dga' yal ler gnas pa/gzhan don sgrub pa la shin tu spro zhing chos la 'jug par bskul ba zhig yin zhes brjod do/ sngon gyi rgyal bo hos lang krin men khri lo gsum pa (ṭha ༅ yo༅zaro)spyi lo 917lor ye

rtsom ཿsamad rapo'i rangamang 4/dengྈngalen dgon pa'i 'gram gyi (chu7co)brag rdo zhig gi ngos rgya yig gis (yo7zayo ༈me 7zocatho7 khu༈khya /rme6 /ma 0/mkhrirasnyeshā0)rje btsun byams pa ngos yin pa'i 'gro don mdzad tshul gyi tshig 'di bris te zhi ba'i dbyings su gshegs so/ de nas bzung rgya nag lha khang phal che ba'i sgor (rwa/ ka༅)rje btsun byams pa'i rnam sprul khong gi sku gzugs yid du 'ong ba 'di bzhengs pa'i srol dar ba yin no/'ga' zhig gis pos te hu treng dang byams pa mgon po khyad par med pa lta bur 'dzin yang / rgya'i rje btsun byams pa dngos ni rgya'i byams pa'i chos gzhung 〈/smo 7༅༈sgrochu〉dang 〈mo 7—kho༅sgrorwa〉sogs las gsal bor bkod yod pa'i khong shākya thub pa'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i mjug tu mi lo dung phyur drug cu tsam gyi rjes su dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin gyi zhing nas (rgya'i de la smyo‘tos ses kong nya(༅ 2)zhes brjod)'dzam bu gling la phebs rjes ri bo bya rkang phug 'dir bzhugs nas chos gos dang slong bzed sogs blangs te thugs sras 'od srung chen mo dang mnyam du chos 'khor rim pa gsum du bskor zhes brjod do/

nga༅ thung ——lo sa lakhams—lha ba 34 ——— ——'od srung chen mo hwa thos min/ co/ /)gyi gnas 'dir ting 'dzin gyi dpal la dngos su rol ba'i tshe bkra shis pa'i ltas bzang sna tshogs a sngon dbyings su 'ja' tshon gyis gur phibs pa dang mthong na yid 'phrog pa'i spu sdug bya brgya'i rab snyan mgrin pa'i phugs nas chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrogs pa/rab mdzes thig le'i mdangs 'dzin shwa dang dgo ba'i grung grung dad pa'i mig gis blta zhing dga' zhing gus pa'i rnam 'gyur ngom pa dang / thig le'i sgro tshogs 'khur gyis mngon par dud pa'i rma bya dang bya yi rgyal bo ('aṭha)sosas kyis mdongs mtha'i 'dab ma lhug par grol ba sogs ngo mtshar zhing bkra shis pa'i mtshan ma mang zhes brjod 'dug/khyad par du zhu dgos pa zhig ni/ gnas 'dir skya rengs kyi sngo bsangs sgeg mos mdzes sdug ngom ma thag pa'i mjug tu mtshams sprin rtse dga' gsar ba'i 'od snang thog mar 'phros tshe khyed kyi rna ba'i lam du bu mo gzhon nu ma du mas mnyam gcig tu 'don pa'i chos kyi sgra dbyangs thos srid/ ngo mtshar nas 'di ci snyam du zhib tu bltas tshe da gzod khyod kyis des gsang ba rtogs srid de/ de ni lha bya yid du 'ong ba dag khyu

————— com ——ba༄༄༄4snga kror+yā/de —bzhin byas te mgrin snyan rol mo'i klong nas rgya skad kyi(31 khyanyu/sko 3rta khocu༈sko)zhes brjod 'dug pa rtogs thub bo/ /de ni rgya rnams kyis ming la (chu༈skoyikhritā)'am (ñtsa/skordza/)yongs grags su ming la ( ༅khya/ ñtsa)zhes brjod/bya de yi lo rgyus ni/ sngon bdag cag gi ston pa shākya thub pa la ri bo bya rkang phugs kyi ngo mtshar ba'i gtam snyan thog mar sgron mkhan lha bya gser gyi bya pho (༅79)dang bya 'di gnyis spun mched yin par bshad la/ gser bya yi sngon nas bya 'di la ri bo bya rkang phugs kyi phyogs bzhi'i mdzes sdug gi mthong snang bzhi dang gnas kyi ngo mtshar ba'i che ba brgyad sogs (/masna/kha157〉dang khyad par du gnas phug hwa hros min gyi lo rgyus sogs yang yang gsungs myong ba'i rkyen gyis bdag cag gi ston pa shākya thub pa dngos su gnas gzigs la rdzu 'phrul gyis phebs par rtsom pa'i tshe bya 'dis rjes su 'khrid par nan zhus byas mthar ston pas zhal gyis bzhes te gnas 'dir slebs rjes ngo ma dngos gnas yul ljongs mdzes zhing skyid pa la lha yul dang gnyis su med pa byin rlabs kyis yid sems spro ba zhig tu mchis phyir de nas phyir 'gro ma 'dod

—/ de ༅ 3zo— sngo sa la mas shīmelong par 'od srung chen mo'i gnas khang gi phyogs bzhi'i dad ldan mjal ba rnams yun ring du chos la brtson dgos par bskul ma mdzad bzhin gnas 'dir bzhugs so/ gzhan yang gnas khang 'dir ming la the tsi ki (mo/k+ka)zhes brjod pa'i lcags kyi spos khang cung che ba gdugs kyi dbyibs can zhig yod pa'i sar 'od srung chen mo'i mchod rten (5༅r+sā1rtso)zhes rgya'i mchod rten zung gcig mchis/ de yi nye 'gram du bdud rtsi chu mig zhig yod la de yi ming la (0ṣ+ṭharjehoblo)zhes brjod 'dugade'i lo rgyus ni 'di ltar/ sngon thang rgyal rabs kyi skabs su gnas 'dir gang nas 'ongs cha ma 'tshal ba'i grwa ba zhig mchis/ de'i ming la zho khrin (71 )zer/ de dang mnyam gcig tu bsdad pa'i grwa ba gzhan gnyis kyang yod/ khong tsho mnyam du sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu gzhol bzhin mchis so/ nyin zhig zho khrin gyis khong grong khyer du 'gro dgos zhes gar song cha med du gyur/ de nas cung zad 'gyangs pa na zho khrin phyir 'ongs te grwa ba de gnyis la bsod snyoms kyi zas slong bar/ grwa ba de gnyis ma rangs par bshad rgyar/ zho khrin khyod grong khyer la spro gseng du song bas da dung jod gnyis zas slong dgos sam

/de/ rtsom bsam ra po'i rang ma ngas 447 ——zhes brjod par zho khrin gyis ci yang mi smra bar hwa thos min sgye gnas sgor phebs te phyag gsum 'tshal par gnas gyi brag sgo rang 'gul gyis phyes de zho khrin nang du phebs par grwa ba gnyis kyis mthong te myur du brgyugs bzhin zho khrin lags cung zad sgugs rogs zhes brjod par gnas sgo yang rang 'gul gyis sgo brgyab par mthong 'phral grwa ba gnyis ka 'gyod gdung drag pos kun nas gzir te yun ring bshums pa'i mig chu sa la 'khyil rjes bdud rtsi chu mig 'di gyur ba yin zhes gdan rabs su gsal/ de la mi rnams kyis (khri7rdzo hoza)zhes brjod 'dug gzhan yang chu mig de ming gzhan zhig kyang mchis te cin cis mchan (༅7phyi lko)zhes brjod/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni gong du bshad pa ltar 'od srung gi bya zhes grags pa spu mdog ser bo gser gyi mdangs bzhin 'khyil ba mgrin pa'i phugs nas chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrogs pa de rnams zung byas nas bdud rtsi chu mig gi khar 'ongs nas chu 'thung ba'i srol mchis/ bya rnams dbyar dgun ston dpyid dus tshigs rnam bzhi nyin gcig kyang chad ma myong bar nges can du 'ong la grangs yang nyi shu las brgal mi srid par brjod/ chu mig

/de 448 /de lo sa la mas ba'i me long lto lor+ṣathogabaskamamamyongabarar+shad do—————————chu d+meg 'di'i nus pa'ang dmangs khrod du 'di ltar brjod de/ chu mig 'di mig nad can gyis mig sngar bskus tshe mig nad thams cad yongs su sel bar bshad la tshan rig smra ba rnams kyis kyang chu mig gi khrod du rdzas thun mong ma yin par (sgo/ 6/ 0zor+ṣazazlo)yod pas mig la phan zhes brjod 'dug gzhan yang phan tshun brtse dung zab pa'i mi'i chu mig 'di 'thung na yun ring phan tshun brtse dung zab shing 'gyur ba med zhes bshad do/'od srung chen mo'i gnas sgo'i brag gi ngos su gnas 'di yin pa'i bden dpang gi yig gzugs shin tu mdzes pa 'di ltar bris yod (‘ 4dzi3/ ka’’‘‘ ༅khu/ོlong za7’’)de'i 'od srung chen mo'i sgom khang yin par gsal byed byas 'dug/bdag ni dus tshod kyi dbang gis ri bo bya rkang phugs su nyin gsum tsam las sdod ma thub pa'i rkyen gyis gnas bshad kyi khongs su ma 'dus pa dang mi gsal ba ci mchis khyed gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan sngar 'chags so//de nas mdun du cung zad chas pa na/ rgya skad du ta pe

rtsom bsam ra po'i rang mdangs 449 — ki(zar+ṣa/k+ka)don la 'phags pa thugs rje chenamo'ilhakharngosmyos pa yin la/ming gzhan (ngaza/ka)yang brjod 'dug de yi byang phyogs su cung zad song pa'i sar brag rdo chen po khog stong zhig gi 'og tu 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sku gzugs byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar ba zhig mchis so/ spyir 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang ni bod yul dang 'dra bar rgya yul na'ang chos dad min gang yin yang mi shes pa med pa'i tshad du 'dug/ khong gi thugs rje'i byin rlabs ni lha gzhan dang mi 'dra bar myur bar 'dug zhes rgya mi yongs kyis khas len pa myong ba'i grub/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam 'phrul yang rgya yul na rigs mi 'dra ba mang du mchis kyang / yongs grags su sngon gyi rgyal rabs khron chos dus su ( ṣ+ṭhaspro/༅)rgyal bo khros krang (༅༅cha)zhes pa'i bu mo spun gsum yod pa las chung ba'i skye ba bzhes/ ming la me'o hran (nya7//tsho)zhes brjod/ khong chung dus nas sems rgyud dul zhing chos la spro ba/ gtong phod che zhing snying rje ldan pa/ lhan skyes kyi shes rab ldan zhing gzugs byad mdzes pa zhig yin zhes brjod/ khong rgyun du yul nges med la

—— 450 — lo sa lakhams ba'imelong1 rtserā zlo.ozhing modesnyomasarloh+pher+shatīrār+sharje skos cheze—rkyezlo bo de tsam chos la mi dga' ba'i rkyen byas te bu mo'i spyod lam mig la ma song bar shin tu thugs khros te bu mo gsod par brtsams pa na/ cung zad snying rje ste dngos su gsod ma nus par bu mo'i lag tu ral gri gtad de khong rang nyid gsod du bcug par (61/1)ral gri rang shugs kyis dum bur 'chags te bya thabs zad par slar yang bu mo'i dbugs lam bcad de gsod rjes rnam shes (zalko)sa bdag la dbul bar bka' bsgo ba na/(zathalolo ) ('di sa bdag gi don yin) bu mo'i lhan skyes kyi spyod lam dang thugs rgyud kyi snying rje'i yid 'phrog nas sa bdag cin lo bang gis( ༅zo)bu mo nan he phos tho hran(ca/ lostsakhya'uwa)du skyel ba'i bshad srol mchis/ de nas bu mo me'o hran gyis yid du 'ong ba'i khrus rdzing gi khrod kyi me tog pad ma 'dab phreng mngon par grol ba zhig yod pa'i dbus su nyin mtshan dus drug du chos la gzhol zhing yul de'i dad ldan rnams la ci la ci 'dod kyi tshul du chos kyi sbyin pa 'bad med du bstsal bar/ yul de'i dad ldan rnams kyis kyang khong nyid bzhugs pa'i lha khang rmad du byung ba zhig bzhengs par ming la

4ba༅ma karapo'irang ma༅༅ / /de tsi kros len bkan yun yan (tshokho/ oṃ7/khacotsho)zer la deng sang yang ri bo phos tho hran te gru 'dzin gling du mjal rgyu yod/de nas rim gyis gnas mchog nan he phos tho hran gyi gnas ri yongs rdzogs spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam 'phrul bu mo me'o hran gyi gdan sar (zolo)gyur ba yin zhes grags/ de nas cang ma 'gor bar yab rgyal bo gso dka'i bsnyun gyis zin te shi bar rtsom pa'i na skad cha de bu mos thos 'phral myur tu yab rgyal bo'i sar 'ong nas bod kyi rnam thar khrod kyi rgyal bu dri med kun ldan dang 'dra bar bu mo'i rang gi mig zung dang lag pa sogs yab kyi ched du bstsal te mi na du dril rjes yab rgyal bo la phul ba'i yab rgyal bos bzhes rjes snyun las yongs su thar te bde thang du gyur bar brjod/ rgyal bo'i sngon gyi bya spyod la shin tu 'gyod de bu mo'i drin lan gsab ched yul phyogs mang bo nas lha bzo grags can shin tu mang bo gdan drangs te 'phags pa thugs rje chen po(༅khyeṣ+ṭha༅r+sha7kha/tso/mi)zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa zhig bzhengs par bskul ba na lha bzo rnams kyis go ba log te rgya'i skad kyi 4’’dang ‘ca ’'dra bar thugs rje chen mo phyag stong spyan stong bi sku gzugs 'di

— 4nga lo sargyalakhams 3grongazo— —— ོ— bzhengs pa yin zhes grags so(༈ ོ༈khri//sna/khakhya༈6)/ /de rjes bu mo me'o hran yang sngar bzhin sku yi mdangs rgyas zhing sems can gyi don chen dpag tu med pa mdzad zhes rgya'i lo rgyus rnams su gsal lo/nga cag gangs can bho ṭa'i ljongs 'dir spyan ras gzigs dbang gis snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i gnas skabs kyi shin tu 'dul dka'i sems can 'dul slad du sangs rgyas bskal bzang stong rtsa'i dbus su zhum pa med pa'i dbugs 'byung zhing mthar dbu lus tshal ba stong du gyur bar 'od dpag med kyis byin gyis rlabs te phyag stong ni 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal bo chen po stong dang spyan stong ni bskal ba bzang bo'i sangs rgyas stong du byin gyis rlabs pa'i lo rgyus sogs rgyas par ma ṇi bka' 'bum dang thugs rje chen mo'i sgrub thabs rnams dang gzhan yang deb ther rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long sogs su gzigs par 'tshal/de nas cung zad mdun du bskyod pa na gnas mchog ri bo bya rkang phugs kyi ches mtho ba'i ri yi zom te mtsho ngos las he pa (khroyo)3240yod par grags/ de yi ming la rgya skad kyis

pa— gro༅ bsam nga ra po'i rang mngangs— 453 —— cin ten(༅ma)zhesa'abod la bod skad durkerārno rmye: zherā yid du 'ong ba'i ri dbyibs mdzes zhing dper na gnam gyi ka ba dbyings su bslangs pa lta bu zhig yin phyir ming gzhan (nga rnyetshoḥ)yang zer/de na dgon pa zhig mchis par ming la(chuyo / )zer/sngon dgon 'di'i 'du khang gi rgya phibs gser zangs kho na las grub pa yin par bshad la rgya phibs yang spyi lo 1637lor khon men gyi ri bo men h+phun hran (khrizhu'al)nas gnas 'dir gdan drangs 'ongs pa yin par grags/ gzhan yang spyi lo 1934lor gsar du bzhengs pa'i mchod rten thog brtsegs bcu gsum du longs pa zhig yod la mtho tshad mu'u bzhi cu zhe gnyis tsam mchis/ mchod rten de yi rab gsal nas rgyang du bltas tshe a sngon gnam gyi mthongs nas mar du blta ba ji bzhin shin tu rgyang thag ring ba'i gnas kun lag mthil du bkod pa ji bzhin gsal bor mthong thub bo//gtso bo ri yi rtse mo 'di nas shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhi la bltas tshe thun mong ma yin pa'i yul ljongs bzhi yi mdzes sdug mig sngar snang thub pas su bkan zhes ming du grags la/

nga——— 454 sa la mas 44 — — —༅ sngon ta ming ban las (༅547khya1༅//1)kyi skabs su gnas kyi rtse 'dir mkhar rnying zhig yod par grags la ming la(lnga)1/ shā )zhes brjod/mkhar dar sgo bzhi dang lcog bzhi yod par grags la lcog bzhi'i rab gsal kha nas mi 'dra ba'i yul bzhi snang thub pa sogs ngo mtshar dang ldan yang lo rgyus kyi 'phel 'grib kyi dbang gis mkhar 'jig rjes deng sang gi cin ten zi(༅maco)dgon pa 'di dar ba yin no/rgya'i skad du su'u bkan (yasmokhu)te yul ljongs thun min bzhi snang thub pa ni 'di ltar/ shar phyogs su/ tho rengs skabs su mtshams sprin rtse dga'i mdangs la chibs te rim bzhin mtho ru 'phags pa'i khri gdugs nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shin tu gsal bo snang thub pa'i yid dbang med du 'phrog nus so/spyir rgya yul gyi ri bo the hran(chol) dang / glang chen 'gying ri(loṭhayi)/ dpang hran(mol)/dpal ri rtse dgu(༅ཿla)hran zhis krung nan hran(༅ca/ la) lo'u hran(ཿyi) nan he gru 'dzin(stsakhyonyu7) hran shi ri bo rtse lnga(1khri/6) kre cang bos tang hran(zazoyo)sogs kyi ri rtser nas nyi ma'i 'od snang sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i mdzes sdug lta ba'i srol mchis

na rtsom ga bsam rapo'i rangamangangs1 455 — rkyeng phal cheragasal borasnang mi thub pa daderjetho— — mtshungs la / gtso bo tho rengs chu tshod drug nas brgyad bar bltas na shin tu legs/ de la (lko7smobram)zhes brjod do/lho phyogs su rab dkar ba zho gsar ba'i phung bo spungs 'dra'i sprin gzhon mdzes pa'i lang tsho rim gyis gyen du 'phags pa'i mtshar sdug snang thub la de yi dbyibs ni skabs 'gar glang chen sa la rab brtan pad+ma'i khrus rdzing du dal bar 'jug pa lta bu dang skabs 'gar yang lha yi bu mo gar la chas pa lta bu sogs ngo mtshar ba'i mdzes sdug snang thub bo/ de yi ming la (ca/ gaku1roza)zhes brjod do/ nub phyogs su ta las sa khul gyi mtshar sdug snying bo 'bum ldan gyi mtsho mo baiḍūr zhun ma sa la 'khyil 'dra'i ar he mtsho yi mdzes sdug yongs rdzogs 'dren byed kyi dpal du snang thub bo/ /de la(༅ཿkhu/tholo)zhes bris 'dug go/byang phyogs su4las kyang sa khul(cho༈ 1) ’ming du grags pa'i gangs ri (rwa༅ zol)de yi mdzes sdug shin tu rgyang ring bo'i sa gnas mngon par mig gi dpyid dpal du snang bir som nyi ci/ de la (ca/ za༅746༅'a7)zhes sngon nas grags

ca ṣ+ṭha ༅ngo4༅4༄4༅ phyo ——————— — 4 'dug la don la'ang 'jar yinami dmangs/ kyi bla ri ming grags can rgyus hri hran (tshicakhu/)gyi mtshar sdug dang khyad par cung zad kyang med zhes brjod 'dug 'jar dzin h+phos hri hran ni mtsho ngos las he pa 3776yod par grags so/ gong du brjod pa'i mdzes sdug gi dpal la mi rnams kyis (ska65smrarwa༅ sgoyi)zhes bsngags kyang brjod do/rgya gar gyi bya rgod phung bo'i ri dang khyad par ci yang med pa'i gnas mchog ri bo bya rkang phugs kyi snod bcud kyi bkod pa re zhig bshad zin to/ /de nas phyir khon men (tsha༅)grong khyer la lam du chas tshe sngar bzhin ta las grong khyer brgyud nas 'gro ba'am yang na pen khron rdzong (ji)//zo)nas thad mar khon men du rlangs 'khor mchis pas gang bde byas chog bro/khon men grong khyer nas spyi le bco brgyad tsam gyi sar rgya nag yul gru kun tu snyan pa'i grags pa rab tu ldir ba dgra bcom lnga brgya'i gdan sa lta bu ‘ chong kros zi(༅/ 4rku6)dgon par slebs thub po/ spyir rgya yul du dgra bcom lnga brgya bzhugs pa'i (1bo༅༈7)gnas dper na si khron khrun tu'u kyi shin tu'u dgra bcom lnga brgya (1tho༅༈7)dang (mo/shākhu)gzhan

rtsom bsam rapo'irangam ngas/1gordo/de/su'u gros kyi zhis yan zi(༅ ༅tso)dgon pa'i dgra bcom lnga brgya sogs mang du mchis kyang dgon 'di'i dgra bcom lnga brgya'i bzo bkod ni yid las 'gongs pa zhig yin par grags so/ gnas 'dir tshang tshing g.yu lo rab tu rgyas pa'i dga' tshal gyi khrod du dwangs gsal lha yi rdzing bu lta bu'i bdud rtsi'i chu mig rang byung du 'bab pa sogs sa yi dge bcu ngang gis grub pa zhig go dgon 'di'i lo rgyus ni/ sngon ta las rgyal khab (zayos༅ma༅71(༅༅))kyi skabs su/ rgyal bo ko bkang (lo༅)dang / ko kri(chos)spun mched gnyis ka rngon pa'i tshul du sa 'dir 'ong nas ri dwags gsod par gang nas phebs par cha ma 'tshal ba'i dge slong zhig 'dir slebs rjes khong gis sngon 'gog ste phyag rten sa la 'dzugs par/ rgyal bo spun mched gnyis kyis ma rangs par dge slong de'i phyag rten sa nas 'bal kyang ma nus par ma zad 'gul kyang ma 'tshal ba'i rkyen gyis chos la dad de sa 'dir dgon pa zhig 'debs par khas blangs/ de nas dge slong de'i phyag rten kyang rang bzhin gyis chong kros (yo7rtse)zhes pa'i smyug sdong yid du 'ong bzhig tu gyur to/ de la brten nas dgon pa des ming yang

——/de58 —— —spro la mas ba'imelong——— /de(po/yor+sha )zhes brjod 'dug gong du bshad pa'i dge slong de yang dgra bcom pa zhig gi rnam 'phrul yin par grags pas/lo rgyus sogs la gzhi byas te man chin gong ma bkang zhis kyi skabs su (༈smo༅7r+ṣa/khya1)spyi lo 1665nas 1691 lor ming grags ldan pa'i dgra bcom lnga brgya'i sku gzugs bzo bkod phul du byung ba can de bzhengs pa yin no/ da lta'i bar du yang gson nyams ldan pa'i dgra bcom lnga brgya'i sku gzugs kyang mjal rgyu yod do/yun nan sa cha'i gnam 'og gi brag phugs rang byung (chasmo༅— ma)klu yi pho brang du grags pa'i gnas chen de ni khon men grong khyer nas spyi le 200lhag tsam na brjid nyams ldan par gnas so/ de yi ming la rgya skad kyis (tapor+ṇakhyem)zhes brjod/ los zhis rdzong (khopo4)nas spyi le gsum gyis slebs thub/ gnas 'dir sngon yon rgyal rabs skabs nas mjal skor ljongs rgya byed yul gtso bo zhig tu 'dzin to/ ngo mtshar 'bum gyi snyirngo bo dang ldan pa'i sgrub phugs chen mo 'di yi nang rol du dus gcig la mi grangs sum brgya lhag shong zhes bshad/ brag phug chen mo'i dbus su dwangs shing bsil ba'i

/tshos rtsom bsam ra po'i rang mngangs —— 459 —————————/de —————— — —ngardza chu rang byung du 'bab pa de la deng rabs tshan rig gi glog 'od sna tshogs kyis kun nas brgyan pa'i yid dbang 'phrog nus la/ gzhan yang rang byung brag dbyibs glang chen gyi nyams dang seng ge lta bu/ shang shang gar la chas pa lta bu dang khrung khrung dkar mos gshog 'gyur bgyis pa lta bu dang lha yi mdzes ma mkha' nas 'bab pa lta bu sogs mang du mchis la/ rdo yis brag phug gi ngos su rdung tshe rang byung gi sgra dbyangs pi wang bi sgra lta bu dang 'khar rnga'i sgra lta bu/gzhan yang gaṇa ṭī'i sgra dang ting shag gi sgra lta bu sogs kyis rna ba'i dbang bo 'phrog par nus so/ gzhan yang dwangs gsal khrus rdzing yid du 'ong bar gser mig nya yi tshogs kyi kha dog shin tu dwangs gsal shel gyi rang bzhin 'grib pa med pa thog nas 'od 'tsher ba phyi nas bltas tshe nya yi khog nang gi don snod sogs kyang gsal bor mthong thub pa ma zad nya'i sgal gzhong gi rus gzugs kyang mthong ba'i mi rnams ya mtshan skye ru 'jug go de la lo ṭ+wāṃs ṭ+wāṃg kyang mchis mod 'dir yig tshogs bskyungs phyir ma bas ༵/ga phugs nang du gtso bo gnas mjal byed yul gnyis

—dza—nga3—8ngh+ru༄44khumu4lha4 4r+sāzo1 ———————te dgra bcom pa'i sgrub phugs su grags pa de dang (khya 54 //1)klu yi pho brang du grags pa(rwalo༅ cha )de gnyis yin no/ bdag ni gnas de gnyis zhib mjal byed pa'i khom skabs de tsam ma mchis pas rkyen gyis 'dir gsal bshad bgyis med pa'i khyed cag gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan sngar 'chags so/ khon men grong khyer nas spyi le 260 tsam gyi phyogs su sa de'i grang rigs mi dmangs dang (4ṭha)me'o rigs mi dmangs (tsho/ //ri )kyi rang skyong rdzong chos pe(yo 46zo)zhes grags pa'i sa char ‘bkas len ri chu gnam 'og na mdzes ’zhes grags pa'i(ོ ༈ 6/7khritshozarwa)gnas de dang khyad par ci yang med pa'i yul ljongs shin tu mdzes pa krin nan bkas len (r+sāsgo/ ṣ+ṭha ༈ )zhes par slebs thub/ yas rigs ( lo)kyi skad du sa de'i ming la ‘‘phos kri has/ (༈/ rtsasta)zhes brjod par don la nya rigs mang ba'i rdzing bu zhes pa yin no/ yul ljongs de yi mdzes sdug gtso bo ni ri yi dbyibs sna tshogs te maṇ+ḍal spungs pa lta bu dang rgyal bo gdan khrir 'khod pa lta bu/ bu mo bag la chas pa lta bu sogs kha dog legs shing dbyibs gzugs mdzes pa rnams kyi bar gseng du baiḍūr khu ba lan brgyar byug 'dra'i mtsho dang

ོ———4ma bas༅da raposgru ༄ 4rwa/nganyu/ /— du — — mtshe'u sngo mer gyis gtams par me tog chu skyes dkar dam/ra dang ut+pal sngon mo sogs mdzes par bzhad pa'i dbus su khrung khrung dkar mo dang ngang ba ser po sogs kyis mgrin pa 'i rdza rnga snyan par 'khrol zhing yid du 'ong ba'i gshog 'gyur bsgyur ba'i mdzes par byas pa'o/lha yul gyi zhing khams mi yul du 'phos pa lta bu'i yul ljongs khyad par can yongs grags su sems kyi nyi zla'am byang phyogs sham bha la yi zhing khams gnyis par brjod pa / (r+shayotsho/3)yun nan zhing chen bde chen bod rigs rang skyong khu' ni yun nan zhing chen gyi nub byang phyogs su sanas yod la/ khul 'di dang nga tsho bod rang skyong ljongs/ si khron zhing chen bcas kyi sa cha 'dabs 'brel tu gnas shing / de yi gzhogs shar du 'bri chu (yi༈༅/ /1)dang / nub phyogs su zla chu (/zlalo/1 )sogs gser gyi bye ma 'dren bzhin dal gyis 'bab bzhin mchis/bde chen bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi mnga' khongs su gtso bo bod kyi rdzong khag gsum te 'jol (ṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha)dang 'ba' lung (2khu po)rgyal thang ( mi)bcas yin la/ khul mi dmangs srid gzhung ni rgyal thang du gnas yod do/ sa 'dir gtso bo gangs

———༷ngang22 nga——༅4lakhamangabastso༅4————————dkar shel gyi mchod rten dgung la zug pa lta bu dang grog rong shin tu zab pa klu la bsnyeg pa lta bu/ mtha' yas mu med kyi rtswa thang yangs po gnam sngon sa la 'khyil ba lta bu sogs yod do/ sa 'dir gangs ri shin tu mang te rgyal thang rdzong (rko.oṃ4)gi mnga' khongs su mtsho ngos las he pa(77)4000 lhag la slebs pa'i gangs ri yid du 'ong ba bzhi brgya dang bdun cu lhag yod par grags/ chu bo chen po ming du grags pa gser gyi bye ma 'dren pa'i 'bri chu ni (༅7/ 41)ba yan ha ri'i lho phyogs nas byung ste rim bzhin mtsho sngon dang si khron sogs zhing chen dang rang skyong ljongs dgu brgyud de mthar hrang he grong khyer nas shar gyi rgya mtshor 'bab/ 'on kyang bdag bde chen bod rigs rang skyong khul du dngos su 'gro ma thub pas go thos ltar bris pa yin phyir 'dir 'bri chu zhes pa chu chen ‘ /j-i/1)te yin min dpyad gzhi mchis so /gzhan yang zla chu (// lko//kyi/1 )ste rang rgyal lho nub sa khul (kyo—tshe1rgya )gyi chu bo chen po zheg te/ chu yi stod rgyud rdza chu (༅yo 11)dang ngom chu (bla/yo ༈ 1)zhes pa gnyis yod pa gnyis ka mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi khongs gtogs gdang la (khyakhye/growa)ri rgyud gyi byang ngos nas byung

— — 4ཿ / ga zo0༄ཿ༷/ — ༷ 1ོ 1— zhing / bod rang skyong kyi grong khyer chab mdo'i (ṭhasko/ṭ+wāṃ)'gram du chu bo de gnyis 'dres rjes brag g.yab (choḥ〉dang mdzo r+sha nga (༅mo)smar khams ( ca.o)de nas yun nan zhing chen gyi bde chen bod rigs khul brgyud de rim gyis rgyal mtshams kyi phyi rol tu 'bab skabs ming la sme kung gtsang bo (༈khyu3co༈0/)zer la mthar phyis rgyal khab yo nan (losto/ )gyi lho rgyud nas lho mtshor 'bab/ gzhan yang gnas 'dir rgyal khab phyi nang kun la snyan pa'i grags pa ring du mched pa'i gangs ri rong chen kha ba dkar bo zhes pa (yotsho sgo/1)ste brjid chags yid du 'ong bar bde chen rdzong gi nye 'dabs (tshorguṣ+ṭha༅lko46ོkhaṃ/)su gnas so/ de ni bod gangs can gyi gnas ri grags can brgyad gyi ya gyal du brtsi la/ mtsho ngos las he pa(loyo)6740tsam mchis pas yun nan sa khul gyi ches mtho'i gangs ri gcig pu lta bu lags/ dus rabs nyi shu'i skabs su gnas ri 'dir dbyin ju (༅༅)dang / a me ri ma 〉༅) 'jar pin(bro)krung go sogs kyi lus rtsal tshogs pa thengs lnga tsam ri rtser (0lalo)'dzegs kyang mthar ma phyin pa'i shin tu gzar zhing 'dzegs dka' ba'i gnas su brjod do/ sked

—spra5 bhe4 rgyu༅4sa ba'i4/ja— — ——d+nghaskabs kyi mtshams su tshang tshing g.yu lo'i mngon par 'grib pa dang 'dabs su skad grags can gyi chu bo chen po zla chu ni g.yu 'brug sngon mo sa la 'khyil ba bzhin brjid chags 'gying nger gnas pa'i shel gyi mchod rten dgung la zug pa lta bu kha ba dkar bo la g.yas bskor gyi tshul du kun nas brgyan pa'o/gzhan yang rgya'i skad du ming la(zakho1stso)zhes grags pa'i mtsho mo yid du 'ong ba de ni rgyal thang rdzong ( khi.oṃ)nas spyi le 25 tsam gyi mtshams su gnam sngon baiḍūr zhun ma sa la 'khyil bzhin mig gi dpyid dpal du snang thub la/ mtho dman mtsho ngos las spyi khri 3539lhag dang / spyi'i rgya khyon la spyi le gru bzhi ma040yod la/ chu'i zab tshad la mu'u 20lhag yod zhes brjod 'dug de lta bu'i mtshon pa'i bde chen bod rigs mi dmangs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i shes rig dang sgyu rtsal/ chos lugs dang glu gar rol mo sogs mtha' yas pa mchis kyang 'dir re zhig brjod pa de tsam mo//gzhan yang las kyang sa khul (tsho/11)du gnas pa'i na shes rigs (༅༅ཿ)kyi ngo mtshar che zhing thun mong ma yin pa'i tong pa rig gnas sam ston pa'i rig gnas(lko༅ 446)

———— ——44444rapo'iro dzengh+ruXng༅ sogs rang rang gi 'od stong ldan pa'i shes rig gi lo rgyus sogs dang / yul gyi dge mtshan yun nan zhing chen yongs la ming grags shin tu che ba'i gangs ri mdzes pa(rwa༅nga//mi)dang /yas lung gangs 'dabs su gser gyi bye ma 'dren bzhin dal gyis 'bab pa'i 'bri chu zhes pa(༅༈pā/snye1)sogs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i mdzes sdug gi dpyid la 'jar pin rgyal khab yongs la ming grags che ba'i gnas ri rgyus hri hran(blo 01)gyis kyang 'gran par ga la bzod/gtso bo gong du bshad pa ltar yun nan zhing chen ni krung go'i rgyal khab khrod du mi rigs ches mang ba'i sa cha dang /rig gnas dang lo rgyus/ gna' shul dang gna' rdzas sogs ches phun sum tshogs pa'i zhing chen zhig kyang yin/ gzhan yang gnas mjal dang ljongs rgyu spro gseng byed yul ming grags ldan pa zhig yin pa smos ci dgos/ mi rigs so so'i rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas dang lo rgyus sgyu rtsal dang glu gar/ chos lugs dang tshan rig sogs khyad chos 'bur du thon pa zhig te dper na/lha yi zhing khams mi yul du brjid pa lta bu'i hri len (bo.oṃ)te shel dkar gyi mchod rten 'bum

— ༵4 ༅ / —nga pre—su༄ ma4hrū ༅4ོ— ————phrag bzhengs pa ji bzhin rdza ri rang byung dbyibs gzugs dang kha dog shin tu legs pa/'i gnas ri ngo mtshar can de ni yas rigs mi dmangs dang sa nyes mi rigs kyis yab mes nas brgyud pas shes rig dang goms gshis tshan rig dang lag rtsal sogs kyis yun ring du srung skyobs dang zhig gso'i byas pa'i grub 'bras sam 'bras bu dang krung go'i gna' bo'i rig gnas kyi bang mdzod lta bu rgyal khab rim pa'i ljongs rgyu byed yul rmad du byung ba ta las ni(nga1tsho)lo ngo stong phrag bzhi yi lo rgyus ldan zhing khyad par du thang rgyal rabs skabs su bzhengs pa'i nan kro go (smo /pu༅)dang sung rgyal rabs skabs su bzhengs par grags pa'i ta las go(snyang1smra༅)sogs ni rgyal khab phyi nang la snyan grags shin tu che ba dang / ngo mtshar ba zhig la rgya nag gi ches snga ba'i lo rgyus kyi sgrung gtam ring mo lha klu sde brgyad’ ces pa(za༅15lo)de yi khrod du yun nan sa khul gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i grong khyer ta las go (1nga11bo)zhes 'khod yod pa dang gzhan yang tshing hran ri bo'i brgyud dang ar he mtsho mo'i 'gram du 'gying nger brjid chags pa'i ta las mchod rten rnam gsum ni srid na mdzes zhes sngon nas

sa ma bsamad rapo'i rangam5༅/de/ de —rgyal khab phyi nang kun tu snyan pa'i grags pa ring du ldir ba sogs ni sa de'i pe rigs mi dmangs dang (༅ṣ+ṭha〉yas rigs mi dmangs kyi lo ngo stong phrag mang bo'i rmad du byung ba'i snying stobs dang las la brtson pa'i 'bras bu kho na las grub pa zhig yin par som nyi ma dgos so/ khyad par du rkang gnyis rnams kyi ston pa 'dren mchog shākya'i dbang bos lung gis bsngags pa'i gnas mchog rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi ri bo bya rgod phung bo'i ri dang cung zad kyang khyad par ma mchis zhes rgya bod tshad ldan mkhas grub rnams kyis yang yang bsngags pa'i gnas ri byin can 'od srung chen mo dngos su bzhugs pa'i gnas mchog ri bo bya rkang phugs zhes grags pa'i byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar ba sogs ni ta la'i sa khul gyi mi dmangs yongs dang khyad par du yul de'i mi dmangs kyi tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i rnam dkar gyi 'bras bu kho na yin par gdon mi za'o/ gzhan yang bde chen bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi sa cha ni deng sang 'dzam gling yongs la zhing mchog ‘‘shing ki las la zhes (chocho༅༈3)brjod pa don la'ang sa de'i bod mi dmangs kyi sems nang gi nyi zla lta bu'am byang phyogs

—rwa༄8 ——— tsha4la mas r+sā1r+yā————sham bha la yi zhing khams dang gnyis su ma mchis pa'i gangs ri'i phreng ba mtho tshad rgya mtsho ngos las spyi khre stong phrag lhag brgal ba'i gangs ri bzhi brgya bdun cu lhag gis yongs su/ bskor ba/ khyad par du gangs can bod mi'i gnas mchog brgyad kyi ya gyal shel dkar gyi mchod rten dgung la zug pa lta bu'i ming grags ldan pa'i gangs ri kha ba dkar bo zhes pa(yo༅sgo )mtsho ngos las mtho tshad la mus stong phrag drug dang bdun brgya bzhi cu lhag la slebs pa'i ri chen dang gzhan yang 'bri chu dang zla chu sogs chu chen gyis mtshon pa'i sa yi dge bcu dang srung bzhi sogs yongs su rdzogs pa/ de'i mtshon pa'i mi rigs rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i shes rigs dang lo rgyus/ lag rtsal/ glu gar dang rol mo sogs brjod kyis mi lang pa zhig mchis mod 'on kyang dus tshod kyi dbang gis re zhig skabs su 'bab pa ni 'di tsam mo//spyir bdag gis ma hā tsi na'i yul gru chen mo de yi khyad 'phags kyi gnas ri dang thun min gyi grub mtha' chos lugs kyi lo rgyus/ ljongs rgyu byed yul gnas mchog ngo mtshar ba rnams zhib bshad kyi skor zhig 'bri 'dun mchis kyang gtso bo

rtsom bsam da ra po'i rang mngangs — 469 ———dus tshodakyi dbang—ṅgas bya r+shanetsung— r+ṣarā—r+yārāzlo pa dang gzhan yang mkhas pa'i dbang po sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis/ deng sang dus na lo grang rgan gyur na/ /blun po rnams kyang gtsug tor ji bzhin te/ /shes rab rgya mtsho'i ngos ltar yangs pa yang / /gzhon nur gyur na tshad mar 'dzin pa dkon zhes gsungs pa ltar khas len min du ma mchis phyir re zhig bzhag go /deng gi dus na rgya bod yig rigs kun la nang byan chud pa'i gzhon nu rnam dpyod yangs pa rnams kyis 'jig rten 'du 'dzi long long gi bya bar mi g.yeng bar rang gi mi rigs kyi ched du byas rjes re 'jog ci thub byed pa shin tu gal che'o/'dir smras pa/kye kye blo gsal thig le'i 'dab yangs pa//legs bshad sbrang rtsi 'thung la brel ba'i tshogs//'di na lo rgyus ge sar 'bum bzhad pa//dga' bas gar gyis rol la cis mi rigs//mkha' nas snyan par ldir ba 'brug sgra'i dbyangs//sa la sgeg 'gros rma bya'i snying la bzhin//

rtsom bsamang rapo'i rang mang45— 473 — —oblumangathoskerob gnam la 'khrerjelo rtse ded+kudejozlozlo pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ logs la bkra shis rtags brgyad/ gzhan yang sa yi dge bcu dang srung bzhi/ ka bzhi gdung brgyad sogs kyi mtshon pa'i sa yi dge mtshan rmad du byung ba steng na mala' dbugs dwangs shing bar na khor yug gtsang ba 'og na yul ljongs mdzes pa zhig ste/ de ltar rgyal phyi nang kun tu grags che la khyad par du gangs rin po che dang hi ma la yi ri rgyad du gnas pa'i jo mo glang ri sogs kyi khrod du lo ngo stong sgrog mang bo'i ring la nyi mas drod kyis gzhil du med pa'i chab rom gyi gur khang dang mchod rten 'bum/ phrag mang bo'i dbyibs can gzhan yang rgyal ba dang byang sems kyi sku gzugs dbyibs can sogs rang byung du gnas zhes gangs dang chab rom zhib 'jug pa rnams kyis gleng bzhin mchis so/ /nga cag bod ljongs 'di ni 'dzam gling sa sgang ril bo'i steng na gangs ri ches mang zhing mkha' dbugs ches dwangs pa'i tshad du 'dzin bzhin yod pa ni smos ci dgos/spyir ma hā tsi na'i yul gru sogs yul khams 'ga' zhig

ོzo sdurdo4 nga 4gu tubardzongs ྾nga———— —— la ches snga rol nang bstan chos lugs dar khyab che zhes gleng 'dug kyang bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'di lta bu'i gzhung sde snong gsum gyi 'chad nyan dang lam bslab pa gsum/ gyi nyams len 'di 'dra ba zhig ni rgyal khab phyi nang gang du'ang med zhes mkhas pa rnams gsung gcig mgrin gcig go//khyad par du gsang ba sngags kyi skor la/ rgya yul du sngon thang rgyal rabs kyi skabs nas slob dpon klu sgrub kyi slob mar grags pa rgya'i mkhas chen ‘‘hran bos bas’ ( cho7cho)dang dge slong ‘‘po'i khong (ra 4)gzhan yang rig gnas kun la mkhas pa ‘yas shin (—2ha)sogs kyi ring la bya rgyud dang spyod rgyud sogs dar spel mdzad pa rjes sor rgya'i grub chen ‘dpas go (tsholko)dang 'jar pin gyi slob dpon ‘khong he ( ༅ )sogs kyis 'jar yin gyi sa phyogs su spel ba la rgyas ‘ dung mas ’(༅cho)zhes brjod pa de'o/ bod na gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi'i 'chad nyan zhib kyang phra la lhad med pa gangs seng dkar mo'i 'o ma lta bu dang rin thang che ba yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che lta bu sogs ci dgos lag tu 'ong ba 'di 'dra 'dzam gling na'ang dkon por gda' 'o//

— ———— —4 4ga sngaspu ཿtsoḥ 5 su ༷— r+ha / shozi — —— gzhan yang bod gangs can gyi thun mong ma/ yin pa/'i blo gros kyi rtsal las 'ong ba'i sman dpyad rig pa dang /lha ris kyi sgyu rtsal sogs gzhan la'ang ngom chos chog tu 'dug pa 'i bcu phrag rig gzhung 'di nyid ni bod gcig pu ma zad kyi deng sang 'dzam gling na yongs su grags pa'i mkhas dbang dang /tshan rig smra ba/ zhib 'jug pa sogs kyis thun mong du rang rang gi blo gros kyi rtsal yod dgu sprugs nas nyin mtshan dbyer med du dka' ba khyad du bsad ngal ba gdong gis bsu bzhin sbyang brtson byed na nga cag sha rus gcig pa/'i bod rigs spun zla rnams kyis rang nyid kyi rin thang ldan pa'i nor bu rin po che rang gi lag tu 'thob par brtson 'grus sha thang thang du 'bad kyang rigs zhes smra'o//de la rje thams cad mkhyen pas/ gzhung lugs che la lo mang sbyangs pa yi//grogs dag rang gi nor bu rin po che//dor nas gzhan kyi mching bu ma len par/ /rang la rin chen yod pa mkhyen par mdzod//zhes gsungs pa ltar legs so//rang gi mi rigs kyi 'od stong 'bar ba'i bcu phrag ris pa'i gzhung lugs dar spel mdzad pa'i 'os 'gan ni mkhas

—— ༷zo4kro rwar+sha—r+yā44༅nga—— ————pa 'ga' zhig dang rtsom pa po 'ga' zhig gi 'os 'gan tsam du ma zad kyi gangs ri'i ljongs na gnas pa'i shes ldan bod mi yongs la'ang dar spel dang srung skyob byed pa'i 'os 'gan phrag tu 'bab pas ci nas kyang brtson pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin byed par 'tshal//bdag gis de la dmigs te bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa/'i snyan ngag srol rgyun gyi nyams dang deng rabs sgyu rtsal gyi snyan tshig rig pa dang sgo bstun te bris pa dper na/ don rgyan so lnga'i dpe brjod thog ma'i blo sgo 'byed pa'i lde mig dang le'u gsum pa'i sgra rgyan skor gyi zung ldan gyi rnam bzhag bshad pa dbyangs can gzhon nu dgyes pa'i 'dzum zer sogs las rgyan gyi nyams deng rabs snyan ngag la thog mar 'jug pa'i gzhon nu rnams kyi blo kha dang bstun ci thub kyis brjod bya dang ldan zhing tshig rgyan rjod byed kyi cha nas kyang snyan ngag gi nyams sna tshogs kyi kun nas mdzes nga/ra byas yod/ lo rgyus kyi skor la yun nan sa khul gyi gnas ri khyad 'phags can spyi dang khyad par du gnas mchog ri bo bya rkang phugs kyi ngo mtshar ba'i lo rgyus kyi mthong snang cung zad brjod pa tshangs

— ———4za———༄sa4dngadapo'i rangasngadungag ——3 1—༷—ྈ——chen mes po'i zhal lung zhes bya ba las ma hā tsi na'i yul gru chen po'i lo rgyus cung zad brjod pa spyi bshad kyi tshul dang krung go'i lho nub kyi yun nan sa khul gyi lo rgyas cung zad rgyas pa rgyas bshad kyi tshul du brjod pa sogs zlorjod bya'i snying bo dang ldan zhing rjod byed tshig gi ngos gdong nas 'khyog brjod dang sgro btags/mngon brjod sogs kyis ma bcing bar so sla bar brjod yod do//krung hwa nor 'dzin dpal mo'i khyon 'dir rig gzhung dang lo rgyus kyi gzengs su mtho ba gangs can bho ṭa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i snyan ngag gi gzhung la 'jug tshul ka rtsom dang gnas bstod/ mgur glu/ rtogs brjod sogs kyis mtshon pa'i rnam grangs bdun cu lhag tsam brtsams yod pa 'dis kyang gangs can sā la'i snyan gzhung 'o ma'i chu gter mkha' la rtsen pa'i rlabs phreng dkar bo'i ngogs kyi ngang ba'i bu mo bzhin blo gros gsal zhing don gnyer ldan pa rnams kyi dga' ba'i gsos su smin pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ched du zhu dgos pa ni/ 'dir phran gyis brtsams pa'i dpe gzhung gi skor la gser lha rtse dgon gyi lha rtse skyabs
